5. 网关以 `HTTP 429` + `{"error":{"type":"GoUsageLimitError"}}` + `Retry-After` 拒绝时（Harness 归类为 `QUOTA`，**不在默认重试码里**，所以插件自己负责重发）：按 `Retry-After` 与窗口重置时刻冷却该 key，换上另一把，并在**本次请求尚未产出任何 token** 的前提下原样重发一次。已经有输出则如实报错，绝不重复生成。

多个决策（激活预热与并发请求）会串行执行，避免两份状态快照互相交叉。

## 配置

插件本体只有一行 `insert`（见 `cordis.patch.yml`），真正的配置写在你的 profile patch 层：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: opencode-go-pool
      name: 'dsh-opencode-go-pool'
- id: opencode-go-pool
  config:
    route: opencode-go                 # 要接管的 provider 路由名
    activeRef: OPENCODE_GO_ACTIVE_KEY  # 插件独占写入的凭据引用
    keys:
      - { ref: OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY, label: 订阅A }
      - { ref: OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY_B, label: 订阅B }
```

同时把该路由的 `apiKeyEnv` 改成 `activeRef`：

```yaml
- id: llm-pi-ai
  config:
    providers:
      opencode-go:
        apiKeyEnv: OPENCODE_GO_ACTIVE_KEY
        api: openai-completions
        baseURL: https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1
```

可选字段与默认值：`usageUrl`（默认上文的网关用量接口）、`usageTtlMs`（60000）、`cooldownMs`（60000，网关未给出窗口时的冷却下限）、`maxFailovers`（1，一次调用最多切换几次）。

`keys[].ref` 不能与 `activeRef` 相同，配置错误会在插件激活时直接报错并指出字段名。

## 可观察行为

日志（前缀 `opencode-go-pool:`，走 Host logger）：

1. `pooling 订阅A, 订阅B behind route "opencode-go" through OPENCODE_GO_ACTIVE_KEY` —— 装载成功。
2. `installed 订阅B as the active key` —— 首次装填或首次换 key。
3. `switched away from 订阅A (quota spent, resets …) to 订阅B` —— 请求前主动避开已用尽的 key。
4. `failover 订阅A (quota spent, resets …) -> 订阅B (until …) — Go usage limit exceeded` —— 被拒绝后切换并重发。

## 本机接入现状（desktop profile）

1. 插件源码在 `~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-opencode-go-pool`，profile 通过 `file:../../plugins/dsh-opencode-go-pool` 依赖 + `cordis.patch.yml` 里的 `insert` 行接入。
2. 凭据：`OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`（订阅 A）、`OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY_B`（订阅 B）、`OPENCODE_GO_ACTIVE_KEY`（插件独占写入的生效 key）。
3. `llm-pi-ai` 的 `opencode-go` 与 `opencode-go-responses` 两条路由都指向 `OPENCODE_GO_ACTIVE_KEY`。
4. profile 用 `nodeLinker: hoisted`，`file:` 依赖以**硬链接**落盘：改 `index.js` 立即对 profile 生效；若编辑器用「替换文件」的方式写（inode 变了），要在 profile 目录 `pnpm install` 重建链接。改动生效仍需重启桌面端。
5. 真实链路回归 overlay：`tests/e2e-overlay.yml`（用量驱动切换）、`tests/e2e-overlay-failover.yml`（429 驱动切换，把 `usageUrl` 指到不可达端口）。

## 测试

```sh
node tests/selfcheck.mjs
```

用假 context 与假用量端点跑真实插件代码，覆盖 8 组行为：满额 key 不上线、已装填健康 key 不重复写凭据、被拒绝后接管并重发、已有输出时不重发、全满额时按预算收敛、非本路由请求原样透传、配置错误报警、被拒绝那次的记账块不外泄。

## 限制

1. 只在请求发出前与**被拒绝后**判断健康度，不预测额度耗尽。
2. 只对 `route` 指定的那一条路由做逐请求决策；其它路由若也指向同一个 `activeRef`，只能继承当前生效的 key。
3. 切换属于传输层路由，不写会话事件；判定依据在 Host 日志里，不在会话记录里。

## 许可

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: DSH 备忘录插件：侧边栏快速记录 + 本地 SQLite + GitHub 私有仓库同步 + 图片截图｜Memo plugin for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-memo [中文](README.zh-CN.md) | **English** **A memo/scratchpad plugin for DeepSeek Harness** — sidebar entry with quick capture, local SQLite storage, sync to a private GitHub repository, and image/screenshot support. > Built for the moment a requirement changes mid-conversation: **capture it in seconds, find it later, keep the context, never lose it.**


Type it, press Enter — thirty seconds later it is in your private GitHub repository

| Main panel | Capturing with images | |:---:|:---:| | [![Main panel](docs/images/en/panel.png)](docs/images/en/panel.png) | [![Capturing](docs/images/en/compose.png)](docs/images/en/compose.png) | | **Search across everything** | **GitHub sync settings** | | [![Search](docs/images/en/search.png)](docs/images/en/search.png) | [![Settings](docs/images/en/settings.png)](docs/images/en/settings.png) | --- ## Features | | | |---|---| | **Sidebar entry** | Bottom-rail icon next to Settings, with an open-items badge; click to switch to the memo panel | | **Quick capture** | Always-present input at the top of the panel; `Enter` saves; the box is drag-resizable | | **Images & screenshots** | `⌘V` paste / drag-and-drop / file picker (multi-select); content-hash deduplicated, one copy per image | | **Editable** | Inline editing on the card — body and images both; tags follow the `#tags` in the body, images can be added/removed one by one | | **Tags** | Type `#anything` in the body and it is created automatically — not a fixed whitelist | | **Pinning** | Pinned notes sort first and show a pin badge plus a left accent bar on the card; the pin button lights up too | | **Drag & drop** | Hold and drag a card to reorder it within the same day group, with transition animation (inlined SortableJS) | | **Ascending / descending** | One button right of the **Pinned** chip flips the date direction: descending = today on top, ascending = oldest on top; day groups only — order inside a day never moves, and the choice is remembered locally | | **Search** | CJK-safe substring search plus `#tag` / `source:` / `after:` / `before:` / `has:image` / `is:open` qualifiers | | **Local storage** | `node:sqlite` (built into Node) — **zero external dependencies**, no native module compilation | | **GitHub sync** | Auto-pushes the text layer to a private repo (30s debounce), plus daily compact SQLite snapshots | | **No build step** | The client half is a hand-written module bundle using `React.createElement` — edit and refresh | --- ## Installation ### Requirements - DeepSeek Harness (dsh) **0.2.0-rc.2 or newer** - Its bundled Node **≥ 22.5** (the minimum for `node:sqlite`; dsh's Electron usually ships 24.x) - No third-party runtime dependencies, no `npm install` needed ### Option 1: Install from npm (recommended) ```sh dsh plugin --profile add @adamcjm/dsh-memo ``` `` is your dsh profile name (e.g. `web`, `tui`). **Restart dsh** afterwards. ### Option 2: Install from GitHub Pins to the repository's default-branch HEAD instead of a published release: ```sh dsh plugin --profile add github:adamcjm/dsh-memo ``` ### Option 3: Install for local development ```sh git clone https://github.com/adamcjm/dsh-memo.git dsh plugin --profile add link:/path/to/dsh-memo ``` With `link:` your edits are live (refresh the page for client changes; restart for host changes). ### Option 4: Manual wiring (desktop profile only) **The `desktop` profile is owned exclusively by the dsh desktop app and the CLI refuses to write to it** (it reports `profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`). Wire it manually: 1. Edit `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json`: ```jsonc { "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ // ... existing bundles ... "@adamcjm/dsh-memo" // ← add ] } }, "dependencies": { // ... "@adamcjm/dsh-memo": "^0.2.11" // ← add } } ``` 2. Install dependencies (creates the symlink): ```sh cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop pnpm install ``` 3. **Restart DeepSeek Harness.** ### Verifying the install ```sh dsh --profile --dump-config | grep -A3 "id: memo" ``` Or just look at the UI: a **Memo** icon should appear at the bottom of the sidebar. --- ## Usage ### Capturing a note Open the **Memo** icon at the bottom of the sidebar and type into the input at the top, then press `Enter`: ``` Mr. Zhang wants a WeChat QR login entry on the login page; prototype due next Wednesday #requirement-change #login ``` `#requirement-change` and `#login` become tags automatically, and the tag markers are stripped from the body. ### Editing a note Hover a row and click **Edit** (the pencil); the row expands **in place** into an editor: - Change the body directly. The `#tags` in the body become the note's tags (remove a `#tag` from the body and the tag is removed too) - Opening the editor merges the note's existing tags back into the body as `#tags` — visible, and saved back as-is - Images can be removed one by one (the × on the thumbnail) or added at any time (paste / drag / multi-select) - `⌘Enter` saves, `Esc` cancels Saving regenerates the `.md` source of truth, bumps `rev`, and syncs to GitHub within 30 seconds. ### Reordering **Date dimension: ascending / descending** One button sits to the right of the **Pinned** filter chip; it shows only the current direction — click it to flip: - **Descending** (default): today on top, older as you go down - **Ascending**: the oldest date on top, closer to today as you go down - It only changes the **order of the day groups** — the order inside a single day is left untouched (that one is yours, from dragging) - The choice is remembered locally (`localStorage`), so it survives reopening the panel **Within one day: drag & drop** Within one day group, hold a card and drag it to change the order: - The new order saves on drop and is written to the `.md` source of truth as `order:`, so it survives syncing to another machine - **You cannot drag across day groups** (a "today" card will not drop into "yesterday"); use **Pinning** to lift something across days - Order is decided only by dragging and pinning: marking done / undone or editing the body no longer bounces an item to the top ### Adding images / screenshots Three ways, freely mixable and repeatable: - **Paste** — take a screenshot, then press `⌘V` in the input - **Drag** — drag images straight from Finder onto the input - **Pick** — click the "Image" button; hold `⌘` / `⇧` in the file dialog for multi-select Images are named by SHA-256 and stored in `attachments/`, so **pasting the same image twice costs one copy**. Click a thumbnail to view it full size. ### Tags Tags are **not fixed**. The defaults (`#requirement-change` `#todo` `#follow-up` `#idea` `#meeting`) are just starting suggestions: - Type `#customer-A` or `#MrZhang` in the body and save → the tag is created and attached to that note - Anywhere works: start, middle or end of the body (`buy milk#groceries`, `meeting,#work` also count); a tag name ends at whitespace or punctuation - The tag area is sorted by usage; click one to filter - A tag that no note uses anymore disappears on its own ### Search Use the search box in the panel header and press `Enter`. Qualifiers combine: | Syntax | Meaning | |---|---| | `scan` | Body or source contains the string (works for short CJK queries too) | | `#requirement-change` | By tag | | `source:MrZhang` | By origin | | `after:2026-10-01` `before:2026-10-08` | By date range | | `has:image` | Only notes with attachments | | `is:open` `is:done` | Only open / only completed | ### Keyboard shortcuts | Key | Action | |---|---| | `Enter` | Save the current input | | `⇧Enter` | Newline inside the input | | `⌘V` | Paste an image from the clipboard | | `Esc` | Close an overlay (settings / image zoom) | ### Syncing to GitHub 1. plugins.description: Deepseek Harness 敏感字符自动替换插件，用于替换模型读取的敏感字符从而避免官方 API 400 错误。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-sensitive-replace

敏感字符自动替换插件（v0.7.0）：按**用户自行维护的屏蔽表文档**，在**内容进入会话上下文之前**、以及**请求出网之前**两个关口把命中字符替换为占位符，
从源头规避 DeepSeek 官方 API 的 `Content Exists Risk` 400（根因：特定字符如部分 emoji 码位组合单独出现即命中官方审核）。
真出了 400 也能自动加硬清洗并重试，**对话与上下文保持连续**。
替换是**单向且不可逆**的（详见[能力与边界](#能力与边界务必读)）；屏蔽表写错的形态会在加载期明确告警，不再静默失效。

本包是一个 **DSH Profile Bundle**（`package.json` 里声明 `dsh.bundle.patch`），装进 profile 即自动挂载，不需要手写组合行。

**同类项目**：生态里已有 [dsh-text-guard](https://github.com/7771sd/dsh-text-guard) 等同类插件，差异见[与同类插件的关系](#与同类插件的关系)。

---

## 安装

前置：DSH（`dsh` CLI 在 PATH 上）、profile 名（默认 `web`）。

### 方式一：从 npm / tarball 装（推荐）

```bash
# 已发布到 registry 时
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-sensitive-replace

# 用本地构建产物 / tarball
dsh plugin --profile web add /abs/path/dsh-sensitive-replace-0.7.0.tgz
```

`dsh plugin` 本质是在 profile 目录里跑 pnpm，并在装完后把「声明了 `dsh.bundle` 的依赖」自动并入 `dsh.profile.bundles` 层栈。
本包声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch`，所以它自带的 `cordis.patch.yml` 会在下次启动 profile 时被组合进去，**无需手写插件行**。

装完重启该 profile（`dsh web` 的 profile 若开着 `patchReload: live`，改 patch 层可热生效；新增依赖仍建议重启一次）。

### 方式二：作为普通 npm 依赖 + 手写一行

不想用 bundle 机制时：

```bash
npm install /abs/path/dsh-sensitive-replace-0.7.0.tgz     # 或放进 profile 的依赖里
```

然后在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（用户 patch 层）里加一行：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: sensitive-replace
      name: 'dsh-sensitive-replace'
```

### 之后：准备屏蔽表

把 `samples/sensitive-blocklist.example.yaml` 复制为 `$DSH_HOME/sensitive-blocklist.yaml`
（`$DSH_HOME` 默认 `~/.dsh`；Windows 上是 `%DSH_HOME%`，默认 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh`；可用 config `blocklistPath` 覆盖）。

**保存即生效**：屏蔽表按文件 mtime 热重载，增删词无需重启。

### 配置覆盖

按行 id 覆盖（用户 patch 层在 bundle 层之后，后者生效）：

```yaml
- id: sensitive-replace
  config:
    enabled: true
    autoReplace: true
    detectUnfiltered: true
    blocklistPath: /abs/path/to/sensitive-blocklist.yaml
    replaceWith: '[BLOCKED]'
```

---

## 它到底在哪儿替换（三道关口）

DSH 里发往模型的请求是**深冻结**的：`dsh-llm` 的消息工厂 `createMessage → freezeMessage → deepFreeze(structuredClone(...))`，
`dsh-agent-loop` 构请求时还会对每条消息 `deepFreeze()` 并 `Object.freeze(boundaryMessages)`。
所以在 `llm/stream` 瀑布里**原地改写** `options.messages` 会抛 `TypeError`（严格模式）——v0.4.0 正是踩在这里：
异常被 catch 掉后照常出网，自动面静默空转。**但改成"拷贝一份再发"就完全可行**，这正是 v0.5.0 的第一道关口。

| # | 关口 | 钩子 | 覆盖 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 进上下文（消息） | `agent/pre-step` | 用户输入、steering、插件形成的进入步骤的消息 → 返回 `{ kind:'enter', messages: 替换后的消息 }`（**保留消息 id**，不原地改写） |
| 2 | 进上下文（工具结果） | `tools/post-execute` | 网页抓取/搜索、读文件、命令输出等外部文本（含 `tool-result` 嵌套块）→ 返回 `{ kind:'accept', content: 替换后的块 }` |
| 3 | **出网前（整份请求）** | `llm/stream` | **历史消息 + 模型自己写过的内容 + tool-call 参数 + system**：深拷贝整份请求、替换命中内容后直接续到适配器边界 |

前两道关口发生在**写入会话日志之前**，所以替换结果持久生效。但"已经躺在日志里"的内容（本次会话早先读进来的、
模型自己写出来的、tool-call 参数）前两道关口碰不到——请求是从日志派生的，它们照样出网。第三道关口补上这个洞：

```text
llm/stream(options, next)
  ├─ 命中规则 → scrubRequest(options) 深拷贝清洗
  │            → llm.adapterStream(clean, undefined)   // 直接续链，不重进瀑布
  └─ 未命中   → next()                                  // 原样放行
```

不重进瀑布是有意的：其它 `llm/stream` 监听器（会话标题观察、检查点 flush）不会被同一次调用重复触发。
若 `adapterStream` 不存在则退回公开的 `llm.stream(clean)`，并用 WeakSet 防止递归。

### 400 自动恢复（`recoverOn400`）

万一还是 400（例如内容里有你**还没写进屏蔽表**的字符），插件在 `agent/request-error` 里接管：

1. 判定 `failure.status === 400`（或 `code === 'INVALID_REQUEST'`，DeepSeek 适配器就是这么映射的）；
2. 开启**加硬清洗**：在规则之外额外剥离 emoji / 旗帜 / 杂项符号一类码位（`[\u{1F000}-\u{1FAFF}]` 等），持续 `aggressiveMs`；
3. 返回 `{ kind:'retry' }` —— 循环重试时会**重新从会话日志派生请求**，于是这一次就能发出去，**对话与上下文保持连续，不用新建会话**。

窗口内重试次数由 `maxRecoveries` 封顶（默认 2 次 / 10 分钟），避免 400 循环；到顶后照常失败并提示"把触发内容加进屏蔽表"。

> 加硬清洗也可以在没出事时常开：`aggressive: true`（偏执模式）。

### 路由（provider/model）怎么来的

`agent/pre-step` / `tools/post-execute` 的载荷里没有 provider/model，而规则是分 Provider ID / 模型的。
插件监听 `agent/request` 瀑布，按 agent 记住最近一次解析出的 `provider`/`model`，供清洗时套用专属规则；
会话退场（`agent/disposed`）时清掉缓存。

**边界**：会话第一次请求之前路由还没解析出来，此时只套 `global` 规则；第一次请求之后，该会话的专属规则就都能用上。
出网前那一道直接用请求自带（且最准）的 `options.provider` / `options.model`，不受这个限制。

---

## 能力与边界（务必读）

**会被替换的**（命中屏蔽表即换，三道关口合计覆盖）：

- 用户/插件发来的**新**消息（`agent/pre-step`，进日志前）；
- 所有**工具结果**文本（`tools/post-execute`，进日志前）；
- **出网前的整份请求**（`llm/stream` 深拷贝清洗）：历史消息、模型自己写过的 text/reasoning、`tool-call` 参数、system —— 包括**装插件之前就已经躺在日志里**的内容。

**仍然不会替换的**：

- `tool-call` 参数里的替换是**文本级**的：它保持 JSON 合法，但如果某个规则正好匹配到 JSON 结构字符（比如规则里写了 `"command"`），替换后语义仍合法、只是工具可能收到不同参数 —— 规则尽量写"内容词"，别写结构词；
- 图片/文件附件（二进制，不参与文本替换）；
- 命中内容如果**不在**屏蔽表里，就不会被替换 —— 这是 400 的来源。此时 `recoverOn400` 会兜底（加硬清洗 + 重试），但它只剥离 emoji/符号一类码位；治本还是把词加进屏蔽表。

**替换是单向的，插件不提供还原**（挂之前先想清楚）：

- 关口 1/2 的替换发生在内容**写入会话日志之前**，所以日志里存下来的就是占位符；原文只存在于你的原始输入或外部数据源里，插件不会再写回去。
- 关口 3 只替换**发往 provider 的那一份副本**，会话日志保持原文（这是有意的，见[安全约定](#安全约定)）。因此同一个会话里，你看到的可能是原文、模型看到的是占位符 —— 两边**故意不一致**。
- 平台目前没有给插件「执行前改写 tool-call 参数」或「展示前改写助手文本」的合法挂点（`PreToolDecision` 只有 `allow` / `deny` / `cancel` / `ask`，不含改参；会话事件 append-only 且深冻结），所以占位符一旦落进日志或工具参数，就会**原样执行、原样展示**。
- 需要事后对回原文时，用 `replaceWith: '[BLOCKED:{n}]'` + 工具返回的 `hits` 明细，按屏蔽表当前文件**人工**对照；插件不会自动还原。

诊断：`sensitive_replace_status` 工具（只读）给出规则数、各关口清洗次数、最近一次出网前替换处数、是否处于加硬清洗、400 自动恢复次数，
以及**每条规则的命中次数**（只给编号 / 位置 / 次数 / 距今秒数，不含规则文本：编号规则见[形态](#形态)）和**屏蔽表形态警告明细**。

---

## 与同类插件的关系

解决同一个 400 的插件不止一个，最接近的是 [dsh-text-guard](https://github.com/7771sd/dsh-text-guard)（作者 7771sd，MIT）。
两者思路一致（都在内容进日志前中和），差别在覆盖面与运维方式：

| 能力 | 本插件 | dsh-text-guard |
|---|---|---|
| 进日志前中和（`agent/pre-step` / `tools/post-execute`） | ✅ | ✅ |
| `run_code` 子分发日志副本（`tools/ptc-dispatch-log`） | 不需单独挂（子分发结果写该日志前已经过 `tools/post-execute`，见下） | ✅ 另挂一道 |
| **出网前整份请求清洗**（`llm/stream`）：历史消息、模型自己写过的内容、tool-call 参数、**system prompt** | ✅ | ❌（其 README 把"system prompt 里的文本"列为已知盲区） |
| **400 自动恢复**（加硬清洗 + 同会话 retry） | ✅ | ❌ |
| 目标形态 | 用户维护的 YAML 屏蔽表（字形 / `\u{XXXX}` / `re:` 正则），global → Provider ID → 模型三级链 | 配置里的码位序列（`regional-pairs` 或 `exact`） |
| 改配置后 | 保存即生效（按 mtime 热重载） | 需重新挂载 bundle |
| 诊断面 | `sensitive_replace_status`（计数 + 每条规则命中 + 形态警告）、`replace_sensitive`（手动清洗任意文本） | 无 |

**关于 `tools/ptc-dispatch-log`**：本插件没有单独挂它，因为 `run_code` 的子分发结果是**先过 `tools/post-execute`、再写日志**的 ——
`dsh-tools` 的 `commit()` 先 `scheduler.finalize()`（= 跑 post-execute）拿到结果，之后 `settle()` 才用这份结果写 `tool/ptc-dispatch` 事件，
所以子分发内容不会绕过第二道关口。要自行核对，看 `dsh-tools/lib/index.js` 里的 `finalizeScheduledExecution` 与 `shapeDispatchLog` 两条路径即可。

一句话选型：只要**码位级、零配置**的方案（专治 emoji/旗帜一类码位）用 dsh-text-guard 更轻；
要**出网前兜底（含历史内容与 system prompt）+ 400 自动恢复 + 可热改的屏蔽表**就用本插件。
两者同时挂不冲突（规则各自独立），但没必要 —— 本插件覆盖了它除那道冗余挂点之外的全部能力。

生态里还有一批**目标不同**的插件：PII / 凭据脱敏（`dsh-privmask`、`dsh-privacy-protector`）、
屏蔽文件读取（[Yazzyk/dsh-file-shield](https://github.com/Yazzyk/dsh-file-shield)）、隐私掩码（[Huauauaa/dsh-privacy-mask](https://github.com/Huauauaa/dsh-privacy-mask)）等 ——
它们回答的是"不想让模型看到什么"，本插件回答的是"什么会让官方 API 400"。

---

## 形态

不是插件内置默认目标，而是**用户维护一份 YAML 屏蔽表**，按「全局 / Provider ID / 模型」分类，手动填入需要屏蔽的字符或短语（字形、`\u{XXXX}` 码位、正则均可）。

- 默认文档：`$DSH_HOME/sensitive-blocklist.yaml`（可用 config `blocklistPath` 覆盖）
- 结构：
  - `global:` —— 对所有 Provider ID 生效的字符列表（最通用）
  - `providers:` 下按 Provider ID 分键 —— 键 = **DSH 的 provider 路由 id**（即请求 `options.provider`，如 `deepseek-official`）
- **保存即生效**：按文件 mtime 热重载，增删屏蔽项无需重启

```yaml
# 敏感字符屏蔽表（支持注释）
global:
  - '\u{1F600}'             # 对任何 Provider ID 生效（emoji 码位举例）
providers:
  deepseek-official: []     # 仅对 DeepSeek 官方生效（Provider ID 精确匹配）
```

### 匹配模式（按 Provider ID / 模型，三级链）

`providers.<键>` 的键对应当前请求的 `options.provider` —— 这是 **DSH 的 provider 路由 id**（设置页 / `settings.yaml` 里每个 provider 配置的 id），**不是显示名、也不是厂商名**。
按「来源名」猜键名（`deepseek` 对不上真实 id `deepseek-official`）会导致专属规则**静默空转**。

三级匹配链（从宽到窄，同时生效叠加）：

1. `global` —— 对任何 Provider ID 生效；
2. `providers.<id>` —— Provider ID 匹配：精确键优先，键尾带 `*` 为前缀模式（一族 id 共用，多命中取最长前缀）；值可为数组（简单）或对象 `{ '_': 基础, models: 按模型 }`；
3. `providers.<id>.models.<model>` —— 再按模型细分（`options.model`），模型键精确优先，键尾 `*` 为前缀模式。

```yaml
providers:
  deepseek-official:
    _:
      - '示例词A'                    # 该 Provider 所有模型的基础规则（对象形态的基础规则放 `_`）
    models:
      'deepseek-flash': [ ... ]      # 精确键：本机真实 model id，只对该模型生效
      'deepseek-*': [ ... ]          # 前缀模式：一族模型共用（多命中取最长前缀）
  'deepseek*': [ ... ]               # 前缀模式：一族 Provider 共用（此处为举例）
```

> ⚠ **这页最容易写错的三种写法**（都真实踩过，注意对照）：
>
> 1. **数组形态里再缩进写 `models:`** —— YAML 直接报错 `bad indentation`（序列里不能放映射键）。只有基础规则时用数组 `deepseek-official: [ '词A' ]`；要按模型细分就必须改成对象形态、基础规则放 `_` 下（如上例）。
> 2. **`models:` 与 `deepseek-official:` 同级** —— 会被解析成**另一个 provid

plugins.description: Pixel-level screenshot diff for DeepSeek Harness: two local PNGs in, a PIXEL_CHANGED verdict, difference regions and a self-contained HTML comparison page out. Zero dependencies, fully local.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-vision-diff

两张截图进去，出来一句机器可读的结论和一张能给人看的对照页：**同一屏两次渲染到底变没变、变在哪。**

Pixel-level screenshot diff for DeepSeek Harness. Two local PNGs in; a
`PIXEL_CHANGED=true|false` verdict, difference regions and a self-contained HTML
comparison page out. Everything runs locally — no model call, no network, no
upload.

## 它解决什么

截图类插件已经会「看懂内容」：识图、OCR、元素定位、多模态问答。但视觉回归最刚需的那一步没人做——**回答「这两张图一样吗」**，而且要能用脚本判断，不是让人再看一眼。

所以这个插件的输出以一行字符串开头：

```
PIXEL_CHANGED=false
```

一致就是 `false`，不一致就是 `true`。`grep` 一下就能当断言用，后面才是差异比例、差异区域、证据数字和对照页。

**它不做内容识别。** 它不做「这个按钮是什么」这种判断。它只回答变化，因为那一步是可以做成确定性的，而"看懂"那一步不行。

## 装

```sh
# npm 版 CLI 管理的 profile
dsh plugin --profile <name> add <插件目录>

# 桌面版：desktop profile 由 Electron app 独占，npm 版 CLI 会被拒绝——
#   error: profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application
# 用它自带的那个 CLI 才行（在 app 的 resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh 下）：
"<app>/resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" plugin --profile desktop add <插件目录>
```

装完重启一次 app（host 半区的改动必须重启进程才会加载；Node 按 URL 缓存 ES 模块，关开插件换不掉已经加载的代码）。重启后对话视图里会出现「视觉差异」Tab，agent 也多了一个 `vision_diff` 工具。

## 用

### 让 agent 调

```
vision_diff(before: "shots/home-dark.png", after: "shots/home-light.png")
```

### 命令行直接看产物

每次比对会在 `$DSH_HOME/vision-diff/runs/<id>/` 留一份完整证据，双击 `index.html` 就能看，不需要服务器。

### 参数

| 参数 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `before` | ✅ | 第一张 PNG 的路径（绝对路径，或相对 `cwd`） |
| `after` | ✅ | 第二张 PNG 的路径 |
| `ignore` | | 忽略区，见下 |
| `threshold` | | 通道差必须**大于**它才算变化。默认 `0`。截图有压缩噪声时用 `2~8` |
| `blockSize` | | 判断两个差异像素是否**相连**的粒度，默认 `16`。只影响区域如何分块，**不影响区域边界** |
| `regionLimit` | | 最多返回几个差异区域，默认 `20`，按差异像素数从大到小取 |
| `cwd` | | 解析相对路径用的目录。不填则用插件配置的工作目录 |
| `label` | | 这次比对的说明，会写进报告和对照页 |

### 忽略区

每次都会变的部分——时钟、光标、随机广告、动画帧——用忽略区排除掉，否则日报式的比对会天天报"有变化"。

以下写法都接受：

```json
{ "x": 0, "y": 0, "w": 100, "h": 40 }
{ "x1": 0, "y1": 0, "x2": 100, "y2": 40 }
{ "left": 0, "top": 0, "right": 100, "bottom": 40 }
[0, 0, 100, 40]
{ "regions": [ { "x": 0, "y": 0, "w": 100, "h": 40 } ] }
{ "x": 0, "y": 0, "w": 0.1, "h": 0.05, "unit": "fraction" }
```

`unit: "fraction"` 时按图片宽高的比例解释，所以同一份配置能跨分辨率复用。

宽度或高度取负值表示反方向（人拖框拖反了就是这么写的）。超出图像的部分会被裁剪而不是报错。

**解析不了的忽略区不会被静默忽略**——它进 `ignoreRejected`，并在结论、对照页和 Tab 上都标出来，因为一个失效的忽略区会让差异数字虚高，看起来像被测页面出了问题。

## 输出

```json
{
  "pixelChanged": true,
  "verdict": "PIXEL_CHANGED=true",
  "width": 1920, "height": 1080,
  "afterWidth": 1920, "afterHeight": 1080,
  "dimensionChanged": false,
  "totalPixels": 2073600,
  "comparedPixels": 2073600,
  "ignoredPixels": 0,
  "diffPixels": 1483,
  "diffPercent": 0.071527,
  "maxChannelDelta": 255,
  "meanAbsError": 0.4123,
  "boundingBox": { "x": 240, "y": 96, "w": 120, "h": 18 },
  "regions": [ { "x": 240, "y": 96, "w": 120, "h": 18, "pixels": 1483, "blocks": 9 } ],
  "regionsTruncated": false,
  "threshold": 0,
  "blockSize": 16,
  "ignore": [],
  "ignoreRejected": []
}
```

几个刻意的取舍：

- **`diffPercent` 保留 6 位小数。** 1920×1080 里一个像素是 0.0000482%，四舍五入到两位就成了 `0.00`，紧挨着 `diffPixels: 1` 读起来像"没变化"。
- **比对范围是 before 的完整面积。** 尺寸不一样时，没有对应像素的部分**计为已变化**，同时 `dimensionChanged` 置真。反过来——只比重叠区——会让"侧边栏没了"这种渲染事故报出 `PIXEL_CHANGED=false`。
- **`regions` 的边界是精确像素包围盒。** 网格只用来判断连通性（一个视觉变化算一个区域），不用来决定矩形——否则一个像素的变化会被描述成 16×16 的"区域"。
- **`meanAbsError` 是每通道平均绝对误差。** 四个通道都计入。用"每像素最大通道差"去平均会让单通道的变化显得大四倍。

## 支持的图片

刻意划定的范围，而不是碰巧能跑：**非交错**的 PNG，颜色类型 0/2/3/4/6（灰度、RGB、调色板、灰度+alpha、RGBA），位深 8 或 16（16 位取高字节）。

**不支持的会明确报出来，不会近似解码**：

- Adam7 交错 → 报错并提示另存为非交错
- 位深 1/2/4（每字节多像素）→ 报错并提示另存为 8 位
- 非 PNG 文件 → 报错说明文件头不匹配
- CRC 校验失败 → 报错说明文件已损坏

这一条比看上去重要：**这个插件的全部价值就是它的数字可信**，所以一个把不支持的布局猜着解出来、给出一个看似合理但错误的像素数的解码器，比一个直接拒绝的解码器糟得多。

## 隐私与成本

**全部本地。** 不调用模型、不联网、不上传图片。截图里可能是别人的私有页面、客户后台、未发布的产品——这也是它做成插件而不是服务的理由。

**零依赖。** host 半区只 import `node:` 内置模块和同目录兄弟模块。PNG 编解码是自己写的（`src/png.js`），因为它必须存在，而引一个解码器库就破坏了这条铁律。

## 数据落在哪

| 路径 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| `$DSH_HOME/vision-diff/runs/<id>/index.html` | 自包含对照页，可归档、可转发 |
| `$DSH_HOME/vision-diff/runs/<id>/report.json` | 原始结论 |
| `$DSH_HOME/vision-diff/runs/<id>/diff.png` | 差异图：红色=变化，蓝色=已忽略 |
| `$DSH_HOME/vision-diff/runs/<id>/before.png`、`after.png` | 输入副本（`keepInputs: false` 可不留） |
| `$DSH_HOME/vision-diff/state.json` | 历史索引与最近一次结论 |

HTTP 面（挂在 `webServer` 的 `/dsh-vision-diff` 前缀下）：

```
GET  /dsh-vision-diff                      统计、最近一次、历史、配置
GET  /dsh-vision-diff/view/<id>            自包含对照页
GET  /dsh-vision-diff/asset/<id>/<file>    原始 PNG
POST /dsh-vision-diff/clear                清空历史索引
```

## 容错姿态

这个插件任何一处坏掉都不该拖垮 harness，所以：

- **读文件优先走 `ctx.fs`**，让读取经过 harness 自己的文件系统抽象、遵守它的策略。只有宿主根本没有 fs 服务时才退回 `node:fs`——**出错不会静默退回**，因为那等于绕过一个安全边界。
- **像素上限**取 `ctx.attachments.imageLimits.maxImagePixels`（宿主给的话）与配置的较小值。超限的图**在解码前就被拒绝**，不是解完再发现占了 4GB。
- **`webServer.register` 失败只是没有对照页和 Tab**，`vision_diff` 工具照常工作——一个变了形状的 web 契约不该让用户连比对都做不了。
- **落盘是尽力而为**：state.json 写不进去不影响这次比对的结果。
- **历史滚动**：超出 `historyKeep`（默认 30）的旧记录，连同它的产物目录一起清掉，不会无声堆积。
- **每次注册都可撤销**（`ctx.effect`），因为 dsh 能在运行期卸载插件。

## 配置

`apply(ctx, config)` 的 config 全部可覆盖：

| key | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dataDir` | `$DSH_HOME/vision-diff` | 产物与索引落在哪 |
| `baseDir` | `process.cwd()` | 解析相对路径的基准目录 |
| `maxBytes` | `64 MB` | 单个输入文件上限 |
| `maxPixels` | `4000 万`（取与宿主图像策略的较小值） | 单张图上限 |
| `threshold` / `blockSize` / `regionLimit` | `0` / `16` / `20` | 这三个的默认值，可被单次调用覆盖 |
| `historyKeep` | `30` | 保留多少次记录 |
| `keepInputs` | `true` | 是否在产物目录里留下输入副本（对照页永远内含两边，不受此项影响） |

## 开发

```sh
node --test          # 60 个测试
node scripts/build.mjs
```

**测试用的 PNG 是手工构造的，不是编码器自己产出的。** `encodePng` 只写 filter 0，所以"编码再解码"这种往返测试**永远测不到 filter 1–4**。测试里有一份独立的 PNG 构造器（自己的分块、自己的 CRC32、自己的正向 filter），解码器的所有滤镜都是对着这份独立实现验证的。

`test/host.test.mjs` 用桩 Context 驱动真实的 `apply()`：真的把文件写进临时目录、真的走工具执行路径、真的调 HTTP handler，不是这些逻辑的复刻。

## 和现有实现的关系

**没有参考任何现有实现的代码。** 这条设想的证据来源是 `ankye/dsh-client-vision`——它做的是内容识别（识图、多模态问答），回答的是"这屏是什么"；本插件回答的是"这两屏一样吗"。两者不重叠，我也没有去看它的实现。

- PNG 编解码是按 PNG 规范手写的（`node:zlib` 提供 DEFLATE，其余是分块解析、五种行过滤器、CRC32）。
- 差异算法是自己写的逐像素比较 + 连通块聚类，没有用 pixelmatch 之类的库——引依赖会破坏零依赖构建。
- 工程骨架（零依赖构建、host/client 双半区、cordis.patch.yml、README、测试）沿用 `dsh-warden` 的既有结构，那是同一个作者自己的脚手架。

本插件是独立仓库，不是任何仓库的 fork。

## License

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-vibe-coding-prd

**把一个说不清需求的人，通过一问一答，带到一份 AI 能直接照着开工的 PRD。**

![许可](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)
![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-%3E%3D0.1.0-1f6feb.svg)

---

## 它解决什么问题

用 AI 写东西的人，真正的瓶颈很少是"AI 不会写代码"，而是**需求说不清**：

- 对着空白 PRD 模板，写不出第一行；
- 被问"你想要什么"就卡住，只能说"就那种…你懂的"；
- AI 一听需求就冲去写代码，方向跑偏，返工三遍；
- 聊了两个小时，最后什么都没落下来。

这个项目把流程反过来了：**让 AI 来问，你只负责回答**。一次只问一件事，在你判断不了的地方给选项和推荐，
问完把成果落盘成 `docs/prd.md` 和 `docs/项目说明书.md` —— 一份能直接拿去开工的文档。

它由七个工具 + 一份访谈行为规范组成：工具管状态和门禁，规范管"怎么问才像产品顾问"。
**该强制的地方写进代码，而不是写在提示词里靠模型自觉。**

---

## 为什么要做成插件（而不是一段提示词）

一段"访谈剧本"提示词也能用，但四个地方一定会失控，插件把它们变成硬约束：

| 容易失控的地方 | 提示词方案 | 本插件 |
|----------------|-----------|--------|
| 步骤顺序与门禁 | 靠模型自觉遵守 | 引擎强制：退出条件不满足就停在本步，返回缺口清单 |
| 跨会话续接 | 靠模型每次重读文档 | 账本 + 状态文件，`interview_start` 一次调用恢复 |
| 跳步 | 靠模型记得留痕 | 必经步骤直接拒绝跳过，可选步骤理由自动写进账本 |
| 验收标准质量 | 靠模型自律 | 空话黑名单 + 可观察性检查，不合格过不了门 |
| 出口门自检 | 靠模型自查清单 | 11 条机器校验，**有一条没过就不写任何文件** |
| 产物结构 | 模型自己组织文档 | 按固定结构渲染，无占位符残留 |
| 账本归属 | 靠模型记得传对目录 | 目录不可信就拒绝执行；账本记工作目录，不一致不续接 |
| 单次参数体积 | 靠模型自己拿捏 | 生成分步提交计划，一批一落盘，超限给提醒 |

## 安装

### 方式一：本机路径安装

在 Harness 会话里让 agent 执行，`target` 填插件的**绝对路径**：

```
plugin_manager  action=install_bundle  target=<本仓库>/packages/dsh-vibe-coding-prd
```

成功后 profile 的 `package.json` 会多出该依赖，补丁层插入 `vibe-coding-prd` 一行。
**装完需要重启 Harness 宿主**——DSH 把模块代次缓存在进程里，热切换不会加载新的 `index.js`。

### 方式二：从 GitHub 安装

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:<你的用户名>/dsh-vibe-coding-prd#path:packages/dsh-vibe-coding-prd
```

`#path:` 后缀指向仓库里的子目录（pnpm 的子目录依赖语法）。

### 方式三：从 npm 安装

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-vibe-coding-prd
```

### 装完怎么确认生效

在会话里问一句"我们走到哪了"，如果 agent 能调用 `interview_status`，说明七个工具已经注册。
也可以让 agent 跑 `cordis_inspect_query`（`Tool.listTools`）核对工具名。

## 跑一遍看看

对 agent 说：

> 我想做个 XX，但不知道怎么跟 AI 说

然后它会走完这套流程（工具名 → 实际动作）：

```
interview_start      读账本（或新建）→ "我们现在在 S1.0，第一个问题……"
interview_next       取当前这一问的提问稿：问什么、给用户哪些选项、退出条件是什么
（模型把问题发给你 —— 选项会渲染成可点按钮）
interview_advance    记答案并过门；一次只交 1-3 个字段，缺东西就返回缺口清单 + 下一批交什么
… 重复 10 步 …
interview_finalize   出口门自检 → 全过 → 落盘 prd.md / 项目说明书.md
```

**你会拿到什么**（工作目录下）：

| 文件 | 内容 |
|------|------|
| `docs/prd.md` | 产品结论、目标用户、★形态与资源约束、信息架构、边界情况、验收标准、MVP 定义、以后再说 |
| `docs/项目说明书.md` | 一句话、四要素需求基准描述、选定技术栈、验收清单、决策复盘案例库入口 |
| `docs/进度账本.md` | 十步走到哪、跳步留痕、阻塞项（插件自动维护，不用手改） |
| `docs/开发文档.md` | 可选：传 `includeDevDoc: true` 时产出 |

顺带一提：本仓库的 [`docs/`](docs/) 里就有一份真实产物——"机器学习讲解网站"的 PRD，
走完全部十步、出口门通过后落盘的。可以直接拿来对照产出长什么样。

## 七个工具

| 工具 | 作用 | 关键返回 |
|------|------|---------|
| `interview_start` | 开场 / 续接：读账本恢复进度，不存在就初始化到 S1.0；项目目录不确定或账本属于别处时拒绝执行 | `resumed`、`step`、`mode`、`project`、`missingRequired` |
| `interview_next` | 取当前这一问：提问稿、给用户的选项、退出条件、已收字段、分步提交计划 | `ask`、`fields`、`options`、`exitCondition`、`submissionPlan` |
| `interview_advance` | 记答案并判断退出条件；**一次只交 1-3 个字段**，每批立即落盘 | `advanced`、`gaps`、`stillMissing`、`oversized`、`next` |
| `interview_skip` | 跳过可选步骤并留痕；必经步骤一律拒绝 | `skipped`、`reason` |
| `interview_finalize` | 出口门自检 + 落盘两份（或三份）文档；`terms` 可加英文自检白名单 | `written`、`checks`、`blocking`、`files` |
| `interview_status` | 只读查看进度、跳步留痕、阻塞项、目录归属异常 | 全量步骤状态 |
| `interview_ask` | 直接把当前这一问弹给你并等回答（选项渲染成按钮） | `answer` |

七个工具的 `parameters` 都是标准 JSON Schema，返回值都是 JSON，`output.render` 给出一行中文摘要。

## 两条 v0.2 的硬规矩（都是踩过坑补的）

**一、分步提交：一次只交 1-3 个字段。** 工具参数由模型流式拼出来，参数越长、嵌套越深，
越容易在拼装环节产出非法 JSON——harness 判定 `MALFORMED_RESPONSE` 就中止整轮，之前做完的步骤全部作废
（真实案例：一轮 45 步、89 次工具调用，废在最后一个"11 条中文长句 + 深嵌套对象"的参数上）。
所以 `interview_next` 会给一份 `submissionPlan` 把字段切成小批，`interview_advance` 每收一批立即落盘；
一次交多了不拒收（答案绝不丢），但会带 `oversized` 警告告诉模型下一步怎么拆。
模型若中途断了，上一批的进度已经在 `docs/` 里，补一句"请继续"就能接上。

**二、账本不串项目。** 项目目录只认显式 `workspace` 或**会话工作目录**：
拿不到就拒绝执行，**不再回落到宿主进程的当前目录**（那可能是 profile 目录，里面躺着别的项目的账本）。
账本头部与状态文件都记下工作目录，加载时比对；不一致就不续接、不写文件，只报告"发现历史账本在别处"，
并给出两条路：`adoptWorkspace: true`（目录确实搬了家）或换对的 `workspace` / `reset: true`。

## 十步门禁

| 步骤 | 必经? | 退出条件 |
|------|-------|---------|
| S1.0 破冰 | ✅ | 一句话描述 + 谁用 |
| S1.1 分诊定深度 | ✅ | 判定轻 / 重并写入账本 |
| S1.2 资源现实盘点 | ✅ | 现有资源清单已回填 |
| S1.3 ★ 定形态：它活在哪 | ✅ | 四个形态里选定一项 |
| S1.4 补全需求 | ✅ | 数据旅程扫过，每个缺口都有"怎么办" |
| S1.5 信息架构 | 可选 | UI 类产品才需要，否则跳步留痕 |
| S1.6 边界与禁区 | ✅ | 明确不做 ≥ 1 条 + 合规红线已问 |
| S1.7 验收 + MVP | ✅ | ≥ 1 条可验证验收（EARS 优先）+ MVP 线已定 |
| S1.8 技术栈雏形 | 可选 | 同时写明"选定"与"否决" |
| S1.9 落盘 | ✅ | 两份文档已写 |

三条硬规矩：

1. **一步没过，不进下一步。** `interview_advance` 返回 `advanced: false` 时，模型必须补问缺口。
2. **必经步骤不能跳。** `interview_skip` 会拒绝，并告诉你必须问出什么。
3. **出口门不分轻重模式。** 轻模式省的是停顿次数，不是产出质量。

---

## 出口门

`interview_finalize` 逐条机器校验，**只要有一条 error 未过就一个文件都不写**：

- [ ] 必经步骤全部 ✅、跳过的可选步骤有留痕
- [ ] PRD 元信息（文档状态 / 版本 / 产品名称）已填，版本形如 `v0.1`
- [ ] 核心定位是一句完整的话（≥ 10 字）
- [ ] 明确不做 ≥ 1 条
- [ ] 「它活在哪」已选定
- [ ] 验收标准 ≥ 1 条且具体可验证（"系统正常""体验良好"这类空话直接拒绝）
- [ ] MVP 完成定义 ≥ 1 条
- [ ] 需求基准描述覆盖场景 / 目标 / 约束 / 验收
- [ ] 无占位符 / TODO / TBD / `___` 残留（URL、路由、行内代码里的 `<id>` / `<标签>` 不算占位）
- [ ] 无英文正文（术语、代码、URL、品牌名除外；标题里的 "Land of Knowledge" 这类品牌名不再误伤）
- [ ] 无密钥、密码、token 等敏感信息

全过之后才落盘，并给出这句声明：

> ✅ S1 出口门通过：prd.md / 项目说明书已写、账本 S1 已标完成、无占位符、格式合规。

第 9、10 两条 v0.2 起收窄了判定：真被误判时把产品名 / 品牌名 / 术语放进 `interview_finalize` 的
`terms` 重新过门，**不要为了让自检通过去改产品名或改写法**。

更新源码后执行 `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`、`pnpm build` 并重启 profile；Python 锁文件/源码基线变化时，重新运行安装脚本。

## 0.3.5：适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2

增加新版宿主版本声明，更新 DSH 核心依赖、Cordis 4.0.5 和 Schemastery 3.18.5；适配测试中的客户端模块入口、调用方身份与交互权限。模型配置页补充缺少凭据时模型不可见的提示。保留同步读图、渐进搜索和原有 Python 依赖。安装与验证细节见 [0.3.5 适配说明](docs/upgrade-0.3.5.md)。

## 0.3.4：指定图片直接同步解析

复制 `images[].read_args` 指定图片后，已完成的结果直接从缓存返回；缓存未命中则立即发起独立模型请求，等待解析成功并写入缓存后返回。该请求不进入后台图片队列，不受 `progressive.waitMs` 的短等待限制。失败、取消或超时直接返回明确错误。

同一图片、同一模式的并发读取共用一个同步请求。后台该图已排队或正在解析时，取消该图的后台任务，由同步请求接管；其他图片继续处理。`imageConcurrency` 约束后台图片，同步请求额外执行。保持 0.3.3 的 DSH 兼容范围及 Python 依赖，升级后无需新增配置。详见 [0.3.4 同步读图说明](docs/upgrade-0.3.4.md)。下方 0.3.1 的插队行为为历史记录，以本节为准。

## 0.3.3：放宽 DSH 宿主兼容范围

全部 DSH 宿主依赖改为 `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`，接受 0.2.0-rc.2、后续 0.2 系列正式版与预发布版，拒绝更早版本及 0.3.0 的所有预发布版和正式版。Cordis 兼容 4.0.4 与当前 4.0.5-alpha.1 系列；构建依赖仍固定原有基线，不随兼容范围自动升级。Python、读取、搜索、配置及图片优先解析逻辑未变。

停止 DSH，替换源码，执行 `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`、`pnpm build`，再重启 DSH 并刷新页面。确认插件管理页显示 `0.3.3`。已有 Python 环境无需重装。验证范围见 [0.3.3 兼容性说明](docs/upgrade-0.3.3.md)。

## 0.3.2：适配 DSH 0.2.1-alpha.1

同步升级 DSH 宿主依赖、Cordis、加载器和 Schemastery，并重新生成依赖锁文件。读取、搜索、大型 Word 渐进解析和指定图片优先解析功能保持原有行为；Python 发布包版本和持久缓存格式未变。无需版本豁免，已正常工作的 Python 环境无需重装。

停止 DSH，完整替换源码，执行 `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`、`pnpm build`，再将新包添加到实际使用的配置档并重启 DSH、刷新页面。请确认插件管理页显示 `0.3.2`。详细步骤与验证范围见 [0.3.2 升级说明](docs/upgrade-0.3.2.md)。

## 0.3.1：指定图片优先解析

通过图片的 `read_args` 指定图片读取时，未开始的任务自动提升优先级；尚未进入搜索批次的图片可直接插队。目标图片完成即可返回，不等待整批搜索。已运行的图片继续执行，识别并发上限保持不变。同一图片、同一模式复用已有任务。详见 [0.3.1 升级说明](docs/upgrade-0.3.1.md)。

## 从 0.2.2 升级到 0.3.0：大型 Word 优化

完整替换源码，执行 `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`、`pnpm build`，重启 DSH 并刷新页面。Python 依赖版本未变，无需重装已正常工作的环境。

Word 默认先返回正文搜索结果，通过工具返回的 `next_search_args` 分批补全图片文字；搜索不再生成图片语义说明。新增有限并发、重复图片去重、持久检查点、跨重启恢复、文档变更后的图片复用、大图无损切片、稳定定位与图片目录分页。默认完整搜索；明确只查正文时传 `scope: "text"`。

图片未识别完时，结果会显示进度和缺口，不得把零命中解释成全文不存在。已有图片模型开关和手动选择保持不变。持久缓存默认 1 GiB、7 天保留期，可在新配置分组修改或关闭。

完整行为、参数、缓存位置、恢复与限制见 **[0.3.0 使用和升级说明](docs/upgrade-0.3.0.md)**。以下历史说明与新版本有冲突时，以该文档为准。

## 从 0.2.0 / 0.2.1 升级到 0.2.2

本次修复配置页面找不到图片模型的问题。DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 的通用会话模型目录不返回 `inputModalities`（支持的输入类型），0.2.0 错误地据此过滤了全部模型。0.2.1 通过插件只读接口读取模型注册表的实际能力。

0.2.1 的页面还缺少新接口的作用域依赖声明，导致服务商列表请求被 DSH 拒绝。0.2.2 在接口注册后创建明确依赖该接口的页面作用域，修复这一回归。详细原因及验证范围见 [0.2.2 修复说明](docs/upgrade-0.2.2.md)。

停止 DSH，完整更新源码，在插件目录执行 `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`、`pnpm build`，再重启 DSH 并刷新浏览器。已有插件安装路径不变时无需重新添加插件。无需更改 `llm-pi-ai` 中的 `input: [text, image]` 配置，也无需重装 Python。详见 [0.2.1 修复说明](docs/upgrade-0.2.1.md)。

## 从 0.1.0 / 0.1.1 升级到 0.1.2

停止 DSH，将新源码覆盖原插件目录，在该目录执行：

```powershell
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm build
py -3.12 .\scripts\setup_python.py
dsh plugin --profile web add .
dsh --profile web
```

`web` 是示例 profile（配置档），请替换成实际名称。**本次必须重新运行 Python 安装脚本**：它会将专用环境中的两个源码预发布包替换为指定发布版本，并校验安装结果，不修改全局 Python。若原配置使用自定义环境，给脚本加 `--venv 'D:\你的路径\venv'`，或把配置的 `python.executable` 改为脚本输出的路径。

文档读取/搜索参数保持不变。旧版缺少统一的图片扩展接口，新增 `python/stable_compat.py` 做小范围适配：沿用原生正文转换，将内嵌图片交给既有识别和来源标记流程。扫描图片仍由 markitdown-ocr 0.1.0 的官方识别服务处理。

## 0.1.1 历史升级说明

以下“无需重装 Python”仅适用于 0.1.0 → 0.1.1；升级到 0.1.2 请执行上一节。

本次修复 DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 启动时因 peerDependencies（宿主依赖版本约束）仍为 0.1.6-alpha.2 而跳过插件的问题。同步更新宿主包、Cordis 及其加载器、Schemastery 和依赖锁文件；文档转换逻辑与 Python 依赖未变。无需授予版本豁免。

1. 停止正在运行的 DSH，保留原有配置。
2. 将新源码覆盖原插件目录，必须包含 `package.json`、`pnpm-lock.yaml` 和 `pnpm-workspace.yaml`。
3. 在插件目录运行以下命令；`web` 是示例 profile（配置档），请替换为实际使用的名称。

```powershell
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm build
dsh plugin --profile web add .
dsh --profile web
```

再次执行添加命令用于确保该配置档引用新的本地包；仅重启不一定会刷新原先安装的副本。此次无需重建已可用的 Python 专用环境。若仍提示 `dsh-document-reader@0.1.0`，说明该配置档仍指向旧包，请核对当前目录和安装目标。

详细修复与验证范围见 [0.1.1 兼容性说明](docs/compatibility-0.1.1.md)。

## 配置

推荐在 DSH 侧栏进入 **插件 → 已安装 → dsh-document-reader → document-reader 行的“配置”**。

1. 先在 **设置 → 模型** 配置好服务商、地址和凭据；对应模型的输入类型必须包含“图片”。
2. 在插件页面将视觉服务来源设为 **使用 DSH 已配置模型**，先选择服务商，再选择图片模型。
3. 按需打开“生成图片内容说明”和“识别图片文字”。二者共用所选模型，可同时开启。
4. 点击 **保存配置**。新文档转换使用新配置，不需要重启 DSH，也不需要重新构建插件。

服务地址、密钥、协议和请求头由 DSH 服务商适配器处理，本插件页面不复制或展示密钥。服务商没有图片模型时会显示空列表；已保存模型被删除后保留原选择并显示“当前不可用”，不会自动换模型。图片能力依赖 DSH 的声明，实际网关是否支持仍以调用结果为准。

模型服务与附件服务只在 DSH 图片识别模式下需要；关闭图片说明与文字识别时，纯文本读取不依赖这两项服务。无前端的命令行环境仍可修改配置文件。

**附件保留：**

plugins.description: LAN text and file sharing for DeepSeek Harness — discover peers, send text/files, accept-or-ask policy
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lan-share

Share text and files between DeepSeek Harness devices on the same local network —
from a **局域网服务** tab in the right sidebar, or by asking the agent.

简体中文说明见 [README.zh.md](./README.zh.md).

## What it does

- **Discovers devices** that also run this plugin: UDP multicast plus broadcast,
  with a hand-added `IP` path for networks that filter both.
- **Rename devices** — your own name (what the whole LAN sees) or a local alias
  for someone else's machine.
- **Sends text or a file to one chosen device.**
- **Receives text and files**, with the file placed in a directory you choose
  (the DSH working directory, or a path you set).
- **Asks or accepts automatically**: an "全部默认接收" master switch, a fallback
  policy for unknown devices, and a per-device override on top. A size ceiling
  and an extension filter decide which files may skip the question.
- **Notifies on arrival**: unread count on the tab, a page-wide prompt for a
  file that needs a decision, and a receive history with the local path.
- **Shows progress** for every send and receive: bytes, rate, ETA, cancel.
- **Resumes** an interrupted transfer from the byte the receiver actually kept.
- **Visibility switch**: hide this device from the LAN entirely, or require a
  shared code before another device may connect.
- **Seven model tools** (`lan_share_devices`, `lan_share_send_text`,
  `lan_share_send_file`, `lan_share_inbox`, `lan_share_respond`,
  `lan_share_rename_device`, `lan_share_settings`) so the agent can do all of the
  above in a conversation.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-lan-share
```

DSH Desktop uses the `web` profile; **restart the app afterwards**, because the
host half only loads at boot.

If `dsh` is not on `PATH`, use the binary shipped with the desktop app:

```powershell
$app = "<INSTALL_DIR>\DSH Desktop\resources\app"
node "$app\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh\lib\bin.js" plugin --profile web add dsh-lan-share
```

### Verify

1. `profiles\web\package.json` lists `dsh-lan-share` in `dependencies` **and** in
   `dsh.profile.bundles`.
2. `profiles\web\node_modules\dsh-lan-share\lib\` contains `index.js` and
   `client.js`.
3. After a restart, a conversation's right sidebar "add tab" guide offers
   **局域网服务**, and a 局域网服务 button appears in the conversation header.

## Install on another machine

A LAN plugin is installed **once per machine** — it is not "install on one, the
whole network has it". Two routes:

### 1. Ship the tarball (no registry, no toolchain on the target)

On the development machine:

```sh
npm run check      # make sure the artifacts are current and the gates pass
npm pack           # writes dsh-lan-share-<version>.tgz
```

Copy the `.tgz` to the target (USB, `scp`, or send it with this very plugin), then
**on the target machine**:

```powershell
# The dsh bundled with the desktop app; DSH Desktop uses the `web` profile
$app = "<INSTALL_DIR>\DSH Desktop\resources\app"
& "$app\node_modules\node\bin\node.exe" "$app\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh\lib\bin.js" `
    plugin --profile web add "C:\path\to\dsh-lan-share-0.1.0.tgz"
```

Then **quit and restart** that machine's harness (tray → Quit for the desktop app,
Ctrl+C and re-run for `dsh web`).

`lib/` is built into the tarball, so the target needs **no Node toolchain, no
`npm install`, and no network**. There is no `src/` and no devDependency inside it.

### 2. Publish to npm

```sh
npm publish --access public
```

Every machine is then one command, with nothing to copy:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-lan-share
```

### Verifying on the target

```powershell
# 1) the manifest
Select-String dsh-lan-share "$env:APPDATA\dsh-desktop\harness\profiles\web\package.json"

# 2) the built halves shipped with it
Test-Path "$env:APPDATA\dsh-desktop\harness\profiles\web\node_modules\dsh-lan-share\lib\client.js"

# 3) the LAN plane (no login needed; the port is in the startup log or the panel header)
curl.exe -s "http://127.0.0.1:48901/lan-share/v1/info"

# 4) the panel plane: 401 without a cookie, 200 with one
curl.exe -s -o NUL -w '%{http_code}' "http://127.0.0.1:43129/lan-share/api/state"
```

That `401`/`200` pair is the cheapest proof the trust gate is really working, and
it is worth re-running on every deployment.

### Two timings that look like failures

- **The panel routes register a beat after the listening port.** Probing
  `/lan-share/api/state` the instant the port opens answers `404`; a second later
  it answers `401`. Do not read that as "the plugin did not install".
- **The browser boot graph is scanned once, at harness start.** After installing
  — or after rebuilding `lib/client.js` — that harness must be restarted, because
  the page keeps the old graph. The host half hot-mounts; the browser half does not.

## Use

Open the tab from the sidebar's add-tab guide, or ask the agent to send something.

1. **Same network, nothing else to do.** On a normal home or office LAN the two
   devices find each other within a few seconds. If they do not, use *手动添加设备*
   with the other machine's IP — many guest Wi-Fi networks and managed switches
   drop multicast.
2. **First time on a trusted network:** leave 共享口令 empty, or set the same code
   on both machines. With a code set, a device that does not know it cannot
   connect at all.
3. **Send:** pick the device, then *发文字* or *发文件*. The file box takes a
   **local absolute path** — a browser cannot read a real path from a file
   picker, so the path is what the panel can actually send.
4. **Receive:** with the default policy the panel asks before any byte moves.
   Turn on *全部默认接收* to skip the question, and use a device's own policy
   selector when one machine should stay manual.

### Where received files go

The 设置 tab chooses between **当前工作区目录** (the DSH process working
directory, or a path you set) and a **指定目录**. The resolved absolute path is
shown at the top of the panel, so there is never a guess about where a file
landed. Partially received transfers live in `<save dir>/.dsh-lan-share-incoming`
and are removed once the file is complete.

## Ports and firewall

| Port | Protocol | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 48900 | UDP | Beacons: multicast to `239.255.77.88`, plus broadcast to `255.255.255.255` |
| 48901 | TCP | Transfer plane, bound to `0.0.0.0` |

Both are configurable in the composition patch row:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: lan-share
      name: 'dsh-lan-share'
      config:
        discoveryPort: 48900
        transferPort: 48901
        multicastGroup: '239.255.77.88'
        checksumMaxBytes: 268435456
        maxConcurrentInbound: 4
        registerTools: true
```

If the port is taken (a second instance on the same machine), the plugin binds a
free port instead, says so in the panel, and hand-added devices still work.

**The transfer plane is not the DSH web server.** The web server is
loopback-only and gated by a browser cookie; this plugin runs its own listener on
`0.0.0.0` so a peer on the LAN can reach it, and gates every route with the
bearer token from the handshake. The panel, in contrast, uses same-origin routes
on the DSH web server and is gated by the host's own trust fence.

## Security model

- **Beacons are unauthenticated advertisements.** They can only make a device
  *appear*; they never authorise anything.
- **Every data request carries a token** proving the sender completed a
  handshake. With 共享口令 set, that requires knowing the code, and **changing the
  code invalidates every token already issued**.
- **The sender's name comes from the receiver's own device table**, never from the
  request body — one device cannot label its messages as another's.
- **File names are sanitized** to a single path segment, and the resolved path is
  re-checked against the save directory before every write.
- **Executables are refused by default** (`exe, bat, cmd, com, scr, msi, ps1,
  vbs, js, jar`), whatever the policy says.
- A file is only renamed into the save directory after its declared size — and
  its digest, when one was offered — has been verified.

An open LAN (no share code) means any device running this plugin on the same
segment can send you files. That is the convenient de

plugins.description: Automatic guitar-tab transcriber & synced player generator as an Agent Skill — works with DeepSeek Harness (dsh), Claude Code and compatible harnesses
plugins.readme_text:
# Guitar Tab Maker · 吉他谱工坊

自动扒歌 + 生成「边播放边跳和弦」的吉他跟练播放器。技能目录形式，遵循 [Agent Skills](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/agents-and-tools/agent-skills) 规范（`SKILL.md` + `scripts/`），**可直接被 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（dsh）、Claude Code 等兼容 harness 加载**。

## 它做什么

输入一首歌的音频（mp3/wav/m4a/flac），输出单文件 HTML 播放器：

- 原曲音频内嵌（**不转调、不损伤音质**）
- 和弦随播放进度跳动高亮，附下一个和弦预告
- 每个和弦带指法图（开放和弦 + 大横按）
- 每小节标注扫弦箭头（8 个八分音符格）
- 歌词逐行同步、段落快捷跳转、播放变速跟练

## 工作管线

| 脚本 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `scripts/fetch_lrc.py` | 双通道抓带时间轴歌词（酷我 musicId 优先，网易云兜底） |
| `scripts/analyze_song.py` | librosa 扒谱：beat 追踪 + 调内白名单 HMM/Viterbi + 小节制合并 |
| `scripts/verify_song.py` | 音频-谱面一致性校验（低频频谱根音比对），防原调标错/文件错配 |
| `scripts/build_songs.py` | 按配置重建曲库；指法和弦按 `(原调根音 − capo) mod 12` 自动换算 |
| `scripts/build_player.py` | 音频 base64 注入模板，生成单文件 HTML |
| `scripts/validate_player.py` | 成品综合校验（占位符/字段/段落索引/图库覆盖） |

## 快速开始

依赖：Python 3.10+、[ffmpeg](https://ffmpeg.org/)、Node.js（仅 harness 加载需要）。

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt

# 1) 歌词
python scripts/fetch_lrc.py --title 歌名 --artist 歌手 --kuwo-id 358603096 --out lrc.json
# 2) 扒谱（原调根音与 BPM 为粗略先验，可用网络资料）
python scripts/analyze_song.py --audio song.mp3 --key-root Bb --key-mode minor --bpm 89 --lrc lrc.json --out analysis.json
# 3) 一致性校验（必跑）
python scripts/verify_song.py --audio song.mp3 --analysis analysis.json
# 4) 写配置（参考 examples/songs.example.json）后构建
python scripts/build_songs.py --config songs.json --template assets/player_template.html --out built.html
python scripts/build_player.py --template built.html --out player.html --audio 1=song.mp3
# 5) 终验
python scripts/validate_player.py player.html
```

完整 SOP、变调夹选法与踩坑检查点见 [`SKILL.md`](SKILL.md)。

## 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用

把整个目录放到 dsh 的技能发现路径即可，无需转换：

- 用户级：`~/.dsh/skills/guitar-tab-maker/`（或 `~/.agents/skills/`，Claude Code 同根）
- 项目级：`<repo>/.agents/skills/guitar-tab-maker/`

dsh 只发现发现根下的**直接**子目录（不递归），不要嵌套两层。frontmatter 支持 `disable-model-invocation`、`user-invocable` 两个 dsh 专属开关。

## 免责声明

- 输出为**参考级谱面**：AI 听辨的切换点可能有小偏差，可在 `SONGS` 数据中改 `t` 值自行校准。

plugins.description: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that replaces the font settings in general settings with searchable font pickers.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-font-settings

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) web plugin that replaces the font settings in **Settings → General** with searchable font pickers: text, code, and terminal fonts are set independently, and the fonts installed on your machine can be listed on request.

The shipped rows ask you to type a comma-separated font name from memory. This plugin shows you the list instead — and draws every candidate in its own face, so you pick by sight.

## Features

- **Searchable pickers** for the text, code, and terminal font roles. Focus or type to open the list; ↑/↓ move with wrap-around, Enter applies, Escape cancels the edit, a click outside closes it.
- **Every row is drawn in the family it would apply**, so a candidate is recognized by how it looks rather than by its name.
- **Free text still works.** Anything not in the list can be typed; the harness normalizes it (names are quoted, generic families stay bare) and it becomes the field's value.
- **Load the fonts installed on this machine** with one button (Chromium-based browsers expose the list through `queryLocalFonts`; where it is unsupported or denied, the button says so and everything else keeps working). The catalog is searchable rather than dumped: type part of a family name and its matches are listed.
- **Font size for every role**, next to its font picker.
- **Collapsed by default** to a single "Font settings" row with a chevron disclosure, so the General list stays compact. The current text font is summarised on the collapsed row.
- **The system default is always one click away** — the first entry in every list clears the override.

## Install

The plugin installs as a profile bundle. Use the Web sidebar's **Plugins** page, or the `plugin_manager` tool's `install_bundle` (it requires `danger-full-access`). The spec can be a git address, a local path, or a registry name:

- **From GitHub**: `https://github.com/yiqiuacc/dsh-font-settings.git` (the manager runs `git ls-remote` against GitHub before installing; pnpm's `github:yiqiuacc/dsh-font-settings` shorthand works too).
- **From a local checkout**: `link:<absolute path to this directory>`.
- **From a registry** once published: `@styiqiu/dsh-font-settings`.

Installing enables the bundle by default. Opening **Settings → General** then shows one "Font settings" row where the built-in font group used to be.

## Where the choice is stored

The plugin owns no storage and no stylesheet. Every read and write goes through the harness theme service (`ctx.theme`), so the shipped machinery does the rest:

- **Persistence** — the settings scope stores each list and size; the profile records them as the `ui-theme` config row of its `cordis.patch.yml`.
- **First paint** — the harness boot script embeds the stored lists into the served index HTML, so a page never flashes the default font before applying yours.
- **Application** — the theme presenter writes `--dsh-font-family-<role>` onto `body` as inline styles, and the token sheet composes the interface and code stacks from them.

Because both surfaces read one store, this plugin's choices and the built-in font rows are always the same data. (Once installed, the built-in rows are not rendered — they are shadowed, see below.)

## How it works

- `client.js` is the whole plugin. It registers one entry in the General section's item slot **using the built-in entry's id at a lower priority**, which shadows that entry: a list slot renders one row per id and the lowest priority wins. The group replaces the built-in font rows rather than sitting beside them.
- The field and the candidate card are the shared client primitives — `Input`, `MenuSurface`, and `MenuGroup` from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`, a client baseline module — so the shared field geometry, menu material, sticky group headings, and focus behavior come from the harness rather than from this plugin.
- The committed list is adopted as the field's text only while the field does not hold the keyboard, so a write landing while you type — including the echo of your own commit — cannot replace what you typed or move the caret.
- The `theme` service is taken through a scoped injection (`ctx.inject(['theme'], …)`). Where that service is absent, the plugin registers nothing at all: the built-in font settings keep their place and the plugin is simply inert. The outer plugin never waits on the service, so a composition without it still boots.
- `index.js` is an **empty mount shell** (`export function apply() {}`). A profile bundle needs a mountable Host plugin for the Loader row to exist, and the browser bundle is discovered from that live entry — but this plugin has no Host-side behavior left.
- No build step and no dependencies of its own: plain ES modules, with React and the client primitives supplied by the client module loader.

## Compatibility

- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.x` web (and Desktop, which uses the same web profile template).
- The local-font button needs a Chromium-based browser. Everything else is engine-neutral.
- `ctx.theme` is a **pre-stable API**: the harness states that public APIs can change, so a harness upgrade may require updating this plugin.

## Known limitations

- **The local catalog is listed only while filtering, and at most 24 rows of it.** Every row is painted in the family it would apply, and a cold font cache loads one font face per distinct family — hundreds of rows in one open stall the page for seconds. The curated list is unaffected; a filtered local list costs about what the curated one costs.
- **The group sits above "Appearance".** Shadowing requires a lower slot priority, and a list slot sorts by priority, so the group renders first in the General section. This cannot be avoided while replacing the built-in rows.
- **It depends on the built-in entry id `font-size`.** If a future harness renames that entry, the shadow stops applying and this group renders **beside** the built-in font rows instead of replacing them — duplicated controls, no crash and no error.
- **The roles are independent.** There is no "also replace the monospace font" switch: the code and terminal roles have their own pickers.
- **No separate preview block** — each list row is already drawn in its own face.
- **No font-size formatting beyond the harness ranges** (text 10–22, code 10–16, terminal 10–20 px); the steppers clamp to them.

## Development

There is nothing to build and nothing to install.

- Edit `client.js` and reload the page — the client bundle is fetched per page load.
- Only a change to `index.js` (the mount shell) needs a server restart.
- `README.zh.md` is the Chinese counterpart of this file.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-local-model-supervisor

[中文](README.zh-CN.md) | **English**

> **Lazy-start a local llama.cpp model when DSH needs it, release RAM/VRAM when it doesn't.**
>
> **本地大模型「用到才起、不用就放」:按需冷启动 + 空闲自动释放 + 一个假的上下文上限来兜住压缩。**

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **AI-written code.** Every file in this repository was produced by an AI coding agent, not by
> hand — see **[AI-DISCLOSURE.md](AI-DISCLOSURE.md)** before you run it. It was verified on a
> single Windows machine, with no security review and no test suite.
>
> **本项目由 AI 编写。** 全部代码与文档均由 AI 编码助手产出,不是手写的 —— 运行前请先读
> **[AI-DISCLOSURE.md](AI-DISCLOSURE.md)**。仅在作者的一台 Windows 机器上验证过,无安全审计、无测试套件。

A local-model supervisor for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai). It occupies the
ports your DSH local routes already point at and runs `llama-server` on private internal ports:
the model is loaded on the first request and **all RAM/VRAM is given back once it goes idle**.
Ships with a DSH plugin so the whole thing starts and stops with DSH.

```
DSH ──> 127.0.0.1:8080 (supervisor, always resident: ~30 MB RAM, 0 VRAM)
              │
              ├─ first inference request ──> 127.0.0.1:9080 (llama-server, started on demand)
              └─ 500s with no requests   ──> llama-server killed, VRAM released
```

---

## 1. Why this exists

DSH's local routes go through `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai`, whose config is just
`api: openai-completions` + `baseURL` — it is a plain **HTTP client**. It has no hook that could
execute `llama-server.exe`. So in practice: the model is statically configured and always visible
in the model picker, but selecting it while nothing is running just fails to connect, and
**nothing will ever start it for you**.

The decision to lazy-start has to happen *before* the request reaches llama-server, so it can only
be intercepted at the HTTP layer. This project makes the supervisor **occupy the ports DSH is
already talking to** and moves the real llama-server to internal ports — so **no DSH configuration
has to change at all**, and curl / Python / any other client gets the same behaviour for free.

## 2. Features

| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| **Only inference routes wake a model** | A stray request to the port must not load a multi-GB model — and, with a single GPU slot, must not kill whatever is serving. Non-inference paths get a plain 404 (with the caller's User-Agent logged) while nothing is loaded. Added after a client polling `GET /wyvrn/Synapse` swapped the resident model 24 times and cut off live generations. |
| **Never kills a live generation** | Switching models checks whether the resident model still has active requests; if it is mid-stream the switch is refused with a 503 explaining why, instead of cutting the stream off. |
| **Cheap while idle** | The resident supervisor is one Node process and measures ~2–4 MB above a bare `node.exe` on the same machine (bare node 36.9 MB, supervisor ~38–41 MB RSS; JS heap ~6 MB). It holds **no VRAM at all** until a request arrives. `node supervisor.js` also reports its own breakdown at `GET /__supervisor/status` → `memory`. |
| **One unified model list** | Declare any number of local models in a single list. Give a **`path`** and the supervisor manages the process; give a **`url`** and it just forwards to a server you already run (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, …). Two fields per entry is enough. |
| **Ports allocated automatically** | The *i*-th model takes `publicBase + i`; managed models take the next free port at or above `internalBase`, skipping anything claimed. Collisions are rejected at startup, never at spawn time. |
| **Routes generated for you** | `scripts/export-dsh-routes.ps1` turns the list into a ready-to-paste DSH `providers:` block, so importing a model does not mean hand-writing YAML. |
| **Cold start on demand** | The first inference request spawns llama-server, waits for health, then proxies. Clients never need to retry. |
| **Idle release** | After `idleTimeoutSec` (default 500s) with no requests the process is killed and **both RAM and VRAM are returned**. The countdown starts when the last request *ends*, so long generations are never cut off. |
| **Metadata never wakes the GPU** | `/health` and `/v1/models` are answered synthetically; `/props` and `/metrics` return 503 while unloaded. **Otherwise a client polling `/v1/models` would pin the VRAM forever.** |
| **Single GPU slot** | Requesting a different model stops the current one first (one card cannot hold two). |
| **Soft context ceiling ("fake overflow")** | A fake ceiling below the real window forces DSH to compact while redundancy still exists — see section 5. |
| **Compaction grace window** | After a rejection, requests are let through for a while, so the summarization replay cannot be blocked by the same ceiling. |
| **Cold-start protection** | A 1-token warm-up plus a settle delay, and one automatic restart-and-replay if the server still dies on its first large request. |
| **Streaming preserved** | Byte-for-byte `pipe` forwarding; SSE works untouched. |
| **DSH plugin** | Starts/stops with DSH, plus `/localmodel status \| unload \| start` from any chat. |

## 3. Quick start

### 3.1 Requirements

- **Node.js ≥ 18** (standard library only — no third-party dependencies)
- **llama.cpp**'s `llama-server` (CUDA / Vulkan / CPU all work; developed against a Windows CUDA build)
- **PowerShell 7+** (optional, only for the `.ps1` helper scripts; the supervisor itself is pure Node)

### 3.2 Configure

```bash
cp supervisor/models.example.json supervisor/models.json
```

`models` is **one unified list** that accepts both kinds of local model source. All an entry needs
is a `name` plus either `path` or `url`:

```jsonc
{
  "idleTimeoutSec": 500,                       // how long before a model is released
  "ports": { "publicBase": 8080, "internalBase": 9080 },

  "defaults": {                                // applied to every managed model
    "ctxSize": 32768,
    "cacheTypeK": "q8_0",
    "cacheTypeV": "q4_0",
    "softContextRatio": 0.75                   // softContextLimit = ctxSize * this
  },

  "llamaServer": {
    "bin": "C:\\path\\to\\llama-server.exe",
    "args": [ "--host", "127.0.0.1", "--threads", "8", "--flash-attn", "on", "--jinja", ... ]
  },

  "models": [
    { "name": "qwen-2bit", "path": "D:\\models\\Qwen-2bit.gguf" },
    { "name": "qwen-4bit", "path": "D:\\models\\Qwen-4bit.gguf", "ctxSize": 16384, "mtp": true },
    { "name": "ollama",    "url":  "http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1" },
    { "name": "lmstudio",  "url":  "http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1" }
  ]
}
```

| Entry | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| **`path`** — managed | The supervisor spawns llama-server for that file, cold-starts it on the first request and releases RAM/VRAM when idle. |
| **`url`** — external | An already-running OpenAI-compatible server (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, another llama.cpp). The supervisor only **forwards** to it on its own public port; it is never started or stopped, so external entries get no idle release. |

**Ports are handed out for you.** The *i*-th entry takes `publicBase + i`, and each managed entry
takes the next free port at or above `internalBase` — skipping anything already claimed, so even a
deliberately overlapping base pair (8080 / 8081) can never hand the same port to two things.
Set `publicPort` / `internalPort` on an entry to override; genuine duplicates are rejected at
startup with a clear error instead of failing later at spawn time.

**Backwards compatible.** `common` is still accepted as an alias for `llamaServer`, and the legacy
explicit schema (`publicPort` / `internalPort` / `model` / `args` per entry) keeps working unchanged.

### 3.3 Generate the DSH routes

Declaring a model is only half the job — DSH also needs a route pointing at it, and hand-writing
YAML for every model does not scale. Generate it from the same config instead:

```powershell
pwsh -File scripts/export-dsh-routes.ps1                          # print to stdout
pwsh -File scripts/export-dsh-routes.ps1 -OutFile ..\routes.yml   # or write it to a file
```

It emits a ready-to-paste `providers:` block — one route per model, pointing at that model's
supervisor public port, with `contextW

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-model-reasoning-levels

Per-model reasoning effort levels inside DeepSeek Harness's **Settings → Models**.
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels?style=flat-square)](LICENSE)
[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels/releases/tag/v0.1.2)
[![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels/ci.yml?branch=main&style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Last commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels/commits/main)
[![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels/stargazers)
[![PRs welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-brightgreen?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-model-reasoning-levels/pulls)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.17-339933?style=flat-square&logo=node.js)](https://nodejs.org)
[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-0.2.0--rc.2-4B5563?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

**Model Reasoning Levels** — the reasoning-effort control each model entry is
missing, written straight into that model's `reasoningEfforts` in the profile's
`cordis.patch.yml`.

The shipped Models page edits a model's `id`, display name, context window,
max-output tokens and input types, and deliberately edits **no** reasoning
effort: effort is a per-*model* capability while that editor is per-*provider*.
This plugin adds the missing control **inside each model entry** — directly
under the id/name line, or under the expanded context-window/input-types area —
and converts the selection into the model's `reasoningEfforts` in the profile's
`cordis.patch.yml`.

## What it contributes

| Surface | What it does |
|---|---|
| `settings.models.provider-card` (keyed `llm-pi-ai`) | reaches each pi-ai provider card, discovers its model rows, and portals a per-model effort editor into every model entry — hand-declared routes included |
| Locale namespace `dsh-model-reasoning-levels` | English and Simplified Chinese copy |
| `scripts/reasoning-efforts.mjs` | validates a selection and prints the `reasoningEfforts` YAML and the settings path op it becomes |

Browser half only: the host half (`exports["."]`) exists so the Loader row can
carry the browser half (`exports["./client"]`). No route, no service, no Config.

## What it looks like

```
Settings → Models → Baidu Team → Customized settings → Models
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ [deepseek-v4.1-flash] [DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash]       ⌄   🗑   │
│ Reasoning effort levels              Inherited              │
│ [Off] [Minimal] [Low] [Medium] [High] [XHigh] [Max]        │
│ Low wire value: low   High wire value: high                 │
│ [Inherit catalog] [Non-reasoning] [Apply]  { off: null, … } │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

![The Reasoning effort levels control appended inside a model entry on the Settings → Models page](docs/images/reasoning-levels-row.png)

*The control inside one model entry: the seven level chips, one wire-value field
per selected thinking level, **Inherit catalog** / **Non-reasoning** / **Apply**,
and the exact `reasoningEfforts` value the current selection becomes.*

## How the control reaches the row

The shipped page declares **no seat inside a model row**, and its `ModelRow` is
an internal component. The only sanctioned row-level change is shadowing the
whole `settings.section` `models` entry — a shadowed copy of the page. This plugin takes
the narrower path instead: it owns the provider-card seat, then discovers each
model row structurally.

- The row's id input carries an `aria-label` built from the shipped page's own
  `settings.models` locale namespace (`Model ID 1`, `模型 ID 1`, …). The plugin
  binds that namespace and matches the label, so discovery follows the active
  language and never depends on a hashed CSS class name.
- It appends one container per `modelEntry` and portals a React editor into it,
  so the control lives inside the model entry and disappears with the row.
- A `MutationObserver` re-runs discovery when the fold opens, a row is added or
  removed, or the page re-renders. A shipped row restructure would need the
  selector updated.

### Saving, and the page's own Apply

The editor writes through the settings transport (`settings.mutate` path ops);
the host persists the result. The shipped page keeps its **own draft** of the
model list and its own Apply writes the whole `models` array for a hand-declared
route, which can restore the `reasoningEfforts` value the card loaded at open.

To keep the editor's value authoritative, the row remembers the declaration the
user applied and, if a later settings change reverts it, writes it again — up to
three times, so a refusal is reported instead of retried forever. Applying the
effort and then using the card's Apply for another field therefore converges on
the effort value you chose.

For a catalog route the editor uses the narrow
`providers.<route>.modelOverrides.<id>.reasoningEfforts` path, which the page's
model editor does not touch — unless the page materializes a `models` array (by
editing the model list), which the adapter refuses beside `modelOverrides`. The
row's re-apply covers that case while the card is open.

## The level vocabulary is closed and ordered

`off, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max` — exactly the harness's own
`THINKING_LEVELS`, in escalation order. The editor always emits the map in that
order, whatever order the chips were clicked. `off` means "do not think"; the
other six are thinking levels.

## The conversion rules (they are the adapter's)

Each chosen level becomes a key whose value is the spelling dispatch sends, so a
gateway with its own vocabulary can be renamed (`max: ultra`). The plugin
enforces `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai`'s `resolveModelReasoning` rules before the
write:

| Selection | Result |
|---|---|
| `off, low, high, max` with wire values | `{ off: null, low: 'low', high: 'high', max: 'max' }` |
| `off` alone | refused — a model that cannot think uses `false` |
| nothing selected | refused — omit the field to inherit |
| a non-`off` level with no wire value | refused — it needs the value dispatch sends |
| an empty-string wire value | refused |
| a level outside the seven | refused |
| the "Non-reasoning" form | `reasoningEfforts: false` |
| the "Inherit catalog" form | the field is unset, restoring inheritance |

A declared map **replaces** the model's capability set: levels not declared are
not offered. That is why `off` must be present in the map when the user keeps
it, and why "off only" is `false` rather than `{ off: null }`.

## Where the value lands in `cordis.patch.yml`

The editor writes settings path ops; the host persists them into the profile's
`cordis.patch.yml`. `reasoningEfforts` sits beside the fields the shipped row
already edits:

```yaml
- id: llm-pi-ai
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai"
  config:
    providers:
      baidu-team:
        models:
          - id: deepseek-v4.1-flash
            reasoningEfforts: { off: null, low: 'low', high: 'high', max: 'max' }
            contextWindow: 1000000
            maxTokens: 256000
            input: [text, image]
            name: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
```

The expanded spelling is equivalent and easier to hand-edit:

```yaml
            reasoningEfforts:
              off:
              low: 'low'
              high: 'high'
              max: 'max'
```

A model that cannot think, and one that keeps the installed catalog capability:

```yaml
          - id: acme-plain
            reasoningEfforts: false      # no selector beyond off
          - id: acme-catalog
            contextWindow: 128000        # reasoningEfforts omitted -> inherits
```

### The
