# DSH WorkBuddy Project

为 DeepSeek Harness 按项目配置专家、技能、规则与连接器，复用项目模板，并可接入共享能力库。

Configure DeepSeek Harness projects with experts, skills, rules, connectors, reusable templates, and optional shared capability libraries.

包名与仓库名：`dsh-workbuddy-project`。正式版本：`0.3.0`。市场目录收录与 npm 发布状态分别说明，目录审核不会影响从 GitHub 制品安装。

## 功能

- **项目**：绑定工作目录、项目指令和所选能力，保存并编译为 DSH preset。
- **专家**：首位专家作为主专家加载，其他专家提供按需方法论卡；专家团按单个入口加载。
- **完整能力包**：专家、技能、规范、连接器保留完整目录及附带文件；项目能力选择器展示本地与共享来源。
- **能力库**：统一展示本地、项目和共享来源，按来源与类型筛选；新建能力默认保存到本地，无需 Git 仓库。顶部共享资源库横栏仅显示已连接库数量与添加按钮，具体配置在弹窗中完成，能力清单保持全宽。填写 Git 地址后显示同步设置。
- **连接器**：HTTP/stdio MCP 桥接、本机 DSH 连接器引用和 CLI 包；检查连接、授权要求与工具发现结果。
- **固定版本**：项目锁定能力内容，资源库同步不会自动升级已保存项目；显式升级后使用新版内容。

个人使用不需要团队账号、管理平台或 Git 仓库。Git 同步与贡献操作需要本机 Git 及仓库访问资格。

## 运行要求

- Node.js >= 22。
- 兼容当前 `package.json` peer 范围的 DSH；本轮验证使用 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`。
- Web 界面提供「项目」「能力库」两个设置入口；命令和模型管理工具也支持无界面宿主。

## 安装

从正式 GitHub Release 的制品安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add -w https://github.com/matiomlei/dsh-workbuddy-project/releases/download/v0.3.0/dsh-workbuddy-project-0.3.0.tgz
```

也可打包并从本地制品安装：

```sh
npm pack
dsh plugin --profile web add -w /absolute/path/dsh-workbuddy-project-0.3.0.tgz
```

如果以 npx 运行 DSH，命令前缀可换为 `npx --no-install @deepseek-ai/dsh`。安装后重启目标 DSH profile 并刷新界面。

也可从[项目仓库](https://github.com/matiomlei/dsh-workbuddy-project)安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add -w github:matiomlei/dsh-workbuddy-project#v0.3.0
```

从 npm 安装指定正式版本：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add -w dsh-workbuddy-project@0.3.0
```

## 第一次使用

1. 打开设置 → 项目 → 新建项目，选择已有工作目录并填写项目指令。
2. 按需选择专家、技能、规范和连接器。没有能力包时，也可先创建仅含指令的项目。
3. 保存并编译；配置连接器的项目可点击「检查连接器」。
4. 新建会话，在 preset 选择器中选中该项目。已有会话保留创建时配置。

默认项目注册与编译目录是 `<DSH_HOME>/projects`；未设置 `DSH_HOME` 时使用 `~/.dsh/projects`，也可在插件配置中显式指定 `projectsRoot`。工作目录里的项目声明保存在 `.dsh/project.json`。

## 体验示例模板

在 DSH 插件配置中，将 `libraries` 设为 `[{"name":"examples","path":"/absolute/path/to/dsh-workbuddy-project/examples/library"}]`（替换为本机实际路径）。随后在「项目」新建页面选择「代码评审」或「资料研究」模板。模板自带专家，无外部连接器或凭据依赖。界面添加新 Git 资源库时需要仓库地址；预配置本地示例库无需 Git 同步。

项目模板位于「项目」页。能力库同时发现本地能力、已注册项目自有能力和共享资源库；本地及项目能力可直接保存，外部已安装来源为只读查看。详见[能力包格式与运行约定](docs/capability-packages.md)。

## 命令

```text
/project list
/project preview <id>
/project apply <id>
/project upgrade <id>
```

库同步与项目升级是两个动作；保存现有项目保持已锁定版本。

## 当前边界

- 专家卡不代表独立多智能体并行执行；共享资源库不提供成员角色、共享对话或任务协作服务。
- 当前 MCP 桥接支持 HTTP 与 stdio，SSE 不支持。OAuth 交互登录尚未实现，可引用已授权的本地 DSH 连接器或使用本机环境变量凭据。
- CLI 包不自动安装本机命令。发现 WorkBuddy 包不代表导入其账号授权。
- 包编辑器「提交为 PR」目前创建并推送 Git 评审分支；不会自动在托管平台建立 PR。
- 发布版与旧开发插件应分别在不同 profile 验证；二者都提供 `/project` 命令和项目 preset，请避免在同一 profile 同时启用。

## 开发与发布验证

```sh
npm install
npm test
npm run test:host
npm run test:ui
npm run check:package
```

宿主测试通过 `WB_DSH_NODE_MODULES` 指定已安装 DSH 的 `node_modules`；默认查找 `~/.dsh/profiles/node_modules`。UI 测试使用开发依赖，也可通过 `WB_UI_PACKAGE_JSON` 指向已有 React/jsdom 环境。

发布流程与市场收录要求见[发布清单](docs/releasing.md)。

plugins.description: DSH plugin: memory-preserving session handoff. Carries a conversation into a fresh session before it becomes unusable, and rescues sessions that already are.
plugins.readme_text:
[![dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh--plugin-yes-4b6bfb)](https://github.com/iuuuuuuuu/dsh-session-handoff)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-2ea44f)](./LICENSE)
[![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.15-339933)](https://nodejs.org)

# dsh-session-handoff

**English** · [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

Carry a conversation's memory into a new session **before** the old one becomes unusable.

## The problem this solves

A long DSH session eventually reaches a size where its own compaction stops working. The
mechanism is worth stating precisely, because it is what makes the failure permanent:

- Compaction replays the **whole shadowed region** as the input to one summarization request.
- The upstream provider enforces a hard ceiling on one request's prompt.
- Once the session passes that ceiling, the compaction request *is itself* over the ceiling.
- So compaction fails with the same overflow it was supposed to cure, every time, forever.

The session then cannot be compacted, cannot be continued, and — because the naive handoff
implementations build their summarization request the same way — cannot be handed off either.
That is the deadlock. `/handoff` exists to break it.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add /path/to/dsh-session-handoff
```

If your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` already mounts this plugin by hand, remove that row
first, or you will run two instances.

**Restart DSH.** This is required, not optional: the harness keeps loaded plugin modules in
its loader cache, and `hmr.root` defaults to `[]`, so editing a plugin's source does **not**
take effect in a running host.

After restarting, the log shows:

```
[session-handoff] installed: /handoff registered, pressure monitor active (upstream limit 1048576)
```

## Use

```
/handoff           hand this conversation off to a fresh session
/handoff-status    show the measurement, the binding ceiling, and the trigger state
```

`/handoff` prints a report:

```
Handed off `session-9ef22e43-…` to `session-e7d70ba3-…`.

- read: 32286 messages, 117541 events
- memory: 240 facts, 0 checkpoints
- summarize: 70 chunk(s), source=map-reduce, 18422 chars
- seed: 21544 chars (~5386 tokens)
- create: session-e7d70ba3-…
- archive: session-9ef22e43-…

The source session is archived; it stays readable in the sidebar.
```

The source is archived **last**, so a failure anywhere earlier leaves it intact and usable.

## What it does

### It watches

At every **turn boundary** the plugin measures the session's token pressure and classifies it
against **two** independent ceilings, binding on whichever is tighter:

| Ceiling | Where it comes from | Why it matters |
| --- | --- | --- |
| The model's context window | read from the model configuration the session is using | what the model itself accepts |
| The upstream prompt limit | configured, because nothing declares it | what the provider accepts on **one request** |

The second is the one that actually kills sessions, and it is *not* derivable from the first —
a routed model may advertise a 1,000,000-token window while the account behind it enforces
less on a single request.

When pressure crosses the policy ladder the plugin injects a **notice** into the session
naming the measured number, the binding ceiling, and the way out. A notice is model-facing
context for the next step, so it **never starts a turn on its own**, and it is rate-limited on
both growth and time so a session parked at `critical` does not nag.

### It hands off

`/handoff` runs one transaction:

```
1. read        the live session (messages + events)
2. memory      extract four layers of memory
3. summarize   bounded map-reduce, one request per chunk
4. create      the successor, inheriting the source's route and cwd
5. deliver     the seed as the successor's opening turn
6. archive     the source, with stopActivity — its work is terminated
7. release     drop the source's live event tree
```

**The successor starts working immediately.** The seed is not a note for you to read; it is
delivered as the successor's first turn, so the new session picks the work up and continues.

### Archiving does not free memory, and releasing only half-frees it

Archiving is a **visibility** change: the session id joins the archive set, which hides it
from the sidebar's default view. Its log stays on disk, it stays readable, and unarchiving
restores its exact position. **Nothing is deleted, and nothing is freed.**

**One rule governs memory: a session is released only once it is archived.** A handoff that
keeps the source visible — the automatic default — leaves it resident, because you may still
be looking at it. Anything you archive yourself is picked up by a periodic sweep of the
archive set, since a manual archive emits no event a plugin can listen for.

Releasing calls `SessionStore.remove(id)`, which runs the store's official detach lifecycle.

**What that does and does not free.** A session is held by two independent registries:

| Registry | What it holds | Can a plugin drop it? |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ctx.sessions` | the session's event tree | **yes** — `sessions.remove(id)` |
| `ctx.agents` | the agent, which holds the session | **no** |

The agent registry is a plain `Map` with **no public removal**: `agents.enter()` returns the
detach disposer, but `enter()` is called by the agent loop, not by a plugin, and neither
`agents.remove` nor `agent.dispose` exists on the public surface. So releasing a session
removes it from the session store while its agent keeps the tree reachable. The log on disk is
untouched either way.

Measured, with a real `SessionStore` and a real `AgentRegistry`:

```
BEFORE release:  sessions.get(id) -> true    agents.get(id) -> true
AFTER  release:  sessions.get(id) -> false   agents.get(id) -> true
                 the agent still carries all events
```

A session whose own agent is still **running** is skipped, because removing it then would race
its closing events. Switch the sweep off with `monitor.releaseArchived: false`.

### The memory it carries

The design question is *what to carry*. Four layers, ordered by cost:

| Layer | Source | Fidelity | Cost |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Verbatim facts** | Regex extraction over the transcript | Exact | Free |
| **Earlier checkpoints** | Successful `compaction/end` summaries the session already wrote | Exact | Free |
| **Recent turns, verbatim** | The tail of the conversation, word for word | Exact | Free |
| **Narrative summary** | Model-written, map-reduce | Paraphrase | One pass |

The three exact layers are never dropped to make room for the paraphrase: only the narrative
layer is truncated, and only from its middle. The verbatim tail gets a *reserved share* of the
seed budget rather than competing with prose for the leftovers, because facts give you the
paths while only the tail gives you the exact thought you were mid-way through.

### Credentials never ride along

The verbatim layer is a *copy*, so anything the session once echoed — a token printed while
debugging, a key in a dotenv dump — would be copied too. A handoff seed is a new artifact that
may be read or shared, so it is redacted by shape before it is written: bearer tokens, `sk-` /
`ghp_` / `github_pat_` / `xox` / `AKIA` keys, JWTs, PEM private keys, `password=`-style
assignments and inline connection-string passwords. The fact layer is redacted too, since a
path can embed a secret.

## Automatic handoff

Automatic handoff is **on by default**; automatic archiving is **off**.

The distinction is the point: handing off creates a successor that keeps working, while
archiving *hides* the session that broke. When a session dies while you are away, that session
is evidence — you want to see what it was doing, not find it gone.

Three independent triggers, because a session can become unusable in three different ways:

| Trigger | Signal | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Pressure** | measured pressure reaches `atLevel` | `critical` |
| **Failed turns** | a run of consecutive failed turns | 2 |
| **Compaction failure** | a failure streak **and** enough volume | 3 failures, 35% of the window |

Only `error`

plugins.description: DSH plugin: control iKuai (爱快) soft routers over their JSON API. Zero-dependency Node MCP stdio server exposing 11 read tools plus a write-gated generic API call; credentials live in the DSH credential store.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ikuai-mcp

在 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 里控制爱快 (iKuai) 软路由。纯 Node 零依赖的 MCP stdio server + DSH 宿主半：
模型侧出现 11 个 `mcp__ikuai__*` 工具，另有 3 个宿主工具（`ikuai_credentials_status` /
`ikuai_set_credentials` / `ikuai_ping`）。写操作默认关闭。

- 只读：系统状态、LAN/WAN 接口、在线终端、DHCP 地址池与绑定、DNS、静态路由、VLAN、DDNS、端口映射
- 通用读写 `ikuai_api_call`：需 `IKUAI_ALLOW_WRITES=1`，且每次调用传 `confirm: true`
- 连接参数存 DSH 凭据中心，改密码/换 IP 不用重启 DSH
- 默认 `https://192.168.1.1`（爱快出厂 LAN 地址），用户名 `admin`

---

## 安装

> 用法：把这个仓库地址（或本地目录）发给你 DSH 里的 AI，说一句「按 README 的安装一节把 dsh-ikuai-mcp 装好」。

### 交给 DSH 里的 AI（照做即可）

1. **安装进 profile**（三选一，把占位符换成实际值）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /绝对路径/dsh-ikuai-mcp       # 本地目录（必须是绝对路径）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:MingShi350/dsh-ikuai-mcp  # GitHub
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ikuai-mcp                 # npm
```

2. **确认写进了 profile**（`bundles` 里应出现 `dsh-ikuai-mcp`）：

```bash
node -e 'const p=require(process.env.HOME+"/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json");console.log(p.dsh.profile.bundles.filter(b=>b.includes("ikuai")))'
```

3. **重启 dsh web**。这一步交给用户做，agent 不要 `kill` 宿主进程（会中断当前会话）。
   装了 dshmarket 的话，界面上的「待重启」提示旁有一键重启。

4. **配置连接参数**（见下一节）。**不要猜 IP 和密码，问用户要。**

5. **验证**：调用 `ikuai_credentials_status`，再调用 `ikuai_ping`。

### 判断装好没有

| 现象 | 含义 | 处理 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 工具列表里出现 11 个 `mcp__ikuai__*` | 装好了 | 去配置连接参数 |
| 只有 `ikuai_credentials_status` / `ikuai_set_credentials` / `ikuai_ping` | 宿主半起来了，MCP 那一行没起 | 看 `mcp-server:ikuai` 开关是否被关；确认第 2 步的 `bundles` 里有它；确认重启过 |
| 一个都没有 | 插件没装上 | 回到第 1 步 |

### 原理（手工安装时才需要看）

`package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 指向 `cordis.patch.yml`，里面的 `- insert:` 两行分别是宿主半和
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`（以 stdio 挂载 `server/ikuai-mcp-server.mjs`）。`dsh plugin add` 会自动把包名
追加进 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/dsh.profile.bundles`，启动时装配；不想装包也可以手工把那两行并进
profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`。

---

## 配置：改爱快 IP / 加账号密码

取值优先级：**环境变量 > DSH 凭据中心 > 默认值**。默认值：

| 键 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `IKUAI_URL` | `https://192.168.1.1` | 爱快 web 管理地址；只写 `192.168.1.1` 会自动补 `https://` |
| `IKUAI_USERNAME` | `admin` | web 登录用户名 |
| `IKUAI_PASSWORD` | 空 | 必须配，否则工具直接报「未配置 IKUAI_PASSWORD」 |

### 改 IP

先用浏览器确认管理地址能打开：默认 `192.168.1.1`；改过 LAN 网段就用改后的地址；端口不是 80/443 要带上，
例如 `http://192.168.1.1:81`。然后任选一种：

**A. 让 agent 调工具写进凭据中心（不用重启）**

```
ikuai_set_credentials  { "url": "192.168.1.1", "username": "admin", "password": "你的web登录密码" }
```

会先归一化地址 → 再用这组参数试连一次 → 成功才写入。连不上就不落盘（确需强存加 `"allowUnverified": true`）。
写入后 **5 秒内生效**。

**B. 在 GUI 里填（推荐，密码不进对话记录）**

设置 → 凭据中心 → 新增 `IKUAI_URL`（值如 `192.168.1.1`），同样方式加 `IKUAI_USERNAME`、`IKUAI_PASSWORD`。

**C. 环境变量**

给启动 DSH 的进程设 `IKUAI_URL=http://192.168.1.1`，需重启。注意环境变量**优先于**凭据中心，
设了之后在凭据中心改同名值不生效。

### 加账号密码

密码就是你登录爱快 web 管理页的那个密码。

- **推荐**：设置 → 凭据中心 → 加 `IKUAI_PASSWORD`（明文只存 `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`，权限 0600，不进对话记录）
- 或者调 `ikuai_set_credentials { "password": "..." }` —— 该参数是明文，**会留在会话记录里**，能用 GUI 就用 GUI

### 验证

```text
ikuai_credentials_status   →  四项生效值与来源（env / 凭据中心 / 默认值）
ikuai_ping                 →  ✅ 登录成功：192.168.1.1（用户 admin）
mcp__ikuai__ikuai_status   →  CPU / 内存 / 在线终端数
```

`ikuai_ping` 结果对照：

| 返回 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `✅ 登录成功：…` | 通了 |
| `❌ 登录失败：code=1005 账号或密码错误` | 用户名/密码不对 |
| `❌ 连接失败：connect ECONNREFUSED …` | 地址或端口不对 |
| `❌ …响应不是 JSON（地址可能不是爱快 web 管理端口）` | 这个端口不是爱快管理页 |

### 什么时候要重启

| 改的是 | 重启？ |
| --- | --- |
| 凭据中心里的 `IKUAI_*` | 不用（每次调用重读，5s 缓存） |
| `server/*.mjs` 代码 | 重挂 MCP 子进程：能力面板把 `mcp-server:ikuai` 关掉再打开，或 kill `server/ikuai-mcp-server.mjs`（配了 reconnect 会自动拉起） |
| `lib/index.mjs` 或 `cordis.patch.yml` | 重启 dsh web |

---

## 写权限（默认只读）

任何非 `show/get/list/query/search` 的调用默认被拒。开启方式二选一，都不用重启：

1. **推荐**：设置 → 凭据中心 添加 `IKUAI_ALLOW_WRITES = 1`（5s 生效；改回 `0` 立刻恢复只读）
2. 给 DSH 进程设 `IKUAI_ALLOW_WRITES=1`（需重启）

开启后每次写仍要传 `"confirm": true`；插件不提供「让模型自己开写权限」的工具。写之前先 `show` 拿原记录
（含 `id`/`uuid`），改字段后 `edit` 回写。排序参数必须大写（`ORDER_BY` + `ORDER`），小写会被静默忽略。

---

## 工具清单

| 工具 | `func_name` | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ikuai_status` | `homepage` | CPU/内存/温度/在线终端数/连接数/运行时长/WAN 线路 |
| `ikuai_interfaces` | `lan` | 物理端口、上下线、netinfo（内外网 IP/网关）、VLAN 失败项 |
| `ikuai_online_devices` | `monitor_lanip` | 在线终端：IP/MAC/名称/流量/连接数；分页 + `order_by`/`order` |
| `ikuai_dhcp_pools` | `dhcp_server` | 各 LAN/VLAN 地址池、租期、网关、DNS |
| `ikuai_dhcp_bindings` | `dhcp_static` | 静态绑定 + 动态租约混合列表（`static_status`: 1=静态） |
| `ikuai_dns_config` | `dns` | 本机 DNS 开关、上游 DNS、代理规则、缓存 |
| `ikuai_static_routes` | `static_rt` + `static_rt_table` | 用户静态路由规则 + 生效路由表 |
| `ikuai_vlan_config` | `vlan` | VLAN ID/名称/成员端口/tag |
| `ikuai_ddns_config` | `ddns` | DDNS 配置与最近解析 IP（密码/AK 已脱敏） |
| `ikuai_port_mapping` | `dnat` + `netmap` + `upnpd_leases` | 端口映射、1:1 映射、UPnP 租约 |
| `ikuai_api_call` | 任意 | 通用读写兜底（ACL/QoS/流控/域名黑名单/syslog 等） |

**V3 → V4 模块名**：V4 改了名，用旧名会 `code=1003 Access denied` ——
`dhcp_addr_bind`→`dhcp_static`、`port_mapping`→`dnat`、`upnp`→`upnpd`、`static_routing`→`static_rt`、
`mac_bind`→`acl_mac`/`mac_comment`。插件会自动回退候选名。
注意 V4 对不存在的模块也回同样的 `1003`，无法与「无权限」区分。

---

## 安全

- 爱快用自签证书，客户端必须放开证书校验；**只在受信内网用**，不要指向公网设备。
- 密码明文存 `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`（0600）。插件不把凭据写进 `process.env`。
- 结果按字段名**尽力**脱敏：`pass|pwd|secret|token|credential|api_key|access_key`、以 `key` 结尾的字段，
  以及 `LTAI…`/`AKIA…` 形式的云 AccessKeyId；不认识的字段名原样返回，别当脱敏网关用。
- 写操作能改坏网络（DHCP、路由、端口映射），所以默认只读 + 每次 `confirm`。

---

## 自测

离线，不需要路由器也不需要凭据：

```bash
npm test
node tests/mock-test.mjs   # 握手、11 工具、会话过期重登、写请求不重放、写闸门、脱敏、坏地址不崩
node tests/host-test.mjs   # 宿主半：env 不被污染、来源标注、set_credentials 校验与先试连后落盘
```

---

## 排错

| 现象 | 处理 |
| --- | --- |
| 看不到 `mcp__ikuai__*` | 能力面板 `mcp-server:ikuai` 是否被关；`bundles` 里有没有它；是否重启过 |
| 报「未配置 IKUAI_PASSWORD」 | 凭据中心里加 `IKUAI_PASSWORD` |
| 报 `code=1005` | 用户名/密码不对；若该值来自环境变量，改完要重启 |
| 报 `ECONNREFUSED` / 超时 | 地址或端口不对，先确认浏览器能打开该地址 |
| 改配置没生效 | 凭据中心的值 5s 内生效；若存在同名环境变量，它会盖住凭据中心 |
| 写操作被拒 | 默认只读，见「写权限」；并确认传了 `confirm: true` |

---

## 已知限制

- 写操作只有通用透传，没有为 DHCP/DNS/路由写专用写工具（字段名随固件变化）。
- 未覆盖 Docker / QEMU / 行为审计 / AC 管理 / SD-WAN，用 `ikuai_api_call` 直接调 `func_name`。
- 会话 10 分钟重登一次；爱快并发登录会互相顶号，别同时开着 web UI 做写操作。
- 部分字段是设备回吐的原始字节（如 DHCP 租约的 `hostname`），按 UTF-8 解可能是乱码。
- 大结果不裁剪：`ikuai_online_devices` 默认 100 行 × 约 50 字段，按需调小 `limit`。
- 仅在 iKuai V4 (4.0.311 x64) 上完整实测；V3 走候选名回退，未逐项验证。

---

## 许可与致谢

MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。作者：[MingShi350](https://github.com/MingShi350)。

API 用法与 `func_name` 清单参考 [beck-8/ikuai-mcp](https://github.com/beck-8/ikuai-mcp)（MIT，© 2026 Beck），
本项目是独立的 Node 实现，详见 [THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md](THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md)。

plugins.description: 面向 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的专家与专家团插件：给 AI 加"角色与团队"两个协作维度——用一个领域专家的身份干活，或拉起一支多 Agent 团队按流程交付。
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH 专家工坊 · dsh-expert-suite

面向 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的**专家**与**专家团**插件：给 AI 加"角色与团队"两个协作维度——用一个领域专家的身份干活，或拉起一支多 Agent 团队按流程交付。 - **专家（Expert）**：单角色切换——「人设 + 方法论 + 工具白名单」，让 AI 以特定领域专家身份执行任务，且白名单是进程内强约束； - **专家团（Expert Team）**：多 Agent 协作——团长把任务拆解、按需派工给成员子代理、整合交付，支持会话式（和团长对话）与批量（一次跑完）两种工作方式； - **三种创建方式**：手动创建（工具 / 面板表单）、文件导入（JSON / Markdown）、AI 生成（一句话描述 → 自动成稿入库）。 随包内置 8 位专家与 1 个「全栈交付团」，开箱即用。 ## 特性 - 🧑‍💻 **召唤专家**：注入 persona + 工具白名单门禁，`/expert data_analyst` 即用； - 👥 **会话式专家团**：进入团队和团长对话，打招呼就只是打招呼，有任务才按需派工； - ⚙️ **批量交付**：`team_run` 一次跑完整条流水线（serial / parallel / auto 三种执行模式 + step 干预）； - 📥 **多种创建方式**：手动表单 / 文件导入（JSON、Markdown）/ AI 生成，均校验后入库； - 🔒 **进程内权限隔离**：工具白名单由宿主 `tools.guard()` 单调拒绝，不是提示词提醒； - 🎛️ **图形面板**：设置页分栏 + 悬浮入口，浏览 / 创建 / 导入 / 详情 / 一键召唤与进入； - 🧩 **运行时 skill**：每位专家 / 每个团队 / 使用说明都注册为 skill，AI 可随时加载； - 🔌 **零侵入降级**：所有宿主接缝集中在适配层，服务缺席只降级、不影响宿主。 ## 安装 **从 npm 安装（推荐）**：在 DSH 的「插件」页（设置 / 侧边栏）搜索安装 `dsh-expert-suite`；或用命令行： ```sh dsh plugin add dsh-expert-suite ``` 装完**重启一次**：插件加载时会把「专家模式」「专家团模式」两个预设铺到 `$DSH_HOME/.agent-presets/`，重启后出现在预设选择器里。 **从源码开发安装**：构建产物后引入（见下文「开发」）。 > 兼容性：对齐 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 运行时与 `@deepseek-ai/*` rc peer；更早版本请按宿主安装时的 peer 提示处理（`dsh plugin --profile allow-version` 授权）。 ## 快速上手 ```text # 单专家 /expert-list # 浏览名册 /expert data_analyst # 召唤数据分析师（注入 persona + 工具白名单） /expert data_analyst 帮我解读这份报表 # 召唤 + 立即发送第一句话 /expert-dismiss # 退出专家模式 # 专家团（会话式：进入团队，和团长对话） /team-list # 浏览团队 /team fullstack_delivery # 进入团队（打招呼、问能力、下任务都行） /team fullstack_delivery 你好 # 进入团队并发送第一句话 # 之后正常对话：团长确认任务后才按需派工，打招呼就只是打招呼 # AI 创建（在会话里直接说） 请调用 expert_generate：我需要一个专门写技术文档的专家 请调用 team_generate：帮我组建一个能完成产品从设计到上线的团队 ``` 也可以全程用工具驱动：`expert_list` → `expert_summon` → `expert_dismiss`；团队侧 `team_dispatch`（团长按需派工）/ `team_status` / `team_end`，或 `team_run`（批量一次跑完）。 图形界面：**设置 →「DSH 专家工坊」**（或右下角悬浮按钮）打开浏览面板，可视化浏览 / 创建 / 导入专家与专家团。 ## 核心概念 ### 专家（Expert） 一个专家 = 一份「人设 + 方法论（persona）」+ 一个工具白名单（`toolFilter`）。召唤后，模型以该专家身份执行任务；白名单外的工具调用被当场拒绝（进程内强约束）。字段： `id / name / category / description / capabilities / expertise[] / exampleTasks[] / persona / model? / toolFilter[] / source` ### 专家团（Expert Team） 一个团队 = 团长（lead）+ 若干成员（members），成员按 `order` 排序、各带 `responsibility`。字段： `id / name / description / executionMode(serial|parallel|auto) / interventionMode(auto|step) / members[{expertId, order, responsibility}] / leadPersona? / source` ### 三种创建方式 | 方式 | 入口 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | | 手动创建 | 面板「创建专家 / 创建专家团」、工具 `expert_create` / `team_create` | 逐字段填写；团队成员可选现有专家或「自定义角色」现场定义 | | 文件导入 | 面板「导入」、工具 `expert_import` / `team_import` | 专家支持 JSON / Markdown；团队只支持 JSON | | AI 生成 | 面板「AI 生成」、工具 `expert_generate` / `team_generate` | 自然语言描述 → 生成器子代理成稿 → 校验后入库 | ## 使用指南 ### 召唤与退出专家 - 召唤：`/expert `，或面板点「召唤专家」；可带一句话 `/expert 消息` 立即开工。 - 退出：`/expert-dismiss`，或状态条上的 ✕。 - 召唤成功后面板自动收起，右上角状态条显示当前专家 / 团队，可一键退出。 ### 团队协作：会话式（默认）与批量（显式） **会话式（默认）**——`/team <团队id>` 或面板「进入专家团」：注入团长契约，你和团长对话。打招呼、问团队能力就只是对话；有实际任务时团长先澄清目标、再用 `team_dispatch` 按需派工给成员（每次派工 = 一次 one-shot 子代理，等待交付后整合回复你），**不会一上来跑全队**。随时 `team_status` 看派工记录，`team_end` 结束并把各成员交付留档供总结。 **批量（显式）**——`team_run` 工具：给定自包含总目标，团长一次拆解、按执行模式跑完所有相关成员并整合总结。适合"现在就把整件事跑完"。 批量模式的执行模式（团队定义里的 `executionMode`）： - `serial`：按 `order` 串行，后续成员能看到前序交付物； - `parallel`：全部成员同一波次并行（受 `maxParallelMembers` 限制，默认 4），团长最后整合； - `auto`：团长先做结构化规划（`outputSchema` 校验的波次计划），按波次执行；规划失败自动回退为按 `order` 串行并记入日志； - `interventionMode: step`：每位成员（或每个并行波次）交付后暂停，用 `team_message(action=continue)` 放行。 成员的「连续性」由提示词承载（后续派工带上前序交付物全文），子代理会话不做跨派工驻留——这是 v1 的刻意取舍，换取只依赖宿主最稳定的 API 面。 ### 权限与工具白名单 - **专家召唤**：`toolFilter` 通过宿主 `tools.guard()`（单调拒绝，不可撤销）按 agent 生效；白名单外的工具调用被当场拒绝并说明原因。空白名单 = 不限制。 - **团队成员**：每次派工都是一次 one-shot 子代理（`ctx.subagents.start('spawn')`），其 `persona` / `toolFilter` / `maxDepth=1` 在子代理创建窗口内落地，且不能继续向下委派。 - **团长**：默认 `leadToolFace: 'coordinator'`——只协调不执行（拒绝 `bash`/`pwsh`/`write`/`edit`）；可在 Config 改为 `full`。 - **指定模型**：专家定义里的 `model` 映射到子代理 `agentOptions.model`，需要宿主开启「子代理模型选择」opt-in，否则派工会报错——内置专家默认不指定模型（继承会话路由）。 - **跨平台工具名**：`toolFilter` 里的工具名会按当前部署可见工具自动清洗（例如 Windows 上没有 `bash`、提供 `pwsh`），避免未知名导致 spawn 失败。 ## 工具清单（19 个） | 工具 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | `expert_list` / `expert_get` | 列出（支持 `category` 筛选）/ 获取专家完整定义 | | `expert_create` / `expert_import` / `expert_delete` | 创建（zod 校验）/ 导入 / 删除（内置不可删） | | `expert_summon` / `expert_dismiss` | 召唤（注入 persona + 启用门禁）/ 退出 | | `team_list` / `team_get` / `team_create` / `team_import` / `team_delete` | 团队同名管理操作 | | `team_dispatch` | （团长模式）按需派工一项子任务给成员，等待交付并返回 | | `team_run` | 批量模式：`teamId` + 自包含 `objective` 一次跑完全队并整合，返回 `runId` | | `team_status` | 查看运行状态（成员进度、日志、总结）；缺省返回当前会话的活跃团队 | | `team_message` | `action=send` 与成员对话；`action=continue` 放行 step 模式暂停点 | | `team_end` | 结束团队（缺省结束当前会话的活跃团队），返回各成员交付供总结 | | `expert_generate` / `team_generate` | 自然语言 → AI 生成专家 / 从现有名册组团并入库（`save=false` 可只预览） | ## 数据与存储 ``` $DSH_HOME/expert-suite/ ├── experts/.json 用户创建 / 导入 / AI 生成的专家 └── teams/.json 用户创建 / 导入 / AI 生成的专家团 ``` 内置资产随包提供；**同 id 时用户目录版本优先**。内置定义不可删除（返回 `BUILTIN_READONLY`）。 ## 导入格式 ### 专家 **JSON**：直接是完整定义对象；**Markdown**：YAML frontmatter + 正文（正文即 persona）： ```markdown --- id: tech_doc_writer name: 技术文档专家 category: 写作 description: 面向开发者的技术文档写作 expertise: [技术写作, Vue, Vite] exampleTasks: - 把这份源码注释整理成教程 toolFilter: [read, write, grep, glob] capabilities: |- 多行能力介绍…… --- 你是资深技术文档工程师……（persona 正文） ``` ### 专家团 只支持 **JSON**。成员通过 `expertId` 引用**已存在的专家**，所以先确保这些专家在名册里： ```json { "id": "launch_team", "name": "上线筹备组", "description": "把新产品从定义推到上线", "executionMode": "auto", "interventionMode": "auto", "members": [ { "expertId": "product_manager", "order": 0, "responsibility": "产出需求定义与验收标准，交给设计师" }, { "expertId": "ui_designer", "order": 1, "responsibility": "基于需求产出界面方案" }, { "expertId": "code_reviewer", "order": 2, "responsibility": "评审可实现性与风险" } ], "leadPersona": "可选：自定义团长人设，留空用内置模板" } ``` - `executionMode`：`auto`（推荐）/ `serial` / `parallel`； - `interventionMode`：`auto` 全自动 / `step` 每位成员交付后暂停等你放行； - `members[].order`：数字，决定默认执行顺序；`members[].responsibility`：该成员负责什么、产出交给谁； - 名册里没有的角色，可在「创建专家团」表单用「+ 自定义角色」现场建，或先创建 / 导入专家；导入后自动注册运行时 skill，同 id 覆盖已有版本。 ## 插件配置 在 `cordis.yml` 的插件行里配置： ```yaml - insert: - id: expert-suite name: 'dsh-expert-suite' config: dataDir: '' # 缺省 $DSH_HOME/expert-suite layPresets: true # 自动铺设两个预设 maxParallelMembers: 4 # 波次内最大并行子代理数 leadToolFace: 'coordinator' # coordinator | full ``` ## 架构与平台集成 宿主半边按官方契约实现：`ctx.tools.register` / `ctx.tools.guard`、`ctx.subagents.start('spawn', …)`、`ctx.skills.register`（运行时 skill）、`ctx.commands.register`、`ctx.webServer.register`（0.2.0 起为 `webServer`，0.1.5 线为 `httpServer`，两个名字都挂 inject 回调、谁先就绪注册谁）、`agent.inject` / `agent.followup`、`ctx.agents.get` / `list`。所有宿主接缝集中在 `src/ports.ts`（host）与 `src/client/slots.ts`（client），改宿主版本适配只动这两处。 Client 半边按官方模块加载契约实现（`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` 自注册、`require('react')` 取平台 React、导出 `{ apply, inject }`），面板是 Vue 3 SFC 通过 React 宿主组件以「孤岛」挂载。入口为两个已核实的官方 slot：`settings.section`（设置页分栏）与 `shell.overlay`（右下角悬浮按钮）。面板数据与动作走 `/expert-suite/*` 路由（在 webserver 上注册；无 webserver 的 profile 自动降级为只读空态）。 两个值得知道的平台行为： - **链接安装的包**（`link:` / `file:`）内部 import 的 `@deepseek-ai/*` peer 会被宿主重定向到安装副本——本包 `peerDependencies` 必须与运行时真实 import 一一对应； - **插件展示元数据**：`locale/{en,zh}.json` 的 `meta.title/description` + `package.json` 的 `icon`（宿主 `readPluginMeta` 经 ESM 解析读取，`exports` 必须放出 `./locale/*.json`）。 ## 开发 ```sh pnpm install pnpm run typecheck # TypeScript 严格模式（零错误为合并门禁） pnpm run build # host（tsc → dist/）+ client（vite → dist/client.js） pnpm publish # 发布前会先跑 build ``` 本地装进 DSH 调试：把本包以 `link:` / `file:` 引入 profile，或 `

plugins.description: DSH Web GUI sidebar glance card: DeepSeek account balance, peak/off-peak billing countdown and today's spend / tokens / calls, seated right above the account row. Self-contained host half; @linxin666/dsh-usage optional.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-account-glance English | [中文](README.zh.md)


The live card: probed balance, Beijing peak / off-peak clock, and today's ledger.

A three-line glance card for the DSH Web GUI, seated **directly above** the sidebar's bottom-left **account / Settings** row: | Line | Content | | --- | --- | | 1 | DeepSeek **account balance** — probed from `/user/balance` with the host-held API key; hover names the source | | 2 | **Peak / off-peak** billing period, with a live countdown to the next flip and the discount in effect | | 3 | **Today's spend / tokens / calls**, plus a **manual refresh** button that forces one fresh probe | Peak / off-peak follows DeepSeek's official schedule (Beijing time, UTC+8 all year): **peak** is Monday–Friday `09:00–12:00` and `14:00–18:00` at full price, **every other hour** (nights and weekends included) is billed at **50% off**. The countdown switches to seconds for the final minute. ## Install Needs **DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 or newer**. No other plugin, no dependencies, no build step. ```bash git clone https://github.com/faith372/dsh-account-glance.git dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:./dsh-account-glance ``` The Plugins page also accepts the repository URL in its **Add plugin** dialog. Installing by hand: put the source at `\plugins\dsh-account-glance\`, add the package to both `dependencies` and `dsh.profile.bundles`, then link it into `node_modules` (or run `pnpm install`). Do **not** add `account-glance` to `cordis.patch.yml` yourself — the package ships that row. **Upgrading from 1.3.x:** the host half is new, so restart DSH (or toggle this row off and on in the Plugins page) and refresh the page once. ## Turning it on and off Sidebar **Plugins** icon → **Installed** → **dsh-account-glance**: the card switch toggles the whole bundle, the row switch toggles this card. Instant — no restart, no refresh — and turning it off brings dsh-usage's own glance card back. ## Where the numbers come from Both data sources live in this plugin's own host half and are served over loopback-only routes (`api/dsh-account-glance/overview`, `.../refresh`); the API key never reaches the browser. - **Balance** — `GET https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance`, with the key resolved from the DSH credential store (pi-ai record → configured env reference → ambient env). No probe value falls back to the `account` Remote (Settings → Account & balance). A route pointed at a reseller is reported as unsupported rather than probed with the official endpoint; a failure keeps the last good number and flags the row. - **Today's usage** — folded from the session event stream into a small per-day ledger at `/account-glance/ledger.json` (atomic write, 180-day retention), keyed by **Beijing date**. - **Cost** is priced for DeepSeek official routes only (the published CNY peak / off-peak table). Other routes — a DashScope-compatible provider, for example — still count tokens and calls, at cost 0, so a mixed ledger never sums two currencies. - `@linxin666/dsh-usage` is **optional**: install it and nothing breaks — this card still reads its own route first, its glance card stays hidden, and its settings and usage pages keep working. Probing is a read-only account query: no prompt, no tokens, no credit. ## Verify ```bash npm test # node test/verify.mjs && node test/host-verify.mjs ``` Both suites run offline. The client suite boots the shipped `lib/client.js` against React / DOM stand-ins: seat and cadence, the probe outranking the account wallet, the fallback identity, the peak clock's boundary cases, the 15-second deadline, the refresh button, the degradation paths, and the dsh-usage fallback. The host suite covers the clock and price book, the ledger, credential resolution and probe shapes, the origin guard, session folding, the route fence, persistence across a restart, and the entry point. ## Known limitations - Hiding dsh-usage's glance card relies on its `data-dsh-plugin="usage"` / `data-dsh-part="foot-card"` attributes; if it renames them, both cards appear (nothing breaks). - The balance belongs to the DeepSeek account the configured key belongs to — swap the key, swap the number. - Cost appears for DeepSeek official routes only; other routes show tokens and calls without an amount. - With dsh-usage installed too, both plugins keep their own ledger (this one buckets days by Beijing date, dsh-usage by host-local date), so the two totals can differ slightly. - The card hides while the sidebar is collapsed to its 56 px rail, matching the shell's own foot area. ## License MIT — except `lib/host/*` and `lib/index.js`, adapted from [`@linxin666/dsh-usage`](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web) v0.4.4 (Apache-2.0). See [`THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`](THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md) and [`LICENSE-APACHE`](LICENSE-APACHE).

plugins.description: DSH 的持久化共同白板插件：完整白板在左、原生对话在右，人和 AI 持续维护同一份草稿。基于 draft-board。
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH-board

[![CI](https://github.com/MYming-yue/dsh-board/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/MYming-yue/dsh-board/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

**在 DSH 对话旁，放一张人和 AI 可以长期共同维护的白板。**

A persistent shared whiteboard beside the native DeepSeek Harness conversation.

DSH-board 是 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的本地插件，基于 [draft-board](https://github.com/MYming-yue/draft-board)。白板保留理解和成果，对话用来提出问题、讨论与纠正：学一个概念、拆解一个产品，或持续打磨一个项目。

当前为 **0.1.5 早期试用版**。插件单独维护宿主集成，白板界面和模型通过 [upstream.json](upstream.json) 固定上游提交构建，不维护两套白板代码。已构建的安装包可以独立安装，无需相邻的 draft-board 仓库；尚未发布到 npm。

## 可以做什么

- 完整白板在左，DSH 原生对话在右；对话可展开／收起，分隔线可拖动调整宽度。
- 保留 Markdown、LaTeX、图片、卡片备注、关系、集合、布局、结构视图、历史和撤销／重做。
- 新开或切换聊天继续同一张白板，直到主动“新建”或“打开”另一份草稿。
- 选中卡片后发消息，AI 知道本条回复所指的对象；不改写用户回复，不自动附上卡片全文。
- AI 通过 `draft_board_read`／`draft_board_apply` 主动维护白板，复用原子批次、版本校验与整轮撤销。
- 在“设置 → DSH-board 白板”管理启用与卡片关联；关闭功能保留草稿。

## 兼容范围

| 项目 | 已验证范围 |
| --- | --- |
| DSH CLI | 0.1.5-rc.1 |
| DSH 组合包 | 0.1.5-rc.2 |
| 宿主 profile | web |
| 实际宿主联调 | Windows、Chrome |
| 构建环境 | Node.js 22+、npm、Git |

布局和消息提交适配依赖 DSH 当前接口，升级宿主后需要重新验证。其他 DSH 版本和操作系统的完整宿主集成尚未确认；欢迎附版本信息反馈。

## 安装试用版

先确保 DSH web profile 可以正常启动。到 [Releases](https://github.com/MYming-yue/dsh-board/releases) 下载 `dsh-board-0.1.5.tgz`；安装已构建的包不需要 Git、编译工具或 draft-board 源码。

以下为 PowerShell 示例，使用 GitHub CLI 下载。也可以在浏览器下载，再将最后一行改为安装包的绝对路径。

```powershell
$dshHomePath = if ($env:DSH_HOME) { $env:DSH_HOME } else { Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.dsh' }
$pluginDir = Join-Path $dshHomePath 'local-plugins'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $pluginDir | Out-Null
gh release download v0.1.5 --repo MYming-yue/dsh-board --pattern 'dsh-board-0.1.5.tgz' --dir $pluginDir
dsh plugin --profile web add ("file:" + (Join-Path $pluginDir 'dsh-board-0.1.5.tgz'))
```

安装后重启 DSH Web Host，并重新载入页面。在设置中找到“DSH-board 白板”，确认共同白板已启用。

DSH home 使用 `DSH_HOME`，未设置时默认 `~/.dsh`。不要将插件安装到另一个 profile 或 home。更新同样下载新版本安装包后执行 `add` 并重启；构建包使用不同版本和文件名，避免本地依赖缓存误用旧包。

## 第一次体验

1. 在白板上双击创建一张卡片。
2. 选中它，在右侧发送“给这张卡片补充解释”。
3. 观察 AI 工具记录与画布更新，点击“撤销最新一轮”回退该批次。
4. 新开聊天，确认仍然是当前白板。

AI 使用 DSH 原有模型、工具和审批流程。插件不增加模型 API 配置，不管理账户，也不添加云同步。

## 保存、上下文与管理

草稿位于 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-board/`，包含图片与历史；`current.json` 指向当前草稿。主动更换时保留前一份宿主文件。原生“打开”“保存”“另存为”继续可用：宿主持有一份副本，绑定的磁盘原文件仍通过白板保存入口回写，页面刷新后需重新绑定其文件句柄。

固定使用说明注册在系统提示末尾；卡片身份和短标题在本轮运行上下文末尾注入。相同关联复用原生快照，不为每条回复重复追加。不附上全文、时间戳或修订号，不重写既有历史；发生过变化的快照仍由宿主保留，缓存命中率取决于宿主和模型服务。

“设置 → DSH-board 白板”提供“启用共同白板”和“发送时关联选中的卡片”。关闭白板恢复完整聊天区、暂停白板工具，保留草稿与未提交输入；重新启用后继续维护。选项和待处理关联保存在 `plugin-state.json`。

浏览器约每 750ms 与宿主同步。输入、指针操作、布局和回放期间保留当前操作。并行修改冲突时保留双方内容、暂停镜像；另存为后重新打开副本，明确选择继续维护的版本。当前没有自动合并、多任务白板管理、多人协作、AI 图片解析或完整消息／批次追溯。

卸载插件：

```text
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-board
```

随后重启宿主；卸载不会删除 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-board/` 中的草稿。

## 从源码构建

```bash
git clone https://github.com/MYming-yue/dsh-board.git
cd dsh-board
npm ci
node node_modules/playwright-core/cli.js install chromium
npm run check
```

首次构建自动拉取锁定的 draft-board 提交并执行其锁定依赖安装，需要访问 GitHub 与 npm。源码缓存在被忽略的 `.upstream/`；构建产物位于 `lib/`。上游锁不变时复用缓存；更新需显式修改 `upstream.json` 并重新验证。构建不会读取个人 DSH 配置、模型凭据或草稿。

`npm run check` 执行上游类型检查、界面与模型构建、插件测试，以及真实浏览器的安装包检查。安装包检查从 tgz 解压运行，验证持久化、画布接收批次与整轮撤销，不调用模型 API。`DSH_BOARD_BROWSER=chromium` 可指定 Playwright Chromium；默认依次尝试系统 Chrome、Edge、Chromium。Linux 可用 `install --with-deps chromium`。

发布包：

```bash
npm run build
npm pack --pack-destination artifacts
```

贡献前阅读 [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) 和 [规格](docs/spec.md)。涉及宿主接口的变化仍需在实际 DSH 中联调，不能只用合成宿主检查宣称兼容。

## 来源与许可

本项目采用 [MIT License](LICENSE)。插件最初位于 draft-board 的 `plugins/dsh-board/`，从提交 `c37c6fe` 拆出。

白板界面和纯模型来自锁定的 draft-board，安装包保留其许可证及来源。构建会收集所嵌入运行依赖的许可证，写入 `lib/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt`；包含 React、KaTeX、markdown-it、fflate、nanoid 等依赖的声明。DSH 本体由使用者单独安装，本插件不打包分发 DSH 源码。

plugins.description: DSH plugin: enforce AI rules and protect tools/paths from accidental modification.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-bulwark

DSH 插件：向 systemPrompt 注入守则段，并在工具调用层拦截受保护路径的修改与受保护插件的卸载。

## 功能

- **守则注入**：把一个可配置的守则段写进 systemPrompt，位置由中心顺序表推导。
- **路径保护**：拦截对 protectedPaths 内路径的写 / 删 / 移动（含相对路径与 cd 链解析、重定向、dd / truncate / tee、python / node 内联脚本）。
- **插件卸载保护**：命中 protectedRemovalPatterns 关键词的卸载 / 删除命令一律拦截。
- **配置热重载**：监听 config.json，改动后无需重启。
- **逃生通道**：一个环境变量即可完全禁用。

## 安装

```
dsh plugin add github:Hashing2030/dsh-bulwark
```

安装后重启 DSH 生效。

> **首次启动会看到一行提示**：
> `[dsh-bulwark:config] watcher unavailable, config changes need a restart: ENOENT...`
> 这不是错误。它表示 config.json 还没创建，热重载暂未启用。创建配置文件后此提示自动消失。

## 配置

配置文件路径：`$DSH_HOME/dsh-bulwark/config.json`（`DSH_HOME` 未设置时退回 `~/.dsh`）。

完整默认值：

```json
{
  "rulesText": "[dsh-bulwark 守则] 部分工具和路径受保护，不要尝试绕过。",
  "protectedPaths": [],
  "protectedRemovalPatterns": [
    { "keywords": ["dsh plugin", "remove", "dsh-bulwark"] },
    { "keywords": ["dsh plugin", "remove", "dsh-plugin-host-template"] },
    { "keywords": ["dsh plugin", "remove", "dsh-plugin-client-template"] },
    { "keywords": ["pnpm", "remove", "dsh-bulwark"] },
    { "keywords": ["npm", "uninstall", "dsh-bulwark"] }
  ]
}
```

字段说明见 [CONFIG.md](CONFIG.md)。

## 用 CLI 管理配置（推荐）

不建议手改 JSON。用 scripts/protect.sh：

```
# 从插件安装目录进入（路径按实际 profile 替换）
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-bulwark

./scripts/protect.sh add /path/to/protect
./scripts/protect.sh list
./scripts/protect.sh remove /path/to/protect
./scripts/protect.sh test "rm -rf /path/to/protect/foo"
./scripts/protect.sh set-rules "[dsh-bulwark 守则] 新的守则内容"
```

也可以克隆一份仓库，用仓库里的脚本操作同一个配置文件：

```
git clone https://github.com/Hashing2030/dsh-bulwark
cd dsh-bulwark
./scripts/protect.sh add /path/to/protect
```

完整命令说明见 [SCRIPT-USAGE.md](SCRIPT-USAGE.md)。

## 逃生通道

```
DSH_FORTRESS_DISABLE=1 dsh web
```

设置这个环境变量后，DSH 启动时完全不加载 dsh-bulwark。清除即恢复。

> 变量名 DSH_FORTRESS_DISABLE 中的 FORTRESS 是项目旧名（dsh-fortress）的遗留。改名时保留它是为了不破坏已有配置。

## 本地开发

```
pnpm install
pnpm build          # tsdown → dist/index.js
dsh web --patch cordis.yml    # 用源码路径加载，不用装
```

## 测试

```
pnpm test:e2e       # 71 条端到端回归
```

## 相关文档

- [配置说明](CONFIG.md)
- [脚本用法](SCRIPT-USAGE.md)
- [灾难恢复](DISASTER-RECOVERY.md)
- [测试说明](TESTING.md)
- [迁移记录](MIGRATION.md)

## 许可证

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
# Analog Liquid Glass for DeepSeek Harness

> **把 DeepSeek Harness 的输入框变成一片模拟质感的液态玻璃。**

顶部镜面高光、内缘白线、边缘溢出的一圈柔光；模型思考时玻璃里往上冒泡；
深浅主题切换带 1.7 秒的从容过渡。

名字里的 **Analog** 指**模拟仪表那种质感**（弯液面、观液管、刻度），不是技术上的"模拟/数字"
—— 对应插件里的玻璃容器、液位式进度与上升的气泡，也与"数字进度条"划清界线。图标即为此意。

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/Siloet-phy/analog-liquid-glass-for-dsh)

![浅色](docs/light.png)
![深色](docs/dark.png)

## 安装

从 GitHub 安装（**当前推荐**，本包尚未发布到 npm）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add github:Siloet-phy/analog-liquid-glass-for-dsh
```

> 桌面版 DSH 的包管理需要**先完全退出 DSH** 再执行；装完重启生效。
> profile 名一般是 `desktop`（桌面版）或 `web`（`dsh web` 起的服务）。

如果只想用短名（需要在 npm 上已发布同名包）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add analog-liquid-glass-for-dsh
```

## 它做了什么

| 元素 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| **磨砂层** | 白雾 + 重度模糊，是"玻璃感"的来源（不是简单叠一层半透明） |
| **顶部镜面高光** | 玻璃最容易辨认的那道柔光 |
| **内缘白线** | 上缘一道发丝白线 |
| **外扩散泛光** | 光从玻璃边缘微微溢到外面一圈 |
| **三点吐泡泡** | **只在模型思考时出现**：三颗泡错开 1/3 周期、同一个出生点，一个破灭、一个新生 |
| **主题过渡** | 浅 ↔ 深切换时，玻璃比整页更慢地插值（1.7s vs 0.9s） |
| **真毛玻璃** | 为做出磨砂感，覆盖原生卡片的背景与 `backdrop-filter`（见下方"设计决定"第 2 条） |

## 两个我坚持的设计决定

1. **玻璃里不放颜色。**
   真正的液态玻璃几乎是"无色"的——透白玻璃 + 染白的雾 + 白边色散。
   颜色只允许出现在**边缘的高光**上。任何"玻璃内部有一团彩色在流动"的做法，
   看着都会像彩色塑料。（我做出过六版彩色玻璃，全被否了。）
2. **玻璃层只往 slot 里"加层"**，靠测量原生卡片的矩形贴合尺寸，不改它的 DOM 结构。
   唯一例外是"真毛玻璃"：为做出磨砂感，会覆盖 `[data-composer-card]` 的背景与
   `backdrop-filter`（这是毛玻璃唯一能成立的物理位置——在卡片内容之上加雾会把文字压淡，
   对它做 `backdrop-filter` 会把文字一起糊掉）。该段集中在 `client.js` 一处、带注释与旋钮，
   删掉即回到纯加层模式；`/` 菜单底板那处小修复同理可删。卸载后不留任何样式。

## 图标

`icon.svg` 的立意是**模拟仪表**，和"数字进度条"划清界线：

一根竖直的**玻璃观液管**（sight tube），里面一柱淡蓝液体，顶端一道**弯液面**
（液体贴管壁上翘的那道弧，是"模拟时代"最一眼可辨的符号），液柱里两点气泡正在上升。
—— 玻璃是容器、液位是进度、气泡是"模型正在思考"，正好对应插件的三件事。

配色与插件本体一致（天蓝 `112,176,244` 为主、冷白为釉）。
多尺寸与深浅底的对照见 [`docs/icon-preview.html`](docs/icon-preview.html)；
设计草图留在 [`docs/icon-concept.svg`](docs/icon-concept.svg)，
上一版图标备份在 [`docs/icon-previous.svg`](docs/icon-previous.svg)。

## 兼容性

- **DSH**：`0.2.0-rc.2` 及以上（依赖 `conversation.input.overlay` slot 与
  `ctx.theme` 的 `theme/change` 事件）。
- **平台**：Web 客户端（桌面版内置浏览器 / `dsh web`）。纯 CLI 会话不受影响。
- **浏览器**：Chromium 系（Electron）。用到 `backdrop-filter` 与 `color-mix()`，需要现代内核。
- **无障碍**：遵循 `prefers-reduced-motion`——开启后所有动画停止，只保留静态玻璃与状态色。

## 开发

```bash
node selftest.mjs                      # 19 项断言：替身环境，验证模块面与 apply() 行为
node livetest.mjs [react-umd 目录]      # 30 项断言：真 React + 真 DOM，验证真的能渲染
```

- **`selftest.mjs`**：用替身把客户端 bundle 完整跑一遍——语法、模块面（`name`/`inject`/`apply`）、
  `apply()` 在有无服务时的行为、slot 注册目标、样式挂载、`theme/change` 订阅、组件渲染。
  **改完 `client.js` 先跑它**，因为客户端 bundle 一旦在最顶层抛错会牵连 Web 端模块系统。
- **`livetest.mjs`**：需要 `react`/`react-dom`/`jsdom`（**故意不进 package.json 依赖**，
  避免让插件包带上开发期重量）。它用**真 React** 把玻璃层真的挂进真 DOM，并验证
  几何锚定（含"包含块非视口"时的差值归零）、fail-closed 行为、
  `running` 状态翻转时 `data-busy` / `data-on` 跟着变、卸载后 DOM 清干净。

> 两个测试装置上的坑（都写进注释了）：
> ① `document`/`window` 必须在 `require('react-dom')` **之前**就位；
> ② 必须用 `createRoot` + `act()`，**不能用 legacy `ReactDOM.render`**——
>    legacy render 会把 passive effects 推到下一个任务，同步断言时会看到
>    "玻璃层没进 DOM"这种**假失败**。

## 技术笔记

- **主题**：直接消费 DSH 的 `--dsw-*` token 与 `body[data-ds-dark-theme]`，
  **不自己管理主题状态**；过渡窗口通过监听 `ctx.theme` 的 `theme/change` 事件实现。
- **挂点**：`conversation.input.overlay`（list，session 作用域）；
  "模型是否在思考"来自标准 props 的 `useSession((s) => s.running)`，
  取不到时退化为观察原生按钮的「发送 ↔ 停止」态（MutationObserver），保证气泡不会静默失效。
- **几何**：玻璃层用 `position:fixed` + 实测原生卡片矩形写进 CSS 变量。
  ⚠ 取的是「卡片矩形 − 自身矩形」的**差值**，不能直接用卡片的视口坐标——
  卡片一旦带 `backdrop-filter` 就会成为 fixed 的包含块，直接写会偏移叠加两次。
  找不到卡片则整体隐藏（fail-closed）。
- **踩过的坑**（都写进注释了）：
  - **已删除的「镶边」**：曾用"放大盒子 + `mask-composite` 只留边线"做 1.5px 绕行亮边，
    深色下会变成**一圈巨大的旋转发光矩形**（用户点名要求删掉）。教训：`mask-composite`
    必须 `-webkit-` 前缀与标准属性**双写**，且**绝不要放大盒子**；要做镶边应让盒子就是玻璃本身。
  - 玻璃里的彩色无论多淡都会显土；低饱和色块压在深底上还会变泥浆色。
  - 循环动画必须让元素在关键帧里**自己收束**——曾做成"无限上浮"，到顶被裁掉，看不出破灭。
  - 给会动的元素做 `scaleY` 调幅度时**必须显式写 `transform-origin`**，否则元素会"消失"。
  - 读 `getComputedStyle` / 条件调用 hook 都会在真实环境里炸；前者要 try/catch，后者要定序。
- **参考**：
  [wxperia/liquid-glass-vue](https://github.com/wxperia/liquid-glass-vue) 与
  [rdev/liquid-glass-react](https://github.com/rdev/liquid-glass-react)（折射位移图的算法来源），
  以及 Apple 的液态玻璃设计语言。

## 截图说明

`docs/light.png` 与 `docs/dark.png` 是设计稿（单文件 HTML 演示）在浏览器里的实拍；
插件的实现与设计稿逐像素对齐（同一套 CSS）。设计稿与全部探索过程在同一作者的
`magic-cast` 工作目录里，未随包发布。

## 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> remove analog-liquid-glass-for-dsh
```

卸载后输入框恢复原样，不会残留样式（样式表随插件生命周期移除）。

## 许可证

MIT

plugins.description: Traceable context compaction for DeepSeek Harness: hierarchical summaries, source retrieval and verified DM session rotation.
plugins.readme_text:
# Lossless Context for DeepSeek Harness

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) · [Security](SECURITY.md)

A **hierarchical context-compaction and retrieval backend** for DSH. Keep the native session history intact while building traceable summary nodes and allowing agents to retrieve their original supporting text.

## Features

- Uses the native DSH compaction transaction; the plugin does **not** replace or delete source session logs.
- Summarizes bounded, tool-call-safe event groups into a layered source DAG.
- Exposes one session-local model tool, `lcm_recall`, with `action: 'search'` (default), `action: 'describe'` (summary DAG), and `action: 'expand'` (raw source by sequence, DAG node, or query).
- Adapts headroom, target summary length and output budgets to the **actual selected model**; model failures, timeouts and truncated summaries are handled with bounded attempts and safe commit rules.
- Can prepare reusable summary leaves during idle maintenance without committing compaction.
- Optionally rotates eligible owner-verified Discord/Feishu direct-message sessions after a verified [Dream & Memory](https://github.com/Kerberos255/dsh-memory-dreaming) handoff; recent rotation failures are backed off rather than retried every idle turn.

## Task-end compaction and retained history

The default leaf **source input** chunk is **24,000 tokens** (not the completion cap). Successful, complete leaf and condensed summaries are cached in the derived local SQLite index for up to 7 days, capped at 128 per session / 512 globally and 128 KiB each. A failed multi-stage compaction never publishes an incomplete checkpoint; next retry or restart reuses fragments only when source content, model and summary settings match. The default per-request summarizer timeout is 240 seconds to allow slower valid merged summaries.


Normal pressure threshold checks now schedule **idle compaction after a completed turn**, while active turns only compact for imminent pressure or provider-confirmed context overflow. Both modes use the same `retainRatio` / `retainTokens` budget (including model-specific policies); a threshold such as 0.5 controls *when*, not how much recent text is retained.

The installed DSH RC.2 `compactNow` safety path did not expose a retained-tail parameter. The bundled MIT-licensed, narrowly adapted native helper adds that argument and otherwise preserves the native idle maintenance, complete tool-pair boundaries, durable transaction, cancellation, and checkpoint flushing. It must be reviewed again when updating DSH; see `native/SOURCE.md`.

A provider can advertise a very high absolute `maxTokens` ceiling. Proactive emergency compaction now uses a bounded output forecast, rather than treating that entire ceiling as the expected next completion. It targets near-window pressure while preserving the native context-overflow recovery path; exceptionally long generations can still exceed the forecast. Idle compaction retries a temporarily busy native maintenance slot up to three times, only while the agent is idle.

Transport errors and truncated summaries use separate bounded retries; timeout and output budgets are independently configurable. A successful unit test does not substitute for a live model compaction test.

## Install and enable

Requires a compatible DSH host with its native session, token-meter and compaction services. See [package.json](package.json) for peer dependencies.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Kerberos255/dsh-lossless-context
```

Then open **Settings → Plugins → Lossless Context**, enable the backend, and choose the `dsh-lossless-context/agent` compaction backend for the agent preset that should use it. Installing the settings plugin alone does not guarantee that every preset uses this backend. Restart when changing plugin code or preset composition.

## How it works

```text
Native session events
  → native compaction selection
  → bounded summary leaves → merged summary DAG
  → native commit (only on success)
  → searchable index with references to source event IDs
```

The current session keeps its native record. Retrieval and expansion resolve back to original source events. Model/provider limits and existing policies control thresholds; unavailable model metadata causes a safe error instead of invented budgets.

## Safety, storage, and tests

The plugin stores **derived indexes** under DSH's data directory, not a second complete conversation history. Invalid, cancelled, oversized or truncated summaries are not committed. Private-channel auto-rotation requires verified owner/workspace bindings and completed Dream evidence; ordinary desktop/group/unverified sessions are not silently moved.

Run `npm test` for portable policy/regression tests. Real compaction and summary quality require an active model and DSH host. Example settings: [config.example.json](config.example.json). Historical notes: [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).

Related: [Dream & Memory](https://github.com/Kerberos255/dsh-memory-dreaming) · [Channel Core](https://github.com/Kerberos255/dsh-channel-core).

MIT licensed. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).

## Optional plugin diagnostics

The plugin optionally emits privacy-restricted operation and failure metadata to dsh-plugin-diagnostics. Diagnostics contain event type, status, fixed error code and elapsed time; conversation content and credentials are not logged. The diagnostics plugin is optional and does not change the host requirements.

## Editable compaction guidance

Leaf and merged summaries can include customizable default quality guidance emphasizing project decisions, exact file paths/configuration names, validation evidence, and task state changes. A **Restore default** button resets the setting. Guidance supplements the native compaction protocol: tool pairing, source retention, cancellation and complete-transaction checks are unchanged. Changes to the summary policy invalidate stale reusable leaves.

plugins.description: DSH host plugin: detect long tasks (long-output & multi-step) and auto-split them for small-context local models - parts skeleton or PLAN.md ledger plus injected execution rules.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-task-splitter

**A DSH host plugin that notices long tasks and splits them before they fail — built for small-context local models.**

[中文说明见下方](#中文说明)

Small local models (llama.cpp / Ollama, e.g. Qwen3 27B at IQ2 with `maxTokens: 8192`) fail long tasks in two
*completely different* ways. This plugin detects both on the **host side** and hands the model an executable
procedure, instead of hoping the model judges its own limits.

| | **Lane A — long output** | **Lane B — long workflow** |
|---|---|---|
| Example | "write a 3000-word industry report, 4 sections" | **"pick me a stock likely to rise tomorrow"** |
| Prompt shape | usually explicit | **often tiny** ("pick me a…") |
| Real bottleneck | the per-request output budget (`maxTokens`) | **step count and context**: tool output floods the window, a small model drifts, intermediate results get lost |
| What this plugin does | scaffolds `tasks/<slug>/parts/NN-*.md` + `MANIFEST.json`; one part per reply, then `assemble` | scaffolds `tasks/<slug>/PLAN.md` + `notes/`; **plan first, one step per reply, results on disk** |

## How it decides

Scoring runs in the host (no model cooperation needed):

- **Lane A signals** — explicit word/char count, explicit part count, numbered section list (used as part titles),
  long-document keywords + a writing verb, very long prompt, multi-deliverable phrasing.
- **Lane B signals** — decision/research verbs (pick / recommend / evaluate / compare / analyse / predict / research / screen)
  **plus** a data-dependent domain noun (stocks, funds, housing, flights, insurance, papers, competitors, laptop…),
  explicit multi-step phrasing, or "needs current external data".
- Single-lookup requests ("what's the weather tomorrow") are deliberately clamped below the threshold.

Examples:

| Prompt | Result |
|---|---|
| `what's the weather` | no split |
| `look up tomorrow's weather for me` | no split (single lookup) |
| `recommend me a movie` | no split (score 2 < 3) |
| **`pick me a stock likely to rise tomorrow`** | **Lane B** → `PLAN.md` + `notes/`, "plan first, one step per reply" |
| `compare these three laptops and pick one` | **Lane B** |
| `write a 3000-word industry report, 4 parts` | **Lane A** → 4-part skeleton |
| a prompt with a 1./2./3. section list | **Lane A** (part titles taken from the list) |

The procedure is injected with `agent/pre-step` **prepended to the very same request** (no extra round trip),
and only for steps that start from a human message.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add dsh-task-splitter
```

Restart DSH afterwards. To build from source: `npm pack` then
`dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add file:./dsh-task-splitter-0.1.0.tgz`.

Requires a DSH host that exposes `agent/pre-step`, `ctx.agents` and `ctx.sessions`
(`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent` / `dsh-session` `^0.1.1-rc.2 || ^0.2.0-rc.1`).

## Configuration

```yaml
# in your profile cordis patch (or a home patch)
- id: task-splitter
  config:
    enabled: true
    providers: [qwen-local]   # empty array = every provider
    lanes: [parts, plan]      # drop one to disable that lane
    minScore: 3               # Lane A threshold
    workflowScore: 3          # Lane B threshold (raise to 4 to be more conservative)
    maxParts: 8               # Lane A: at most this many parts
    wordsPerPart: 900         # Lane A: target chars per part
    tasksDir: tasks           # relative to the session working directory
    toolPath: ''              # CLI used in the injected rules; defaults to the bundled one
    extraRules: ''            # 追加到注入规程末尾的补充说明（放环境特定的工具名/服务地址）
```

## Bundled CLI

`dsh-task-parts` (also exported as `dsh-task-splitter/task-parts`) drives Lane A outside the model:

```bash
node bin/task-parts.mjs init <taskDir> --title "T" --parts "one|two|three"
node bin/task-parts.mjs status <taskDir>     # ✅/⬜ per part, exits 2 while incomplete
node bin/task-parts.mjs next <taskDir>       # the next part to write
node bin/task-parts.mjs assemble <taskDir>   # concatenates into final.md
```

## Limitations (please read)

- Lane B guarantees **process and honesty** (plan, evidence on disk, sources, uncertainty, "do not fabricate data"),
  **not** the correctness of the answer. A local model with no market/financial data source cannot honestly predict
  tomorrow's stock move — the procedure makes it say so instead of inventing numbers.
- Detection is heuristic. `workflowScore` / `minScore` are the knobs; the plugin never blocks a turn — worst case it
  adds one short instruction message.
- Tested against a Windows DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 host with llama.cpp-served Qwen3; 27 offline simulation cases ship in
  [`test-sim.mjs`](./test-sim.mjs) (not included in the npm tarball).

## License

MIT

---

## 中文说明

**DSH 宿主插件：在长任务失败之前识别它并拆开 —— 为小上下文本地模型而做。**

本地小模型（llama.cpp / Ollama，例如 `maxTokens: 8192` 的 Qwen3-27B IQ2）会在**两类完全不同的**长任务上翻车，
本插件在**宿主侧**把两类都识别出来，并交给模型一套可执行的规程，而不是指望模型自己判断极限。

| | **车道 A：产出型** | **车道 B：流程型** |
|---|---|---|
| 例子 | "写一篇 3000 字的行业报告，分 4 部分" | **"帮我选一只明天大概率会涨的股票"** |
| 提示词 | 通常明确 | **可能极短** |
| 真正瓶颈 | 单次输出预算（`maxTokens`） | **步骤数与上下文**：工具结果塞满窗口、小模型多步跑偏、中间结果丢失 |
| 插件动作 | 建 `tasks/<slug>/parts/NN-*.md` + `MANIFEST.json`；每轮只写一段，最后 `assemble` | 建 `tasks/<slug>/PLAN.md` + `notes/`；**先立计划、每轮一步、结果落盘** |

判定在宿主侧打分（不依赖模型自觉）：车道 A 看字数/分段/分节列表/长文关键词/超长提示词；
车道 B 看**决策研究类动词 + 依赖数据的领域名词**、显式多步措辞、是否需要实时外部信息；
单次查询类（"帮我查一下天气"）会被压到阈值以下。

规程通过 `agent/pre-step` **前置到同一次请求**里（不额外耗一轮），且只处理以人类消息开始的那一步。

安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的profile> add dsh-task-splitter
```

装完重启 DSH。配置项同上（`lanes` / `minScore` / `workflowScore` / `maxParts` / `wordsPerPart` / `tasksDir` / `toolPath`）。

**局限**：车道 B 保证的是**过程与诚实性**（计划、证据落盘、来源、不确定性、禁止编造数据），**不保证答案正确**；
本地没有行情/财务数据源时，它就该说"给不出可靠结论"，而不是编数字。检测是启发式的，
`workflowScore` / `minScore` 可调；最坏情况只是多注入一条很短的指令，不会阻塞任何一轮。

MIT 许可。

plugins.description: Manim 渲染：AI 在聊天里写 Python Manim 代码，当场在聊天流卡片里渲染（可独立运行）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-manim-card

给 DeepSeek Harness 加一个能力：**AI 在聊天里直接写 Manim 代码，当场在聊天流里出现一张可播放的动画卡片**——能播放、能查看代码。

代码在浏览器内执行，运行资源随插件分发，**本机不需要安装 Python**，也不依赖任何外部服务。

![聊天流中的 Manim 动画卡片：标题行、画布，右侧三个按钮](docs/shots/card-preview.png)

> 线上文档（安装 / 在聊天里用 / 设置面板，中英双语）：<https://snowowowo.github.io/dsh-manim-card/>

## 特点

- **卡片就长在聊天流里**：一行标题、一块画布，右侧两个按钮——播放 / 查看代码。播放完停在终态画面，不会自己重来。
- **先预检，再呈现**：代码返回前先在真解释器里跑一遍，语法错与不支持的写法当场回给模型、同一回合修正，聊天里不会留下空白或残缺的卡片。
- **不要求本机 Python**：执行在浏览器内完成，运行资源随插件分发。
- **播放有分寸**：只有刚生成的那张卡真播一遍；重新挂载与旧会话里的卡一律直接落终态。手动播放一键压过全部自动规则。

## 安装

在宿主的插件管理里：

```
dsh plugin add github:snowowowo/dsh-manim-card
```

装完刷新宿主页面，设置里出现「Manim卡片」一节。首次渲染需要取一次运行资源（约 13 MB），之后离线可用。

## 用起来

在会话里说一句「用 Manim 画一个单位圆」，卡片随即出现在聊天流中。更多细节见文档站的[在聊天里用](https://snowowowo.github.io/dsh-manim-card/guide/usage)。

## 开发

技术栈、目录结构、开发流程与测试分工见文档站的[开发与调试](https://snowowowo.github.io/dsh-manim-card/dev/)。

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm build      # 产出 client.js
pnpm test       # 单测（不联网那一档）
pnpm docs       # 本地起文档站
```

## 许可

本项目依 **MIT** 授权，全文见 [LICENSE](./LICENSE)。

随包分发的运行资源与构建产物内联的第三方组件，各依其自身许可——清单见 [THIRD-PARTY.md](./THIRD-PARTY.md)。

# dsh-token-chart

一个 **DeepSeek Harness** 插件：把本机会话的 Token 用量采集下来，以图表与统计的形式放回你正在用的界面里——会话抽屉、每日面板、可自由配置的图表形式。交互参考 DSH 产品自带的「用量」，数据口径与它一致（计费口径，含缓存重读）。

![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%E2%89%A5%200.2.0--rc.2-1c3c3c.svg)
![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A5%2020-339933.svg)
![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-007ec6.svg)

## 🚀 快速开始

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-token-chart
```

> 安装的是发布时预构建好的产物（`lib/` 已构建好），在你的机器上不执行任何构建脚本；用量数据全部留在本机，不上报任何遥测。装好之后怎么用见 [使用指南](#-使用指南)。

## 📖 使用指南

### 三个入口

| 位置 | 入口 | 内容 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 左侧边栏 | 「Token 用量」菜单 | 今天 / 近 3 天 / 近 7 天 / 近 30 天：KPI 卡片 + 趋势图 + 分页表格；「今天」表格的会话列显示会话名称，点击跳转到该会话 |
| 会话标题栏 | 「用量」小按钮（与 ⋯ 菜单同一行，**常驻**） | 右侧边栏抽屉：总 Token、输入/输出、缓存读取/写入、命中率、轮次、模型 + 逐轮趋势图 |
| 设置页 | 设置 →「Token 用量」 | 图表形式、展示指标、开关；标题行含插件版本与更新入口（就地安装 / 重启生效 / HMR profile 指向插件市场） |

页面上会出现三个「用量」入口，它们彼此独立，各由不同的东西控制：

| 你看到的「Token 用量」 | 由什么控制 |
| --- | --- |
| 消息底部 / 输入框上方的「用量」胶囊 | 产品自身的组件；插件只拦截点击，把它改成打开本抽屉（开关：**拦截产品用量按钮**） |
| 会话标题栏右上角的小按钮 | 本插件注册在 `conversation.session.header.utilities` 的入口，**常驻显示**（不设开关） |
| 右侧边栏的标签页标题 | 本插件的 `sidebar.right.pane.tab.title` 座位，**不受**上面那个开关影响 |

### 图表形式与交互

图表形式有 7 种：柱状、折线、饼图、表格、多柱状、多折线、柱状折线组合，会话抽屉与每日面板可以分别配置。

- **缓存命中率叠加**：柱状 / 折线 / 多柱状 / 多折线 / 组合图都可在右轴叠加一条命中率折线（默认开）。
- **范围选择条**：坐标轴下方的 dataZoom，拖动两端或中间窗口即可只看某一段 x 范围（滚轮与触控板捏合同样生效）。缩放只改变可见窗口，不改统计口径——数据表、KPI 卡片与总量始终是完整区间的值。
- **分页数据表**：默认每页 20 条，页大小用下拉切换（10 / 20 / 50），页码为数字按钮 + 省略号（`1 … 4 5 [6] 7 8 … 50`），整条分页栏常驻右下角。切换页大小或数据变化会回到第一页。
- **会话跳转**：「今天」表格的「会话」列显示会话名称（取自 DSH 的会话标题），名称过长时以省略号截断、hover 显示完整名称；点击即可打开对应会话（离开用量面板，主区域切回该会话）。没有标题或会话已不在目录里时，回退显示会话 id 尾部。

x 轴按视图区分，口径如下：

| 视图 | x 轴 | 一个点是什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 每日面板「今天」 | 时间 `HH:mm`（同分钟多轮自动补到 `HH:mm:ss`） | 一轮的用量 |
| 每日面板「近 3 / 7 / 30 天」 | 日期 | 一天 |
| 会话抽屉 | `#轮次` | 会话内的一轮 |

### 配置

配置在**设置 →「Token 用量」**里改，落盘到 `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-token-chart/prefs.json`（默认 `~/.dsh/...`）。

| 字段 | 类型 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sessionChart` | 枚举 | `multi-bar` | 会话抽屉的图表形式 |
| `dailyChart` | 枚举 | `multi-bar` | 每日面板的图表形式 |
| `sessionMetrics` | 数组 | `["input","output","cache","total"]` | 会话抽屉展示的指标 |
| `dailyMetrics` | 数组 | `["input","output","cache","total"]` | 每日面板展示的指标 |
| `showTable` | 布尔 | `true` | 图表下方是否渲染数据表 |
| `showCacheHitRate` | 布尔 | `true` | 组合图是否叠加缓存命中率折线 |
| `interceptUsageButton` | 布尔 | `true` | 点击产品「用量」胶囊时打开本插件抽屉 |

枚举值：`bar` / `line` / `pie` / `table` / `multi-bar` / `multi-line` / `bar-line`；指标值：`input` / `output` / `cache` / `total`。非法值会被 `normalizePrefs()` 丢弃并回退到默认，不会让界面挂掉。

### 数据与口径

- 数据目录：`$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-token-chart/`（默认 `~/.dsh/storages/dsh-token-chart/`），`usage.json` 是用量库，`prefs.json` 是界面偏好。
- **只保留最近 30 个自然日**，更早的轮次在每次落盘前滚动丢弃（超出窗口的会话会被整条移除）。
- **幂等采集**：按 `(轮次, 步骤, 重试世代)` 存槽位，重放会话日志不重复计数；存储 schema 不符时丢弃并从日志重建。
- **会话总量**取会话级折叠，而不是把逐轮数字相加；运行时还会与产品的 `tokenUsage` 投影交叉校验，不一致时抽屉里会显式提示。
- **口径提醒**：这里的「总 Token」是计费口径——每次请求的上下文（含缓存重读）都计入，所以一个约 1.5M 上下文的会话跑 350 步会得到约 150M；它不是「上下文大小」。
- **网络**：唯一的出网行为是版本检查（profile 的 `.npmrc` registry，缺省 `https://registry.npmmirror.com/`，宿主侧缓存 30 分钟、超时 12 秒）；用量数据只写本机。

### 进阶：用 HTTP API 读写

宿主半边在 Harness 的 web server 上提供这些路由（`/token-chart/api` 前缀），脚本与外部工具可以直接用：

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/token-chart/api/health` | 采集器状态（保留天数、已跟踪会话数、偏好是否加载、回填是否完成） |
| GET | `/token-chart/api/prefs` | 读取配置（含默认值） |
| POST | `/token-chart/api/prefs` | 保存配置补丁 |
| GET | `/token-chart/api/overview?range=today\|3d\|7d\|30d` | 区间统计（按天分桶 + 今天逐轮明细；未知区间回退到 `today`） |
| GET | `/token-chart/api/session?sessionId=…` | 单会话逐轮用量 |
| GET | `/token-chart/api/version` | 插件版本、registry 最新版与更新状态 |
| POST | `/token-chart/api/update` | 触发一次版本更新 |
| POST | `/token-chart/api/reset` | 清空本地用量库 |

改配置（补丁式，只写要改的键）：

```bash
curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:19387/token-chart/api/prefs \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"dailyChart":"bar-line","showCacheHitRate":false}'
```

## ✨ 特性

- **会话抽屉**：单个会话的逐轮用量趋势 + 文字统计，从会话标题栏一键打开。
- **每日面板**：今天 / 近 3 天 / 近 7 天 / 近 30 天四个区间，KPI + 趋势图 + 数据表。
- **会话跳转**：「今天」表格的会话列显示会话名称，长名称省略号截断、hover 显示完整名称，点击打开对应会话。
- **7 种图表形式**：柱状、折线、饼图、表格、多柱状、多折线、柱状折线组合，会话与面板可分别配置。
- **缓存命中率叠加**：柱状 / 折线 / 多柱状 / 多折线 / 组合图都可在右轴叠加命中率折线（默认开）。
- **范围选择条**：坐标轴下方的 dataZoom，拖动只看某一段 x 范围；缩放不改变统计口径（KPI、总量、表格始终是完整区间）。
- **分页数据表**：默认 20 条/页，页大小 10 / 20 / 50 下拉切换，页码为数字按钮 + 省略号，常驻右下角。
- **接管产品「用量」胶囊**：点击改为打开本插件抽屉，而不是产品自带的对话框（可关）。
- **口径与产品一致**：总 Token 采用计费口径（每次请求的上下文含缓存重读都计入）；运行时与产品的 `tokenUsage` 投影交叉校验，不一致会在抽屉里显式提示。
- **幂等采集**：按 `(轮次, 步骤, 重试世代)` 存槽位，重放会话日志不重复计数；存储 schema 不符时丢弃并从日志重建。
- **降级可用**：ECharts chunk 拉取失败（离线、被拦、产物损坏）时自动回退到内置自绘 SVG，界面不会空掉。
- **零运行时依赖**：宿主半边不 import 任何 `@deepseek-ai/*`，浏览器半边只把 react 平台种子留作 external，安装不需要 peer 解析或共享实例授权。
- **懒加载图表库**：启动只需 ~70 KB 的 `client.js`（gzip 20 KB），首次出图才拉 618 KB 的 ECharts chunk（gzip 234 KB）。
- **版本检查**：设置页自动查一次新版（30 分钟缓存）。可就地安装的 profile 才显示「更新版本」按钮，完成后按插件管理器返回的结果给出「已安装，重启 DSH 生效」或真实失败原因；启用 HMR 的 profile（如桌面端）不能就地升级，会提示到「插件市场」更新并重启。

## 🛠 本地开发与调试

源码全部是 TypeScript（浏览器半边 TSX + JSX automatic runtime）；`src/` 是唯一事实来源，**一切产物落在 `lib/` 且不入 git**。

```bash
git clone https://github.com/lugezuishuai/dsh-token-chart.git && cd dsh-token-chart
npm install              # 触发 prepare：全量构建出 lib/
npm run typecheck        # 两个工程分别类型检查（宿主 + 浏览器）
npm run build            # 清空 lib/ 后全量重建
npm run check            # 发布门禁：typecheck + build + preflight + 宿主用例
```

| 命令 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `npm run build:host` / `:styles` / `:client` / `:chunk` | 单独重跑某一段（tsc / tailwind+less / esbuild / esbuild） |
| `npm run preflight` | 产物与元数据自检：loader id、包名、四件产物、registry、lockfile |
| `npm run test:host` | 宿主套件：折叠语义、跨天分桶、配置校验、落盘、版本检查 |
| `npm run test:client` | 浏览器套件：jsdom 加载**真实产物**，通过 HTTP 连**运行中的** Harness |
| `npm run format` | prettier：`src/**`、`tests/**`、`scripts/**` |

调试期建议隔离数据目录，避免污染真实用量库：

```bash
DSH_HOME=$(mktemp -d) npm run test:host     # 宿主用例必须用独立 DSH_HOME

# 浏览器用例需要运行中的 Harness（默认 http://127.0.0.1:19387）与一个真实会话 id
DSH_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:19387 DSH_SESSION_ID=<session-id> npm run test:client
```

| 环境变量 | 作用 | 默认 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DSH_HOME` | 数据根目录（`usage.json` / `prefs.json` 在其下） | `~/.dsh` |
| `DSH_ORIGIN` | 浏览器用例连接的 Harness 地址 | `http://127.0.0.1:19387` |
| `DSH_SESSION_ID` | 浏览器用例打开的会话 | 内置一个示例 id |
| `REACT_DIR` / `JSDOM_DIR` | 用例解析 `react` / `jsdom` 的目录 | npx 缓存目录 |

> 浏览器用例会在跑前快照、跑后恢复你的真实偏好；jsdom 没有 canvas 与布局，脚本会补 `HTMLCanvasElement.getContext` 与 `clientWidth` 垫片，浏览器端不需要。

让宿主半边也热加载（默认只热替换浏览器半边）：把插件目录加进 profile 的 hmr 监听根，改 `src/**` 重建后即时生效，无需重启。

```yaml
# ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml
- id: hmr
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-hmr'
  config:
    root:
      - /path/to/dsh-token-chart
```

> 构建请用你自己的 Node（本机为 `~/.nvm/versions/node/v22.22.0`）。DSH 自带的 Node 在 macOS 上无法 dlopen tailwind 的 `lightningcss` 原生模块，`build:styles` 会失败。

## 📦 构建与发布

构建产物与 DSH 包契约一一对应，全部落在 `lib/`：

| 产物 | 生成方式 | 被谁读 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `lib/index.js` + `lib/*.js` | `tsc`（`package.json#main`） | DSH 宿主进程 |
| `lib/types/*.d.ts` | `tsc`（`package.json#types`） | 消费方类型检查 |
| `lib/client.js` | `esbuild` → `__ModuleLoader__` CJS 工厂（**不压缩**，逐行可审阅） | 浏览器（`exports["./client"]`） |
| `lib/client.echarts.js` | `esbuild` → 压缩、自包含的懒加载 chunk | 浏览器（`require.async`） |
| `lib/token-chart.css` | `tailwindcss` + `lessc` | 浏览器（宿主路由下发） |

```bash
npm run check            # 发布门禁：typecheck + build + preflight + 宿主用例
npm pack                 # prepack 自动重建 + preflight，然后打包
npm version patch        # 版本号即 tag，更新检查按版本号比较，两者务必一致
npm publish              # publishConfig 固定发往 registry.npmjs.org
```

发布也可以交给 CI：[.github/workflows/release.yml](.github/workflows/release.yml) 在**推送到 main**（含 PR 合并）与**手动触发**时运行——跑门禁 → 版本还不在 npm 上就自动发布、打 `v<version>` tag、建 GitHub Release；版本已存在则只跑门禁。认证走 **npm Trusted Publishing（OIDC）**，仓库里不存任何 npm token；预发布版本按 preid 走独立 dist-tag（`0.1.1-rc.1` → `rc`），不会顶掉 `latest`。

发布流水线要点：

1. **`prepack` = 全量构建 + `scripts/preflight.mjs`**，因此 tarball 一定带着四件产物与 `lib/types`；产物不进 git，`files` 白名单决定包内容。
2. **安装与发布都走 npmjs 源站**：项目 `.npmrc` 与 `package.json#publishConfig.registry` 都指向 `https://registry.npmjs.org/`——镜像是只读的、不接受发布，统一在源站可以让"消费者装到的版本"与"发布出去的版本"始终一致。
3. **preflight 检查**：包名与 loader id 一致（改名事故的护栏）、四件产物存在、`cordis.patch.yml` 按包名插入、`private` 已移除、`engines.dsh` 已声明、lockfile 不含内网/私有 registry。

plugins.description: dsh plugin: read-only host diagnostics (log tail, service-face reachability, crash attribution) plus a key-gated session mouth, closed by default.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-backroom

A read-only **back room** for DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) plugin authors: it makes the host's own log buffer readable over loopback HTTP, and reports — live, in the running process — which official service faces a plugin can actually reach.

`dsh-backroom` is a community plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/). Not an official DeepSeek AI product.

## Why this plugin exists

Two things were missing on the installed desktop host (0.2.0-rc.2), and neither is an API gap:

- **Nobody reads the host's log buffer.** `ctx.logger`'s only built-in sink is cordis' in-memory ring (`logger.buffer`, 1000 entries), and the shipped product registers a second exporter only for the fatal-startup path. Host code logs through `logger`, not `console` (`dsh-hmr` alone emits 19 logger calls), and in the packaged app the backend child's stdout is piped into a GUI process and lost. So "the plugin mounted but did nothing" had no evidence at all.
- **Reachability was measured once and recorded wrong.** Whether `ctx.get('sessionController')` works from a plugin fiber is decided in the running process, not in a `.d.ts` file. This plugin answers that with a live matrix instead of a guess.

## What it does

Current build is the **probe + fault-attribution + narrow session mouth + session-creation** shape: host half only, **six** loopback routes (four read-only, two that act), no UI, and no disk writes from the plugin.

| Route | Returns |
|---|---|
| `GET /dsh-backroom/probe` | Per-service matrix: for each name, `ctx.get(name, true)` / `ctx.get(name, false)` reported separately as `present(<type>)` / `absent` / `threw: <message>`, plus the face's own method names; property-access results for declared vs undeclared deps; `hmr.getLinked()` as-is; how many log records were already buffered before this plugin applied (that is the replayability reading); node/argv/`DSH_*` env **names**; `ctx.fiber.state`. |
| `GET /dsh-backroom/logs?limit=&level=&contains=` | The log tail: everything `ctx.logger` produced since apply **plus** plugin `console.error/warn` output. `level` accepts `error\|info\|warn\|debug` or the official numeric levels 0..3. Ring cap 4000 lines, with the dropped count reported. |
| `GET /dsh-backroom/faults?limit=&dir=` | **Crash attribution**: reads the desktop crash sinks (`%APPDATA%\@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop\logs\crash-*-host.log` / `-renderer.log`) and per file returns the first *installed-bundle* frame (the suspect), the first official frame (the face it mis-called), the `dsh: fatal …` cause line and the wrapper line **as two separate fields**. Files with no installed-bundle frame come back with a reason instead of a guess (`renderer-crash` / `no-stack` / `kill-shaped` / `no-installed-bundle-frame`). **`kill-shaped` was added on 10-19** and is the one that matters for the "your write mouth killed my host" claim: `exit=-1` plus no `dsh: fatal` line plus ≤6 frames means *the backend child was taken out from outside* — the same shape a `Stop-Process` restart leaves behind — so the attribution tool **refuses** to blame a plugin for it (`row.killShaped=true`). Default root is the desktop tree; a CLI instance points it with `DSH_BACKROOM_CRASH_LOGS=<dir>`. `dir` must sit inside an allowed root — this route is cookie-free, so it must not become a local file-read oracle; anything else gets **403**. |
| `GET`/`POST /dsh-backroom/session?session=&key=` | **The narrow session mouth (closed by default)**: `GET` reads one allow-listed session's turn face from the projections that are *actually in the public bag* (`turnOutline`, an array of `{turn,seq,prompt,response}`, and `sessionStats.turns`) and returns `turnCount/lastTurn/lastResponseChars/asOfSeq/readable`; `POST` sends one prompt into that **already-registered** session, and `&wait=turn-end&timeoutMs=…` waits until a new turn appears **and** its `response` has been filled by `turn/end`, returning `ended/endedClaim/turnStarted/assistantResponded/waitedMs`. Only the official handlers are used — `sessionController.prompt(request, signal)` / `.projections(request, signal)`, **both arguments required**. Measured end-to-end on the packaged desktop 10-09: one prompt took `turnCount 1→2`, `asOfSeq 19→30`, and the durable log holds exactly two `turn/end reason:"completed"` with two replies. When the criterion cannot be read the route self-reports `endedClaim:"unreadable"` instead of calling it "not finished". (The earlier wording — read `turnBoundary.lastTurn` — was a guess; that unit is not in the public bag. See `docs/PLUGIN-RULES.md` §H.5.) |
| `GET /dsh-backroom/presets` | **Read-only, no key**: the live official roster from `agentPresets.list()` (`{id,name?,description?,order?,broken?}` — activation failures come back *with* their reason) plus `defaultId`, then `permissionPresets.catalog()` (`names`/`options`/`defaultPreset`) and the current state of all five gates. If this machine's default permission preset is the widest one, the route says so in a `permissionWarning`. Measured 10-19 on the packaged desktop: **8 presets** — `standard` (default), `ptc`, `minimal`, `cordis`, plus one `wsl-*` variant of each ⇒ **preset ids are always read at runtime, never hard-coded** (the roster follows the subscription toggle, per the shipped copy: "标准、创造和自定义 … 开启后还提供 PTC 和极简模式"). |
| `GET`/`POST /dsh-backroom/sessions?key=` | **The session-creation route** (user ruling 10-19: *"no model switching — do the rest"*). `POST {cwd, agentPreset?, caller?}` calls the official `sessionController.create(request)` — the **preset is chosen at creation** (the official `agentPresets.select` jsDoc says verbatim *"Select a preset before a session starts its first turn"*, so an existing session cannot be re-modeled). `POST {op:'archive'\|'unarchive', sessionId}` only ever touches sessions **this plugin created**, via the official `workspaceController.archiveSession`. `GET` returns this process's build-ledger (`owned`/`spendTokens`/quota/budget). Measured twice on the live desktop (`minimal`, then `ptc`): created with title `backroom:<caller>`, one prompt into the fresh session returned `ended:true` (`turn 0→1`, 3.4 s, ledger refreshed to **18,100** tokens), archive returned `archivedNow:true` / `archivedSetSize:13`; out-of-whitelist `cwd` → **403 `cwd-outside-roots`**; trying to archive one of *your* sessions → **403 `not-owned`**. |

All six routes are registered on the plugin's own path prefix through `webServer.register()`, so they answer without the app's session cookie (like `/dsh-chamber/*`). `Cache-Control: no-store`. **The first four are read-only**; the two that act are gated behind an env key, and `sessions` must additionally clear the five gates below. No route writes to disk; the only disk write in this package is the CLI further down, and it writes only after taking a byte-for-byte backup outside the repository.

### One-page usage for another agent (discovery, call format, env, limits)

**How it is discovered** (in order of reliability): ① a model inside dsh sees tool names every turn ⇒ the tool surface carries **`backroom_entry`** (read-only; returns `baseUrl`, the call format of all six routes, every gate and the hard limits); ② any local process can `GET /dsh-backroom/presets` (**no key**); ③ the route table in this README.

**Recognising `baseUrl`** (the port is random since 0.2.1-rc.2): among the listening ports of the `DeepSeek Harness.exe` PID family, take the one whose `GET /dsh-backroom/probe` answers **200**; or just run the launcher, which prints `backend port = …`. **Do not guess the port 0.2.0 hard-coded** — nothing listens there any more (`PITFALLS.md #107`).

**Minimal call sequence** (`$P` = backend port, `$K` = the key the launcher printed):

```bash
# 0) roster (no key): which modes this machine has right now (standard default / ptc / minimal / cordis + four wsl-*)
curl -s "http://127.0.0.1:$P/dsh-backroom/presets"

# 1) create a session (needs the key; cwd must sit under DSH_BACKROOM_WORKSPACE_ROOTS)
curl -s -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:$P/dsh-backroom/sessions?key=$K" -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"cwd":"D:/Temp/backroom-ws","agentPreset":"minimal","caller":"some-agent

plugins.readme_text:
<!-- MIRROR-NOTE:START -->
> [!NOTE]
> 📦 This plugin lives in the [**dsh-plugins**](https://github.com/hy-sde/dsh-plugins) monorepo — file issues & pull requests there.
> npm: [`@hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-tsfork`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-tsfork)
<!-- MIRROR-NOTE:END -->

# dsh-tool-tsfork — Go-native TypeScript compiler devices for DeepSeek Harness

A standalone package, installable as **one plugin** (two device tools) for the
DeepSeek Harness: model-facing devices over a **parked Go-native TypeScript
compiler** — the [can1357/TypeScript](https://github.com/can1357/TypeScript)
perf fork (`perf/checker-speedups-v3`, TS `7.1.0-dev`). `tsfork_status`
reports the binary, version banner and build stamp; `tsfork_check` runs
one-shot `-b` project-graph checks with parsed diagnostics, wall time, and a
GOMAXPROCS cap. The compiler binary is built once and parked on the host; the
plugin only speaks the harness device seam — zero upstream harness changes.

| Identity | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Package | `@hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-tsfork` |
| Plugin id | `hy-sde-tsfork` |
| Devices | `tsfork_status` · `tsfork_check` (device-catalog tools via `dyn`) |

> **Based on [can1357/TypeScript](https://github.com/can1357/TypeScript)**
> (`perf/checker-speedups-v3`, a Go rewrite of
> [microsoft/TypeScript](https://github.com/microsoft/TypeScript), Apache-2.0
> lineage): no compiler code is ported or modified — this package is original
> plugin code that spawns the binary once per call over a stable CLI contract
> (`tsc -b`, JSON-free default output). Adapted, not ported: the harness
> device seam (`device: true` tools via `ctx.tools` + `ctx.systemPrompt`)
> exists so a deployment can expose a fast compiler without touching the
> repo's pinned toolchain. See
> [THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md](THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md).

## Why

The type gate on a large workspace is the stock `tsc -b` over the whole
solution graph — on the fork harness's 337-project host graph that was
**54.25s cold** (91.6s CPU, 4.6GB peak), and every agent that wants a
typecheck pays it serially. The Go compiler checks the same graph
byte-identically (project listings, 14/14 planted errors, deterministic
output) in **7.05s cold / ~0.6s warm** — 7.7× less wall time, 3.4× less CPU.
But nothing in a harness exposes it: gates run through `pnpm` scripts pinned
to `typescript@6.0.3`, and a plugin cannot replace a repo's own toolchain —
nor should it, because oxlint `typeAware` and the typert generator need the
JS API that TS 7 (a Go binary) does not ship. What agents need is a *device*
pointing at a parked binary: loadable per deployment, unloadable by toggling
one row, structured output, no PATH tricks, no upstream changes — while the
pinned toolchain stays exactly as pinned.

## Prerequisites

- Node.js **22.19 or newer** (the package's `engines` floor) with pnpm on `PATH`;
- a DeepSeek Harness installation with the device catalog (the package's peer
  baseline is `@deepseek-ai/cordis ~4.0.5-alpha.1`,
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` / `@deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt`
  `^0.2.1-alpha.2`; registries without the device concept simply present the
  tools eagerly);
- a tsfork compiler binary parked on the host (default `~/.dsh/tsfork/tsc`)
  with a `VERSION` stamp beside it — build it once from a checkout of the
  fork:

  ```bash
  git clone https://github.com/can1357/TypeScript.ts.git typescript.ts   # or your fork
  cd typescript.ts && git checkout perf/checker-speedups-v3
  go build -o ~/.dsh/tsfork/tsc ./cmd/tsc        # inside the tsc/ dir of the checkout
  printf 'source: can1357/TypeScript perf/checker-speedups-v3 @ <commit>\n' > ~/.dsh/tsfork/VERSION
  ```

  (the Go tree ships its generated files — no generate step; Go 1.27+)

## Quick start

### Route A — published npm package (recommended)

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-tsfork
```

> Publishing after the Shape-A trial — until then use Route B.

### Route B — from source (validate this checkout or hack on the plugin)

```bash
git clone git@github.com:hy-sde/dsh-plugins.git
cd dsh-plugins/dsh-tool-tsfork/packages/tool-tsfork
pnpm install
PACKAGE_TARBALL="$(pnpm pack | tail -n 1)"
dsh plugin --profile web add "$PWD/$PACKAGE_TARBALL"
cd ../../../..
```

Deployment variant used for the trial (no `dsh` CLI on PATH, hand-managed
profile): link the built package into the profile with an absolute `file:`
path — `pnpm add file:<abs-path-to-package>` in the profile dir, then add
`@hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-tsfork` to `dsh.profile.bundles`. The package's own
`dsh.bundle.patch` mounts the `hy-sde-tsfork` row.

### Verify the composed configuration

```bash
dsh web --dump-config
```

### Run

Start the harness (`dsh web`) and ask the agent to check or probe a graph.
The model-facing calls (device catalog — `dyn search tsfork`):

- `tsfork_status` (no arguments) — resolved binary, `Version 7.1.0-dev`
  banner, build stamp from `<binaryDir>/VERSION`, 20s health probe.
- `tsfork_check` — `tsc -b <project>`; returns `exitCode`, `wallMs`,
  `errorCount`/`warningCount`, parsed `diagnostics` (`file:line:col TSxxxx`),
  an `outputTail`, and a reproducible `command`. `dry: true` prepends
  `--dry` (list the projects a build would run, without building). Pass
  `cwd` (and `project`) explicitly outside the deployment's default checkout.

### Uninstall

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove @hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-tsfork
```

## What the bundle does

The plugin's `cordis.patch.yml` mounts **one plain agent-plane row**
(`hy-sde-tsfork`) that consumes the deployment's host services — `tools` and
`systemPrompt` (the stock agent bundle provides both). No service, realm, or
filesystem seam of its own: each call spawns the parked compiler once, so
concurrent agent lanes are isolated by construction and the only shared-box
knob is GOMAXPROCS. It also registers the `tsfork:tools` prompt section,
which documents the buildinfo gotcha and the adoption boundary to every
session that mounts the device.

## Engine behavior

- **One-shot spawn, stdin closed.** Every call is `spawn(binary, argv)` with
  `stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe']` — the compiler never reads stdin, and
  a held-open pipe is the classic CLI-wrapper hang.
- **Flag order.** The Go parser requires `-b`/`--build` to precede the
  project path; post-project flags (`--dry`, …) are accepted after it. A
  bare `tsc <tsconfig>` (no `-b`) fails with TS5112 — the plugin always
  sends `-b` first.
- **Timeout semantics.** SIGTERM at `timeoutMs`, SIGKILL 5s later — the
  escalation is scheduled *by* the timeout, never at spawn. A timed-out run
  resolves with `timedOut: true` and the partial output instead of rejecting.
- **Output caps.** stdout/stderr are captured up to `maxOutputBytes` per
  side (default 4 MiB, flagged `outputTruncated`); diagnostics are capped at
  500 with exact counts kept beyond the cap (`diagnosticsTruncated`).
- **`.tsbuildinfo` is compiler-version-tagged.** Alternating `tsfork_check`
  with the repo's stock `tsc -b` invalidates the other side's incremental
  caches — runs go cold. The prompt section warns agents; pick a primary
  and accept the other side paying one cold run.
- **Adoption boundary.** tsfork does not replace the pinned `typescript@6.0.3`
  toolchain: oxlint `typeAware` and typert need the JS API (TS 7's npm
  package is a launcher shim with no `lib/typescript.js`). Promotion, if the
  trial proves out, is a `pnpm` override of the gate binary — not this
  plugin.

## Configuration

| Option | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `binary` | `~/.dsh/tsfork/tsc` | Compiler binary (expandable `~`), must be executable |
| `defaultProject` | — | `-b` project used when a call omits `project` |
| `defaultCwd` | — | Working directory used when a call omits `cwd` |
| `timeoutMs` | `900000` | Per-call process timeout |
| `gomaxprocs` | — | `GOMAXPROCS` written to the child env (lane-friendly parallelism cap) |
| `maxOutputBytes` | `4000000` | Cap on captured stdout/stderr bytes per side |

```yaml
- id: hy-sde-tsfork
  config:
    binary: ~/.dsh/tsfork/tsc
    defaultProject: tsconfig.host.json
    defaultCwd: /path/to/your/checkout
    timeoutMs: 900000
    gomax
