| 入站合并（连打三行算一个回合） | 由 `rhythm` 完成 |
| 情绪 / 主动发言 / 风格学习 | 由 `persona` 提供 |
| 14 条行为规则 | 由 `prompt` 每轮注入 |
| QQ 分享卡片的标题与链接 | `linkcard` 模块（上游只留一个 `[卡片]`） |
| 会话换代防护 | `adopt` 模块 |
| 时间戳与间隔（`time=`/`gap=`） | `stamp` 模块 |
| 群里喊名字也算被叫到 | `mention` 模块 |
| 群里聊到兴趣时插一句 | `mention` 模块的 `topics` |
| 群友回合禁用工具（硬隔离） | `isolation` 模块（`ctx.tools.guard()`） |
| 她自己的小本子（三档遗忘） | `diary` 模块 + `qq_diary` 工具 |
| 答应过的事到点想起来 | `promise` 模块 + `qq_promise` 工具 |
| 关系阶段（不只是个数字） | `tier` 模块（把 `affinity` 投影成台阶） |
| 「她最后一次开口是什么时候」 | `lastword` 模块 + `/physical` 体检表 |

**为什么不手改 `node_modules`**：把那批约定直接写进 `node_modules` 里，`dsh-onebot-qq`
一升级（pnpm 换目录）就会整个被冲掉，同样的坑会再踩一遍。所以本插件一行都不改
`node_modules`，只从外面给原型挂包装 —— 升级不会再把功能冲掉。

### 为什么是一个插件而不是四个

这四个能力最初被拆成 `guard` / `prompt` / `rhythm` / `persona` 四个独立包。合并的理由很实在：

- 四份代码里重复的东西太多 —— `resolveProfileDirs()`（探测 profile 目录）逐字重复两份、
  `patchMethod()` 两份、HTTP 观测面三份、loopback 判定三份、状态落盘两份。
- 四个包各自 `import()` 同一个 `dsh-onebot-qq`，各自起一个 3 秒扫描定时器，各自维护一份统计。
- 用户只装一个、只配一块，比装四个再对着四份文档调参好得多。

合并后：**一个包、一份配置、一个 HTTP 面**，内部按职责分成十七个模块，各自可独立开关。

## 它做什么

| 模块 | 干什么 | 挂在哪 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `guard` | 出站闸：拦 `[[silent]]`、剥整行括号旁白、吞「⏳ 排队提示」「该命令仅管理员可用。」与**自述/报幕**（「我在等他回话」「我已经发了一句过去」这类回合进度，2026-10-19 加）；整条为空就不发 | `OutboundPipeline.prototype.sendToChat` / `sendMsg` |
| `adopt` | 会话换代防护：裸 id 还有磁盘日志时**接管**（resume）而不是把它永久退休、另开一个新会话 | `ChatRegistry.prototype.createChat` |
| `stamp` | 给注入边界补回 `time="..."`（本条消息的时刻）与 `gap="..."`（距上一条的间隔，如 `3m47s`），让模型不必自己做时间戳减法 | `ChatBridge.prototype.handleInbound`（记账）+ `ChatBridge.prototype.dispatchFollowup`（注入） |
| `prompt` | 每轮注入 14 条行为规则 + 情绪行 + 风格行 | 宿主 `agent/pre-step`（不挂原型） |
| `rhythm` | 入站合并（连打三行 = 一个回合）+ 出站分段（一条长回复分几次发） | `ChatBridge.prototype.dispatchFollowup` / `sendToChat` |
| `persona` | 情绪四变量 + 随机主动发言 + 风格学习 | `ChatBridge.prototype.handleInbound` / `onSessionEvent` |
| `mention` | 群里喊她名字算被叫到（`diving` 潜水续话）+ 聊到她感兴趣的方向时插一句（`topics`） | `InboundPipeline.prototype.processInbound` |
| `isolation` | 群聊里非管理员回合禁用一切工具（只留发声 + 白名单内的 `read_image` + 本轮聊天里出现过的链接） | 宿主 `ctx.tools.guard()`（不挂原型） |
| `linkcard` | 把 QQ 分享卡片的正文与跳转链接捞回来：`[卡片]` → `[卡片:标题 https://…]`（直链优先 `qqdocurl`，否则 `jumpUrl`） | `InboundPipeline.prototype.processInbound` |
| `emoji` | 把上游翻错的 emoji 换成 `[表情:名字]`；把被丢弃的商城表情包补成可读图片；认不出的原生表情整条不回 | `InboundPipeline.prototype.processInbound` |
| `sleep` | 睡意闸：说了「去睡/晚安」之后，群里**只有被 @ 或喊名字才接**，私聊照旧 | `InboundPipeline.prototype.processInbound`（优先级 30，在 mention 外层） |
| `hands` | 「社交的手」：`qq_poke`（戳一戳）/ `qq_react`（贴表情回应）/ `qq_like`（名片赞）/ `qq_requests`（查申请）；`qq_approve` **不直接生效**，生成审批单发管理员私聊，等他回 `/同意 编号` | `InboundPipeline.prototype.processInbound`（拦管理员的审批命令） |
| `voice` | `qq_say` 工具：文字 → 合成（edge-tts 云端 / 本机 IndexTTS）→ 作为 QQ 语音发出 | 只注册工具，不挂原型 |
| `lastword` | 记一笔「她最后一次真正开口是什么时候」，含原文片段与累计条数。不改参数、不抛错 | `OutboundPipeline.prototype.sendToChat` / `sendMsg` |

十七个模块中有十一个挂在原型上，且**存在共享挂载点**（`dispatchFollowup` 上是 stamp + rhythm，
`handleInbound` 上是 stamp + persona，`processInbound` 上是 sleep + mention + emoji + linkcard + hands）。它们靠 `core/patch.js`
的模块身份标记共存、互不吞并，链上的先后由模块**优先级**唯一决定，与挂载时序无关。

> `sleep` 的优先级是 **30**（高于 `stamp` 的 20），必须排在 `mention` **外层**：
> `mention` 会给「没 @ 但叫了名字」的消息补一个假 at 段，如果 `sleep` 在内层，
> 那道闸看到的就已经是「被 @ 了」，永远拦不住。

### `adopt` 修的是什么

`dsh-onebot-qq` 原生的 `createChat` 里有这么一段：

```js
let sessionId = makeSessionId(sessionIdForChat(chatId));
if (this.isSessionIdBlocked(sessionId)) {
    sessionId = this.freshSessionId(chatId);
}
else if (await this.hasPersistedLog(sessionId)) {
    this.retireSession(sessionId);          // ← 永久退休，写进 retired-sessions.json
    sessionId = this.freshSessionId(chatId);
}
```

裸 id（如 `onebot-group-535746440`）在磁盘上**还有历史日志**时，它不接管，而是把裸 id
**永久退休**、换一个带时间戳后缀的新 id。`retireSession` 是永久的，此后每次 `createChat`
都从第一个分支掉进 `freshSessionId` —— 表现就是**每条消息开一个新会话**，上下文全丢。

关键区别：**只有 `agents.create()` 会和已存在的日志撞车；`agents.resume()` 正是「接管这份
日志」的那个调用。** 所以本模块从外面包住 `createChat`，在进入原方法之前先做决定。
三种情况**明确放行**给原方法：① `evictedChats` 里有这个 chat（快照 id 比裸 id 更权威）
② 裸 id 已被退休（尊重记录）③ 裸 id 没有持久化日志（没有可接管的）。

会话 id 的推导**直接用上游自己的 `chat.js#sessionIdForChat`**，不在本模块里复刻那个
正则 —— 抄一份就等于埋「上游改了规则而我们还按老规则算 id」的坑，算错 id 的后果是
「采纳一个不存在的会话」，比不采纳更糟。拿不到该函数时**直接放弃挂载**，不退化成猜。

### `stamp` 修的是什么

上游的 `<user_message ...>` 边界上**一点时间信息都没有**。`lib/chat.js` 两个构造器都是
3 参，签名里没有时刻：

```js
export function wrapUserMessage(content, userId, nickname) { … }            // lib/chat.js:133
export function buildGroupMessagePrefix(nickname, userId, mentioned) { … }  // lib/chat.js:109
```

`lib/inbound.js` 的 `normalizeOneBot11(event)` 返回的对象里同样没有 time 字段 —— 它把
`event.time` 丢掉了。所以模型看到的每条消息都是「刚才」，两个时间戳都没有。

**为什么需要**：模型**不会可靠地做两个时间戳的减法**，很容易把「隔了两小时」说成
「过了一整天」。这正是加这两个属性的全部动机 —— 把已经算好的间隔直接递过去，等于把
那道算术从模型手里拿走，让它**没有算术可做错**。

本模块往开标签上补回两个属性：

- `time="2026-10-08T15:15:23+08:00"` —— 对方**按下发送**的时刻（本地时区、带秒；
  保留秒是为了同一分钟内的两条也能排序、能被可靠相减）。
- `gap="3m47s"` —— 距他上一条消息隔了多久，**已经算好**。写法是紧凑、**不含空格**、
  最多两个最高整单位的时长：`47s` / `3m47s` / `15h35m` / `2d4h`。不含空格是为了原样
  穿过下面那道字符白名单，短到一眼能读完。

**首次没有基线时 `gap` 留空，不猜** —— 省略属性好过印一个模型会当真的间隔。跨宿主重启的
「上一条入站时刻」因此要落盘（`stamp-state.json`，与 `mood-state.json` / `style-state.json`
同目录同范式，debounce 3 秒原子替换）。不落盘的话，重启后基线就是空的，第一条只能省略
gap，模型随即去读周期旁白里的 Elapsed 行，又把「两小时」说成「过了一整天」。
基线表**最多 500 个 chat**（沿用同一套 `MAX_CHATS`），超出时按「最久没来消息」淘汰 ——
没有这道闸，那张表会随这辈子收过消息的 chat 数单调增长。

**字符白名单**：两个值都用正则洗过 —— 时间戳只留数字与 `T:+-`
（`replace(/[^0-9T:+-]/g, '')`），间隔只留数字与 `dhms`
（`replace(/[^0-9dhms]/g, '')`）。保证这两个值**永远不可能闭合标签、也永远不可能从
`<user_message>` 边界里逃出去**。文本改写只动**开标签**，块内内容一字不碰；同名属性
先摘掉再写，重复注入 / 热重载重入都不会堆出两个 `time=`。

**为什么挂两个点**：职责不同，两张表语义也**必须分开**。

| 挂载点 | 干什么 | 记的什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ChatBridge.prototype.handleInbound` | **记账**：把 OneBot 事件的 `time`（unix 秒）连同它属于哪个 chat 记下来 | `seenAt`：每次入站都覆盖，含后来被门禁吞掉的未 @ 消息、去重、限流、命令 —— 只回答「这个 chat 最近一次入站是什么时候」 |
| `ChatBridge.prototype.dispatchFollowup` | **注入**：把属性写进交给模型的文本 | `baseline`：注入**成功后**才写，是 `gap` 的基线 —— 只对真正到达模型的消息推进，命令回执之类的投递不污染它 |

`dispatchFollowup` 已被 `rhythm` 挂着（入站合并）。`core/patch.js` 的语义是**后挂的在外层**，
所以本模块必须排在 `scanAll()` 里 rhythm **之后**：这样每条消息各自单独经过本模块（各自注入
自己那一刻的 `time`/`gap`），再由 rhythm 把已注入的几条合并成一批。换过来（本模块在内层）
只会在合并后拿到一整批文本，只能贴一个时间。

chatId 的推导**直接用上游自己的 `chat.js#buildChatId`**，不复刻那个拼法 —— 抄一份就是埋
「上游改了规则而我们还按老规则算」的坑，算错的后果是把时刻记到**别的 chat** 名下。
拿不到该函数时**直接放弃挂载**，不退化成猜。入站时刻还要求像样（2001–2286 年的 unix 秒），
坏值退回当前时刻 —— 一个坏值绝不该给消息盖上胡说八道的钟。

> **已知未补回的一处**：群消息前缀 `[HH:MM 昵称(QQ)]` 不受本模块影响 —— 它用的是**处理时刻**，
> 与 `time` 属性只差几秒，而改写群前缀要啃昵称里的方括号，不划算。

### `mention` 修的是什么

上游 `dsh-onebot-qq/lib/cq.js` 的 `detectMention` 只认两件事：`at` 段指向机器人、或
`reply` 段（引用）指向机器人。**在群里直接喊「云玥」不算。** 这跟真人群聊的习惯不一样 ——
真人被叫名字就知道在叫自己。本模块在 `InboundPipeline.prototype.processInbound` 外面加三条判据：

| 判据 | 干什么 | 默认 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 喊名字 | 正文里出现 `names` 里的任一个（默认 `云玥` / `玥玥` / `Yara`）→ 算被叫到 | 开 |
| `diving` | 被叫醒之后的一小段时间里，群里不 @ 也会搭话，然后自己潜回去 | 关 |
| `topics` | 群里聊到她感兴趣的方向时自己接一句（见下） | 关 |

**怎么表达「她听见了」**：往 `inbound.segments` 追加一个 `{ type: 'at', data: { qq: bot } }`
段 —— 复用上游「被 @」这条现成语义，`detectMention` 的 `at`

plugins.description: Tavily-backed WebSearchProvider for the DeepSeek Harness web capability seam (ctx.web) — npm: dsh-tavily-cxykyw
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-tavily-cxykyw

[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md) A [Tavily](https://tavily.com)-backed `WebSearchProvider` for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) web capability seam (`ctx.web`). It routes the built-in `web_search` tool to Tavily's dedicated search API instead of the shipped DeepSeek model-based search channel, so **a search costs no model tokens** and the result set comes from a real search engine index rather than an auxiliary model request. Verified against DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`. > Package name note: `dsh-web-search-tavily` on npm belongs to another author. This plugin is published as **`dsh-tavily-cxykyw`**; the GitHub repository is still `cxykyw/dsh-web-search-tavily`. ## What it does - registers a search provider with the stable id **`tavily`** on `ctx.web`; - maps Tavily's response to DSH's normalized `WebSearchResult` — `results[].url/title/content` become `sources[].url/title/snippet`, and Tavily's optional `answer` becomes the result `content`; - resolves the API key on **every** search, in this order: literal `apiKey` → credentials service (`~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`) → launch environment / `process.env`; - `available()` is a cheap local check (key + base URL present) with no network calls — a missing key surfaces as `WEB_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_MISSING` at search time; - then truncates to `request.maxResults` through the seam, exactly like any other provider. ## Install ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-tavily-cxykyw ``` If your DSH profile is a pnpm workspace root (the default `~/.dsh/profiles/web` is), the add must target the workspace root: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-tavily-cxykyw -w ``` The bundled `cordis.patch.yml` declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so adding the package also registers it as a profile bundle: the provider row is inserted **and** `web.searchProvider` is set to `tavily` for you. Restart `dsh web` afterwards — bundle changes are not hot-reloaded. From a checkout instead of npm: ```sh git clone https://github.com/cxykyw/dsh-web-search-tavily.git dsh plugin --profile web add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-web-search-tavily -w ``` ## Configure the API key Get a key at [app.tavily.com](https://app.tavily.com) (there is a free tier). Then pick **one** of: **1. Credentials file (recommended — outside every repository):** ```yaml # ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml TAVILY_API_KEY: tvly-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx ``` **2. Environment variable** of the process that launches DSH: ```sh TAVILY_API_KEY=tvly-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx dsh web ``` **3. Literal key in your own profile patch** (works, but keeps the secret in a plain file — prefer 1 or 2): ```yaml # ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml - id: web-search-tavily config: apiKey: tvly-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx ``` > **Never commit an API key.** This repository, its `cordis.patch.yml`, and its published npm tarball contain **no** credentials and no default key: the plugin only ever reads them from your machine at search time. `.gitignore` also excludes `.env*`, `.npmrc`, and `*.local.yml`. ## Options Configurable on the inserted `web-search-tavily` row: | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `apiKey` | — | Literal Tavily API key. Prefer `apiKeyEnv` + credentials/env. | | `apiKeyEnv` | `TAVILY_API_KEY` | Credential reference / environment variable name to resolve the key from. | | `baseURL` | `https://api.tavily.com` | Tavily API base URL (point it at a proxy if you need one). | | `searchDepth` | `basic` | `basic` (fast, 1 credit) or `advanced` (deeper crawl, more credits). | | `maxResults` | `8` | Results requested per search, 1–20. A per-call `maxResults` still wins. | Example, overriding just the depth and result count: ```yaml # ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml - id: web-search-tavily config: searchDepth: advanced maxResults: 5 ``` ## Switching providers The bundle patch already pins the seam: ```yaml - id: web config: searchProvider: tavily fetchProvider: http ``` To fall back to the official DeepSeek search, set `searchProvider: deepseek-official` (or remove the line only if `deepseek-official` is the single usable provider — with two usable providers and no pin, the seam fails closed with `WEB_PROVIDER_AMBIGUOUS`). > Upgrading from a hand-inserted copy in your own profile patch? Delete that `insert` block and keep only the `- id: web-search-tavily` config override above, otherwise the row id is inserted twice. ## Notes and limitations - No Web settings page: DSH `0.2` cannot mount this plugin's settings section, so the provider is configured through the profile patch only. - `fetch` (page retrieval) is untouched — it stays on `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-fetch-http`. - Tavily search results carry no publication date, so `sources[].publishedAt` is not set. ## Uninstall ```sh dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-tavily-cxykyw -w ``` ## License MIT © cxykyw

plugins.description: Sign in to ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot and other subscription model routes inside the DeepSeek Harness — the sign-in button the Harness never shipped.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-subscription-signin

[![tests](https://github.com/amosogra/dsh-subscription-signin/actions/workflows/tests.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/amosogra/dsh-subscription-signin/actions/workflows/tests.yml)

**The sign-in button the DeepSeek Harness never shipped.**

Use the AI subscriptions you already pay for — ChatGPT Plus/Pro, Claude Pro/Max,
GitHub Copilot, and more — as model routes inside the
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Adds a
**Subscriptions** settings page plus a compact extension on every provider card
in **Settings → Models**.

```text
Settings → Subscriptions → ChatGPT (Codex) → [ Sign in with ChatGPT (Codex) ]
                                    ↓
                    github.com/login/device  ·  code ABCD-1234
                                    ↓
                    ✓ Signed in — draws on your plan
```

No password is ever collected or stored by this plugin. The vendor runs the
sign-in on its own page; the Harness credential store writes the token.

## Repository layout

The **installable package is the `dsh-subscription-signin/` directory.** The
tests, license and documentation sit beside it and are not part of the package:

```text
dsh-subscription-signin/   ← the package; this is what you install
  host.js                  ← the Host half (tool + HTTP route)
  client.js                ← the Client half (settings page + provider card)
  cordis.patch.yml         ← the accounts, as configuration
  locale/en.json           ← package metadata strings
  package.json
smoketest/                 ← five dependency-free suites (run from the root)
docs/FINDINGS.md           ← what was measured vs inferred
```

---

## Why this exists

The Harness already ships everything needed to *use* a subscription as a model
route. Its LLM adapter registers OAuth flows for eight providers — the transport
works, the token exchange works, the credential store works.

What it has no surface for is **starting** one. Nothing in the GUI or CLI ever
calls the authorization seam's `begin()`. This plugin is that missing surface.

It implements **no OAuth**. It does not touch PKCE, state, device codes, or token
parsing — all of that lives in `@earendil-works/pi-ai`, shipped by DeepSeek. This
plugin asks the Harness to begin a flow, shows you the URL and code, and reports
the result.

## Supported providers

Configured out of the box, driven through the Harness's own authorization seam:

| Provider | Credential | Login style |
|---|---|---|
| ChatGPT (Codex) | `llm-pi-ai/openai-codex` | device code |
| Claude (Pro/Max) | `llm-pi-ai/anthropic` | OAuth |
| GitHub Copilot | `llm-pi-ai/github-copilot` | device code |
| xAI | `llm-pi-ai/xai` | device code |
| Meta | `llm-pi-ai/meta` | device code |
| OpenRouter | `llm-pi-ai/openrouter` | OAuth + paste fallback |
| Radius | `llm-pi-ai/radius` | browser callback |
| Kimi For Coding | `llm-pi-ai/kimi-coding` | device code |

**Honest status.** Sign-in is verified end to end for **ChatGPT (Codex)** and
**Claude (Pro/Max)**; Claude's route was observed authenticating successfully and
then being rate-limited by the account (HTTP 429 with Anthropic's own
`request_id` — a quota answer, not a credential failure). Copilot's flow is
verified and completes. xAI, Meta, OpenRouter, Radius and Kimi hold credentials
that have been written successfully, but **no request has been served on those
routes in the session where this was verified**, so treat them as untested rather
than broken. `docs/FINDINGS.md` records what is measured versus inferred.

## Install

**Requirements.** DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` or later. Developed and verified
against `0.2.0-rc.2`, the release this plugin's two seams were checked on
(`ctx.authorization` from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-authorization`, and the client
`slots` service). Every Harness service it consumes is reached with a defensive
`ctx.get(...)` plus an undefined check, so a missing one degrades to a reported
message instead of a crash — but a Harness that has moved a seam will still need
a matching plugin release.

The plugin is installed into a Harness **profile** as a bundle. Point the plugin
manager at this directory:

```text
install_bundle: link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-subscription-signin
```

Or, if you publish/consume it as a package, install by name and add it to your
profile's bundle list:

```jsonc
// $DSH_PROFILE_DIR/package.json
"dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app", "dsh-subscription-signin"] } }
```

Then **restart DSH once.** This matters and is explained under
[Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting) — the client half is composed into the
browser's boot graph at startup, so a freshly installed bundle has no page until
the process restarts.

## Use

From the GUI: **Settings → Subscriptions**, pick an account, press *Sign in*.

For an agent, or a headless harness, the same implementation is exposed as a tool
with actions `status`, `start`, `poll`, `cancel`, `signout`, `submitCode` and
`diagnostics`. Read `status` first; `start` returns the URL and, for device
grants, the code you enter on the vendor's page.

## Safety

This section is the reason to trust the plugin, so it is specific rather than
reassuring.

**It never sees a secret.** No password, token, API key or refresh token is read,
written, logged, or forwarded. The token is produced and stored by the Harness
credential seam (`ctx.authorization` / `ctx.credentials`), not by this code.
Audit it yourself — it is two files:

- **`host.js`** — zero imports. No filesystem access, no network requests, no
  child processes. It asks the credential store *whether* a record exists, and
  can delete one on explicit `signout` with `confirm: true`; it never reads a
  token value. The one `process.env` write is the documented per-account `env`
  field (used so a provider that selects its endpoint from the environment can be
  configured per account), and it is restored when the attempt settles.
- **`client.js`** — one dependency, `react`, supplied by the page. Its only
  `fetch` calls go to the plugin's own `/plugins/subscription-signin` route on
  your local Harness. Nothing is rendered from a credential.

**The one network-bearing route is trust-gated.** The panel reaches the Host half
over an HTTP route that inherits the Harness's own checks
(`connection.requestRejection`: Host/Origin validation and browser
authentication). On top of that, every mutating call must be a JSON `POST`, which
forces a CORS preflight and blocks form-based CSRF; bodies are capped at 64 KiB;
responses are `no-store` + `nosniff`.

**Not sanctioned by the vendors — read this.** For ChatGPT-plan usage, the
Harness targets the ChatGPT/Codex backend
(`chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex`), which OpenAI's developer documentation tells
third-party apps not to target for plan usage. **This plugin surfaces behaviour
the Harness already ships; it does not introduce it and cannot change it.** The
sanctioned path for third-party apps is *Sign in with ChatGPT*, which the Harness
does not implement. Using a subscription outside a vendor's intended client may
conflict with that vendor's terms, and vendors may rate-limit or block such
traffic. You are choosing to do that with your own account. Do not use this to
resell access, and do not use it to reach credentials that are not yours.

**No credentials are in this repository.** If you ever find one here, that is a
bug — please open an issue. The repository was scanned for tokens, private keys,
home paths and email addresses before its first commit. `docs/FINDINGS.md` does
cite exact package versions and source symbols from the Harness, which is
deliberate: a claim about a specific build is only useful if it names the build.

**Found a vulnerability?** Report it privately via
[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) rather than a public issue. That file also lists what
is and is not in scope — worth reading first, because the unofficial-backend
caveat above is a documented trade-off rather than a defect, and the two are easy
to confuse.

## Configuration

Accounts are configured, not hardcoded. They live in this package's own
[`cordis.patch.yml`](dsh-subscripti

plugins.description: A portable memory protocol for AI agents — load it as standing rules; a curation discipline + reference spec + optional cap hook.
plugins.readme_text:
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

# Engramory

[![CI](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Python 3.9+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.9%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/)

**An opinionated, zero-infrastructure memory *protocol* for small-scale, local,
file-based agent memory** — a strict curation discipline plus a validator
(`tools/engramory_doctor.py`), loaded as **standing rules** (`CLAUDE.md` /
`AGENTS.md` / your host's rules file). It is not a database, a framework, or a
relevance-loaded skill. Memory is a folder of small, human-readable markdown files
plus one always-loaded index. No database, no embeddings, no server — just
plain-text files you can open, read, edit, and diff in any editor (the live store
itself stays git-ignored).

> *Engramory* — coined from *engram* (the physical trace a memory leaves in the
> brain) + *memory*. Here: one file = one fact.

> ⚠️ **Unrelated projects share this name.** *engram + memory* is an obvious
> coinage and at least one other repository arrived at it independently. This
> project is only ever `tinqiao-oss/engramory` (npm: `dsh-engramory`); a same-named
> repo under a different owner is not a fork, a mirror, or a newer version of it.

> 🤖 **Are you an AI agent, asked to install or check this?** Start at
> **[AGENT-SETUP.md](AGENT-SETUP.md)**, not at the install steps below. It is the
> procedure for working out what your host can actually enforce, whether a store
> already exists, what you must not touch, and what to tell the user — the parts
> agents reliably get wrong when improvising.

> **Status: 0.12.1 — experimental.** The hard index cap (a `PreToolUse` hook) is
> deterministic for the matched direct-edit tools (`Edit | Write | MultiEdit`) but
> NOT a global write guard (shell tools — Bash, PowerShell, a background Monitor
> command — plus MCP file tools, external editors, and sync clients bypass it);
> the discipline loads as standing rules the model follows, so it's
> best-effort, not guaranteed on every task (see [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) §8). Assumes a
> single writer / serialized writes. Don't rely on it as a "mandatory, reliable,
> cross-agent" memory layer yet.

---

## What this is — and is NOT

Engramory is **not a new memory architecture**. The "markdown files + a small index
loaded into context + the model curates it" pattern is now the mainstream shape
for agent memory, and it ships in several places already. Engramory stands on:

- **Claude Code native auto-memory** — the same markdown-`MEMORY.md`-index +
  lazy detail-file pattern; its system prompt even uses the same
  `user | feedback | project | reference` type vocabulary (per
  [anthropics/claude-code#58840](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/58840);
  the *public docs* describe only the index + topic files). Engramory is a
  disciplined superset of this default.
- **[basic-memory](https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory)** — markdown
  source-of-truth, YAML frontmatter `type`, `[[wikilink]]` graph, local-first.
- **[obsidian-second-brain](https://github.com/eugeniughelbur/obsidian-second-brain)**,
  **[claude-memory-compiler](https://github.com/coleam00/claude-memory-compiler)**
  ("a loaded index beats vector search at personal scale"), and the broader family
  of markdown-memory skills.

What Engramory contributes is the **opinionated bundle + the discipline**, not the
primitives. Do not claim novelty on markdown, frontmatter, wikilinks, a loaded
index, one-file-per-fact notes, or curation hygiene — all are prior art.

## What's actually differentiated

1. **A role/purpose ontology, headed by `feedback` = procedural memory.** The
   semantic / episodic / **procedural** split is established prior art — the CoALA
   taxonomy, and a named procedural type in LangMem and mem0 — so Engramory does not
   claim the category. What it does is make procedural `feedback` the *spine* of a
   deliberately tiny, hand-authored, human-readable set, with required **Why:** /
   **How to apply:** lines, instead of auto-extracting it into a vector/graph store.
   The contribution is the packaging and discipline, not the ontology.

2. **The curation contract as concrete behaviour** the protocol applies (model-followed, not a hard gate): dedup-before-write,
   update-don't-duplicate, delete-when-wrong, and a negative-scope rule ("don't
   store what git/CLAUDE.md/the code already records"). Surveys consistently name
   *modify/delete/forget* as the most under-implemented memory operation — Engramory
   makes it the spine.

3. **A bounded index designed not to silently rot.** The index loads every session and
   Claude Code reads the first 200 lines / 25 KB (documented behavior), so an unbounded index silently
   drops memories off the end. Engramory warns at 150 lines / 20 KB, compacts-or-asks
   before 200 / 25 KB, and ships a hard `PreToolUse` hook backstop (it blocks only
   *growth* past the cap — shrinking/compaction edits always pass). Both the line and
   byte caps apply — whichever is hit first triggers (an index can be under the line
   count yet over on bytes when the lines run long).

   Claude Code has since followed up on this natively: v2.1.186 (released
   2026-06-22) reminds the agent to compact the index when it nears the cap, and
   v2.1.210 (released 2026-07-14) turned an over-cap write into an explicit error
   instead of a silent truncation. Both are after-the-fact alerts, though — the
   write still lands, and entries past the cap stay invisible until someone
   compacts. Engramory's hook denies the write *before* it happens, so a write
   through the matched edit tools never leaves the index over-cap in the first
   place (writes outside them — a shell, an MCP file tool — are not gated; see the
   status note above and SKILL.md §8). The native alerts validate the direction
   and make a welcome second layer — and older versions and other hosts still
   have neither.

## How it compares

| | storage | recall | human-readable | typed ontology | curation discipline | bounded index | infra |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Engramory** | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ role-based (4) | ✅ contract (model-run) | ✅ 150/200 + hook | none |
| CC auto-memory | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ same 4 types | partial (auto) | ~200-line window* | none (built-in) |
| basic-memory | md + SQLite | semantic/FTS search | ✅ | ✅ freeform type | schema + overwrite checks | ❌ (no loaded index) | SQLite + embeddings |
| obsidian-second-brain | md vault | index-first + search | ✅ | folder-typed | ✅ reconcile/lint | partial | none |
| mem0 / Zep | vector/graph DB | semantic | ❌ (DB) | typed (prefs/episodic/proc.; Zep custom) | auto-extract | n/a | DB + embeddings |
| [agentmemory](https://github.com/rohitg00/agentmemory) | SQLite + vector index (+opt. graph) | hybrid BM25+vector (+opt. graph), RRF | ❌ (DB/engine) | ✅ 4-tier lifecycle (work./epis./sem./proc.) | auto (capture + dedup + decay) | n/a | iii engine (local) + opt. embeddings |

Engramory's lane: **minimalism + actionable role typing + curation discipline, zero
infra.** It does *not* try to out-search basic-memory, out-scale mem0, or
out-capture agentmemory — those solve a different problem (auto-capture /
auto-ingest at volume) at a different cost point. agentmemory is the closest
heavyweight foil: also local-first, but it bets on automatic capture (lifecycle
hooks) + hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vectors + optional graph) on a SQLite/`iii`
engine, where Engramory bets on hand-curation + a tiny always-loaded index and
ships no engine at all.

\* Claude Code's [memory docs](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/memory)
document this exactly: *"the first 200 lines of `MEMORY.md`, or the first 25KB,
whichever comes first, are loaded at the start of every conversation."* Other hosts
vary, so the window stays configurable via the hook's env vars.

## Where it fits — and the goal

Engramory is a **portable memory *discipline*, not a

# Artifact Center · 产物中心

Find the file a DSH conversation produced, together with its workspace and conversation history.

[中文说明](README.zh-CN.md) · [Requirements](docs/requirements.zh.md) · [Acceptance record](docs/acceptance.zh.md) · [MIT](LICENSE)

## Features

- A global sidebar panel that works without an active conversation.
- Historical backfill from complete session events, including file writes, edits and explicitly presented deliverables.
- Live workspace snapshots at turn end to detect shell and subprocess outputs. Large output bursts are summarized rather than flooding the list.
- Workspace/tag/date filters, favorites, notes, bounded text-content search and a virtualized list. Check or uncheck extensions directly under “Readable formats” to control visibility; the choice is saved in this browser.
- Native image, PDF, Markdown, Mermaid, text/code, CSV/TSV, sandboxed HTML and media previews. Office files and binaries use the system's applications; no format conversion takes place.
- Conversation links, path/link copying, file-handler selection, provenance history and CSV/Markdown export.
- Missing-file checks and confirmed moves to the system trash. Retrieve a file using your file manager, then check files to restore its index status.
- A read-only `artifact_search` Agent tool and Chinese/English UI.

History records provenance and metadata; it **does not preserve old file contents**. Snapshot results are labeled as inferred because filesystem changes cannot prove which concurrent task caused them. Historical shell outputs that have no recorded path cannot be reconstructed from current files alone. Starting with 0.1.2, a separate provenance table preserves recorded outputs and annotations when the derived list cache is rebuilt. Persisted turn checkpoints survive restarts; completed turns are recovered without including files modified after their recorded end time. Removing the entire storage domain also removes provenance and annotations. `enableBetterSidebar` is reserved; delegation to that optional plugin is not implemented. The built-in Markdown and Mermaid renderers work independently.

## Install

From npm (published baseline: 0.1.0):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-artifact-center
```

Or install the repository while directory review is pending:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:YQing0123/dsh-artifact-center
```

Restart the Host and refresh the browser. The Electron-managed `desktop` profile must be installed through its plugin manager; do not manage it with CLI commands. Market availability depends on acceptance of the [directory entry](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin).

## Configuration

The plugin ID is `artifact-center`. Override settings in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- update:
    artifact-center:
      config:
        backfillOnStart: true
        snapshotOnTurnEnd: true
        burstThreshold: 500
        maxIndexedFiles: 50000
        previewMaxBytes: 20971520
        textMaxBytes: 1048576
        validationIntervalMs: 300000
        readableExtensions:
          - md
          - txt
          - json
          - yaml
          - yml
          - csv
          - js
          - ts
          - png
          - jpg
          - pdf
        autoTags:
          - name: Deliverable
            kind: glob
            value: outputs/**
          - name: Spreadsheet
            kind: ext
            value: xlsx
```

Automatic tag rules accept `glob`, `ext` and `session` (conversation-title substring). `readableExtensions` is a whitelist of extensions without the leading dot; the Artifact Center navigation shows the active list under “Readable formats”. An empty list uses all built-in supported formats. Files outside this whitelist are not indexed or content-read. Default ignored directories: `.git`, `node_modules`, `dist`, `build`, `.next`, `__pycache__`, `.venv`, `target`, `.cache`, `.dsh`. `ignorePatterns` replaces the default list when explicitly supplied. State is held through the Host's `storageDomain` API under `artifact_center`.

HTTP routes under `/artifact-center/*` require the Host's browser authentication and same-origin request guard. Only indexed files inside their registered workspace can be read or opened; outside symlinks are rejected. HTML previews cannot execute scripts or access the network. Text search reads at most `textMaxBytes` per candidate; it is not a semantic or binary-document search engine.

## Agent tool

`artifact_search(query, workspace?, type?, tag?, since?, limit?)` returns matching metadata and paths. `workspace` accepts an ID or title; types include `doc`, `sheet`, `slide`, `image`, `web`, `data`, `code`, `media`, `archive` and `other`. `since` is an ISO timestamp and `limit` is at most 100. Missing and trashed files remain labeled in results.

## Development

Host and UI are plain JavaScript. Only the lazy Mermaid renderer is independently bundled; no Harness build preset or internal UI package is imported.

With the isolated development Host and authenticated `artifact-p0` browser running, `npm run test:ui` checks fixture-only previews, tag errors and a 10,000-record virtual list. API writes are intercepted and never reach real storage or system actions. `npm run test:locale` checks the English UI and restores the original language preference.

Search refreshes the current registered workspace boundaries before reading content. Removed workspaces and paths outside a workspace's changed root are excluded without deleting their recorded provenance. After committing the release source, pack into `.cache` and run `npm run release:check` to compare the archive with both the working files and Git HEAD and generate a local integrity receipt. This command does not publish or authenticate.

```sh
npm ci --legacy-peer-deps
npm run build:vendor
npm run check
npm test
npm pack
```

Renderer bundles and license notices are committed and shipped, so installation does not run a compiler. Test probes are excluded from the npm package and load only through a separate development overlay. Read [development notes](docs/dev-notes.zh.md) and [implementation corrections](docs/implementation.zh.md) before changing the integration.

The reference acceptance Host is DSH `0.1.7-rc.2`. Desktop `0.2.0` compatibility is declared in the optional native-opener peer range, but desktop installation must also pass that Host's plugin manager and browser acceptance. Older sessions rejected by the Host's migration are reported individually; their raw logs are never modified by this plugin.

## License

MIT. Browser renderers and their dependencies retain their own licenses; see [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) and `vendor/`.

plugins.description: 去掉 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）「当前模型不支持图片」的拒绝限制：不改 app.asar，用运行时接缝放行未声明多模态能力的模型
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-vision-unlock

去掉 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai)（DSH）「当前模型不支持图片」的拒绝限制，让未声明多模态能力的模型也能发送和读取图片。

不修改 `app.asar` 里任何一行代码，也不改配置树——纯运行时接缝，随 DSH 升级继续可用。

## 为什么会被拒绝

DSH 判定一条路由能否吃图片，依据两处能力声明：

- **`LlmModelInfo.inputModalities`**（可选字段）。缺这个字段，或数组里没有 `"image"`，
  就被当成纯文本模型。这是**所有门禁**的唯一判定来源：

  | 位置 | 表现 |
  |---|---|
  | 会话控制器 `prompt()` | 发送时弹「当前模型不支持图片，请切换支持图片的模型」 |
  | 子代理 `assertImageCapable` | 向子代理发图被拒 |
  | `read_file` 读图 | `does not declare image input` |
  | MCP / ACP 图片注入 | 同上 |

- **适配器自己持有的模型表**（不经过上面那处）。pi-ai 在发请求前查
  `model.input.includes("image")`；deepseek 适配器序列化前查
  `connection.models[].inputModalities`。

**典型触发场景**：自定义/本地网关路由（如 Agent2API、自建 OpenAI 兼容网关）在配置里只写了
`id / name / contextWindow / maxTokens`，没写 `input`，于是落到默认值 `["text"]`，
被判定为不支持图片——哪怕上游模型其实支持。

## 本插件怎么做

只用两个运行时接缝：

1. 包装 `llm.resolveModelInfo`，给结果补上 `"image"` → 拆掉上表中所有门禁。
2. 遍历 `llm.adapters`，把适配器模型表里的 `input` / `inputModalities` 补上
   `"image"` → 拆掉 pi-ai 的自检。适配器换快照（配置热更新）时自动重做。

## 安装

### 方式 A：用 `plugin_manager` 安装（推荐）

在 DSH 里让 agent 执行：

```
plugin_manager  action: install_bundle  target: github:wmk66ds/dsh-vision-unlock
```

或在 Web UI 的 **设置 → 插件** 面板里，把上面这串填进安装框。

`target` 也可以写完整 URL，两种等价：

| 写法 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `github:wmk66ds/dsh-vision-unlock` | GitHub 简写，推荐 |
| `https://github.com/wmk66ds/dsh-vision-unlock` | 完整 git URL |

锁定版本用 `#` 加 ref：

```
github:wmk66ds/dsh-vision-unlock#v1.0.0
```

> 若本机访问 GitHub 不畅，DSH 走的是它自己的网络栈；必要时先确认你的代理环境
> 能被 DSH 进程继承（例如 Clash Verge 的 TUN / 系统代理）。

### 方式 B：手动安装（CLI 或插件管理不可用时的降级方案）

1. 把本仓库放到一个稳定的路径，例如 `D:\workbench\dsh-vision-unlock`。
2. 在你的 profile 目录（默认 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/`）的 `node_modules` 下建立指向它的链接：

   ```powershell
   cmd /c "mklink /J `"%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-vision-unlock`" `"D:\workbench\dsh-vision-unlock`""
   ```

3. 编辑该 profile 的 `package.json`，在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组加入 `"dsh-vision-unlock"`，
   并在 `dependencies` 加入 `"dsh-vision-unlock": "link:D:/workbench/dsh-vision-unlock"`。
4. 重启 DSH。

> Windows 上用 **junction**（`mklink /J`）而不是符号链接——后者需要管理员权限。
> 注意 desktop profile 由 Electron 应用独占管理，`dsh plugin --profile desktop`
> 会拒绝执行，所以才有这里的手动步骤。

## 配置

`cordis.patch.yml` 里的 `config`：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: vision-unlock
      name: 'dsh-vision-unlock'
      config:
        providers: []   # 留空 = 所有 provider；否则只放行列出的
        models: []      # 留空 = 所有模型；否则只放行列出的
```

两个白名单都为空时全部放行；非空时需**同时**命中才放行。

## 已知边界

- deepseek 适配器的模型表来自它自己的 plugin config，不经由 `llm.adapters` 暴露，
  本插件改不到。该路由如需图片，请在设置页给模型勾选 Image（等价于写
  `inputModalities: [text, image]`）。
- 放行后图片**真的会发出去**。若上游实际不支持多模态，报错会从模型侧返回，
  不再是 DSH 本地拒绝——这是预期行为，不是 bug。

## 卸载

从 profile 的 `package.json` 中删掉 `dsh-vision-unlock`（`bundles` 与 `dependencies` 两处），
删除 `node_modules/dsh-vision-unlock`，重启 DSH。

## 适用版本

针对 DSH 桌面版（含 `dsh-llm` / `dsh-llm-pi-ai` / `dsh-api-session-controller`）验证。
依赖的是 `llm.resolveModelInfo` 与 `llm.adapters` 这两个接口，若上游改动需要同步调整。

## 许可证

MIT

plugins.description: 自动识别本机所有工具的 MCP 配置，并且能进行修改
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mcp-global-manager

DSH 侧栏面板：把散落在本机各编程工具里的 MCP 配置收进一处——扫描差异 → 一键采纳进 DSH → 需要时写回原工具 → DSH 侧直接增删改停用。

*A DSH sidebar panel that scans MCP configs from the tools it knows (28 built-in sources plus custom ones), syncs diffs into DSH, and lets you import, write back, or edit MCP servers.*

MIT · Windows / macOS / Linux · DSH ≥ 0.1.6-alpha · 不出网 · 不执行命令

## 界面速览

> 以下截图中的本机绝对路径已做模糊处理，仅保留 `~` / `%APPDATA%` 通用占位。

**① 扫描总览** —— 顶部状态徽章（条目 / 一致 / 存在的文件）+ 按工具分组的差异账本，新/变/缺/同四态一目了然：

![扫描总览](assets/screenshot-1.png)

**② DSH 侧新增** —— 三步表单（基本信息 / 怎么启动 / 环境变量），支持整行命令粘贴「识别」自动拆好，底部实时预览将要写入的内容：

![新增 DSH 条目](assets/screenshot-2.png)

**③ 来源注册表** —— 28 个内置源 + 自定义源，每条带 `builtin` 徽章与多平台候选路径，可点开展开管理、增删自定义源：

![来源注册表](assets/screenshot-3.png)

**④ 自检横幅** —— 面板内「自检」一键校验 js-yaml 解析、安装包/bundles/client.js 是否就位、DSH 受管行数：

![自检输出](assets/screenshot-4.png)

---

## 为什么需要它

MCP 配置散在 Claude Code / Codex / VS Code / Cursor / Trae / Kiro / OpenCode / Cline / Gemini CLI 等 28 个已登记源（外加自定义源）的配置文件里，同名条目（比如 `pencil` 出现在 5 个工具里）改一处忘三处。这个插件做三件事：

1. **发现**：按注册表扫每个工具的配置文件，识别各自方言（JSON / TOML / OpenCode / Continue 数组形态，`//` 注释与尾随逗号都能吃）。
2. **同步**：勾选后写进 DSH profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`，生成 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 受管行（与 `dsh-mcp-manager-plus` 的行形状互通，彼此认得对方的行）。
3. **管理**：DSH 侧的新增 / 编辑 / 删除 / 停用直接在面板做；写回原工具需在条目上逐条显式授权。

侧栏入口：地球图标 + **MCP全局管理**（`order: 22`，排在 dsh-remote-web-ui「远程链接」的 21 后面；没装那个插件也照常可用）。

## 功能一览

- **扫描**：28 个内置源 + 自定义源；400ms 请求级缓存，连点「刷新扫描」不会把磁盘扫穿。
- **差异账本**：`无变化 / 新发现 / 有变化 / 源里已删` 四态指纹；JSON 键序重排不误报；同名条目跨工具互相点名（`重复于: Trae CN, Cursor`）。
- **采纳导入**：勾选批量或单条导入；`--emit` 预览与真实导入共用同一个纯函数，「说写几行」＝「真写几行」。
- **写回原工具**：逐条打开「允许写回」＋ 确认弹窗 ＋ 服务端账本双重闸门；**没有任何 force 旁路参数**。
- **DSH 侧管理**：增删改停用；每次写盘前做结构校验，认不出主行宁可拒绝也不误删。
- **密钥安全**：名字命中 `KEY`/`PASSWORD`/`SECRET`/`TOKEN`/`AUTH`/`BEARER`/`COOKIE`/`CRED` 任一（不分大小写）的 env 键与请求头，以及 URL 查询串里的同名令牌，面板一律打码显示；写回时服务端用磁盘原值逐条还原，还原不了（源文件里压根没有这条真值）直接 409 拒写——任何配置文件都不会被写进那八个圆点。
- **备份**：每次写入前自动备份到 `~/.dsh/mcp-global-manager/backups/`，最多保留 40 份。
- **自检**：一键输出 js-yaml 可用性 / 客户端包三项 / DSH 受管行数，专治「现在能用、重启就崩」。
- **双语界面**：中英文案跟随 DSH 语言。

## 安装

用 DSH 自带的插件命令，`--profile` 换成你实际在用的 profile 名（`web` / `desktop` / `tui` …）：

```powershell
# ① 包发布到 npm 之后（推荐）
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mcp-global-manager

# ② 从源码装（开发态，无需 npm 账号）
dsh plugin --profile web add file:C:/Users/you/dsh-plugins/dsh-mcp-global-manager

# ③ 或装 GitHub Release 上的 tarball
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/asfre/dsh-mcp-global-manager/releases/latest/download/dsh-mcp-global-manager.tgz
```

装完**彻底重启** DSH（托盘右键退出再打开——`Ctrl+R` 只重载前端，宿主进程里的 `lib/*.js` 还是旧的），侧栏「远程链接」正下方就会出现 **MCP全局管理**。

## 面板怎么用

1. 侧栏点 **MCP全局管理**，顶部 **刷新扫描**。
2. 徽章一行：总数 / 新发现 / 有变化 / 源里已删 / DSH 已管 / 存在的文件 / 读取失败。
3. 「各工具的 MCP 配置」每个源一块：勾选 → **采纳选中**；或单条 **采纳到 DSH**。
4. 单条 **改配置** 编辑；先开 **允许写回**，才会出现 **写回该工具 / 从该工具删除**（改的是别的工具的配置文件，会先弹确认框）。
5. 「DSH 侧」做增删改与停用；**新增 DSH 条目** 手工建一条。
6. 遇到「源里已删」只标红不自动删，要删得亲手点；想彻底清账本，删 `~/.dsh/mcp-global-manager/state.json` 下次扫描全新开始。
7. 服务名进 DSH 前会规范化非 `[A-Za-z0-9_-]` 字符（`API 文档` → `API`，纯中文 → `server-<hash6>`），面板会提示改名。

## 安全与权限（收录披露）

**它会做什么：**

- **读**：扫描注册表内各工具的 MCP 配置文件（默认全程只读）。注册表标只读的源（lingma / cherry-studio / zed / warp / continue）点写回会被 403 挡下。
- **写**：只有两处——① 采纳/DSH 侧管理写 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（先校验后备份再原子写）；② 你在某条上开过「允许写回」并确认，才写那个工具自己的配置文件。
- **落盘数据**：仅 `~/.dsh/mcp-global-manager/`（`state.json` 差异账本 + `backups/` 写前备份），在插件目录之外，也不随仓库分发。

**它不会做什么：**

- **不联网**：宿主侧不开任何出网连接；浏览器侧只与本机 `/mcp-global/*` 通信。不上传、不上报你的配置。
- **不执行命令**：不会为装 MCP server 跑 `npx` / `git` / 下载脚本，只改配置文本。
- **不需要密钥**：插件自身不持有任何独立凭据，只搬运你配置里已有的 token（显示与接口返回都打码）。但要坦白：差异账本 `state.json` 会为每条扫到的条目保留**上次的原值快照**（含 env 里的 token 明文），用于「消失条目回补展示」和写回还原——它只落你本机磁盘、绝不出网。如果这台机器有多用户或远程控制软件，注意 `~/.dsh/mcp-global-manager/` 的目录权限。
- **不越权**：API 只监听 loopback，且 Origin 必须与 Host 相等、Host 还必须是字面量 `127.x.x.x / localhost / [::1]`（挡 DNS 重绑定）。同站的 CSRF 一律 403。同时要说清：**loopback 端口对本机任意进程可见**，跑不受信程序的机器上别指望这层隔离。本地脚本不带 `Origin`、桌面壳用自定义协议源，正常放行。
- **不提权**：只用当前登录用户的文件权限。

⚠️ 提醒：不少工具（如 Trae CN 的 Apifox 条目）把 token **明文**存在自己的配置里，本插件不改变这一点——别把那些文件原样贴给别人或提交进仓库。

**写回完整性**：任何写盘都走 `读原文 → 纯函数改 → 结构校验 → 回读验证 → 备份 → 原子写`，任一环节不过整笔取消，磁盘一个字节不动。

## 自定义源

内置清单之外的新工具：面板「扫描的源」里加一条自定义源（id / 格式 / 容器键 / 候选路径，支持 `%APPDATA%` 等环境变量展开），标 **允许写回** 才会真写。

## 已知限制

- JSON 源写回时 `//`、`/* */` 注释与尾随逗号会**丢失**（读能容错，还原不了）；写前必有备份，丢了可回滚。
- TOML 只处理 `[mcp_servers.x]` 一层；`.env` / `.http_headers` 子表写回时展平成 `env = { K = "V" }`。
- 面板管的是**配置**，不代管 DSH 的 MCP 运行状态（启不启得来看 DSH 的 MCP 层）。
- 补丁 `id` 命名空间全 profile 共享：停用/删除/改名三个操作都先确认补丁里存在这条受管服务器行，认不出主就 409/404 拒绝。服务名避开 `manager-plus` 一类与插件同名的前缀即可。
- 兼容性：`@deepseek-ai/dsh` 的 `>=0.1.6-alpha.1 <0.2.0-0` 或 `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`（0.2.0 正式版前的过渡版本不支持）。

## 开发与自测（零写入）

```powershell
node tools/cli-scan.mjs            # 只扫描打印；--emit 预览导入 YAML
node test/run.mjs                  # 后端单测（含写路径沙箱演练）
node tools/smoke-client.mjs        # 面板渲染冒烟（React 桩，拦整页白屏）
node tools/cold-start-check.mjs    # 冷启动演练：等价「重启后用户的第一次点击」
```

改源码后同步进 profile：`powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/sync-to-profile.ps1`，然后按改动侧决定 `Ctrl+R`（仅客户端）或彻底重启（宿主 `lib/*.js`）。

⚠️ **js-yaml 版本坑**（社区装机最常见的「重启后崩」）：补丁方言依赖 js-yaml 4.x 的 `Type` 构造器，`package.json` 已显式声明 `dependencies`，但 profile 的 hoisted 目录可能被别的插件的 5.x 占位。`resolveYaml()` 会按能力挑副本（标准解析 → `.pnpm/js-yaml@4.x` → 邻居目录兜底）。装完务必重启后点一次 **自检**。

## 卸载

从 profile 移除这条依赖（`dsh plugin remove` 或删 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里的条目），刷新界面即可。DSH 补丁里已生成的 `mcp-*` 行**不会**跟着消失——那是你的配置，不是插件的东西；需要的话在面板里逐条删。账本与备份在 `~/.dsh/mcp-global-manager/`，一并删除即彻底清理。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Local code memory for DeepSeek Harness: automatic source context, semantic search, and dependency graphs.
plugins.readme_text:
# Code Memory for DeepSeek Harness

**Give your coding agent the relevant source before its first step.** Code Memory (CM) is a local code index and context plugin for JavaScript and TypeScript projects. It combines symbol lookup, dependency graphs, and semantic search to reduce repeated source discovery.

**Unofficial community project.** Independently developed; not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek.

**English** · [Русский](README.ru.md) · [Download v0.9.1](https://github.com/kobubu/Rag-Coding/releases/tag/v0.9.1) · [Windows installation](docs/INSTALL-WINDOWS.md)

## What it does

- Supplies compact source context before the first model call in DeepSeek Harness.
- Looks up named files and symbols directly; uses local MiniLM embeddings and LanceDB when discovery is needed.
- Expands relevant dependencies using the TypeScript compiler's symbol and call graph.
- Checks source versions and avoids repeating unchanged whole files already supplied to Harness.
- Exposes an MCP server for Codex and Claude Code and an optional `UserPromptSubmit` hook for automatic context.
- Includes CM Atlas, a local map of modules, symbols, and their relationships.

The index, embeddings, and graph stay on your computer. Selected code is still sent to your model provider when you use a cloud model. CM does not include model credits or a model-provider subscription.

![CM Atlas displaying modules and structural relationships in this public repository](docs/assets/cm-atlas.png)

Actual CM Atlas screenshot of this repository's public `src` directory: 39 modules, 2,409 symbols, and 8,321 relationships. The current Atlas interface is in Russian; the installation guide below is in English.

## Measured results, with limits

The published Harness pilot used GPT-6 Luna on **six task types in one repository**, Geo Dash. Three evaluation series each ran 36 sessions: no CM, the earlier CM, and the newer CM, with two repeats per task and arm.

| Newer CM versus no CM | Published result |
|---|---:|
| Total model tokens | 45–66% fewer across the three series |
| Estimated model price | 30–47% lower |
| Total Harness session time | 18–37% lower |
| Independently checked solutions, pooled across series | 36/36 with newer CM; 35/36 without CM |

These are **small, single-project pilot results**, not guaranteed savings. The ranges are observed series results, not confidence intervals. Costs are estimates; session time does not include first-time installation or indexing. All attempts, including failures, are retained. Earlier approaches and native-client experiments have different outcomes; do not transfer these percentages to every client or workload.

[Method, raw results, and reproduction](docs/EFFICIENCY-AB.md) · [Codex and Claude Code experiments](docs/NATIVE-CLIENTS.md) · [What did not work](docs/HISTORY.md)

## Install into an existing Harness

Requires DeepSeek Harness **0.2.0-rc.2** and Node.js 24 or 22.19+ within 22.x:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:kobubu/Rag-Coding#v0.9.1
```

The tag contains the compiled plugin, CLI entry points, and Atlas. CM needs no installation build or Vite/React runtime modules. Then [prepare the project index and local model](docs/DEEPSEEK-PLUGIN.md#github-installation). A ready release tarball is also available:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/kobubu/Rag-Coding/releases/download/v0.9.1/dsh-plugin-code-memory-0.9.1.tgz
```

Git tags before 0.9.1 require their release tarball or an explicit source build. The new runtime works with scripts disabled; native dependencies follow the host package manager's policy.

If CM was installed with the Windows bootstrap, update it using the new ZIP and the same `-InstallRoot`. Harness 0.2.0-rc.2 can prefer a CM copy beside its own installation over a profile-installed copy; adding another Git dependency to that older installation does not replace its launcher or embedded copy. The bootstrap creates a new release directory and switches managed project launchers.

## Install on Windows

Download **CM-0.9.1-Windows.zip** and **SHA256SUMS.txt** from the [v0.9.1 release](https://github.com/kobubu/Rag-Coding/releases/tag/v0.9.1), verify the checksum, and extract the ZIP. From the extracted folder, run:

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install_cm.ps1 -ProjectRoot 'C:\path\to\your-project' -Clients harness
```

The installer uses a compatible Node.js or downloads a private runtime, installs CM and Harness **0.2.0-rc.2**, downloads the embedding model, and prepares your index. Administrator rights and a source checkout are not required. Internet access is required for the initial dependencies and model downloads. Open the generated `start-harness.ps1` path printed by setup, then configure your model provider in Harness.

Use `-SourceScope src` to index a subdirectory. Use `-Clients harness,codex,claude` to add project MCP connections for all three clients; Codex and Claude Code must be installed separately. Their automatic-context hook is currently a **separate manual setup**, not an installer default.

[Install, launch, verify, and remove](docs/INSTALL-WINDOWS.md) · [Native-client hook setup](docs/NATIVE-CLIENTS.md)

## Build from source

Use Node.js **24 LTS**, or Node.js **22.19.0+ within the 22.x line**.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/kobubu/Rag-Coding.git
cd Rag-Coding
npm ci
npm run verify
npm run cm:index
npm run cm:vectors
npm run cm:search -- --query "how are embeddings reused between snapshots"
npm run plugin:smoke
```

`plugin:smoke` dispatches tools through the real Harness runtime without a model call. In PowerShell, use `npm.cmd` for commands that forward flags. For restricted cloud builds, `ONNXRUNTIME_NODE_INSTALL=skip npm ci` skips the native runtime download; running local embeddings still requires a working ONNX runtime.

The Windows bootstrap is the packaged installation path. A macOS/Linux installer, automatic release updates, and a subscription service are not included.

For source changes, `npm run compile` rebuilds the runtime. Commit matching `dist/src/` and `dist/viewer/`; `npm run package:check` and CI reject missing/stale artifacts. The command is named `compile` because npm treats a script named `build` as a reason to rebuild Git dependencies.

## Documentation

The following engineering documents are currently in Russian; the README and Windows release guide are in English.

| Document | Contents |
|---|---|
| [How CM works](docs/HOW-IT-WORKS.md) | Routing, graph expansion, context budgets, and source freshness |
| [Harness integration](docs/DEEPSEEK-PLUGIN.md) | Bundle installation, configuration, and tools |
| [MCP setup](docs/MCP-SETUP.md) | Shared local retrieval for coding clients |
| [CM Atlas](docs/LOCAL-ATLAS.md) | Local project visualization |
| [Release notes](docs/releases/v0.9.1.md) | What is included in the public package |
| [Release procedure](docs/RELEASING.md) | Rebuilding the installer and checking artifacts |

CM is written in TypeScript/Node.js. Project code is indexed without being executed. Supported inputs are JavaScript/TypeScript source files; current corpus limits are 500 files and 8 MiB of source. See [contribution rules](CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Try it on another repository

[Show Your Plugins discussion](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/10196) · [Community catalog submission](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/pull/7989)

Independent A/B results are welcome: use the same task, model, reasoning settings, checks, and starting commit with CM on and off. Include indexing/setup time separately, all failed attempts, total tokens, elapsed time, and whether the patch actually passes independent checks. Report regressions as well as wins in [Issues](https://github.com/kobubu/Rag-Coding/issues).

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that publishes the running Harness as a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for other agent harnesses.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH MCP Server

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that publishes a **Model Context Protocol (MCP)** server from the
running Harness host, so other agent harnesses — Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, another DSH, any MCP
client — can call DSH: start sessions, drive turns, wait for them, read transcripts, and cancel work.

The plugin is a Host-only bundle with **zero dependencies** (no DSH import, no third-party module),
so it installs into a profile and survives Harness upgrades that keep the service contracts.
Every request is attributed to the calling agent and every session is recorded against its creator,
so several harnesses can share one endpoint and still ask "which sessions are mine?".

The same tool table is also registered into the local Harness, so a DSH agent calls these tools
directly — switchable on this bundle's row in the Web **Plugins** page, and clamped to the calling
session's own authority (see [DSH-local tools](#dsh-local-tools)).

```
other harness ──MCP (Streamable HTTP or stdio)──> DSH MCP Server ──> DSH services
                                                                     sessionController / sessionQuery / tools
```

## What it exposes

| MCP tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `dsh_run_prompt` | Start a **new** DSH session and run one prompt; returns the assistant's final text and the new `sessionId`. Supports `cwd`, `agentPreset`, `permissionPreset`, `model` (`provider/model`), `wait: false`, `timeoutMs`. |
| `dsh_continue_session` | Send a prompt to an **existing** session (resuming it if it is cold). Keeps the session's context and workspace; `permissionPreset` re-pins the session's sandbox mode and approval policy before the prompt, and `model` (`provider/model`) overrides the session's model. Without `model` the session keeps the model it already runs. |
| `dsh_list_commands` | The slash commands a session's agent can currently run: the global command layer plus whatever that agent's preset composes, so availability differs per agent preset. |
| `dsh_run_command` | Run one slash command in a session and return its settled `{ kind, text, commandId }`. `line` takes a complete command line (`"/compact"`, `"/permission danger-full-access"`); `command` (+ optional `args`) takes a bare name. The command executes immediately without a model turn. |
| `dsh_list_sessions` | A page of the session index: `sessionId`, title, running state, archival state, activity time, and the recorded owning agent (`view: "full"` adds cwd and liveness). Narrow server-side with `query` (title/cwd/owner/id), `mine: true` (or the `restrictToOwner` setting), `owner: "<id>"`, and `running`; page with `cursor`/`nextCursor`. Archived sessions are hidden unless `includeArchived: true`, mirroring the Web UI. |
| `dsh_read_session` | A window of one session's transcript (user-authored and assistant messages only), plus the last durable `permissionPreset`. `mode: "tail"` (default, last 10) / `"head"` / `"outline"` (one compact row per message with a preview and length, no full text); `roles`, `afterSeq` + `window.nextAfterSeq` to page, `maxChars` (default 2000) to cap a single answer. Reports `totalMessages`, `matchedMessages` and `returned`, so the caller always knows what it has not read. `limit: 0` still means everything. Works while the session is archived. |
| `dsh_answer_request` | Answer a parked decision, only when the deployment sets `answerUserRequests: true`: `decision: "allow"|"deny"` for an approval (a one-shot grant, or a denial) or `answers: [{ id, selected }]` for a question. Ids come from `dsh_list_requests`, which marks what this endpoint parked with `answerable: true`. The GUI stays in the race — whoever decides first wins — and an unanswered request still fails closed at `requestAnswerTimeoutMs`. An internal DSH caller may only settle an **approval** while it already holds `danger-full-access`; questions are always answerable (see [DSH-local tools](#dsh-local-tools)). |
| `dsh_wait_session` | Block until the turn a session is already running ends, then return the assistant text it produced — for `wait: false` starts, GUI-driven sessions, or another caller's work. Never prompts, steers, or cancels: reaching `timeoutMs` returns `status: "timedOut"` with the turn still running, so call it again; `status: "idle"` returns immediately when nothing is running. |
| `dsh_list_requests` | The user decisions a session — or the newest visible sessions, running first — is waiting on: approval requests (`approval/asked` with no matching `approval/decided`, the one-shot permission decision behind a sandbox escalation) and unanswered `ask_user_question` calls, with tool, reason, call id and seq. These audit events are invisible to the model, so this is how a caller learns *why* a delegated turn stopped progressing. Reporting only: the decision is granted in the Harness GUI. |
| `dsh_search_sessions` | Find sessions by content server-side and get bounded snippets instead of transcripts: title/cwd/owner/id (`scope: "title"`) or the messages themselves (`"messages"`, `"both"` by default). Looks at the newest `scan` sessions the caller can see (default 20), reports `where`/`seq`/`snippet` per match, and then `dsh_read_session` reads just that session. |
| `dsh_whoami` | How this endpoint identifies the calling agent — `x-dsh-mcp-client` header, else `initialize` `clientInfo`, else `User-Agent` — plus the sessions that agent created. Attribution, not authentication: callers share the endpoint token. |
| `dsh_cancel_session` | Cancel the active turn of a session without dropping its pending inbox. |
| `dsh_archive_session` | Archive one session durably: hidden from every grouping surface, and it cannot run a model step until restored. A session with running work is refused unless `stopActivity: true` (which archives first, then stops that work). Archiving drops the pin. |
| `dsh_unarchive_session` | Drop a session from the archive set; it is listed again and returns to its recorded workspace position. |
| `dsh_list_permission_presets` | The deployment's permission presets (each bundles a sandbox mode with an approval policy) plus the default for new sessions, for the `permissionPreset` argument above. |
| `dsh_list_tools` | The tools DSH exposes to its own agents, for choosing what a delegated prompt can do; `query` narrows by name or description and `limit` caps the list. |
| `dsh_open_session` | Ask the running Web GUI to open one session and select it in the sidebar — for pointing the person at a session this endpoint started. Queued for the page that is open and consumed once; the session itself is untouched. |
| `dsh_status` | Endpoint, profile, version, session/live-agent counts, default model, active turns, the default permission preset, the delivery policy, and the local tool surface (`dshTools`). |

Archival needs the Host's `workspaceRegistry` service (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-workspace`). Without it the
two archive tools report that the service is unavailable and listings simply omit the `archived`
field instead of guessing.

Permission presets need the Host's `permissionPresets` service
(`@deepseek-ai/dsh-permission-presets`). `permissionPreset` is applied through that service's own
`set()` — the same write path as the GUI `/permission` command — once the session is live and before
its prompt is admitted, so the turn's own tool calls already see the chosen sandbox mode and approval
policy. The outcome echoes the applied preset; `dsh_read_session` folds the session's last durable
`permission/preset` event back into its payload, and `dsh_status` carries `defaultPermissionPreset`
plus the catalog. Without the service the permission fields are omitted and
`dsh_list_permission_presets` reports that the service is unavailable. A session created without a
`permissionPreset` keeps the deployment default, exactly as a GUI-created session does.

Commands need the Host's `commands` service and are addressed by **agent**, not by session: the
registry merges a global layer with the layers of the preset that agent is mounted under, so
`dsh_list_commands` must be asked per session

plugins.description: 把 WorkBuddy2API 网关的模型目录自动同步进 DeepSeek Harness（模型名/思考档/最大上下文），带可视面板
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-workbuddy2api-connect

把 **WorkBuddy2API 网关**的模型目录自动同步进 **DeepSeek Harness**：模型名、思考档位、
最大上下文、最大输出、图像能力，全部来自网关的 `/v1/models`；**并带一个界面**，可以直接
增删路由、改分组名称 / URL / Key，保存即热重注册——不用手写配置，不用重启 DSH。

```
WorkBuddy2API 网关  GET /v1/models
        │  id / name / reasoning_supported_efforts / context_length / max_output_tokens / supports_images
        ▼
dsh-workbuddy2api-connect   （本插件：拉表 → 映射 → 注册 provider；界面负责增删路由）
        ▼
DSH  @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai  →  模型选择器里的一个分组（模型 + 推理等级 + 上下文窗口）
```

## 界面

装好并重启 DSH 后，打开左侧栏 **「插件」** → 本插件那一行的配置区（DSH 0.2.0 的
`plugins.bundle.config` 位，按包名 `dsh-workbuddy2api-connect` 分发）。

每一条路由就是一张卡，**三个输入** + 一个状态行：

| 字段 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| **分组名称** | 模型选择器里显示的分组名（如 `work2api-CN`） |
| **URL** | 网关的 OpenAI 兼容基地址（如 `http://192.168.1.201:7863/v1`） |
| **Key** | 网关的 API Key。**只写不回显**：已保存时输入框留空、标签提示「已保存，留空不改」，要换就填新的，要删就勾「清除已保存的 Key」 |

界面上不需要（也没有）路由 id 与凭据名，两者都由**分组名称自动派生**：

| 派生 | 规则 | 例子 |
|---|---|---|
| 路由 id（= provider 名） | 分组名称折小写、非 `a-z0-9._-` 的字符折成 `-`、去首尾符号、截断 48 字符；中文等非 ASCII 名称退化为 `wb2api`；重名自动加序号 | `work2api-CN` → `work2api-cn`；`我的网关` → `wb2api`；已有 `my-gw` 时 `My GW` → `my-gw-2` |
| 凭据名 | `WB2API_KEY_<路由id 大写、非字母数字折成 _>` | `my-gateway` → `WB2API_KEY_MY_GATEWAY` |

> **路由 id 只在新建时派生，之后改名不变**：界面会把它随保存请求回传（用户看不见），
> 所以改分组名称只是换个显示名，既有会话与 `agent-default-model` 里记的 `{provider, model}`
> 不会指空。想真正换 provider 名，直接编辑配置文件。

底部三个按钮：**保存并生效**（写入 + 热重注册 + 重拉模型表，全程不重启）、
**立即刷新模型表**、**重新读取**。每条路由的状态行显示 `20 个模型 · 上下文 192K–1000K ·
思考档 low/high/max · 可关思考 3 个 · 30 分钟前`；拉取失败时**原样显示网关的错误**
（例如密钥不对会看到 `HTTP 401 invalid_api_key`），而不是给一张空表。

密钥去向：**DSH 凭据库**（`ctx.credentials` 的 refs，即 `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`），
插件自己的配置文件里**只有凭据名、没有明文密钥**。

### 模型选择（勾选要启用的模型）

每张路由卡里有一个可折叠的 **「模型选择（启用 N / 共 M）」**：

- 展开后逐个列出网关返回的模型，**勾选 = 启用**；行尾标出要点（上下文 / 思考档 / 可关思考 / 图片 / 倍率）
- 支持 `全选` / `全不选` 和关键字过滤（模型多时按 id 或名字搜）
- 未勾选的模型进宿主的 `exclude` 列表，**不会注册进 DSH**——模型选择器里就只剩勾上的那些
- 保存后立即生效（热重注册）；一个都不勾时会提示该分组会是空的

**点一下就现拉清单（含错误提示）**：新建路由时填好 URL 与 Key，点卡片里的
**「拉取模型（按当前 URL / Key 去网关取）」** 就会就地请求 `…/models`（`POST /probe`，不落盘、
不注册），拉到什么立刻列出来，标题随即变成「模型选择（启用 N / 共 M）」。

拉不到时**把原因写在卡片里**，而不是留一张空表：

| 情况 | 卡片上看到的 |
|---|---|
| Key 不对 / 没权限 | `拉取模型失败：HTTP 401 Unauthorized——网关拒绝了这把 Key（不对、过期或没有权限）：…` |
| 端口没开 | `…：端口没有在监听（ECONNREFUSED）——检查地址与端口` |
| 域名解析不了 | `…：解析不了 … 的主机名（ENOTFOUND）——检查域名或网络` |
| 没有响应 | `…：超时（网关没有响应）` |
| 缺少 `/models` | `…：HTTP 404 …——这个地址下没有 /models，确认 URL 是否指到网关的 /v1 根` |
| URL 不合法 | `请先填 URL…` / `URL 不合法：…` / `URL 只支持 http/https，收到 ftp:` |
| 通了但没模型 | `… 通了，但没有解析出任何模型（返回里没有 data/models 数组）` |

- 已保存的路由**不用重填 Key**：只回传路由 id，宿主自己按凭据名去凭据库/环境变量取
- 改了 URL 或 Key，之前现拉的清单会自动作废（不会让旧清单冒充新地址的结果）
- 也有 `重新拉取` 按钮；现拉成功会标一句「清单来自 …（现拉，尚未保存）」

> 为什么用「排除」而不是「白名单」：网关新增模型时默认就可用，不会因为一份过期的白名单把新模型挡在外面。想全部启用就把勾选全打开（等价于 `exclude: []`）。

### 显示开关：命令与思考「完全展开」

卡片顶部还有一个 DSH 显示开关（**默认关闭**）：

| 开关 | 写入的值 | 效果 |
|---|---|---|
| 关（默认） | `ui-chat.transcriptView = standard` | 折叠已完成轮次、步骤分组——DSH 桌面版默认 |
| 开 | `ui-chat.transcriptView = verbose` | **轮次不折叠、步骤不分组**，命令与思考全部摊开 |

改的是 DSH 自己那个值（**设置 → 通用 → 工作详情**，同一个 `ui-chat` 设置分节），走
`ctx.configForms.get('ui-chat').set(...)`——宿主设置持久化 + **立即生效，不需要重启**；两边
随时同步（卡片订阅了设置变化，在 DSH 设置页改这里也跟着变）。开关旁会标出当前档位
（`compact` 精简 / `standard` 标准 / `detailed` 详细 / `verbose` 完全展开），四个档位都能被如实
显示出来。宿主没有设置服务（headless）时开关禁用并说明原因，不影响网关同步。

### 配置的优先级

| 来源 | 何时生效 |
|---|---|
| 界面保存的 `$DSH_HOME/.workbuddy2api-connect.json` | **优先**。存在即以此为准 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` 里本插件的 `config.routes` | 仅当上面的文件**不存在**时作为种子写入一次 |

也就是说：首次启动把 cordis 里的路由种进配置文件，之后界面（或手工改那个 JSON）是唯一
事实来源——不会出现「改了两处配置互相打架」。

## 它解决什么问题

DSH 自带的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` 支持手写网关路由，但在 `cordis.patch.yml` 里手写
路由时：

1. 只能写 `id` / `name` / `contextWindow` / `maxTokens` 这几个字段，**写不进思考档位**——
   想给某个模型加一行「推理等级」，得自己补 `reasoningEfforts`；
2. DSH 的设置界面**故意不提供档位控件**（`dsh-client-ui-settings-models` 的源码注释明确
   指向 `cordis.patch.yml`），也就是说档位只能手工维护；
3. 网关新增/下架模型，得改配置 + **重启 DSH** 才生效。

本插件把这条链子自动化：**从网关读事实，自己装配 provider**，并给一个界面来增删路由。

## 安装

两种方式都行：**从 Release 附件装**（推荐，不用 clone 源码），或**从源码打包装**。

### 桌面版

桌面版的 `desktop` profile 由 App 独占管理（独立 CLI 的 `--dump-config` 之类会被拒绝），
但装包这条路是通的。

**推荐：手工改两处配置再 `install`**——`dsh plugin add` 会重写 `dsh.profile.bundles`，实测会把
其它第三方 bundle 从列表里挤掉（本机丢过 `dsh-workbuddy-connect` 与
`@eghrhegpe/dsh-connect-qoder`）；而 `install` 只装依赖、**不动配置**。

```powershell
# 1) 从 Release 取附件（或自己 npm pack 出来的那个）放进本地插件目录
copy dsh-workbuddy2api-connect-0.5.0.tgz "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\local-plugins\"
```

2) 编辑 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\package.json` 两处：

- `dependencies` 里加一行
  `"dsh-workbuddy2api-connect": "file:C:/Users/<你>/.dsh/local-plugins/dsh-workbuddy2api-connect-0.5.0.tgz"`
- `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组里追加 `"dsh-workbuddy2api-connect"`

```powershell
# 3) 装依赖（DSH 自带的 CLI 只是 pnpm install）
cd "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop"
$dsh = "D:\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd"   # 换成你的安装目录
& $dsh plugin --profile desktop install
```

> 也可以一条命令 `& $dsh plugin --profile desktop add "<附件路径>"`（自动写依赖与 bundles），
> 但装完**务必核对 `dsh.profile.bundles`**，少了别的插件就补回去。

### Web / TUI

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/che246/dsh-workbuddy2api-connect/releases/download/v0.5.0/dsh-workbuddy2api-connect-0.5.0.tgz
```

### 从源码

```sh
npm pack                        # → dsh-workbuddy2api-connect-0.5.0.tgz
```

再按上面「桌面版」或「Web / TUI」的方式装上那个 tgz。

### 装完

**重启一次 DSH**：profile 的 patch 层与客户端 bundle 都只在启动时装配。重启后模型选择器里
出现本插件声明的分组（默认 `work2api-AI` / `work2api-CN`），「插件」页里出现配置卡片。

> ⚠️ 装/升级需要重启一次（插件在 boot 时注册 provider 路由与浏览器卡片）；此后改路由、
> 模型表变化都不再需要重启——这正是本插件的意义。
>
> ⚠️ `dsh plugin add` 会重写 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`：本机两次升级各丢过别的插件
> （`dsh-workbuddy-connect`、`@eghrhegpe/dsh-connect-qoder`），而 `install` 从不动配置。
> 这也是上面推荐手工改配置的原因；用 `add` 的话装完请核对那个列表。

## 兼容性与升级排查（DSH 更新后「不适配」）

DSH 更新后插件消失，实测两种成因，**都不在插件代码里**：

1. **profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 被重置**。更新会重写
   `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json`，bundles 里只剩官方条目，插件的
   `cordis.patch.yml` 于是根本不生效——看着像「不适配」，其实只是没被加载。
   把 `"dsh-workbuddy2api-connect"` 加回 `dsh.profile.bundles` 就恢复。
2. **manifest 的 peer 版本判定**。DSH 用 `evaluatePluginCompatibility` 比对
   `@deepseek-ai/dsh` / `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` 的 peer，而 DSH 版本是预发布序列
   （`0.2.0-rc.2` → `0.2.1-rc.2` → …）。npm semver 对预发布有额外规则：只有 range 里
   出现**同一个 X.Y.Z 的预发布比较符**，该版本才算满足。所以 `0.2.0-rc.2`、甚至
   `>=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0` 这种看似宽松的写法都判定不了 `0.2.1-rc.2`。**本插件因此不再声明
   任何 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer**——官方自带的插件也都不声明。

自检工具：

```sh
node tools/check-compat.mjs      # 用 DSH 自己的判定逻辑比对当前运行时；退出码 1 = 不兼容
node tools/dump-profile.mjs      # 看 profile 实际合成出的 bundle 层与插件条目
```

实测通过：`dsh 0.2.0-rc.2`（pi-ai 0.87.1）与 `dsh 0.2.1-rc.2`（pi-ai 1.1.0），各 100 项在线核对。

升级后安装还有一个坑：在「`resources/app/` 补丁版」这类部署里，升级后
`dsh plugin --profile desktop install` 可能报
`Cannot find module ...\app.asar\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop-host\lib\cli.js`
（CLI 仍按 asar 布局找入口）。这时不必修 CLI：把依赖与 bundle 条目写进 profile 的
`package.json`，再把 tgz 解压到 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/<包名>/`，
DSH 一样能解析（本机这次就是这么恢复的）。

## 配置（cordis 层）

插件自带一个 bundle 级 `cordis.patch.yml`，装完即用；要改就在 **profile 层**
（`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`）覆盖同名 `id` 的条目：

```yaml
- id: llm-workbuddy2api
  name: dsh-workbuddy2api-connect
  config:
    refreshMinutes: 30          # 模型表刷新周期（分钟）
    timeoutMs: 20000            # 单次模型表请求上限
    showRate: true              # 模型名后附带积分倍率（仅显示）
    maxTokensCap: 0             # 输出上限钳制（0 = 不钳制）
    configFile:                 # 路由配置文件，缺省 $DSH_HOME/.workbuddy2api-connect.json
    routes:                     # 仅当配置文件不存在时作为种子
      - id: workbuddy2api       # provider 名 = 选择器分组键（会话按它引用）
        displayName: work2api-AI
        baseURL: http://192.168.1.201:7864/v1
        apiKeyEnv: WORKBUDDY2API_API_KEY      # DSH 凭据库引用 → 环境变量 → apiKey
      - id: workbuddy2apicn
        displayName: work2api-CN
        baseURL: http://192.168.1.201:7863/v1
        apiKeyEnv: WORKBUDDY2APICN_API_KEY
        headers: {}             # 可选：附加请求头
        exclude: []             # 可选：要排除的模型 id
        defaultContextWindow: 262144
        defaultMaxTokens: 32768
        reasoning: high         # 可选：该路由的默认思考档
```

密钥的解析顺序：**DSH 凭据库（`apiKeyEnv` 引用）→ 环境变量 → 内联 `apiKey`**；三者都没有
时该路由的请求以 `MISSING_CREDENTIAL` 明确失败，而不是默默发一个匿名请求。

> 路由 id 与原手写路由保持同名是有意为之：`@deepseek-ai

plugins.description: 傲娇小鲸鱼：给 DeepSeek Harness 加一段可开关的全局人格段落（Tsundere whale-girl persona plugin for DSH）
plugins.readme_text:
# 傲娇小鲸鱼 · dsh-xiaojingyu-persona

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 挂上一段**可随时开关**的全局人格段落：从装上那一刻起，每个会话、每个子代理（包括 MCP 桥接创建的子 Agent）说话都带一点傲娇小鲸鱼的味道——但活照样干得漂亮。

- 一个 `enabled` 开关：插件管理页启用/停用，或插件设置里直接切换，立即生效，不用重启。
- 一段 `persona` 文本：不喜欢出厂文案？在插件设置里整段替换，不用改代码。
- 纯 Host 插件：没有客户端半、没有构建步骤、没有 install 脚本。

## 效果

开启后，模型的系统提示词里会多出一段：

> 你是「傲娇小鲸鱼」——主人身边的那只鲸鱼娘……自称「本小姐」……真的干活：需要事实就调用工具去查，不许凭空编造……

完整出厂文案见 [`PERSONA.md`](./PERSONA.md)。

## 安装

本插件需要在某个 profile 里安装（桌面端默认 profile 是 `desktop`）。

**从 GitHub 仓库安装**（把 `<owner>/<repo>` 换成实际地址，pnpm 会拉取仓库 tarball，无需本机装 git）：

```powershell
& "<?? DSH ????>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/archive/refs/heads/main.tar.gz
```

**从本地目录安装**（开发调试用）：

```powershell
& "<你的 DSH 安装目录>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add link:E:\path\to\dsh-xiaojingyu-persona
```

**从插件管理页安装**：Web UI 的「插件」页面 · 安装本地 bundle / 输入包目录。

装完**重启 DSH**（新 bundle 需要一次重启才会加载新的 JavaScript 模块）。

## 设置页卡片（Web UI）

装好后在 **设置** 页会出现一个「傲娇小鲸鱼 · 人格预设」分区（客户端注册在 `settings.section` 槽位）：

- 展示 **三视图**（`assets/turnaround.jpg`，以 base64 内嵌进 `client.js`，不额外请求网络）；
- 展示 **出厂人设**，放在**可编辑文本框**里（默认值取自 `index.js` 的 `DEFAULT_PERSONA`，单一来源；就绪后以主机里的当前值为准）；
- **保存到配置**：直接写主机配置行的 `persona` 字段（客户端服务 `configForms` → `form.set('persona', text)`），保存后对**新建会话**生效；
- **启用 / 停用**：同样是直写 `enabled`；
- 辅助：恢复出厂文案、复制到剪贴板、字数、状态徽标（未就绪 / 可保存）。

### 三视图也可自定义（banner 字段）

- 卡片里的「选择本地图片…」会读图 → 浏览器侧缩到宽 720px → 转 JPEG（q 0.86，必要时逐级降到 0.4），直到 data URL ≤ 190,000 字符；
- 「保存三视图」把它写进配置行的 `banner` 字段（空串 = 使用插件内置的 `assets/turnaround.jpg`）；
- 「恢复内置图」把 `banner` 清空；
- 代价：自定义图以 data URL 存在 `cordis.patch.yml` 的配置行里，行会明显变胖（上限 ~190 KB 文本）。想彻底干净就得让 host 端存文件并提供路由，属于后续增强。

### 卡内保存是怎么做到的

客户端注入官方的 `configForms` 服务（与 `@linxin666/dsh-pet` 同一套机制）：

```js
inject: ['slots', 'configForms']
const form = ctx.configForms.get('xiaojingyu-persona')   // 配置行 id
await form.set('persona', text)                           // true / false
form.getSnapshot()                                        // { status, value, revision }
```

该服务**可能在 apply() 之后才发布**（官方 `dsh-pet` 的注释明确提到这一点），因此卡片内用 40×250ms 的轮询延迟绑定，并对 `status === 'ready'` 才允许保存。`ctx.configForms.describe()` 会列出主机实际服务的命名空间，卡片据此自动匹配本插件的行 id。

## 开关与配置

| 方式 | 位置 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 启用 / 停用 | Web UI「插件」页面该插件行 | 停用后人格段落立刻消失，其余功能不受影响 |
| `enabled` | 插件设置表单 | `true`（默认）生效，`false` 关闭 |
| `persona` | 插件设置表单 | 整段替换人格文案；留空则回落出厂文案 |

手工改配置的话，在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里按 id 覆盖（**按 id 覆盖会整体替换 config，字段要写全**）：

```yaml
- id: xiaojingyu-persona
  name: 'dsh-xiaojingyu-persona'
  config:
    enabled: true
    persona: |
      你是一只傲娇小鲸鱼……
```

## 工作原理（以及为什么不是「新增一个段」）

很多插件会注册一个**新段名**来注入人格，但在按段名白名单收敛提示词的 agent preset 下（例如 `@linxin666/dsh-liangshen` 的 `minimal-prompt` 只保留 `deployment:persona-prefix` / `deployment:persona` / `persona` / `plan:policy` / `tools:*`），自定义段会被静默过滤掉——插件看起来「装了没效果」。

所以本插件的做法是：挂 `system-prompt/assemble`（`prepend: true`，拿到最终段列表），把人格文本**追加进已经存在、且必然被保留的 persona 段**；若某份 preset 完全没有 persona 段，则补一个名为 `persona` 的兜底段。

顺带一提：追加不会动工具指导、runtime context、协作监听器等其它段，因此「越狱式」丢失能力的风险不存在——人格只改口气。

### 这是一次有理由的偏离

DSH 官方插件开发指引（`cordis-plugin-development/references/practices.md`）建议用 `ctx.systemPrompt.section()` 注册段，并明确劝阻监听 `system-prompt/assemble` 去增删文本。本插件仍然选择后者，原因实测：`section()` 注册的**新段名**会被「按段名白名单收敛提示词」的 preset 直接过滤掉（例如 `dsh-liangshen` 的 `minimal-prompt` 只保留 `deployment:persona-prefix` / `deployment:persona` / `persona` / `plan:policy` / `tools:*`）——那样插件会「装了没效果」。两害相权，选可用的那个，并把偏离写在这里。

## 卸载

```powershell
& "<你的 DSH 安装目录>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-xiaojingyu-persona
```

或在插件管理页里移除该 bundle，然后重启。

## 开发

- 入口 `index.js`：`apply(ctx, config)` + `Config`（schemastery）。纯函数 `appendPersona()` 可离线单测。
- 语法自检：`node --check index.js`。
- 依赖只有 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`（宿主已自带同名包，安装时会正常解析）。

## 兼容性

- 需要 DSH `>= 0.2.0-rc.2`（`dsh-persona` 段的段名与 `system-prompt/assemble` 事件在本版可用）。
- 与 `dsh-persona`（preset 内人设行）、`dsh-cosplay` 可共存：本插件不注册新段、不改段名，只把文本追加进 persona 段。
- 若同时装了别的也挂 `system-prompt/assemble` 的插件（例如 `dsh-liangshen` 的 `minimal-prompt`），谁在外层决定「工作区行 / 调度规则」与人格文本的先后次序；两种顺序都实测通过，不丢内容。

## `link:` 本地安装的一个坑

用 `dsh plugin ... add link:<目录>` 安装时，插件目录是**软链接**，Node 按真实路径解析依赖，因此它**看不到** profile 的 `node_modules`。本插件对 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 做了容错：解析不到时不导出 Config schema（loader 对无 schema 的插件原样放行 config），**插件照常工作，人格照常注入**，只是少了设置表单里的 `enabled` / `persona` 两个字段。

想要设置表单，二选一：

```powershell
# A. 在插件目录里装上它声明的依赖（推荐本地开发时用）
npm install --prefix <本目录绝对路径>
```

```powershell
# B. 或者改成从仓库 tarball 安装，pnpm 会自己把依赖装进 profile
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/archive/refs/tags/v1.0.13.tar.gz
```

## 已知限制

- **`complete: true` 的人设 preset 下本插件静默无效**：系统提示词服务会在组装瀑布**之前**就浅拷贝该 complete 段、瀑布**之后**用它整体替换 sections（`dsh-system-prompt` 里 `completeSection = { ...assembled }` 与 `sections: [completeSection]`），因此任何监听器对段的修改都会被丢掉——这是设计使然，插件层绕不过去。**内置的 `minimal` preset 就是 `complete: true`**，用它会看不到人设；请选用 `standard` / `ptc` / `cordis` / 自定义 preset（例如 `liangshen`）等非 complete 的组合。
- **自定义文案里的 `{{...}}` 会被安全化**：persona 段文本参与提示词插值，写成 `{{foo}}` 会在渲染时抛 `unknown prompt variable`，打挂该会话的每一次组装；因此注入前把 `{{` / `}}` 拆成 `{ {` / `} }`（其余文本逐字保留）。
- **`dsh.engines.dsh` 只是声明**：DSH 目前不读取该字段，真正的运行门槛是本插件用到的 `system-prompt/assemble` 与 volatile Config 行为（0.2.0-rc.2 起可用）。这里刻意**不**声明 `peerDependencies: {"@deepseek-ai/dsh": ...}`——那会把宿主整包拉进 profile 的 node_modules，反而制造 dual-package hazard。

## 许可

MIT
