--- **📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/). ## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你 这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。 *English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it. ## What is dsh-permission-rules? Claude Code-style declarative permission rules for DeepSeek Harness. Rules decide what is known. A reviewer model decides what is not. ![Terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules: dsh-permission-rules — deny/ask rules in one YAML file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.png) ![Animated terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.gif) *The same run, animated.* ## Compatibility | Surface | Status | |---|---| | Harness | DeepSeek Harness `dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.1` (adapted 2026-09-22, full gate chain): its plugin config is the live settings contract — every field is declared `.volatile()`, the Loader hands `apply` a live reference per field, and a saved edit is committed into the running references WITHOUT remounting the plugin, with out-of-range values refused by the schema before anything is written. A host whose Schemastery predates `volatile()` (before 3.18.3) still mounts and runs this plugin — the fields simply stay ordinary values and the live config form is unavailable — because the marker is applied through a capability probe rather than assumed. `Session.append` on this line still cannot stamp the `ignorable` marker (its third argument is the surface-intent bag, and the envelope field survives for stored-log reads only), so the whole `0.2-alpha` line is pre-checked as unmarked and session-log audit stays disabled by default — `append` reads only `sourceEventSeqs`/`surfaceOp` and freezes the envelope, so it has no code path that could stamp the marker; the earlier `0.1.7-alpha` (adapted 2026-09-22), `0.1.5-rc.2` (adapted 2026-09-09) and `0.1.3-alpha` lines keep the same surface-only append signature, and every `0.2` prerelease is classified with them (a STABLE `0.2.x` release is left to the append probe, so a restored marker surface is adopted without a new plugin release). Those lines' log migrations refuse unclassified plugin events even when marked, so `strip` v1 audit rows before a `0.1.3-alpha` host opens the log and v2 audit rows before a `0.1.5-alpha` host migrates it (native v3 logs only need `repair`). | | Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` | | Platforms | All (host + web settings client) | | Model | Any (deny/ask reasons surface through tool results) | ## What you get `dsh-permission-rules` puts an ordered **`allow` / `deny` / `ask`** rule list in front of every tool call on the `tools/pre-execute` waterfall — deterministic, instant, auditable, and written by you in plain YAML: - **`deny`** blocks the call; the rule's `reason` becomes the model-visible error. - **`ask`** rides the official approval seam (mount `dsh-auto-review` for a second-model answerer, or a human answers; with neither, the harness fails closed). - **`allow`** (and no-match) strictly delegates via `next()` — downstream listeners are never short-circuited. Every hit **and** every passthrough is audit-logged as a `permissionRules/decision` session event (log-only — nothing extra is injected into the model context). - **Rich matching** — tool-name globs (including `mcp__*`), agent-identity selectors (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:*`), argument key/value globs **or** regexes (with `!pattern` negation and an `absent` key dimension), workspace-relative path globs at **any nesting depth**, `when` host conditions (env vars, platform), and **shell command decomposition** (`argv`: command word, argument tokens, pipeline signature) for token-precise command matching. - **Built-in high-risk baseline** — a shipped deny/ask ruleset (destructive commands, privilege escalation, download-and-execute, sensitive paths) enabled by default and appended after user rules so a nearer user rule can override it; toggle with `builtin.enabled`. - **Hierarchical rule files** — optional `searchUp` merges every `.dsh/rules.yaml` from the session cwd to the filesystem root, nearest first. - **Dry-run rollout** — `enforce: false` audits what the policy *would* do while passing every call through. - **Hot reload** — Chokidar watch with debounce; a broken edit keeps the previous rules, never crashes. On a WSL host, or for a rule file under `/mnt/`, the watch switches to polling because native change events are unreliable there. - **Fail loud** — invalid YAML, unknown actions/fields, bad globs/regexes, backtracking-prone patterns, or more than `maxRules` rules fail the load. ## Rule syntax ```yaml # /.dsh/rules.yaml rules: - match: { tools: [bash, pwsh], params: { command: "git push*" }, paths: ["**/secrets/**"] } action: deny reason: "No pushes from protected paths" - match: { tools: [edit, write] } action: ask reason: "File writes need confirmation" ``` - **Match dimensions** — `tools` (globs, incl. `mcp__*`), `agents` (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:`; unknown identity never matches — fail closed), `params` (key/value globs or regexes, `!pattern` negation, `absent` key dimension), `paths` (workspace-relative globs extracted at any nesting depth), `when` (`env` var globs/regexes + a closed `platform` list), and `network` (`domains` / `ips` / `ports` / `schemes` — globs, wildcards, CIDRs, port ranges). - **Actions** — `allow` / `deny` / `ask`, evaluated in file order, first match wins. - **Rule metadata** — `enabled: false` (visible but inert), `description`, `tags`; unknown fields fail the load. - **Schema**

plugins.description: Runtime evidence that helps agents trace, profile, and burn down hotspots in application and native code, GPU kernels, and inference stacks.
plugins.readme_text:
flameox

Bounded local runtime evidence for coding agents.

Flameox coordinates profilers, benchmark tools, trace processors, and direct local targets. It turns an explicit artifact or command into bounded evidence while keeping durable preservation optional. The agent chooses hypotheses and experiments; Flameox records observed inputs, execution provenance, typed evidence, coverage, and limitations. There is no workspace to initialize or project configuration to maintain. Pass exact artifact paths to analysis and an explicit argv plus absolute working directory to capture. Flameox does not search parent directories, edit project files, or provide a hosted service. ## Quick start Configure an MCP client with the global setup command: ```console npx flameox@latest setup ``` Setup detects supported clients and asks which configurations to update. For automation, select clients explicitly, for example `--client codex --yes` or `--all --yes`; `--dry-run` reports the paths and actions without writing. Setup preserves unrelated client configuration and does not change project files. See [the npm package guide](npm/README.md) for details. Update existing MCP registrations with: ```console npx flameox@latest update ``` `update --check` reports available updates without changing configuration. Updates preserve each client's provider extras and settings, verify the new environment before changing release pins, and report which clients need a restart or reconnect. Use `--client codex` to select one client, or `--version 0.2.8` to select a specific release, including for rollback. The Python CLI exposes the same `flameox update` command. For direct CLI use, pass exact artifact paths or an explicit command: ```console uvx flameox analyze preview_artifact /absolute/path/to/artifact.json uvx flameox capture --provider direct --cwd "$PWD" -- python benchmark.py ``` To launch the stdio MCP server manually: ```console uvx flameox mcp serve ``` For local development, clone the repository, install its development dependencies, and inspect the available tools: ```console git clone https://github.com/morluto/flameox.git cd flameox uv sync --extra dev --extra memory --extra trace --extra cpu uv run flameox mcp inspect ``` ## Evidence and storage Analysis and unpreserved capture use bounded session scratch. Session `analysis_id` values expire when evicted or when the server stops. Explicit preservation creates the user-level Flameox data directory and stores native bytes and a canonical evidence bundle by SHA-256. Set `FLAMEOX_DATA_DIR` to choose another location. Preservation is optional; it does not imply full console-output retention. Flameox distinguishes observed, derived, and inferred claims. Profiles guide exploration but do not establish causality or performance improvement. Confirmatory claims require representative workloads, declared metrics and estimands, compatible identities, preserved samples, and a semantic oracle. ## MCP The MCP server has no workspace binding. It exposes named analysis and capture tools through the same operation registry as the CLI. Analysis tools accept explicit sources; capture tools accept a typed target and provider. Tool schemas expose operation-specific fields directly. Inspect the catalog with `flameox mcp inspect`; use `--tool TOOL_NAME` for focused schemas and examples. The complete contract and current tool catalog are in [the interface guide](docs/interfaces.md). Tools return their full bounded results inline, including failures and recovery actions. Preserved evidence has a durable `evidence_id`; `inspect_evidence` returns its redacted metadata and replay sources inline. Capture takes argv, not a shell string. A direct target supplies an absolute working directory and bounded environment overrides. Results may include `next_page`; replay its named analysis tool and arguments unchanged. Capture continuations read collected artifacts and do not rerun the target. MCP work belongs to the live request, so cancellation applies directly and no detached job survives a restart. ## Documentation - [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) describes process and package boundaries. - [Storage and evidence](docs/storage-and-evidence.md) defines preservation and provenance. - [Investigations](docs/investigations.md) covers experiments, comparison, and evidence quality. - [Adapters](docs/adapters.md) documents provider compatibility and integration policy. - [Runtime safety](docs/runtime-safety.md) covers limits, recovery, integrity, and privacy. - [Interfaces](docs/interfaces.md) defines CLI and MCP contracts. - [Testing](docs/testing.md) describes test selections and known proof gaps. ## Development Flameox requires Python 3.12 or newer and uses the committed `uv.lock`. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for development setup and contribution guidance. ```console uv run ruff check src tests tools uv run ruff format --check src tests tools uv run mypy src tests tools uv run pytest -q ``` Flameox is licensed under the MIT License.

plugins.description: DSH 1.5 能力组合器：按会话或工作区编排工具、技能与 MCP，按需缩小系统提示。仅支持 DSH 1.5，后续会跟进更新。 / Capability composer for DSH 1.5: per-session tool / skill / MCP compositions that shrink the system prompt on demand. DSH 1.5 only; newer releases will follow.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-capability-composer

**The resident tool surface collapses into a few switchable sets, shrinking the system prompt on demand.**

> ⚠️ **DSH 1.5 only** (`>=0.1.5-rc.2 <0.2.0`). Newer DSH releases will be supported in follow-up updates.

> 🟢 **Collision risk: very low.** It occupies **one server-side seam (`system-prompt/assemble`)** — only **4** plugins here share it — and its **two client slots are both `list` / `keyed`** (stackable, one cell per key), never `chain`. See [Compatibility](#compatibility).

**English** · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-1.5-4c6ef5.svg)](#compatibility)
[![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows%20%7C%20macOS%20%7C%20Linux-lightgrey.svg)](#compatibility)

**Shrink what the model sees, not what is running.**

---

## Table of contents

- [What this is](#what-this-is)
- [What it does (four mechanisms)](#what-it-does-four-mechanisms)
- [How a composition is resolved (three levels)](#how-a-composition-is-resolved-three-levels)
- [UI](#ui)
- [Screenshots](#screenshots)
- [Configuration](#configuration)
- [HTTP API](#http-api)
- [🔗 Integration](#-integration)
- [Known limitations (stated plainly)](#known-limitations-stated-plainly)
- [Installation](#installation)
- [Compatibility](#compatibility)
- [FAQ](#faq)
- [Repository layout](#repository-layout)
- [Self-check](#self-check)
- [License](#license)

---

## What this is

By default DSH stuffs all of the following **into every single request**:

| What gets stuffed in | Measured size |
|---|---|
| **Tool schema** registered by every installed plugin | 414 tool definitions / ~65.6K tokens |
| The **catalog of all skills** | ~76K tokens as a baseline |
| The **system-prompt section** registered by each plugin | `agent-teams:usage` ≈1296 tok + `plugin:dsh-docker` ≈579 tok + `plugin:api-client` ≈254 tok |

Every request pays for "the things you might use", while only a few of them are actually useful in this turn.

`dsh-capability-composer` groups these into **compositions**, and **only lets the current composition into the context**.

### What it does / what it does not do

Let's make the boundary clear first, because this is where misunderstandings happen most easily:

| ✅ It does | ❌ It does not |
|---|---|
| Narrow **the plugin catalog the model sees** | Never turns off any plugin — plugin processes keep running, the UI keeps showing them |
| Shadow **skill catalog entries** that are not on the list | Never removes skills — `/skill-name` can still be invoked manually |
| Make tools **non-resident by default** (keeping only the core + meta tools) | Does not restrict execution — `invoke_tool` can call anything by default |
| Prune the **system-prompt sections** registered by plugins, according to the composition | Does not touch committed history |
| Resolve compositions at the session / workspace / global levels | Does not modify any third-party plugin file on disk |

In one sentence: **it shrinks "the catalog the model can see", not "the things that are running".** Plugins keep running, skills stay available, tools stay callable — all that changes is how much gets stuffed into each request.

---

## What it does (four mechanisms)

### ① Tools are non-resident by default

**Only 31 are resident**: the 28 official core tools, plus 3 meta tools — `search_plugins` / `load_plugin` / `invoke_tool`.

All other tools **never enter the tools list**. The model sees them in the catalog section of the system prompt (section heading `# 可用插件与 MCP 工具`), and calls them directly when needed:

```js
invoke_tool({ tool: "mcp__vnpy__run_backtest", args: { ... } })
```

Use `load_plugin` when a whole group needs to be loaded:

```js
load_plugin({ ids: ["mcp:vnpy"] })
```

**The granularity is "plugin", not "tool name".** This is deliberate: finer granularity was tried — after 417 / 211 tool names were compressed away, the model had no idea what to search for, which made things harder to use instead. The granularity now is the plugin.

Mounting it prints one log line saying so:

```
工具按需加载已挂载：常驻白名单 28 个 + 元工具 3 个（其余全部按需；组合只决定可见范围）
```

### ② Skill shadowing (not disabling)

A skill that is not in the current skill composition gets a **shadow entry with the same name** registered:

- `invocation.modelInvocable: false` — does not enter the skill catalog the model can see and auto-invoke
- `rank: 0` — the lowest rank wins, shadowing the original skill

**`/skill-name` can still be invoked manually.**

One shadow entry is mounted at the global level, and every agent gets one more at the **"nearest level"**, so that session-level compositions also take effect at the agent dimension.

### ③ Plugin compositions narrow "the model's plugin catalog"

Narrowing happens **when the catalog section is generated**, not by unloading plugins.

There are **two lines that are never narrowed**:

- **MCP server lines** — one line per MCP server; the tools inside a server are not governed by compositions
- **The "unassigned tools" fallback line** — tools that cannot be attributed to any plugin are always kept

### ④ System-prompt sections registered by plugins are pruned by composition too

Plugin compositions **cannot control** "the system-prompt sections a plugin registers for itself" — those are inserted by the plugin itself in `system-prompt/assemble`, and are a different thing from the catalog section.

This plugin's `prunePluginSections()` is the only place that can prune them according to the current plugin composition.

Measured saving: **≈2129 tokens / request**:

| Section | Size |
|---|---|
| `agent-teams:usage` | ≈1296 tok |
| `plugin:dsh-docker` | ≈579 tok |
| `plugin:api-client` | ≈254 tok |

**Fail-open design** — better to prune too little than to prune by mistake:

- A section whose owner cannot be identified is always kept
- A section without a namespace is always kept
- When the visible plugin list is empty, **nothing is pruned**, and the log records 「没有『不在组合里』的依据，宁可留着」
- When the plugin list cannot be obtained, nothing is pruned either

Every drop prints one line of evidence to the log.

It can be turned off with `DSH_COMPOSER_PRUNE_PLUGIN_SECTIONS=0`.

---

## How a composition is resolved (three levels)

**The rule is "the nearest level that specifies something wins" — not a strict override.**

| Level | Description |
|---|---|
| 1. **Session** | specified for the current session alone |
| 2. **Workspace** | specified for the current working directory (`cwd`) |
| 3. **Global** | `pinned[axis]['*']` |

A few easy-to-get-wrong points:

- **An empty string / an empty array / `null` all count as "not specified"** and keep inheriting from the level above — they do not mean "specified as empty"
- **A single level can select several entries**; the union is taken
- **An empty list = no filtering** (not "select none"). To select none, use `__none__`

The UI shows which level the current one comes from: 『当前会话』 / 『当前工作区』 / 『全局』 (Session / Workspace / Global).

---

## UI

It installs into DSH's **Settings → Plugins**, adding two tabs:

### Plugin compositions

Decides which plugins appear in **the model's plugin catalog**.

### Skill compositions

Decides which skills appear in **the model's skill catalog**. You can create a composition, rename it, delete it (with a second confirmation), rename a series, delete a series, select all / select none, and search skills.

### Changes take effect immediately, no restart needed

- UI changes are **debounced by 400 ms**, then `POST /dsh-capability-composer/state`
- After the host writes to disk, the state is refreshed immediately

### Saving merges item by item per composition name, not a whole-state overwrite

The server state is the base; only composition names that **actually exist** in the local draft are overwritten. So a composition created elsewhere will not be accidentally deleted by this UI.

The trade-off: a composition deleted here will be "resurrected" if it still exists on the server. **This is a deliberately conservative direction** — losing a composition costs far more than keeping one extra composition.

plugins.description: 数据出境检查：查代码与配置里的境外数据出口、个人信息外发、缺安全评估说明。
plugins.readme_text:
# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-cn-data-export

**数据出境检查** —— 查代码与配置里的境外数据出口。

## 不装它会怎样

你的代码里有这么一行：

```js
fetch('https://api.mixpanel.com/track', {
  body: JSON.stringify({ phone, email })
});
```

看起来是普通的埋点。但**这是数据出境** —— 用户手机号和邮箱被发到了境外服务。

《数据出境安全评估办法》要求这类传输走**安全评估 / 标准合同 / 认证**三条路径之一。
法务和客户尽调都会问这件事，而**开发通常不知道自己踩了**。

## 它查什么

| 级别 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 🟠 高 | 个人信息字段直接发往境外端点 · 境外服务密钥硬编码 |
| 🟡 中 | 代码/配置里出现境外服务端点（**需人工确认**）|
| 🟢 低 | 文档里找不到数据出境说明 |

## 重要的边界：出现 ≠ 违规

**`EXPORT-OVERSEAS-ENDPOINT` 报的是「这里有个境外域名」，不是「你违规了」。**

```
拉取公开文档 / 从境外 CDN 取图        → 没问题
把用户手机号 POST 到境外分析服务       → 构成数据出境
```

**同一个域名，两种性质。** 所以这条规则是**提示你逐个确认**，不是判定。

真正说明问题的是 **`EXPORT-PII-OVERSEAS`** —— 个人信息字段与境外端点在同一个文件里。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-cn-data-export
# 或纯 CLI
npx @deepwhale-cn/dsh-cn-data-export
```

![dsh-cn-data-export 检查报告示例](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-cn-data-export/report.png)

![dsh-cn-data-export 演示模式输出](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-cn-data-export/demo.png)

![dsh-cn-data-export 规则与依据](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-cn-data-export/rules.png)

## 用法

```bash
dsh-cn-data-export --demo
dsh-cn-data-export --list-rules
dsh-cn-data-export --html r.html
```

## 边界

- **域名清单有限** —— 覆盖常见境外 SaaS/云服务；自建境外机房、IP 直连扫不到。
- **不做数据流分析** —— 只看代码里字面出现的域名与字段名。
- **判断不了「是否构成出境」** —— 那是需要知道数据种类/数量/接收方的人工判断。
- 与 [dsh-data-scan](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-scan) 分工：那个查**境内**数据在哪，这个查**数据去哪了**。

**关键词**：数据出境 · 个人信息出境 · 跨境传输 · 数据出境安全评估办法 · 数据安全法 · 出境安全评估 · 标准合同
**Keywords**: data export · cross-border transfer · data export assessment · standard contractual clauses · China compliance

本插件是一个工具。使用者必须遵守所在地区法律法规，**对使用本项目造成的任何后果自行承担责任。**

---

## 深鲸网安守护系列（共 31 个）

> 一个插件做一件事。**安全问题是链式的** —— 配套用才完整。

**国内合规** ｜ [等保对照](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-mlps) · [日志留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-log-retention) · [备案公示](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-filing) · [用户同意](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-consent-guard) · [个人信息权利](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-rights) · [未成年人保护](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-minor-guard) · [影响评估](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-pipia) · [数据分类分级](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-classify) · [算法备案](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-algorithm-filing) · [**数据出境**](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-data-export) · [国密合规](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-crypto) · [AI 内容标识](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-ai-labeling)

**AI 与 Agent 治理** ｜ [AI 输出信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ai-output-trust) · [外部内容信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-content-trust) · [MCP 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-mcp-audit) · [Agent 权限](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-scope) · [策略核对](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-policy) · [可疑指令](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-phishing-guard)

**数据与凭据** ｜ [敏感数据](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-scan) · [密钥轮换](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-key-rotate) · [数据留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-lifecycle) · [配置审计](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-env-audit) · [密钥扫描](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-secret-scan)

**供应链与构建** ｜ [开源许可](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-license-guard) · [依赖投毒](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-dep-audit) · [CI 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ci-guard) · [工具审查](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-tool-vet) · [物料清单](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-sbom)

plugins.description: One-click prompt enhancement plugin for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-prompt-enhancer

一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件：在输入框工具栏加一个 **✦** 按钮，点击即可把当前草稿改写成更清晰、更具体的提示词。

- 结果直接写回输入框，可撤回
- 草稿中的 `@文件引用` 逐字保留
- 输入框为空时不显示按钮

## 使用

1. 在输入框里写下你的提示词（为空则按钮不显示）
2. 点击工具栏右侧的 **✦** 图标
3. 稍等片刻，草稿会被替换为优化后的提示词
4. 不满意就点 **撤回**，恢复原文

按钮有三种状态：

| 状态 | 外观 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 待优化 | ✦ | 点击开始优化 |
| 优化中 | 旋转图标 | 自动禁用，防止重复点击 |
| 可撤回 | ↺ 撤回 | 点击恢复原始提示词 |

优化完成后如果手动修改了草稿，撤回按钮会自动变回 ✦。

## 安装

**方式一：插件管理器（推荐）**

在对话中让 Agent 安装本目录，或使用插件管理工具：

```
plugin_manager { "action": "install_bundle", "target": "<本目录绝对路径>" }
```

安装后可在 **侧边栏 → 插件** 页看到「提示词增强」，可随时启停。

**方式二：手工挂载**

在 profile（`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>`）下：

1. 让包可被解析：`pnpm add link:<本目录绝对路径>`
2. 在 `cordis.patch.yml` 追加：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: prompt-enhancer
      name: 'dsh-prompt-enhancer'
```

> 替换已安装的插件后需重启进程才能加载新代码。

## 要求

- Harness 已配置可用的模型服务
- 优化使用当前部署的默认模型，可在插件配置中指定 `provider` / `model` 覆盖

## License

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-engramory-recall

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-engramory-recall?color=blue)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-engramory-recall)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)](LICENSE)
[![dsh-xray](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https%3A%2F%2Funstone.github.io%2Fdsh-xray%2Fbadge%2Fyffo__dsh-engramory-recall.json)](https://unstone.github.io/dsh-xray/registry.html#yffo__dsh-engramory-recall)
[English →](README.en.md)

> **记忆库就在磁盘上，可模型每轮都像失忆** —— 除非你亲口提醒它「你先读一下记忆」。
> 装上这个插件：相关的老笔记会在**每一轮自己浮上来**（最多 4 条提醒、总共不超过 480 字），
> 不用你再手动投喂。

一条命令装上（重启一次宿主生效）：`dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-engramory-recall`

[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的**本地记忆插件**。记忆库就是一份普通 markdown 文件夹（默认 `~/memory/engramory`），
布局遵循本仓库自己维护并冻结的 **Format v1**（[`docs/format.md`](docs/format.md)）—— 它**借鉴**了
[Engramory 协议](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory)（MIT）「一事一文 + 索引当小抄 + 索引有硬上限」的路子，
规范文本与实现都在这边：**检索、注入、账本、写入闸门、归档、体检、面板、MCP 全部自研**，与上游没有共享代码
（借用部分的版权与出处见 [`THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`](THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md)）。
全部用 `node:` 内置模块实现：**零第三方依赖、零网络、默认零模型调用、零常驻进程**。

## 这是什么

用 markdown 攒长期记忆的人都会撞上同一堵墙：**记是记下来了，可 agent 不会自觉去翻。**
每次都得你手动说一句「你先读一下记忆」——不读，就等于没记。

这个插件补的就是这一步。装上之后，会发生三件事：

1. **不用再自己翻记忆。** 你正常说话就行：相关的老笔记会自己跟上来，在这一轮里多出一条
   「可能相关的既有条目」——文件名 + 命中的那一行片段 + 一句「需要细节自己 `read`」。
   模型顺着它去读原文，你不必再当那个提醒它翻笔记本的人。
2. **只在对的时候出现，而且永远有上限。** 没命中就一个 token 都不注入；命中最多 4 条、
   一轮最多 480 字符（两个数都能调）。「继续」「嗯」「好的」这类寒暄直接放行，零开销。
3. **看得见有没有用上。** 会话里多一个「记忆」标签页：这轮为什么提醒 / 为什么没提醒、
   提醒过的后来有没有被打开、库里有哪些笔记、写得干不干净，都在里面。

顺带还管住三件事（都能关）：**写入保护**（不合规的笔记当场拒写）、**静态体检**（20 项检查，
只报告不动手）、**可逆归档**（把「第 N 批」这类追加式章节整段搬进 `-history.md`，不删历史）。

有几个词，下面统一说人话：

| 你可能看到的词 | 人话 |
|---|---|
| **注入** / 注入一条 | 提醒。把「库里有这几篇相关的」顺手塞进这一轮 |
| **指针** | 一条提醒：一篇笔记的文件名 + 命中的那一行片段 |
| **打开率** | 提醒被用上的比例 —— 提醒了 N 条，后来真的被读了几条 |

`maxPointers` / `maxChars` 这些只是它们的键名，配置表里都给了人话名。

## ✨ 特性

| | 特性 | 人话说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 🧠 | 每轮自动想起 | 在每个用户轮的开头检索一次，命中就顺手提醒模型「库里有这几篇相关的」 |
| 🎯 | 带的是那句话，不是提问的回声 | 注入行按 IDF 挑正文里的句子，标题/描述复述用户问话要被折扣；公开口径「地基句保住率」39.6% → **85.4%** |
| 💸 | 没命中就是不花 | 命中了才塞指针，没命中一个 token 都不注入；寒暄（「继续」「嗯」）连检索都不做 |
| 🔒 | 数据不出本机 | 只需要文件读写权限，不要网络；不建库、不生成索引文件、明文 markdown 可读可 diff |
| 🙅 | 不替你写，也不替你删 | 不往库里写东西、没有自动遗忘、没有自动合并；归档只搬走，不删除 |
| 🎚️ | 硬上限 | 一轮的字符数、条数、索引体积都有天花板，且超限是**拒绝**，不是悄悄截断 |
| 🛡️ | 写入保护 | 不合规文件名 / 缺 frontmatter / 疑似真实密钥，写进来的那一刻就被打回并留审计 |
| 🗄️ | 可逆归档 | 追加式章节搬进 `<笔记>-history.md`，先备份、两段式确认，没有一步不可逆 |
| 🩺 | 体检器 | 20 项检查：孤儿笔记、索引重复、失联路径、超 100KB、待办 30 天没更新、「带进上下文 20 次一次没被读过」、**索引快满了该压哪几行**… |
| 🧹 | 消费侧门控 | 带进上下文很多次、一次都没被读过的笔记会被降权（默认），证据确凿的才移出注入；「过期」只降权不拦 —— 旧不等于没用 |
| 📊 | 打开率账本 + 记忆周报 | 每次提醒、每次被打开都落一行 JSONL；`npm run recall:stats` 看账，`npm run recall:report` 出一页人话周报（谁在干活、花了多少上下文、「本轮一个字都没进」也可见） |
| 🖼️ | 一页人话面板 | 「记忆」标签页：**首屏三问**（这一轮提醒了什么 / 用上了多少 / 有没有人被拦住）接着八个页签看明细；只读、每 3 秒自刷新，另有术语表和「我要的功能在哪个开关上」两张清单 —— 看不懂的仪表盘等于没有面板 |
| 🧩 | 别的宿主也能蹭 | `mcp.js` 是零依赖的 stdio MCP 服务器：五个只读工具 + 索引资源 + 两个提示（`recall` / `curate`），同一份库挂给 Claude Code / Codex / Cursor |

## 🚀 怎么用

前提：装好了 DeepSeek Harness（`dsh` 命令可用）。三条命令，复制就能跑：

```bash
# 1) 装（profile 名按你的环境：桌面端是 desktop，网页端是 web）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-engramory-recall

# 2) 重启一次宿主（网页端重跑 dsh web；桌面端退出 App 再打开）—— 配置会热重载，代码不会

# 3) 用一阵子之后查账：注入了几轮、被打开几次、哪些轮次零命中
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-engramory-recall && npm run recall:stats

# 4) 想要一页人话周报（谁在干活、花了多少上下文、这块记忆值不值）
npm run recall:report -- --days 30
```

装完就该有的样子：

- **会话里多一个「记忆」标签页**（和「对话 / 轨迹」并排）：首屏先给三个结论，下面八个页签看明细；
- **说一句和记忆库里某篇笔记相关的话**，这一轮就会多出一条「可能相关的既有条目」；
- 说「继续」「嗯」这种话，**什么都不多** —— 这是设计，不是坏了。

从源码装也行（把上面的第 1 条换成）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /path/to/dsh-engramory-recall
```

卸载：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-engramory-recall
```

> 装完请确认 profile 的 `node_modules/dsh-engramory-recall` 软链指向真实目录 —— 断链时宿主只会打印
> 一行 `skipping profile bundle`，插件整轮不加载却什么都不报。细节和另一个坑见
> [docs/release.md](docs/release.md)。

## 🖼️ 面板长什么样

![记忆面板首屏](docs/images/panel-first-screen.png)

> 图是面板真实渲染的离屏截图（宽 1120px，浅色主题），不是设计稿；深色主题下同一份代码会跟着宿主换色。

首屏只回答三个问题，答完才轮到明细：

1. **这一轮提醒了什么？** —— 最近一轮带进上下文的笔记、相关度，以及每条**后来有没有被翻开**
   （状态点来自账本的累计打开记录，和「用上了多少」同一份口径，不是估算）；
2. **用上了多少？** —— 打开率，以及「给出去的第几条更容易被用上」的柱状图（虚线是中位），
   并明说这是**代理指标**：它证明笔记被翻开过，证明不了被写进回答；
3. **有没有人被拦住？** —— 写入保护拦了几次、体检有几项要处理或留意、索引**已用多少 / 上限多少**行
   （上限读配置 `indexMaxLines`，并直接说「还早，不用动」还是「快满了，该压缩了」）。

下面八个页签是明细：**提醒记录**（每轮判定，可按类型筛选、复制/导出）、**用上了多少**（打开率、位置级曲线、
预算与分数、没注入的原因分布、`minScore` 代价曲线、门控降权与抑制的账 + 四句判据）、**笔记**、**体检**、**索引全文**、
**归档**（计划 + 一键执行）、**写入记录**、**说明**（术语表 + 「我要的功能在哪个开关上」+ 每个数字的来源）。

面板是**只读**的观测窗：所有数字都来自本地文件（账本 `.engramory-recall.jsonl`、审计
`.engramory-audit.jsonl`、索引与笔记本身），一个都不估。取不到这条路由时（Electron 走
`file://` + IPC）召回照常工作，面板只会停在一行「正在读取记忆库状态…」加上「宿主路由不可用」。

## ⚙️ 配置

改 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（和上面一样，改完重启一次最稳）：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: engramory-recall
      name: dsh-engramory-recall
      config:
        enabled: true
        storePath: ~/memory/engramory    # 留空 = 插件不工作（安全默认）
        maxPointers: 4                   # 每次最多提醒几条
        maxChars: 480                    # 一轮提醒的字数上限
        nudge: true                      # 做完事顺带问一句要不要记录
        guardWrites: true                # 写入保护
        autoArchive: false               # 自动归档（默认关，见下）
```

常用的几个旋钮，人话版：

| 人话名 | 键名 | 默认值 | 什么意思 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 每次最多提醒几条 | `maxPointers` | `4` | 一轮里最多注入几条指针。实测 4→5 只买 1.7 个点，4→6 一个点都不买 |
| 注入策略 | `recallMode` | `push` | 命中之后往上下文里放什么：`push` 照旧推最多 `maxPointers` 条 / `hybrid` 只推最靠前的 1 条 / `pull` **一条指针都不推**，只留一句「库里有 N 条线索，需要时用 `engramory_search` 自己查」。`pull` 在本轮一条都不匹配时保持沉默（没命中就不出声）；默认值已用 7.1 判分器量过（工具回路**四臂**：`none`/`push`/`hybrid`/`pull`，`hybrid` 已于 2026-10-17 补测），**结论是维持 `push`**：`hybrid` 只省一半注入（110 → 57 token），代价是**确定性地丢掉 22.6 个点的指针召回**（86.8% → 64.2%），而它的调用率（34–38%）仍与 `push`（24–30%）同档，并没有像 `pull`（96–98%）那样把主动检索救回来 —— 理由与数字见 [docs/measuring.md](docs/measuring.md) |
| 一轮提醒的字数上限 | `maxChars` | `480` | 提醒文本的硬上限（字符）。装不下时先塌缩成只剩文件名，不会静默丢 |
| 相关度门槛 | `minScore` | `0` | 调高能滤掉弱命中、少些噪音，代价是可能漏；代价曲线在面板里能看 |
| 消费侧门控 | `gate` | `assist` | 让「带进上下文很多次、一次没被读过」的笔记往后排。`off` 不干预 / `shadow` 只记账不改 / `assist` 降权（默认）/ `enforce` 移出注入 |
| 做完事顺带问一句 | `nudge` | `true` | 「长期记住」意图提示；长会话一次都没写过库时也提醒一次（`sedimentMinTurns`，默认 12 轮） |
| 写入保护 | `guardWrites` | `true` | 不合规文件名、缺 frontmatter、疑似真实凭据一律拒写，并写审计 |
| 自动归档 | `autoArchive` | `false` | 打开后归档自动跑（仍先备份、仍过闸门）。默认关：归档是改库，建议先手动点几轮 |
| 记忆库路径 | `storePath` | `~/memory/engramory` | 支持 `~`。**留空则插件不工作** —— 不猜路径，是刻意的 |
| 召回账本 | `usageLog` | `true` | 每次注入 / 打开多写一行到 `<storePath>/.engramory-recall.jsonl`，打开率的数据源 |
| 索引上限 | `indexMaxLines` / `indexMaxBytes` | `200` / `25600` | `MEMORY.md` 长过这个就**拒绝写入**（索引每轮都读，超限部分会被静默不再召回） |
| 召回读多少 | `maxNotes` / `maxBytes` | `2000` / `4194304` | 一次召回最多读多少篇 / 多少字节（防病态目录的护栏）。**超出的笔记不进检索**，不是「排后面」—— 库大到这条线时，体检、首屏与 `engramory_status` 都会把差额说出来 |
| 总开关 | `enabled` | `true` | 关掉它只需改成 `false` |

其余键（查询预算、轮换降权、去重、语义开关…）连同默认值在
[docs/how-it-works.md](docs/how-it-works.md#配置) 的完整表里。

## 🩹 常见问题

**Q：装完了，好像什么都没发生？**
先看「记忆」标签页在不在 —— 在就说明加载成功了，没提醒大概率是这轮本就不该提醒（见下一条）。
不在的话：确认 profile 里的软链没断（断链只打印一行 `skipping profile bundle`，静默失败），
重启一次宿主，再跑 `npm run check` 看它怎么说（配置键认不认、库路径对不对、装的是哪一份）。

**Q：为什么这轮没提醒我？**
三种情况都是正常的沉默：**寒暄/空/短于 4 字**（「继续」「嗯」「好的」「ok」）直接放行、连检索都不做；
**检索了但没命中**；**命中了但没过 `minScore`**。想知道到底是哪种，看「记忆」标签页的「提醒记录」，
或 `npm run recall:stats` 的原因分布（`chitchat` / `too-short` / `duplicate` / `store-not-configured` /
`index-empty` / `no-hits` / `below-min-score`）。库里确实没有相关笔记时，它不会编一条出来。

**Q：我的记忆会离开这台机器吗？存在哪？**
不会。`capabilities` 只要文件读写，不要 network；它只读你的 markdown，不建数据库、不生成索引文件，
**默认零模型调用**。只有你显式打开语义开关时才会走宿主已经配好的模型 —— 插件自己不配 key、不直接出网。
库就是那个文件夹，可以 git、可以手改、可以给别的工具共用。

**Q：为什么我的索引 `MEMORY.md` 写不进去？**
超过 200 行 / 25KB 会被**直接拒绝**（拒绝理由里写着「203 行 > 200」这类原话），磁盘零字节变化。
故意这么设计的：索引是每轮都要读的东西，超限的部分不会被静默地不再召回 —— 它连长都长不上去。
把索引改短的重写能过，体检器也会把超限报出来。

**Q：索引快满了怎么办？**
三步，都能自己做：① 面板「记忆」→「归档」页签执行归档（先备份，把长笔记的历史块搬进
`<笔记>-history.md`）；② 压长行 —— 索引一行只该是「一句短钩子 + 链接」，体检的
`index-long-lines` 会按长度点名最该压的那几行；③ 整篇重写一份更短的（**缩小的重写永远放行**，
可以一步一步压）。体检也不会等到被拒才说话：到 90% 就报 `index-near-cap`（warn），已经超限报
`index-over-cap`（error）。改完看面板首屏「索引已用 x / 上限」。

**Q：写入保护能拦住模型乱写吗？**
能拦住 `write` / `edit`：文件名不合规、缺 frontmatter、疑似真实凭据（私钥块 / `sk-` / `ghp_` /
`AKIA` / `xox` / JWT）当场拒，拒绝理由直接回给模型，后续监听器翻不回来。但它**不是沙箱**：

plugins.description: 给 DSH 用的开发日志插件。自动记录"为什么"和"踩了什么坑"。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-devlog

DSH 插件：在每轮工作结束时，自动把这一轮的上下文加工成一段开发日志，追加到本地文件。

开发者每天写完代码就忘了写日志。这个插件替你记——今天干了什么、为什么这么干、踩了什么坑。

## 定位

- 面向开发者本人的开发日志，不是 CHANGELOG，不是会话摘要
- 读者只有开发者自己
- 验证"上下文 + 记忆 + 检查点 → 自动总结"这套机制在 DSH 生态里跑不跑得通

生态位上，dsh-memory 类负责"记"（输出给 Agent 的记忆片段），dsh-git-commit 类负责"提交"，dsh-trail-plugin 类负责"找"。这个插件填的是空缺的那一环：把上下文和记忆里的技术讨论，加工成面向开发者本人的开发日志。

## 闭环

```
agent/turn-stopping → 切片过滤本轮事件 → 模型判断/生成 → 追加落盘
```

1. 监听 `agent/turn-stopping`（serial 钩子，只观察不 steer）
2. 从 `session/event` 订阅缓冲切出本轮事件，过滤噪音（系统消息、plugin/skill-catalog 注入、request/header、session/title 等）
3. 调模型（deepseek-flash）把材料加工成第一人称开发日志；没有实质内容模型输出 SKIP，不写
4. 追加写入 `$DSH_HOME/devlog/YYYY-MM-DD.md`，每段以二级标题开头，不写日期（日期由外层统一加），只追加不重写

## 项目位置

本仓库（clone 后的目录）是独立项目目录，代码、依赖、测试全在这里。

插件本身不在 `$DSH_HOME` 下，DSH 主目录只被读取、不被污染：挂载靠 `--patch <仓库目录>/cordis.patch.yml`。

注意：主 `cordis.patch.yml` 里 `name` 用的是**包名** `dsh-devlog-auto`（不是绝对路径），因此通过 `dsh plugin add dsh-devlog-auto` 或桌面端插件管理器安装后可直接解析，跨机器无需改路径。只有 `tests/` 下的两个探针 patch 仍写绝对路径——它们是本地开发工具，不随 npm 包发布（见 `files` 字段），clone 到别的机器重跑探针时才需要改。

## 目录结构

```
dsh-devlog/  （仓库根目录）
├── index.js          # 插件主逻辑（监听/切片过滤/生成/落盘）
├── cordis.patch.yml  # patch 层，一行 insert（name 为包名 dsh-devlog-auto）
├── package.json      # type: module
├── node_modules/     # 依赖：schemastery 3.18.4（volatile 字段必需）
├── prompts/
│   ├── system.md     # 系统提示词初始默认值（可在设置页改，见下）
│   └── task.md       # 任务提示词模板（{{date}} 等变量）
├── tests/
│   ├── probe1/       # 探测 1：挂 turn-stopping，dump 事件载荷结构
│   └── probe2/       # 探测 2：确认 prepareCall 形态 + source 字段 + volatile 配置
└── README.md
```

## 安装 / 本地挂载

```bash
cd <仓库目录>
npm install          # 装本地依赖（开发用）

# 作为 DSH 插件安装（已发布到 npm）：
npm install dsh-devlog-auto
```

跑 DSH 时挂上（把路径换成你 clone 下来的仓库目录）：

```bash
dsh --profile headless --patch <仓库目录>/cordis.patch.yml "<你的任务>"
```

或把 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的 insert 行合并进 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` 常驻。

## 依赖说明：为什么 schemastery 是硬依赖

`@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 被**固定锁死为 `3.18.4` 的 `dependencies`**，而没有按生态惯例放进 `peerDependencies`，原因是：

设置页可编辑的 `logPrompt` 依赖 schemastery 的 `.volatile()`（3.18.4 才提供），而 DSH 宿主内置的是 3.18.2，没有 volatile。若改成 peer 依赖并回落到宿主版本，`logPrompt` 会退化成普通字符串——默认值仍在（日志照样生成），但**设置页编辑能力会丢失**。

所以这里刻意保留硬依赖。代价是与"由宿主统一提供 schemastery"的生态惯例不一致，安装时 pnpm 可能打出 peer warnings，属预期行为，不影响运行。

重跑探测脚本（改插件 API 用法前值得先跑一遍确认形态）：

```bash
dsh --profile headless --patch <仓库目录>/tests/probe2/cordis.yml "回复：probe-ok"
```

## 输出目录

默认是 `$DSH_HOME/devlog/`（即 `~/.dsh/devlog`，DSH 默认家目录），符合"插件把产物写进 DSH 主目录"的语义。

想让产物也离开 DSH 主目录，就在设置页填 `outputDir`（例如 `$DSH_HOME/devlog` 或任意你指定的绝对路径）——留空则用默认。运行时日志和 debug dump 会跟着一起走。

## 设置页可配置项

系统提示词不写死在文件里，模型与调试选项也都走 Config（均可在设置页改）：

```js
Config: {
  logPrompt: z.string().default(<prompts/system.md 内容>).volatile(),  // 系统提示词（volatile，可热改）
  blocking: z.boolean().default(true),                  // 阻塞开关
  provider: z.string().default('deepseek-official'),    // 生成模型 provider
  model: z.string().default('deepseek-flash'),          // 生成模型名
  reasoningEffort: z.string().default('low'),           // 思维链强度（low/high；flash 无 none）
  debugDump: z.string().default('on-error'),            // 调试材料落盘：always / on-error / off
  outputDir: z.string().default(''),                    // 日志目录；留空 = $DSH_HOME/devlog
}
```

- `logPrompt`：在 DSH 设置页的插件卡片里编辑，保存后生效；生成时用 `config.logPrompt.get()` 读当前值。已知限制：host（cordis 4.0.2）不识别 volatile，改配置保存后会重启插件（新值生效，非无感热替换）。`prompts/system.md` 是这个字段的**初始默认值**。
- `provider` / `model` / `reasoningEffort`：生成用的模型与思维链强度。默认 deepseek-flash + low，日志加工足够；换模型/档位按需改。
- `debugDump`：调试材料（喂给模型的完整上下文 + 原始事件）落盘策略。
  - `always`：每轮都写 `.devlog-context-debug.txt`（含你的代码/工具回显，**默认不开启**）
  - `on-error`：仅生成失败/异常时写，便于排查（默认）
  - `off`：从不写
  - 文件落在日志目录下，不在意可定期删。

## blocking 开关

- `blocking: true`（默认）：轮次关闭前等日志写完，headless 模式下产物必然落盘
- `blocking: false`：立即放行轮次，生成在后台跑。交互模式延迟低，但进程退出可能丢未完成的生成

## 运行时日志与调试产物

都在 `$DSH_HOME/devlog/` 下：

- `.devlog-runtime.log` —— 每次跳过/生成/落盘/报错，含材料长度、裁剪档位、生成耗时，排查首选
- `.devlog-context-debug.txt` —— 每次喂给模型的**完整材料** + 原始事件结构 dump（每轮覆盖）

第二个文件的价值：**看不到材料就是盲飞**。第一版曾经因为字段名解析错位，让模型只拿到一条用户指令在凭空写日志（材料 133 字符），产物全是编的——靠这个 dump 才抓出来。调提示词时也值得对着它看。

注意：这个文件里是完整轮次内容（含文件正文、工具回显），不在意的话可以定期清掉。

## 时间基准（踩过的坑）

轮次材料里会带当天更早的日志段（`{{existing_log_today}}` 用于避免重复）。模型容易把这些更早段落误当成"昨天写的"，进而写出"昨天我说过……"这种带偏时间基准的句子。

`prompts/task.md` 顶部专门写了一段时间澄清：已有日志是今天更早写的、早先段落里的"昨天"是相对今天而言、引用时段必须基于材料里真实对应的时间段。别删这一段。

## 第一版不做

- 时间戳分段触发
- 手动全量收口覆盖
- PPT 输出
- 扣子 Skill 那条线

plugins.description: Stop leaving DSH to make a temp folder. One-click throwaway workspaces with optional cleanup · 告别手动建目录，DSH 一键临时工作区，删除可控
plugins.readme_text:
# DeepSeek Harness Temporary Workspaces

[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/Agent-DeepSeek%20Harness-4176e6)](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@cliven/dsh-tmp-wks?color=red)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@cliven/dsh-tmp-wks)
[![Version](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Trisia/dsh-tmp-wks)](https://github.com/Trisia/dsh-tmp-wks/releases)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)](LICENSE)
[![CI](https://github.com/Trisia/dsh-tmp-wks/actions/workflows/release.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Trisia/dsh-tmp-wks/actions/workflows/release.yml)

**D**eep**S**eek **H**arness **T**emporary **W**ork**s**paces (dsh-tmp-wks)

![demo](docs/demo.en.gif)

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

## Why you need it

You just want to ask a quick question, but you have to leave DSH, create a folder, come back and point at that directory, then delete it by hand afterwards. Forget to clean one up, and several sessions start contaminating each other.

Temp workspaces collapse all of that into a single click:

- **One-click setup**: click once and a throwaway workspace is created on the spot, with a session already started in it.
- **Deletion under control**: deleting asks whether to delete the temp directory on disk too, and keeps the files by default. That prompt can be turned off.
- **Works on both clients**: available in DSH Web and the DSH desktop client, from a single install.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @cliven/dsh-tmp-wks
```

A "New temp session" button then appears at the bottom of the sidebar; click it to create a temp workspace and start a session. Right-click the button to open the management panel, which handles the temp directories on disk.

Temp workspaces are created under the operating system temp directory by default (`$TMPDIR` on Linux/macOS, `%TEMP%`/`%TMP%` on Windows), for example on Linux:

```
/tmp/tmp-k7mq2z
```

Storage location, name prefix, and the delete confirmation are configurable on the **Plugins** page in the sidebar. Leave the location empty to use the system temp directory, enter a relative path to resolve it against the DSH home, or an absolute path to use it as-is. The plugin only deletes directories it created.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Relabels DSH's normalized WebP request images as image/png so local OpenAI-compatible vision servers (LM Studio, llama.cpp) accept them.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-webp-relabel

Relabels DSH's normalized WebP request images as PNG, so local OpenAI-compatible
vision servers accept them.

English | [简体中文](#简体中文)

## The problem

You paste a screenshot into DeepSeek Harness, pick a local vision model, and the
request dies with:

```
'url' field must be a base64 encoded image.
```

The image is fine. The **label** is not.

## Why it happens

DSH normalizes attachments before storing them, and `dsh-attachment-local` picks
the container from the alpha channel:

```js
const mediaType = hasAlpha ? "image/webp" : "image/jpeg";
```

Screenshots have an alpha channel, so they are stored as WebP. The request-image
ladder only ever emits `alpha:webp` or `opaque:jpeg` — there is no PNG rung and no
configuration option for this.

`dsh-llm-pi-ai` then builds the OpenAI `image_url` payload straight from the
prepared request image:

```js
mimeType: version.mediaType,               // "image/webp"
data: Buffer.from(version.data).toString("base64"),
```

so the wire payload becomes `data:image/webp;base64,...`. LM Studio / llama.cpp
validate that label against a PNG/JPEG allowlist and reject the whole call —
even though the bytes decode perfectly well.

## How it works

Wrap `attachments.readImageRequest()` and return **the same bytes** under a
compatible label:

```js
return { ...version, mediaType: 'image/png' };
```

Measured against LM Studio with `test/diagnostics/relabel-vs-transcode.py`:

| Payload | Result |
|---------|--------|
| webp bytes + `image/webp` | **HTTP 400** `'url' field must be a base64 encoded image.` |
| webp bytes + `image/png`  | **HTTP 200**, image correctly understood |
| png bytes + `image/png`   | HTTP 200 |
| png bytes + `image/webp`  | **HTTP 400** |

Only the label is validated, so no image transcoding is needed.
`test/diagnostics/vision-read.py` confirms the model really sees the image:
it reads a word drawn into a WebP image sent as `image/png`.

Three implementation details matter, and each was verified rather than assumed:

- **Why not rewrite the request messages?** The adapter takes the label from
  `readImageRequest(...).mediaType`, not from the message's
  `ImageBlock.attachment.mediaType`. Rewriting messages changes nothing.
- **Why is a service patch picked up immediately?** The adapter resolves the
  service per call (`resolveAttachments: () => ctx.get("attachments")`), so
  wrapping the method affects the very next request — no restart, no new session.
- **Why the prototype instead of the instance?** `ctx.get()` returns a Cordis
  "traceable" `Proxy` whose `set` trap routes through an extra shadow receiver, so
  an instance-level write is not reliably observable. A property on the prototype
  is always found by the proxy's own descriptor walk.

The model-visible attachment handle text is unaffected: it is built from
`ref.mediaType`, not `version.mediaType`, so it still describes the stored WebP
accurately.

## Install

### From a release tarball (no registry needed)

Download `dsh-webp-relabel-1.0.0.tgz` from the repository's Releases page, then:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add /path/to/dsh-webp-relabel-1.0.0.tgz
```

### From npm

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add dsh-webp-relabel
```

### From a local checkout (verified)

Point the plugin manager at the directory:

```
plugin_manager install_bundle   target = link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-webp-relabel
```

The package is then registered as a link dependency, and its own
`cordis.patch.yml` supplies the loader row — so installing the bundle is the only
step. (Observed on DSH `0.2.1-alpha.2`: `install_bundle` does **not** insert a row
by itself, which is why this bundle ships its own.)

Installing entirely by hand instead? Add the row to your profile's
`cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-webp-relabel
      name: 'dsh-webp-relabel'
```

## Configuration

The bundle already applies these defaults; add this block to your profile's
`cordis.patch.yml` only to override them:

```yaml
- id: dsh-webp-relabel
  name: 'dsh-webp-relabel'
  config:
    from: image/webp     # label to replace (default)
    to: image/png        # replacement label (default)
    debug: true          # log one line per relabeled image (default)
```

## Verify it works

With `debug: true` the DSH console prints one line per relabeled image:

```
[dsh-webp-relabel] relabel #1: image/webp -> image/png (1200x800px, 84521B, ref sha256:...)
```

You can also check the model server's own request log: the payload should contain
`"url": "data:image/png;base64,..."` rather than `image/webp`.

## Disable / uninstall

Disable the plugin in the DSH plugin manager, or set `to: image/webp` in the
config. Either way the original `readImageRequest` is restored from the saved
descriptor — the patch is fully reversible.

## Limitations

- **The label does not match the container.** The bytes stay WebP while the label
  says PNG. This is correct for servers that validate the label (LM Studio,
  llama.cpp). A provider that strictly validates magic bytes would still reject
  it, and the right fix there is real transcoding (`sharp`, `sips`) rather than
  relabeling.
- **It applies to every provider,** because `readImageRequest()` cannot see which
  route the call is going to. Scoping it to local routes would need an extra
  `llm/stream` listener keyed by `options.provider`.
- **It depends on DSH internals:** the `attachments` service, its
  `readImageRequest` method, and that method being a class method on the
  prototype. If a DSH upgrade breaks it, those are the two things to check.

## Development

```sh
npm test
```

Seven cases in `test/plugin-patch.test.mjs`, covering the relabel itself, that the
patch survives a Cordis-style traceable `Proxy`, that non-WebP labels pass
through untouched, that disposing restores the original method (including when it
is inherited from a base class), configurable targets, and idempotent re-apply.

`test/diagnostics/` holds the server-side probes described above.

---

## 简体中文

把 DSH 归一化出来的 WebP 请求图片**重标记为 PNG**，让本地 OpenAI 兼容的视觉模型愿意收下它。

### 问题

在聊天窗口粘贴截图、选一个本地视觉模型，请求直接失败：

```
'url' field must be a base64 encoded image.
```

图片本身没问题，**标签**不对。

### 原因

`dsh-attachment-local` 归一化时按 alpha 通道选容器：

```js
const mediaType = hasAlpha ? "image/webp" : "image/jpeg";
```

截图带 alpha，于是被存成 WebP；请求图档（ladder）只有 `alpha:webp` 和
`opaque:jpeg` 两级，没有 PNG，也没有对应配置项。

`dsh-llm-pi-ai` 再把 `version.mediaType` 直接写进 OpenAI 的 `image_url`：

```js
mimeType: version.mediaType,               // "image/webp"
data: Buffer.from(version.data).toString("base64"),
```

于是线上载荷变成 `data:image/webp;base64,...`。LM Studio / llama.cpp 只允许
PNG/JPEG 标签，整条请求被拒——而字节本身完全能解码。

### 做法

包装 `attachments.readImageRequest()`，**字节一个不改**，只换标签：

```js
return { ...version, mediaType: 'image/png' };
```

实测（`test/diagnostics/relabel-vs-transcode.py`，LM Studio）：

| 载荷 | 结果 |
|------|------|
| webp 字节 + `image/webp` | **HTTP 400** `'url' field must be a base64 encoded image.` |
| webp 字节 + `image/png`  | **HTTP 200**，图片被正确理解 |
| png 字节 + `image/png`   | HTTP 200 |
| png 字节 + `image/webp`  | **HTTP 400** |

即**只校验标签**，所以不需要真的转码。`test/diagnostics/vision-read.py` 进一步确认模型
是"真看见了"：让它读一张以 `image/png` 名义发出的 WebP 图上的字，能读对。

三个关键点都是核实过的，不是推测：

- **为什么不改请求消息？** 适配器的标签来自 `readImageRequest(...).mediaType`，
  不是消息块的 `ImageBlock.attachment.mediaType`，改消息没有任何作用。
- **为什么打补丁立刻生效？** 适配器每次请求都重新解析服务
  （`resolveAttachments: () => ctx.get("attachments")`），所以下一次请求就走新方法，
  不用重启、不用新会话。
- **为什么打在原型而不是实例上？** `ctx.get()` 返回 Cordis 的 "traceable" `Proxy`，
  实例级写入会被 shadow receiver 吞掉；原型属性一定会被 Proxy 的描述符查找命中。

模型可见的图片句柄文案不受影响：它取自 `ref.mediaType` 而不是 `version.mediaType`，
所以仍然准确描述存储的 WebP。

### 安装

本地目录（已实测）：

```
plugin_manager install_bundle   target = link:/绝对路径/dsh-webp-relabel
```

手工安装则在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里加一行：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-webp-relabel
      name: 'dsh-webp-relabel'
```

### 配置（可选）

```yaml
- id: dsh-webp-relabel
  name: 'dsh-webp-relabel'
  config:
    from: image/webp     # 被替换的标签
    to: image/png        # 替换成的标签
    debug: true          # 每张图打印一行日志
```

### 验证

`debug: true` 时 DSH 控制台会打印：

```
[dsh-webp-relabel] relabel #1: image/webp -> image/png

plugins.description: 腾讯 WorkBuddy 接入 DeepSeek Harness 的 LLM 插件：浏览器 OAuth 登录、无需 API Key。Tencent WorkBuddy LLM provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh).
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-llm-workbuddy-cn

**English** | [中文](README.zh.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) plugin for **Tencent WorkBuddy**.

Sign in through your browser — **no API key required** — and use WorkBuddy's own model list.

## Features

- **Browser OAuth sign-in** — authorize in a normal browser tab; no API key needed, ever. Sign in to either the China or the international site.
- **Full model catalog** — WorkBuddy's own models, with context windows, output caps, and credit multipliers; server-side additions and removals are picked up automatically.
- **Streaming chat** — responses stream in real time.
- **Tool calls** — function calling, with a clear error when a model does not support it.
- **Reasoning effort** — pick a thinking level for models that support one.
- **Image input** — attach images for vision-capable models (models without vision support may be routed to a different model by the server).
- **Usage indicator** — a quota bar in the Web UI sidebar for both personal and enterprise plans, with an optional custom cap and a configurable danger threshold.

## Compatibility

| Requirement | Version |
| --- | --- |
| DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) | `>= 0.1.7-rc.1` |

Web UI features such as the settings page, model picker, and usage indicator require the `web` profile.

## Install

Add the plugin to a dsh profile — the `web` profile backs the Web UI:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:wenh56884-wq/dsh-llm-workbuddy
```

The repository ships its compiled `lib/`, so a Git install needs no build step and no
dev dependencies. Installing from a source checkout works too:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-llm-workbuddy
```

## Sign in

Open **Settings → WorkBuddy** in the Web UI and pick a site: **Sign in (China)** for [www.workbuddy.cn](https://www.workbuddy.cn) or **Sign in (Intl)** for [www.workbuddy.ai](https://www.workbuddy.ai). The browser login opens in a new tab; the harness writes the credential automatically. No terminal needed.

The two sites are the same service on different hosts but hold **separate accounts** — one site's account does not work on the other — so the site is chosen per sign-in and recorded with the credential. Every later request goes to the host that issued it. To move to the other site, sign out and sign in again.

Alternatively, sign in from the terminal:

```bash
# A CLI fallback; the Web UI sign-in above is recommended.

# Sign in to the China site (the default; equivalent to --site cn)
dsh plugin --profile web exec dsh-workbuddy-login

# Sign in to the international site
dsh plugin --profile web exec dsh-workbuddy-login --site intl

# Show the signed-in account, its site, and the model list
dsh plugin --profile web exec dsh-workbuddy-login --status

# Remove the stored credential
dsh plugin --profile web exec dsh-workbuddy-login --logout
```

Once signed in, WorkBuddy's models appear in the model picker.

## Build

From a source checkout:

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm run build
```

This compiles the host half with `tsc` and bundles the Web client half with `esbuild`, both into `lib/`.

## Provenance and license

MIT. This plugin is a WorkBuddy adaptation of
[`@shatyuka/dsh-llm-codebuddy`](https://github.com/shatyuka/dsh-llm-codebuddy)
(MIT, © 2026 Shatyuka), which is the original work it derives from: the host
architecture, the browser-OAuth handshake, the model-catalog reader, the
settings page, and the usage indicator are all its author's design. This
repository re-points that client at the WorkBuddy deployments — the site list,
the product token every request identifies itself as, and the provider,
settings, and credential identifiers are WorkBuddy's — and renames it
accordingly. The upstream copyright notice is retained in
[`LICENSE`](./LICENSE) as the license requires.

When the upstream project releases fixes, they can be diffed in against this
tree: the changes here are confined to the identifiers, the two service roots
in `src/constants.ts`, and the catalogue User-Agent documented there.

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: ask_user_question popup enhancement - selecting an option reveals a per-option note input, sent to the model with the selection
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-question-note

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-question-note.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-question-note)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-question-note.svg)](LICENSE)

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）「交互式问答」弹窗增强插件：**用户点选某个选项后，在该选项正下方出现一个可选的补充说明输入框；填写的内容与选中的选项一并传给模型。**

## 效果

- 原版弹窗的样式、功能、交互全部保留（组件是官方 `QuestionComposer` 的忠实移植，同一套 CSS 令牌与几何）。
- **补充说明按选项独立存储**：每个被选中的选项下方各有一个自己的补充输入框，互不共享、不随勾选变化移动；取消勾选时输入框隐藏，文字保留（重新勾选会恢复）。单选题换选选项时同理，各选项各记各的。
- 提交时答案格式不变：`{ "answers": [ { "id": "...", "selected": ["选项文字"], "custom": "…" } ] }`。`custom` 的组装规则：单选 = 补充文本原文；多选 = 每个有补充的选项一行、格式「选项文字: 补充」（模型可分清哪句对应哪个选项）；底部自由回答行若有内容追加在最后。不填补充说明时行为与原版完全一致。
- 底部「其他（自定义输入）」行保留，是独立的自由回答入口（单选打字清空已选 = 原版语义；多选与勾选并存 = 原版语义）。
- 计划审查（plan-review）类卡片、审批卡片、超时后续答、已结算回答回看等全部由官方组件处理，本插件不接管。

## 与原版的唯一行为差异

启用后，**单选点选项不再自动跳到下一题**（原版会跳，但那会让用户没机会填写补充说明），而是停留在当前题并展开输入框；在输入框里回车或点「下一题」按钮进入下一题，最后一题回车即提交。

## 实现原理（面向二次开发者）

- 纯客户端 Cordis 插件：浏览器半往 `conversation.composer` 链式槽以 `priority: -10`（官方在默认 0）注册增强版组件，链选举「数值小者先跑、第一个 select 非 null 者胜出」，因此增强版先被询问并接管通用问题卡的渲染；官方插件的卡片注册、倒计时、投影、续答机制原样复用（`src/client/carrier.ts` 以结构化方式消费官方载体对象）。
- 鸭子类型失配时 `select` 返回 null → 安全降级为官方弹窗（功能缺失但弹窗可用）。
- 合并方案零协议改动：宿主端 `userQuestions.answer()` 只校验「每题恰好回答一次」，不禁止 `selected` 与 `custom` 并存；工具结果与超时续答消息都是原样 JSON 透传。

## 开发与安装

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run build     # 产出 lib/index.js（宿主半）与 lib/client.js（浏览器半）
pnpm run check     # 产物语法检查

# 安装到 desktop 配置（会写入 dsh.profile.bundles，需重启 DSH 生效）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add <本目录路径或 npm 包名>
```

## 版本兼容

针对 DSH 0.2.0-rc 族（`@deepseek-ai/*` peer `^0.2.0-rc.1`）。官方弹窗组件内部结构若在后续版本变化，需同步调整 `src/client/carrier.ts` 的结构匹配与 `src/client/composer.tsx` 的移植。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：把多台 SSH 服务器存成主机清单，agent 在会话里按主机名引用（命令执行 + 远端文件读写）；设置界面管理，支持密钥/密码登录，会话窗口「+」菜单可选主机。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ssh-hosts

[![test](https://github.com/alfredhuang211/dsh-ssh-hosts/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/alfredhuang211/dsh-ssh-hosts/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

给 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）加一组 SSH 工具：**把若干台服务器存成一份主机清单，agent 在会话里用主机名引用它们** —— 执行命令、读文件、写文件、改文件、列目录。

- 凭据只存**怎么连**（host / user / identityFile / 跳板），不存密码、不存密钥内容；
- 认证、known_hosts、ssh-agent 全部交给系统 OpenSSH，插件不重新实现加密；
- 多机：同时配置 N 台，一次调用指定一台；会话里可以 `ssh_use` 设默认机；
- **图形界面管理**：在 `设置 → 插件 → dsh-ssh-hosts`（或设置侧栏「SSH 主机」）里新增/编辑/删除主机、测连通性、设默认机；界面写的就是那份 YAML，改完立即生效，不用重启；
- 与本地同名工具语义一致（`read` 的 offset/limit 是行号，`edit` 要求 oldString 唯一）。

## 装

### 方式零：直接从 GitHub

```bash
git clone https://github.com/alfredhuang211/dsh-ssh-hosts.git
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-ssh-hosts      # 桌面版则在「设置 → 插件」里选这个目录
```

[Releases](https://github.com/alfredhuang211/dsh-ssh-hosts/releases) 里也有打包好的 `dsh-ssh-hosts-x.y.z.tgz`，适合离线安装或内网分发。

### 方式一：桌面 App / CLI 的插件安装（推荐）

```bash
# CLI：把本目录（或 npm pack 出的 tgz）装进某个 profile
dsh plugin --profile web add /绝对路径/plugin-dev/ssh-hosts
```

装完 `dsh web --dump-config | grep -A2 ssh-hosts` 应该能看到：

```
# == dsh-ssh-hosts
- id: ssh-hosts
  name: dsh-ssh-hosts
```

桌面版也可以在 **设置 → 插件** 里安装同一个 tgz / 目录；本插件声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch`，安装后会自动作为一层 bundle 参与 profile 组装（`insert` 一行 `id: ssh-hosts`）。

> 桌面 App 自己的 `desktop` profile 由 Electron 独占：`dsh plugin --profile desktop ...` 会被拒绝（`profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`）。要装进桌面 App，请从 App 内的插件界面装，或者按 App 写 package.json 的方式加 `link:`/依赖后由 App 重启加载 —— 别去手改它的 profile 状态。

### 方式二：手写 patch 行

不想用它自带的 bundle patch、或想在别人的 profile 里手动挂，就在 `~/.dsh/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml`（或 `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml`）里加：

```yaml
- insert:
  - id: 'ssh-hosts'
    name: 'dsh-ssh-hosts'      # 也可以写 file:///绝对路径/plugin-dev/ssh-hosts/lib/index.js
    config:
      defaultHost: web-01
```

`config` 全部字段都有默认值，只写需要覆盖的即可。

## 配置

主机清单有两条路，用的是**同一份数据**（`ssh-hosts.yaml`）：

- **图形界面（推荐）**：装好后打开 `设置 → 插件 → dsh-ssh-hosts`（或设置侧栏的「SSH 主机」），在那里新增/编辑/删除主机、测试连通性、设默认机。界面写的就是下面这个 YAML，写完立即重载，**不用重启**。
- **手工编辑**：直接改 YAML；改完在界面上点「重新读取」，或重启。

![设置里的 SSH 主机卡片（窄列 ~340px）](docs/settings-card.png)

*窄列下的样子：一台主机一个块，事实在上、操作在下，长路径自己断行。*

界面能做的事：

| 能力 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 新增 / 编辑 / 删除 / 设默认 | 字段校验与服务端同一套规则：错了当场红框标出**并说明怎么改**，不用等一次 400 |
| 测试连接 | 结果就地显示在那台主机下面（成功给耗时与远端首行，失败给 exit code 与原因），不用去翻底部日志 |
| 删除二次确认 | 在块内确认，并说清会连带清掉什么（例如「已存密码也一并清除」），不可撤销 |
| 过滤 | 主机多了按名称 / 地址 / 标签 / 备注 / 认证方式过滤，并显示匹配台数 |
| 键盘 | `Enter` 保存、`Esc` 取消；错误是 `role="alert"`、日志是 `aria-live`，读屏能听到 |
| 密码 | 只写不读：显示「已保存（来自哪一层）」或「未设置」，输入可显示/隐藏，清除要再确认一次 |
| 空状态 | 没有主机时直接给「新增主机」按钮 + 手工编辑提示，不用猜下一步做什么 |

### 1. 主机清单（界面与手工共用的那份文件）

```bash
cp ssh-hosts.example.yaml ~/.dsh/ssh-hosts.yaml
chmod 600 ~/.dsh/ssh-hosts.yaml     # 权限不是 0600 会被拒绝加载
$EDITOR ~/.dsh/ssh-hosts.yaml
```

文件**不存在**时插件照常启动、界面照常打开，只是清单为空：在界面上新增第一台主机就会把文件建出来（0600）。文件存在但坏掉（YAML 语法错、`hosts` 不是数组、权限过宽）仍然是**装载期硬失败** —— 那是真配置错误，越早炸越好。

```yaml
version: 1

hosts:
  - name: web-01                    # ← agent 在会话里引用的名字
    host: 10.0.0.11
    user: deploy
    identityFile: ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 # 密钥登录；必须 0600。省略 = 交给 ssh-agent/默认密钥
    defaultWorkdir: /srv/app
    description: 生产 Web（Nginx）
    tags: [prod, web]
    port: 22
    proxyJump: bastion              # 本清单里的 name，或 user@host:port
    connectTimeoutSec: 15
    keepAliveSec: 30
    readOnly: true                  # 拒绝 ssh_write / ssh_edit

  - name: db-01
    host: 10.0.0.12
    user: root
    passwordRef: DSH_SSH_HOSTS_PASSWORD_DB_01   # 密码登录：只写「凭据名」，不写密码
    tags: [prod, db]
```

字段全部可选（`name` / `host` 必填），**未知字段会直接报错**，拼错不会被静默忽略。清单里写 `password:` / `passphrase:` 会被专门拒绝，并告诉你该怎么放密码。

### 1.1 登录方式：密钥 / 密码 / ssh-agent

| 方式 | 清单里怎么写 | 怎么设置 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **密钥**（推荐） | `identityFile: ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` | 界面「登录方式 → 密钥文件」，填路径即可（文件必须存在且 0600） |
| **密码** | `passwordRef: DSH_SSH_HOSTS_PASSWORD_XXX` | 界面「登录方式 → 密码」，在密码框里填一次；插件把值交给 DSH 凭据库，清单里只留引用名 |
| **密钥优先、密码兜底** | 两个字段都给 | 界面选「密钥优先，密码兜底」 |
| **ssh-agent / 默认密钥** | 两个字段都不给 | 界面选「ssh-agent / 默认密钥」，交给 OpenSSH 自己挑 |

密码**不进清单文件**：`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`（0600，DSH 自己的凭据库）存值，`ssh-hosts.yaml` 只存名字。所以清单可以安全地备份/分享；界面、HTTP 响应、模型可见的工具输出里都**只回报「有没有、来自哪一层」**，永远不回显密码。删主机或点「清除已存密码」会顺手把凭据库里的那条删掉，不留孤儿。

密码登录的实现是 OpenSSH 官方路子（`SSH_ASKPASS` + 一次性 0600 文件）：密码不进命令行参数、不进环境变量、不进日志，`ps` 里看不到；每次调用前现解析、用完即删，所以改完密码**下一次调用就生效**，不用重启。没有凭据服务的 profile（极少见）插件照常工作，只是密码主机连不上，界面会说明原因。

### 2. 图形界面背后的 HTTP 路由

界面（浏览器半边）通过同源路由读写清单，也**可以只用 curl**（同一个 web server，CSRF/Host 校验与其它 GUI 接口一致）：

| 方法 | 路径 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/ssh-hosts/hosts` | 清单 + 文件信息 + 是否可写 + 默认机 |
| POST | `/ssh-hosts/hosts` | 新增/修改一台（`{ host: {...}, previousName?, password?, clearPassword? }`，改名靠 `previousName`；`password` 只进不出，`clearPassword: true` 清除） |
| POST | `/ssh-hosts/hosts/delete` | 删除（`{ name }`） |
| POST | `/ssh-hosts/default` | 设/清默认机（`{ name }`，空串清除） |
| POST | `/ssh-hosts/reload` | 重新读盘（手工改完文件点这个） |
| POST | `/ssh-hosts/test` | 真实 SSH 连上去跑一条只读命令 |

返回统一是 `{ ok: true, value }` 或 `{ ok: false, error: { code, message } }`；`400` 参数/文件内容有误、`409` 清单来自 config 不可写、`404` 主机不存在、`501` 当前 profile 没有凭据服务（存不了密码）、`403/401` 未过 Host/来源/登录校验。写入顺序是**先校验、再原子写、再重载**，重载失败会把文件回滚成写之前的字节 —— 界面上一次误操作不会让正在跑的会话失去目标机。

### 3. 插件 config

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hostsFile` | `$DSH_HOME/ssh-hosts.yaml` | 清单路径；相对路径按 `$DSH_HOME` 解析 |
| `defaultHost` | 空 | 没指定 host、本会话也没 `ssh_use` 过时用的默认机 |
| `knownHostsFile` | 空（OpenSSH 默认） | 自定义 known_hosts 路径 |
| `strictHostKeyChecking` | `accept-new` | `accept-new` / `yes` / `no` |
| `connectTimeoutSec` | 10 | 建连超时 |
| `timeoutMs` | 60000 | 单条命令默认超时 |
| `maxOutputBytes` | 262144 | stdout/stderr 各自保留上限（超出保尾并标记截断） |
| `maxReadBytes` | 8388608 | 单文件读取上限 |
| `controlPersistSec` | 300 | 连接复用时长；0 = 每次重建连 |
| `allow` / `deny` | `[]` | `ssh_run` 命令正则白/黑名单（deny 优先） |
| `hosts` | `[]` | 就地声明主机（非空时忽略 `hostsFile`） |

这些标量字段都是 DSH 的 **volatile** 字段：在设置页改完**不用重启插件**，下一次工具调用就用新值（插件每次读配置都解包 volatile 引用）。`hosts` 例外 —— 它是部署方声明，改了要重启；而且它非空时界面变成只读，避免「设置页改一半、YAML 改一半」。

## 用：添加完主机，怎么引用

**在会话窗口里直接选**（新增，最快）：点输入框左边的 **「+」**，在命令菜单里选 **`ssh`** → 弹出主机列表（带 `user@host`、标签、认证方式，并标出本会话当前在用哪台）→ 点一台即可。它设的是**本会话**默认主机（和 `ssh_use` 同一条路径、同一份状态），之后你在这个会话里说「执行 uname -a」就直接落到那台机器。也可以手打 `/ssh <主机名>`，`/ssh clear` 清除。

> 一个平台规则：输入框里**已经有内容**时，「+」菜单只列不带参数的命令（`ssh` 带参数提示，所以那时不显示）—— 这是 DSH 对斜杠菜单的统一约定，`/permission` 等命令同样如此。想在已有草稿上换机器，先选中草稿前的空白再点「+」，或直接手打 `/ssh <主机名>`。

**在会话里直接说人话也行**（最常用）：

```
在 web-01 上执行 systemctl status nginx
看一下 db-01 的 /etc/mysql/my.cnf
把 web-01 的 /srv/app/.env 里 PORT=8080 改成 PORT=9090
```

agent 会先 `ssh_hosts()` 看清单，再带上 `host: "web-01"` 调用对应工具。主机名就是你在界面里填的「名称」。

**显式调用**（想知道底层发生了什么时）：

```
ssh_hosts()                                        → 列主机（含 auth 方式、tags、默认目录）
ssh_use({ host: "web-01" })                        → 设为本会话默认机，之后可以省略 host
ssh_run({ command: "uname -a" })                   → 在默认机上跑
ssh_run({ host: "db-01", command: "df -h" })       → 指定机器跑（不依赖默认机）
ssh_read({ host: "web-01", path: "/etc/nginx/nginx.conf", offset: 1, limit: 40 })
ssh_write({ host: "web-01", path: "/tmp/hello.txt", content: "hi\n" })
ssh_edit({ host: "web-01", path: "/srv/app/.env", oldString: "PORT=8080", newString: "PORT=9090" })
ssh_ls({ host: "web-01", path: "/srv/app" })
```

主机解析优先级：**显式 `host` 参数 → 本会话 `ssh_use` → 界面设的默认机 → `config.defaultHost` → 报错并列出可用主机**（绝不再猜一台）。界面上点「设为默认」写的就是第三档；默认机是**全局**的，`ssh_use` 是**本会话**的。

模型看到的 7 个工具：

| 工具 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `ssh_hosts` | 列出可用主机（含 tags / 说明 / 默认目录 / 认证方式），可按 tag 过滤；`defaultHost` + `defaultSource` 告诉你本次调用实际会用哪台 |
| `ssh_use` | 读/设本会话默认主机，之后其它工具可省略 `host` |
| `ssh_run` | 执行命令，返回 exitCode / stdout / stderr（**非零退出是正常结果**） |
| `ssh_read` | 读文本文件，可给行号区间 |
| `ssh_write` | 整文件写入（远端临时文件 + rename 原子替换，保留原权限） |
| `ssh_edit` | 精确字符串替换（要求唯一匹配，除非 `replaceAll`） |
| `ssh_ls` | 列目录（类型/权限/大小/时间） |

主机解析优先级：**显式 `host` 参数 → 本会话 `ssh_use` → 界面设的默认机 → `config.defaultHost` → 报错并列出可用主机**（绝不再猜一台）。

三种方式的作用域要分清：**会话窗口的「+ → ssh」和 `ssh_use` 是「本会话」**（互不干扰，换会话就没了）；**设置页的「设为默认」是全局**（所有没有会话默认的会话都用它）。`ssh_hosts` 报的 `defaultHost` 是**本次调用实际会用的那台**（会话默认 → 全局默认 → `config.defaultHost`），`defaultSource` 告诉你是哪一档。

plugins.description: An eye-friendly green skin for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-leafy-skin

An eye-friendly green skin: a leafy palette layered over the official DSH web GUI theme, in a
light emerald and a dark mint variant.

> I wanted the effect of a Minecraft resource pack.

**English** | [中文](README.zh.md)

## Compatibility

| Plugin version | DSH version |
| --- | --- |
| v0.1.2 | dsh-v0.2.1-rc.2 |
| v0.1.1 | dsh-v0.2.0-rc.2 |
| v0.1.0 | dsh-v0.2.0-rc.2 |

## Screenshot

![Screenshot](show.png)

## Features

- **Layered greens** — a mist-green canvas, raised panels, and a deeper sidebar, with emerald
  accents in light mode and mint in dark, instead of one flat wash of green.
- **Comfortable by construction** — no pure white or pure black, a single green hue family, and
  all body text at WCAG AA (≥ 4.5:1).
- **Texture** — softer corner radii, green-tinted diffuse shadows, low-contrast hairlines, and
  glassy menu surfaces.
- **Details** — mint text selection, Inter / Noto Sans SC / Cascadia Code font stacks, slim
  scrollbars, and restrained hover and menu motion.
- **Tunable** — the palette is one commented table, a self-check script guards contrast, and the
  style layer has a single on/off switch.

## Install

```
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-leafy-skin
```

Restart DSH once afterwards so the profile recomposes. After that, colour edits only need a page
refresh (client changes hot-reload within about a second).

## Usage

Install the plugin and load the app. The skin layers itself over the active theme, so light, dark,
and follow-system each pick up their own variant automatically.

## Customize

- **Colours** — the `TOKENS` table in `lib/client.js`, grouped and commented by area.
- **Radii, shadows, fonts, motion** — the same file, plus the small style layer below it.
- **Palette only** — set `ENABLE_CSS_LAYER` to `false` in `lib/client.js` to drop the style layer
  entirely.
- **Check your work** — `node tools/check-palette.mjs` validates token shape, text and syntax
  contrast, and the style layer's three constraints.

## Uninstall

Any one of these, then restart DSH:

1. Comment out the `insert` entry in `cordis.patch.yml`;
2. Drop `dsh-leafy-skin` from `dsh.profile.bundles` in `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json`;
3. Run `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-leafy-skin`.

## Known limitations

- The native window title bar belongs to the DSH desktop shell, not to this plugin, so it stays
  DSH grey for the instant before the page paints.
- Real see-through glass is impossible on Windows — the sidebar depth and translucent menus are
  colour layering, not blur through the window.
- Components hard-code font sizes and layout in hashed CSS modules, so this skin deliberately
  leaves them alone.

## Changelog

See [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)

## Contributing

Questions and suggestions are welcome as issues. Pull requests are not accepted.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

[![](https://img.shields.io/badge/powered_by-dsh-4D6BFE?style=flat-square&logo=deepseek&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

plugins.description: Cell-aware Jupyter notebook tools for DSH agents
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-notebook-tools

Cell-aware Jupyter notebook tools for DSH agents. A zero-dependency Node ESM
plugin that ports the OpenClaw `notebook-tools` plugin (9 tools) onto the DSH
host.

The core `read` / `write` / `edit` tools treat `.ipynb` files as opaque JSON,
which is error-prone, token-hungry, and easy to corrupt. This plugin provides a
structured, cell-aware API instead: stable cell ids, output-aware truncation,
stale-edit guards, and format-preserving atomic writes.

## Install

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add --config.minimumReleaseAge=0 F:\path\to\dsh-plugin-notebook-tools
```

`dsh plugin` forwards to the pnpm bundled with DSH, and `--profile` is
required. The `--config.minimumReleaseAge=0` override is needed while the
target profile's *existing* lockfile entries are newer than pnpm's default
`minimumReleaseAge` cutoff (pnpm 11.7.0 enforces that default even when the
profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` lists the same offenders under
`minimumReleaseAgeExclude`). Without it you get
`ERR_PNPM_MINIMUM_RELEASE_AGE_VIOLATION` naming packages you did not touch.

On success the package is appended to **both** `dependencies` and
`dsh.profile.bundles` in `<DSH_HOME>\profiles\<profile>\package.json` — no
manual edit needed. A failed run can still leave a link in `node_modules`, so
treat the `package.json` entry, not `node_modules`, as proof.

The plugin ships a `cordis.patch.yml` that inserts it under the id
`notebook-tools`. DSH composes that row at boot, so **restart the DSH app** for
the tools to appear in an already-running session.

No dependencies are installed: `pnpm install` is unnecessary, and the package
imports only `node:` builtins.

## Companion skill

`skill/notebook-tools/SKILL.md` is the matching DSH skill: it tells the agent
when to reach for these tools, which of them can mutate a notebook, and how
stable a cell id really is. Copy it into the skills directory:

```powershell
Copy-Item -Recurse skill\notebook-tools "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\skills\notebook-tools" -Force
```

DSH hot-reloads the skills directory, so the skill shows up without a restart —
unlike the plugin itself, which is composed at boot.

## Tools

| Tool | Writes | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `notebook_create` | yes | Create a notebook from structured cells |
| `notebook_read` | no | Structured read, optionally with outputs |
| `notebook_list_cells` | no | Cheap index: id, type, preview, counts |
| `notebook_search` | no | Find cells by text or regex |
| `notebook_validate` | no | Validate structure and report facts |
| `notebook_edit_cell` | yes | Replace a cell's source / type |
| `notebook_insert_cell` | yes | Insert a new cell at a position |
| `notebook_delete_cell` | yes | Delete a cell by id or index |
| `notebook_clear_outputs` | yes | Clear outputs (all or one cell) |

## Guarantees

- **Writes preserve the file's own formatting.** The plugin probes the layout a
  notebook already uses — JSON indent (0/1/2/4), CRLF vs LF, trailing newline —
  and writes it back unchanged, so a notebook produced by JupyterLab,
  `nbformat.writes`, or a text editor is not reformatted. A cell whose `source`
  is a plain string stays a string, and keys that were absent (`outputs`,
  `execution_count`, `metadata`) are not invented. Read-then-write with no edit
  is byte-identical. Not preserved: tab indentation, `\uXXXX`-escaped non-ASCII
  (Python's `ensure_ascii=True`), and more than one trailing newline.
- **Atomic saves.** Mutations serialize to a sibling temp file
  (`.‹basename›.tmp-‹pid›-‹counter›-‹random›`) in the same directory, `fsync` it,
  then `rename` over the target. A killed process can never leave a half-written
  notebook, and no temp file ever lands in the system temp directory.
- **Validation before every write.** A notebook that fails the deep audit — cell
  ids outside `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$` or duplicated, non-object `metadata`,
  non-array `outputs`, non-string `source` elements — is refused by the writers
  and reported by `notebook_validate`, instead of being silently rewritten.
- **Cell ids over indexes.** `notebook_read`, `notebook_list_cells`, and
  `notebook_search` always return an `id`. A notebook too old to store ids
  (nbformat < 4.5) gets ids derived from `sha256("v1|<ordinal>|<source>")`, so
  the same cell keeps the same id across loads and processes; the derived id is
  persisted only once the file's format supports ids. `nbformat_minor` is never
  bumped. Indexes shift after every insert/delete — prefer ids.
- **Editing a code cell clears `outputs` and `execution_count`,** and the
  response text says so.
- **Three stale-edit guards on every mutating tool.** `expected_file_sha256`
  catches any change to the bytes on disk — including a rewrite inside the same
  millisecond, which `expected_file_mtime_ms` cannot see; `expected_source_sha256`
  catches a change to the one cell an operation depends on (the anchor cell for
  an insert, the target cell for an edit, delete, or clear); the mtime check is
  the cheap one and tolerates sub-millisecond jitter. All of them fail *before*
  any write. `notebook_read` and `notebook_list_cells` return both `mtime_ms`
  and `file_sha256`; only `notebook_read` returns per-cell `source_sha256`.
- **nbformat 4 only.** v3 and earlier are rejected.
- **No kernel execution, ever.**
- **Failures throw** a `NotebookError` subclass carrying a stable `code`
  (`NOTEBOOK_NOT_FOUND`, `STALE_NOTEBOOK`, `CELL_NOT_FOUND`, …). There is no
  `isError` field on the DSH tool result contract.

## Usage

```
notebook_list_cells  { path: "~/analysis.ipynb" }
notebook_read        { path: "~/analysis.ipynb", cell_ids: ["a1b2c3d4"] }
notebook_search      { path: "~/analysis.ipynb", query: "train_test_split" }
notebook_edit_cell   { path: "~/analysis.ipynb", cell_id: "a1b2c3d4",
                       new_source: "model.fit(X, y)\n",
                       expected_source_sha256: "…",
                       expected_file_sha256: "…" }
notebook_validate    { path: "~/analysis.ipynb" }
```

Pass the guards straight back from the read that produced them — `file_sha256`
comes from `notebook_read` or `notebook_list_cells`, `source_sha256` only from
`notebook_read`.

## Development

```powershell
node --test          # from this directory
```

Tests use `node:test` + `node:assert/strict` and require Node >= 22 (verified
on Node 24).

## Releasing

Releases are one command, run from a clean `main` that already contains the
version bump:

```powershell
npm run release -- --title "v0.2.1 - short one-line summary"
```

It refuses to run unless `CHANGELOG.md` carries a non-empty `## [<version>]`
section and a `[<version>]:` link reference for the version in `package.json`,
the working tree is clean, and HEAD is the commit that carries the bump. Then it
runs `node --test`, pushes the release branch, creates the annotated tag
`v<version>`, pushes it, and
creates the GitHub Release: the tag annotation is the release title and the
CHANGELOG section is its body. Credentials come from `GITHUB_TOKEN` / `GH_TOKEN`,
falling back to the stored `git credential` for `github.com` (nothing is ever
printed); the GitHub CLI is not required.

Other flags: `--dry-run` (print the plan, change nothing), `--skip-tests`,
`--branch <name>` (default `main`), `--remote <name>` (default `origin`).

## Layout

```
lib/index.js              composition only — registers the 9 tools on ctx.tools
lib/nb/*.js               pure domain; node: builtins only, no host SDK imports
lib/tools/*.js            adapters: JSON Schema params, error mapping, response text
scripts/release.mjs       the release command behind "npm run release"
test/*.test.js            node:test suites
cordis.patch.yml          the composition row DSH merges at boot
skill/notebook-tools/     the companion skill (SKILL.md)
```

The domain layer (`lib/nb/`) knows nothing about DSH — it only knows about
notebooks, so it stays unit-testable in isolation.

## Credits and license

MIT. This is a **port**, not a fork: the domain layer and all nine tool
adapters were re-implemented for the DSH plugin host from the original plugin's
documented behavior.
