[![Gitee](https://img.shields.io/badge/Gitee-mirror-c71d23?logo=gitee)](https://gitee.com/perrylink/dsh-permission-rules) [![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules?ref=badge) [![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules) **Claude Code-style declarative permission rules for DeepSeek Harness.** *Rules decide what is known. A reviewer model decides what is not.* [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache%202.0-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh--plugin-✅-green)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) [![dsh-doctor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-doctor/main/badges/PerryLink__dsh-permission-rules.svg)](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-plugin-doctor#verified-徽章) [![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-top-rated.svg)](https://dsh.market/) [![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%5E22.19%20%7C%7C%20%3E%3D24-brightgreen.svg)](#) [![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/ci.yml?branch=main&label=CI)](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/actions) [![Version](https://img.shields.io/github/v/tag/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules?label=version)](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/releases) [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-permission-rules)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-permission-rules) [![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-permission-rules)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-permission-rules) [English](README.md) · [简体中文](README-zh.md) · [Español](README-es.md) · [Português](README-pt.md) · [हिन्दी](README-hi.md)
--- **📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/). ## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你 这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。 *English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it. ## What is dsh-permission-rules? Claude Code-style declarative permission rules for DeepSeek Harness. Rules decide what is known. A reviewer model decides what is not. ![Terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules: dsh-permission-rules — deny/ask rules in one YAML file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.png) ![Animated terminal demo of dsh-permission-rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules/main/docs/assets/dsh-permission-rules-demo.gif) *The same run, animated.* ## Compatibility | Surface | Status | |---|---| | Harness | DeepSeek Harness `dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.1` (adapted 2026-09-22, full gate chain): its plugin config is the live settings contract — every field is declared `.volatile()`, the Loader hands `apply` a live reference per field, and a saved edit is committed into the running references WITHOUT remounting the plugin, with out-of-range values refused by the schema before anything is written. A host whose Schemastery predates `volatile()` (before 3.18.3) still mounts and runs this plugin — the fields simply stay ordinary values and the live config form is unavailable — because the marker is applied through a capability probe rather than assumed. `Session.append` on this line still cannot stamp the `ignorable` marker (its third argument is the surface-intent bag, and the envelope field survives for stored-log reads only), so the whole `0.2-alpha` line is pre-checked as unmarked and session-log audit stays disabled by default — `append` reads only `sourceEventSeqs`/`surfaceOp` and freezes the envelope, so it has no code path that could stamp the marker; the earlier `0.1.7-alpha` (adapted 2026-09-22), `0.1.5-rc.2` (adapted 2026-09-09) and `0.1.3-alpha` lines keep the same surface-only append signature, and every `0.2` prerelease is classified with them (a STABLE `0.2.x` release is left to the append probe, so a restored marker surface is adopted without a new plugin release). Those lines' log migrations refuse unclassified plugin events even when marked, so `strip` v1 audit rows before a `0.1.3-alpha` host opens the log and v2 audit rows before a `0.1.5-alpha` host migrates it (native v3 logs only need `repair`). | | Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` | | Platforms | All (host + web settings client) | | Model | Any (deny/ask reasons surface through tool results) | ## What you get `dsh-permission-rules` puts an ordered **`allow` / `deny` / `ask`** rule list in front of every tool call on the `tools/pre-execute` waterfall — deterministic, instant, auditable, and written by you in plain YAML: - **`deny`** blocks the call; the rule's `reason` becomes the model-visible error. - **`ask`** rides the official approval seam (mount `dsh-auto-review` for a second-model answerer, or a human answers; with neither, the harness fails closed). - **`allow`** (and no-match) strictly delegates via `next()` — downstream listeners are never short-circuited. Every hit **and** every passthrough is audit-logged as a `permissionRules/decision` session event (log-only — nothing extra is injected into the model context). - **Rich matching** — tool-name globs (including `mcp__*`), agent-identity selectors (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:*`), argument key/value globs **or** regexes (with `!pattern` negation and an `absent` key dimension), workspace-relative path globs at **any nesting depth**, `when` host conditions (env vars, platform), and **shell command decomposition** (`argv`: command word, argument tokens, pipeline signature) for token-precise command matching. - **Built-in high-risk baseline** — a shipped deny/ask ruleset (destructive commands, privilege escalation, download-and-execute, sensitive paths) enabled by default and appended after user rules so a nearer user rule can override it; toggle with `builtin.enabled`. - **Hierarchical rule files** — optional `searchUp` merges every `.dsh/rules.yaml` from the session cwd to the filesystem root, nearest first. - **Dry-run rollout** — `enforce: false` audits what the policy *would* do while passing every call through. - **Hot reload** — Chokidar watch with debounce; a broken edit keeps the previous rules, never crashes. On a WSL host, or for a rule file under `/mnt/`, the watch switches to polling because native change events are unreliable there. - **Fail loud** — invalid YAML, unknown actions/fields, bad globs/regexes, backtracking-prone patterns, or more than `maxRules` rules fail the load. ## Rule syntax ```yaml # /.dsh/rules.yaml rules: - match: { tools: [bash, pwsh], params: { command: "git push*" }, paths: ["**/secrets/**"] } action: deny reason: "No pushes from protected paths" - match: { tools: [edit, write] } action: ask reason: "File writes need confirmation" ``` - **Match dimensions** — `tools` (globs, incl. `mcp__*`), `agents` (`main` / `subagent` / `preset:`; unknown identity never matches — fail closed), `params` (key/value globs or regexes, `!pattern` negation, `absent` key dimension), `paths` (workspace-relative globs extracted at any nesting depth), `when` (`env` var globs/regexes + a closed `platform` list), and `network` (`domains` / `ips` / `ports` / `schemes` — globs, wildcards, CIDRs, port ranges). - **Actions** — `allow` / `deny` / `ask`, evaluated in file order, first match wins. - **Rule metadata** — `enabled: false` (visible but inert), `description`, `tags`; unknown fields fail the load. - **Schema**

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness A2A (Agent2Agent) plugin: expose DSH agents as standard A2A servers (agent card, message/send, message/stream SSE, tasks) + a2a_* tools to call remote A2A agents
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-a2a

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的 **A2A（Agent2Agent）协议**插件。

DSH 内置的互操作走 ACP + MCP，不包含 A2A；本插件补上这块拼图，**双向**打通 A2A 生态（Google ADK、a2ajava / a2a-python SDK、各类 agent 网关）：

- **服务器方向（入站）**：把 DSH agent 暴露为标准 A2A 服务器
  - Agent Card：`/.well-known/agent-card.json`（0.3.x）与 `/.well-known/agent.json`（0.2.x 兼容）
  - JSON-RPC 2.0：`message/send`（同步）、`message/stream`（SSE 流式）、`tasks/get`、`tasks/cancel`、`tasks/resubscribe`（断线续订）、`agent/authenticatedExtendedCard`
  - 任务生命周期 `submitted → working → completed/failed/canceled`，支持 `input-required` 暂停与 taskId 多轮续答
  - 版本协商（`A2A-Version` / `X-A2A-Version` 头）、可选 Bearer 鉴权、CORS、单轮超时、任务 TTL 回收
- **客户端方向（出站）**：注册 `a2a_*` 模型工具，让任意 DSH agent 直接呼叫远端 A2A agent
  - `a2a_discover` / `a2a_send` / `a2a_task_status` / `a2a_cancel`
  - 地址白名单（`clientAllowPatterns`）控制 agent 可呼叫的目标
- **可视化运维面板**（Web client 半，v0.2.0）：Plugins → @zyfgood/dsh-a2a 的配置卡与设置 Plugins 分区的 A2A 标签页
  - 服务器状态：运行中/模式/地址/协议版本/鉴权 + curl 验证命令一键复制
  - 实时任务板：最近任务的状态徽标/上下文/产物数，非终态任务一键取消（5s 自动刷新）
  - 远端 agent 目录：保存常用远端地址，浏览器直连拉取其 Agent Card（名称/版本/技能）
  - 数据来自 A2A 服务器自带的 `/admin/status`、`/admin/tasks` 端点（Bearer 门禁同 JSON-RPC）

零运行时依赖（纯 Node ≥20 stdlib + 全局 fetch），与 [dsh-feishu-bot](https://github.com/zyfgood/dsh-feishu-bot) 同一插件体系。

## 一、安装

```bash
# 官方 CLI 一键安装（npm 渠道，推荐；bundle patch 自动挂载）
dsh plugin --profile <name> add @zyfgood/dsh-a2a

# 或 GitHub
dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:zyfgood/dsh-a2a

# 或本地路径
dsh plugin --profile <name> add file:D:/DSHProjects/dsh-a2a
```

> npm 裸名 `dsh-a2a` 是另一个无关项目（TtTRz/dsh-a2a），本插件发布在 `@zyfgood` scope 下，安装时请带 scope。

重启 profile 后生效。默认监听 `127.0.0.1:7310`。

> `lib/` 预构建产物随仓库发布，安装即用，无需构建脚本（无 pnpm ≥10 的 `allowBuilds` 步骤）。

## 二、快速验证

```bash
# 1) Agent Card（0.3 路径）
curl http://127.0.0.1:7310/.well-known/agent-card.json

# 2) 发一条消息（同步）
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:7310/ -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "message/send",
  "params": {
    "message": {
      "kind": "message",
      "role": "user",
      "parts": [{"kind": "text", "text": "你好，介绍一下你自己"}],
      "messageId": "m-1",
      "contextId": "ctx-demo"
    }
  }
}'
```

返回的 `result` 是 A2A Task：`status.state === "completed"`，回复文本在 `artifacts[0].parts[0].text`。同一 `contextId` 再次调用会复用同一个 DSH agent 会话（多轮记忆）。

流式：

```bash
curl -N -X POST http://127.0.0.1:7310/ \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -d '{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 2, "method": "message/stream",
  "params": {"message": {"kind": "message", "role": "user",
    "parts": [{"kind": "text", "text": "流式演示"}], "messageId": "m-2", "contextId": "ctx-demo"}}
}'
```

SSE 依次推送 `status-update(working)` → `artifact-update` → `status-update(completed, final=true)` 后自然收流。

## 三、配置项

profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（或本包 `cordis.patch.yml` 默认层）：

```yaml
- id: a2a
  name: '@zyfgood/dsh-a2a'
  config:
    port: 7310
    mode: agent
```

| 配置 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `host` | `127.0.0.1` | 监听地址；公网暴露改 `0.0.0.0` 并配合鉴权 |
| `port` | `7310` | 监听端口（`0` = 系统分配） |
| `publicUrl` | 按监听地址推导 | 写入 Agent Card 的 `url`；反代/TLS 部署时必须配置为外部可达地址 |
| `bearerToken` | 无 | Bearer 鉴权令牌，支持 `env:VAR`；配置后卡片宣告 `bearerAuth` |
| `agentName` / `agentDescription` / `agentVersion` | `DSH Agent` / … | Agent Card 元信息 |
| `skills` | 内置一条 dsh-agent 技能 | Agent Card 技能清单 |
| `mode` | `agent` | 入站处理模式：`agent` / `llm` / `echo`（见下） |
| `provider` / `model` | — | 模型来源：`llm` 模式直答，`agent` 模式创建会话时写入；未配置时回退宿主默认模型（GUI 的默认模型，即 profile 的 `agent-default-model` 分节） |
| `systemPrompt` / `maxHistory` | — | `llm` 模式参数（`ctx.llm` 直答，短期记忆按 `maxHistory`） |
| `agentId` | 自动 | `agent` 模式：固定复用 `ctx.agents` 中某会话；不配置则按 contextId 自动创建 |
| `agentPreset` | GUI 默认预设 | 自动创建会话的 preset（决定 agent 可用的工具集） |
| `workspace` | `process.cwd()` | 自动创建会话的工作目录 |
| `persistSessions` | `true` | contextId → 会话映射落盘（`$DSH_HOME/a2a/`），重启后自动恢复上下文 |
| `turnTimeoutMs` | `600000` | 单轮执行上限，超时任务置 `failed` |
| `taskTtlMs` | `3600000` | 已完结任务内存保留时长（之后 TTL 回收） |
| `tools` | `true` | 是否注册 `a2a_*` 出站工具 |
| `clientAllowPatterns` | `['*']` | 出站白名单：`'*'`、`https://a2a.example.com/`、`https://*.example.com/`、`'*:7310'` |
| `clientTimeoutMs` | `120000` | 出站调用超时 |

### 三种入站模式

- **`agent`（默认）**：每个 A2A `contextId` 对应一个持久 DSH agent 会话（完整工具/技能/工作目录），跨任务续答；映射可落盘跨重启恢复。会话忙时新消息走 `steer`（下一 step 边界消费）。
- **`llm`**：`ctx.llm` 直答（自包含轻量模式，不建 agent 会话，短期记忆按 `maxHistory`）。
- **`echo`**：回显原文，验证链路。

## 四、出站：agent 调用远端 A2A

插件默认注册 4 个模型工具（`tools: false` 关闭）：

| 工具 | 对应协议方法 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|
| `a2a_discover` | `GET /.well-known/agent-card.json` | 拉取远端 Agent Card（能力/技能/鉴权） |
| `a2a_send` | `message/stream`（自动降级 `message/send` + 轮询） | 发消息并等待远端最终回复 |
| `a2a_task_status` | `tasks/get` | 查询远端任务状态 |
| `a2a_cancel` | `tasks/cancel` | 取消远端任务 |

对话示例：「用 a2a_send 呼叫 http://其它机器:7310/ 的 agent，问它有哪些技能，把结果汇总给我」。

## 五、开发

```bash
pnpm verify   # 本地 typecheck（shims/ 提供 @deepseek-ai 结构类型）
pnpm test     # 构建 DSH 无关核心 + 35 项端到端冒烟测试
pnpm build:local  # 本地全量构建 lib/（shims 类型校验，产物与宿主构建一致）
pnpm build    # 完整构建（需要宿主环境提供 @deepseek-ai/* peer 依赖）
```

代码结构：

```
src/
├── index.ts       插件入口：Config schema + apply()
├── protocol.ts    A2A 类型 / JSON-RPC / Agent Card（纯函数，零依赖）
├── store.ts       任务存储 + SSE 事件中枢（事件缓冲、订阅、TTL）
├── server.ts      HTTP 服务器：card / message/send / message/stream(SSE) / tasks/* / admin/*
├── bridge.ts      DSH 桥接：echo / llm / agent 三种 TaskRunner
├── client.ts      出站 A2A 客户端（fetch + SSE 解析）
├── tools.ts       a2a_* 模型工具注册
└── persistence.ts contextId → 会话映射落盘
client/
└── client.js      浏览器半：A2A 运维面板（免构建 ModuleLoader 工厂，react 为宿主 external）
```

设计说明：

- `protocol` / `store` / `server` / `client` 不依赖任何 DSH 包，可独立构建与测试；DSH 桥接收敛在 `bridge.ts` / `tools.ts` / `index.ts`。
- **agent 模式必须有模型**：agent-loop 不自动兜底 provider/model，缺失时提示词组装里的 `{{model}}` 无值，每轮立即报错（表现为「无文本输出」）。插件因此按「配置 provider/model → 回退 `ctx.agentDefaultModel.currentSelection()`」解析，两者都拿不到时直接返回明确的失败说明；本轮若以 `turn/end reason=error` 结束，错误原因会被回给客户端而不是笼统占位符。改 profile 的默认模型后，新建的 A2A 会话即生效（已存在的会话沿用原模型，删 `$DSH_HOME/a2a/context-sessions.json` 条目可重建）。
- 任务 id 参数：规范写法 `params.id` 与本插件旧约定 `params.taskId` 都接受（`tasks/get` / `tasks/cancel` / `tasks/resubscribe`）。
- `input-required` 事件带 `final=true` 关闭当轮 SSE，但任务保持非终态，客户端可凭 `taskId` 续答（续答复用同一任务与 history）。
- `tasks/cancel` 立即广播 `canceled(final=true)`；agent 模式下正在运行的一轮会在 500ms 轮询粒度感知退出并尽力 `interrupt`，不会阻塞后续轮次。
- 与 A2A 0.2.x 客户端的兼容：旧 card 路径照常服务；0.2 客户端不发送版本头时按同版本处理。
- 不支持的协议面按规范返回明确错误码：push notification `-32003`、批量 JSON-RPC `-32600`。

## 六、与 DSH 内置能力的关系

| 需求 | 用什么 |
|---|---|
| 程序化驱动 DSH agent（进程外） | 内置 ACP（`dsh-acp`，`pnpm dsh --profile acp`） |
| 挂载外部工具/资源 | 内置 MCP 客户端 |
| 跨 agent 生态互操作（Google ADK / A2A SDK） | **本插件** |

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Discover and verify DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugins from GitHub topic:dsh-plugin — trust score, official peer compatibility, one-click install via the official installer
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Plugin Scout

[English](README.md) | [中文](docs/zh.md)

[![ci](https://github.com/fegnze/dsh-plugin-scout/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/fegnze/dsh-plugin-scout/actions/workflows/ci.yml) · MIT

Discover and verify DeepSeek Harness plugins published under the GitHub topic `dsh-plugin`, from inside DSH. Plugins are grouped by purpose, ranked by trust score, and checked against the official peer-compatibility rule. Supports DSH **0.2.x** (`>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0`); tested on desktop 0.2.0-rc.2.

> The in-app UI is currently Chinese only. The plugin's title and description in the official Plugins page are localized (`locale/en.json`, `locale/zh.json`).

## Install

Open the official **Plugins** page → **Add plugin**, and enter one of:

| Spec | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| `dsh-plugin-scout` | Recommended. Prebuilt npm package with provenance; no install scripts, no build approval needed |
| Absolute path of a prebuilt `dsh-plugin-scout-<version>.tgz`, if supplied with a release | Bypasses the npm registry; the current tag workflow creates release notes only and does not attach a tarball |

From the CLI: `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-plugin-scout`. Enable it on the Plugins page; a **发现插件** (Discover plugins) entry appears in the sidebar.

Do not install from `github:fegnze/dsh-plugin-scout`: a git install fetches source without `lib/`, and this repository deliberately ships no `prepare` script.

## Native Discover index

Add this URL in the official **Plugins → Discover → Index sources** dialog:

```text
https://fegnze.github.io/dsh-plugin-scout/index.json
```

This is a format-1 catalog, not an embedded Scout page. You do not need to install Scout to browse it. GitHub Actions rebuilds it daily at 03:23 UTC and on generator changes, then deploys only after the official DSH validator accepts the document. Failed generation leaves the previous deployment intact.

The public catalog contains deduplicated npm bundles compatible with the target DSH 0.2.1-rc.2, with a matching repository, no install hooks, and advertised provenance. Archived, risky, version-drifted, stale or incomplete entries are excluded. Forks retain a source label. Provenance presence is not cryptographic verification or a security guarantee. Each entry pins the npm version and uses npm's real release time; the official installer remains the final authority. The target runtime is a publishing policy, not a compatibility claim for every DSH release.

Generate from public GitHub/npm data with `GH_TOKEN=<read-only-token> node scripts/generate-market.mjs`. `MARKET_OUTPUT`, `SCOUT_CACHE`, and `DSH_TARGET` override the output, disposable crawl cache, and target runtime. No local profile or user cache is published. The generated `site/index.json` and crawl cache are ignored by Git; CI uploads only the public catalog as the Pages artifact. Adding the source remains your explicit action; Scout does not alter configured index sources.

## One-click install, through the official installer

The **Install** button in the details drawer takes the same path as the official **Add plugin**: `inspect` first, then `installBundle(spec, {enabled: false, requestId, registry})`. Installed plugins start **disabled**; **Enable** is a separate click (`setBundleEnabled`).

- Plugins with install hooks, or whose DSH peers do not cover the running version, need a second click to install.
- When the official installer blocks dependency build scripts (`pendingBuilds`), they are listed by name; a double click on **Allow and reinstall** retries with `approvedBuilds`.
- **Cancel install** calls `cancelInstall` with the same `requestId`; a lost reply is recovered with `waitForInstall`. On failure the official installer restores `package.json` and the lockfile.
- **Uninstalling and version exemptions stay on the official Plugins page.** Scout never calls `removeBundle`; the tests fail if it does. Without the official `pluginManager`, the Install button is hidden and the drawer falls back to "copy pinned spec + open the Plugins page".

## Data sources (first-party only)

| Source | Used for |
| --- | --- |
| GitHub GraphQL `search(topic:dsh-plugin)` | Repository metadata, root `package.json`, `cordis.patch.yml` text (never evaluated) |
| `registry.npmjs.org/<name>/latest` | The manifest that would actually be installed: peers, install hooks, `repository`, provenance |
| Official `pluginManager.listBundles` / `inspect` | Installed state; the official pre-install check (resolves only, runs no code) |
| Official `pluginManager.installBundle` / `waitForInstall` / `cancelInstall` / `setBundleEnabled` | One-click install (disabled by default), cancel, separate enable; progress from `plugin-manager/install-state` and `install-log` events |

No third-party marketplace or aggregator is used. Topic searches explicitly use `fork:true` to include both original repositories and forks; forks retain their source notice and undergo the same checks. After upgrading from 0.1.5 or earlier, use **Rebuild full index** once to discover older forks omitted by the previous search scope.

**Crawling, measured (2026-10):** the topic holds about 19,000 repositories, 12,700 of them created in August, many of them same-name copies. GitHub search returns at most 1,000 results per query, so Scout bisects time windows adaptively (≤900 results per window, 60 s minimum window). Pages are 50 items: 100-item pages return 502 in dense windows, so on 502 the page size steps down to 25, then 10, resuming from the same cursor. Later runs crawl incrementally by `pushed`.

**Refresh is streaming and pays only for what changed:**
- **Newest first.** Windows are seeded geometrically (last 6 h / 1 d / 3 d / 1 w / 1 mo / 3 mo / older) and paged from the newest. Window counting and paging overlap (3 workers).
- **Publish while crawling.** Each page is merged into the record set immediately and published every 1.5 s; the UI reloads the list when `status.rev` changes. The previous index stays usable throughout. A checkpoint is written every 30 s.
- **Pay for change.** With an existing index, a light query fetches metadata only (100 per page, no blobs). Repositories whose `pushedAt` is unchanged keep their facts and only refresh stars and similar metadata; changed ones fetch `package.json` and the patch by node id in batches of 50.
- **npm in parallel.** npm lookups run alongside the GitHub crawl (8 workers), only for repositories with new pushes, missing entries, or entries older than one day. Entries older than one day are refreshed oldest first, at most 800 per run, even when the repository was not seen in that incremental crawl.
- **Canonical source recovery.** A refresh also follows same-name npm packages' GitHub `repository` links with bounded, exact read-only queries. A source is added only when GitHub's actual root manifest declares the same package name; missing topics never justify treating an unrelated namesake as the publisher. Failed lookups do not fabricate source facts.
- **Activation does not wait for the index.** The ~30 MB index loads in the background; the UI first sees `loaded: false` and polls.

Measured on 2026-10-14 over a real network:

| Scenario | First results | Total | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Incremental, 1,082 repos pushed | 4.5 s | 38 s | 125 refetched blobs, 963 metadata-only, 70 npm lookups |
| Cold full crawl | 6.7 s | — | ~1,000 plugins browsable within 60 s; the rest fill in the background |

## Checks and trust score

| Check | Rule | Points |
| --- | --- | --- |
| V1 | Root `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle` / `dsh.client` (otherwise not a plugin) | 20 |
| V2 | Official peer rule: only `@deepseek-ai/dsh` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*`, `semver.satisfies(runtime, range, {includePrerelease})`, `workspace:*` means the running version. Inside the App, Scout calls `dsh-app-boot.evaluatePluginCompatibility` directly | covered 30 · no peers 10 · not covered 5 |
| V3 | Install hooks: preinstall / install / postinstall / prepare | none +15 · present −15 |
| V4 | Source chain: the same-name npm package's `repository` points back to this repo | match +15 · mismatch −20 · unpublished 0 |
| V5 | npm proven

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin for Sub2api account quotas and usage monitoring
plugins.readme_text:
# sub2api Account Usage Monitor

English | [中文](<docs/zh.md>)

`dsh-sub2api-monitor` is a DSH desktop plugin compatible with DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.2`. It provides only a usage entry in the conversation title bar, with no sidebar entry, full page, or centered dialog. The title-bar popover has a maximum width of 700px and adapts to the viewport, balancing two-column cards with readability. Clicking outside, pressing Esc, or clicking Close dismisses it; clicking inside does not. It does not modify DSH core or start additional processes or HTTP services.

## Data and refresh

The Host reads the paginated account list, each account's `/usage`, and `/today-stats` through the management API. It refreshes every 60 seconds by default, processing at most 3 accounts concurrently. The Client reads the local cache every 10 seconds; manual refresh has a minimum interval of 10 seconds. All timers and requests are disposed of on plugin unload. Operations are read-only: the plugin does not call account start/stop, credential refresh, or quota-reset endpoints.

- Quota windows: 5-hour, 7-day, and upstream Sonnet/Opus windows, showing usage percentages and relative reset times, with full timestamps on hover. Anthropic explicitly uses `source=passive`, matching the site's passive sampling; the default active endpoint may omit weekly quotas.
- Compact, responsive cards retain today's statistics and abbreviate large numbers. The top explanation area and search box are removed; synchronization status appears as a title-bar dot.
- Subscription type: only allowlisted scalar values from `credentials.plan_type` are extracted, displayed separately from authentication methods such as OAuth. `promax` is shown as the site's corresponding `Pro 500`; missing values display “Unknown subscription”. The credentials object is never passed through.
- Today's requests, tokens, and cost use the Shanghai time zone. Costs use sub2api's accounting basis and are not equivalent to the provider's actual bill.
- Highlights at 80%/95%; the conversation summary counts accounts needing attention. System notifications are not currently sent.
- Unknown fields remain unknown. Partial failures are marked separately; list failures retain old data with a stale indicator. Upstream snapshots may predate collection; source timestamps are shown when supplied by the API.

## Account details

Click a card (or press Enter/Space) to open details within the same popover; Back returns to the list. Details load `/admin/accounts/:id/stats?days=30&timezone=Asia%2FShanghai` only on demand, cache for 60 seconds, and coalesce concurrent requests. Only known collected account IDs are accepted, redirects are rejected, and the Host projects allowlisted fields. No historical database or background history polling is added.

The view shows period totals, reported window length and recorded date range, daily request/Token/account-cost bars, model ranking by Token with expandable input/output/cache composition, active-day averages, peak days, and mean request duration. Missing dates are not filled with zeros. This covers only calls through sub2api; costs are not subscription bills, and mean duration is not time to first token. Account costs use `actual_cost` for daily records and `account_cost` for models; missing fields stay unknown. Errors offer retry; leaving details aborts the UI request, while shared Host work is bounded by timeout and unload cancellation.

## Installation and plugin configuration

Install the npm package `dsh-sub2api-monitor` in DSH's Plugins page. Open the configuration form in the plugin details, fill in the following fields, and save. Configuration is embedded directly in the plugin information page rather than registering a host settings page; the Configuration button at the top of the usage popover also opens it. DSH's settings service writes configuration to the profile; no plugin source edits are needed. The read endpoint returns only non-sensitive fields, the credential reference name, and whether a key is set. Leaving the key input blank preserves the existing value; the first save requires a key. Saves use revisions to detect concurrent conflicts and do not automatically overwrite changes from another window.

Disable the old `sub2api-monitor` and earlier `myspace-sub2api-monitor` packages before enabling the new package to avoid duplicate collection. After moving parameters into plugin configuration, uninstall the old package. Both the component ID and configuration namespace are `dsh-sub2api-monitor`; connection configuration is managed only by the DSH profile. When upgrading to 0.1.0, also replace the old component ID in the profile with the new ID while preserving its config fields; do not just swap packages and lose configuration.

- `baseUrl`: the site's API address, including `/api/v1`.
- `adminApiKeyEnv`: credential reference (environment-variable-style name) for the administrator API key; default `SUB2API_ADMIN_API_KEY`. The profile stores only this name. A key entered in the form is written to the DSH credentials service (`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` with the local provider), not to plugin configuration. The process environment or a `.env` file can also supply it; an inherited environment value is read-only and disables the key input.
- `allowInsecureHttp`: off by default; enable only after explicitly accepting plaintext risks.
- `intervalSeconds`: 30–3600 seconds; default 60 seconds.
- `primaryAccounts`: select multiple accounts from a checkbox list loaded automatically from the unfiltered Host cache. Refresh Accounts fetches upstream data using the saved connection (10-second cooldown). Missing selected accounts are retained; failures never clear selections. Internally stored as exact names, empty by default. Primary cards show a badge.
- `primaryFirst`: defaults to true; places primary accounts before the selected secondary ordering.
- `displayFilter`: `all`, `primary`, `available`, or `attention`. Attention includes unavailable accounts, failed usage/statistics requests, and usage at or above 80%.
- `sortBy`: `available` (default), `name`, `usage-desc`, or `usage-asc`. Usage sorting compares the highest known usage percentage across windows; unknown values sort last. Filtering does not change upstream collection. Settings persist in the profile and are applied to subsequent cache reads. The title-bar count reflects the filtered set; the web dashboard remains independent.

Only the Host resolves the key, once per request, so rotation takes effect on the next refresh without a restart. It is never injected into the Client module, usage endpoint, or profile. The credentials file is plaintext with owner-only permissions; it is not disk encryption.

```json
{
  "baseUrl": "https://your-sub2api.example/api/v1",
  "adminApiKeyEnv": "SUB2API_ADMIN_API_KEY",
  "allowInsecureHttp": false,
  "intervalSeconds": 60
}
```

Set `allowInsecureHttp` to `true` only after explicitly accepting plaintext transport risks. To rotate the key, enter a new one in the form, or update the credential through the DSH credentials service; no reinstallation is needed.

Upgrading from 0.1.x: the plaintext `adminApiKey` field has been removed. Move its value into the credentials service under `SUB2API_ADMIN_API_KEY` (or re-enter it in the form), then delete `adminApiKey` from the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`.

The old standalone JSON configuration and `SUB2API_MONITOR_CONFIG` environment variable are no longer read. Delete the old configuration file after migration, keeping plugin configuration as the single authority.

Upstream redirects are rejected to prevent key leakage. The frontend receives only allowlisted display fields, excluding credentials, extra, notes, and raw errors.

The local `/sub2api-monitor/api` accepts only loopback requests, a valid local Host, a same-origin Origin when present, and the custom header `X-Sub2api-Monitor: 1`. CORS is not enabled. Remote browsers and cross-machine connections are not currently supported.

## Installation and verification

The only dependency is the official `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` configuration schema package; there is no generation step

# Hackathon -- Plug-In

本仓库是 **DSH 黑客松的插件方向**工作区（远程仓库
[kirahvi03/Hackathon--Plug-In](https://github.com/kirahvi03/Hackathon--Plug-In)）。
内容分两部分：

1. **本机开发环境**的配置与自检脚本（第 1–3 节）
2. **DSH 插件**：骨架 `plugins/hackathon-starter/` 与参赛作品
   `plugins/dsh-intent-translator/`（第 4 节）

游戏方向的仓库在另一处：[Hackathon--Game](https://github.com/kirahvi03/Hackathon--Game)
（本地路径 `..\hackathon-game`）。

插件体系的完整研究报告见 [`docs/dsh-plugin-development-report.md`](docs/dsh-plugin-development-report.md)
（58KB，含官方 API 导出名、slot key 目录、模板出处与未能确定事项清单）。

---

## 1. 环境总览

| 组件 | 版本 | 位置 / 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Node.js | v24.21.0 | `C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.exe`（系统安装，已在 PATH 中） |
| npm | 11.19.0 | 随 Node 提供 |
| pnpm | 11.7.0 | 由 `~\.dsh\bin\pnpm.cmd` 转发到 DSH 内置 pnpm 11.7.0 |
| Python | 3.12.14 | DSH 内置解释器，已通过 PATH 前置覆盖失效的商店别名 |
| pip | 26.2.1 | `~\.dsh\bin\pip.cmd` → `python -m pip` |
| Git | 2.55.0 | `C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe` |
| GitHub 凭据 | 已就绪 | Git Credential Manager 2.9.1，账号 `kirahvi03` |
| VS Code | 1.140.0 | 命令行入口 `code` 可用 |
| ffmpeg | 7.1.1 | 已在 PATH 中 |

未安装（按需再补）：`gh`（GitHub CLI）、`docker`、PowerShell 7（`pwsh`）。

Python 预装库：`numpy` 2.3.5、`pandas` 3.0.1、`openpyxl` 3.1.5、`XlsxWriter` 3.2.9、
`python-docx` 1.2.0、`python-pptx` 1.0.2、`Pillow` 12.3.0、`lxml` 6.1.3。

---

## 2. 本次为环境做的改动

1. **修复 Python**：PATH 上原本只有 Microsoft Store 的 `python.exe` 占位符（执行即失败）。
   现已把可用的 DSH 内置解释器目录前置到用户 PATH。
2. **补上 pnpm**：`pnpm` 之前不在 PATH 上。新增 `~\.dsh\bin\pnpm.cmd`、`pnpx.cmd` shim，
   指向 DSH 内置 pnpm，并把 `~\.dsh\bin` 加到用户 PATH 最前面。
3. **补上 pip 入口**：内置 Python 的 `Scripts` 目录没有可执行文件，新增 `pip.cmd` shim。
4. **PowerShell 执行策略**：当前用户范围设为 `RemoteSigned`，本地脚本可直接运行。
5. **初始化本仓库**：`main` 分支、`.gitignore`、`.gitattributes`。
6. **GitHub 凭据**：全局 `credential.helper = manager`，`git push` 无需再次登录。

> 以上 PATH 改动写入的是**用户级**环境变量。已打开的终端需要重开一次才能生效。

---

## 3. 快速开始

### 3.1 环境自检

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\env-check.ps1
```

全部通过时退出码为 0，并逐项打印各工具的实际版本与路径。缺少可选项（`gh`/`docker`）只告警。

### 3.2 Web / Node 项目

```powershell
pnpm init                 # 或 pnpm create vite my-app
pnpm add -D typescript    # 依赖安装
pnpm dev                  # 跑开发服务器
```

> 用 `npm` 也可以，但本工作区统一用 `pnpm` 以节省磁盘并避免依赖提升问题。

### 3.3 Python 项目

全局解释器可直接用；做正式项目建议建虚拟环境，避免污染内置环境：

```powershell
python -m venv .venv
.\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

> 若激活脚本被执行策略拦截，先运行
> `Set-ExecutionPolicy -Scope Process -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Force`。

### 3.4 推送到 GitHub

远程仓库已接好并完成首次推送：

| 项 | 值 |
| --- | --- |
| 仓库 | <https://github.com/kirahvi03/Hackathon--Plug-In>（public） |
| remote | `origin` |
| 分支 | `main`，已设置上游跟踪 `origin/main` |

日常提交：

```powershell
git add -A
git commit -m "feat: ..."
git push
```

认证由 Git Credential Manager 自动完成（本机已存 `kirahvi03` 的 token，含 `repo` + `workflow` 权限），
正常情况不会再弹出登录。

---

## 4. DSH 插件：骨架与参赛作品

### 4.1 插件骨架（`plugins/hackathon-starter/`）

本机 DSH 是 **0.2.1-rc.2**，插件框架为 **Cordis 4**。一个插件包 = 一个 bundle，
由 `package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 指向 `cordis.patch.yml`，后者把插件行 insert 进 profile 的插件树。

骨架同时演示两个扩展点：

| 半边 | 文件 | 内容 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Host | `index.js` | 具名导出 `{ Config, apply, inject, name }`，用 `ctx.tools.register(defineTool({...}))` 注册工具 `plugin_ping` |
| Client | `client.js` | `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` + `ctx.slots.register` 往 `conversation.composer.dock` 插一个徽标 |

每个 API 字段都对照官方实现 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-todo` 抄写（不是猜测）：
`name` / `description` / `parameters` / `output.{schema,render}` / `execute(args, exec)` / `presentCall(args)`。

**语法自检**（无需安装任何依赖）：

```powershell
node --check .\plugins\hackathon-starter\index.js
node --check .\plugins\hackathon-starter\client.js
```

**安装到 profile**（转发给内置 pnpm，必须用绝对路径）：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "C:\Users\19371\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\plugins\hackathon-starter"
```

> ⚠️ 尚未替你执行安装：`desktop` 是当前运行中的这个应用独占管理的 profile，
> 安装后需重启才生效，可能打断正在进行的会话。要装的话说一声。

> ℹ️ 官方包（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 等）**不在 npm 上**，它们打包在 `app.asar` 内。
> 插件通过 `peerDependencies` 声明版本要求，由宿主提供实现，因此**不要自己 `pnpm add` 这些包**。

### 4.2 参赛作品：`plugins/dsh-intent-translator/`

面向 vibecoding 的**意图翻译器**：用亮蓝色 `#66ccff` 标出输入里的 1–3 处模糊描述，
每一处独立分叉成 2–3 个「人话方向」卡片；点选一张只替换它所属的模糊片段，
「背景有图片」这类确定信息原样保留。支持撤回和「换一组」。

![意图翻译器多片段候选卡片](plugins/dsh-intent-translator/docs/preview.png)

| 项 | 位置 / 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 工具行按钮 | `conversation.input.left`，与 `dsh-prompt-optimizer` 的 ✨ 同槽位 |
| 候选卡片 | `conversation.input.dock`，输入框上方 |
| Host | `lib/host.js`：`ctx.webServer` 路由 + `ctx.llm.stream()`，15s 超时 |
| 纯逻辑 | `lib/engine.js`：多片段校验、人话标签守卫、方向去重、span 定位与替换 |
| Client | `client.src.js` → `client.js`：按钮、卡片、`#66ccff` 高亮、逐段替换、撤回、换一组 |
| 完整说明 | [`plugins/dsh-intent-translator/README.md`](plugins/dsh-intent-translator/README.md) |
| 实现计划 | [`docs/dsh-intent-translator-plan.md`](docs/dsh-intent-translator-plan.md) |

安装到 `desktop` profile（需要重启一次让 Host 新行生效）：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "C:\path\to\Hackathon--Plug-In\plugins\dsh-intent-translator"
```

验证：

```powershell
cd plugins\dsh-intent-translator
npm test        # 构建 client.js，再跑 34 个 Node 测试
```

V2 只预留接口：点选方向后可通过 `ctx` 调用 `dsh-prompt-optimizer` 精修，
V1 不自动调用，也不复制其代码。详见插件 README。

---

## 5. 注意事项

- **不要在 DSH 会话里直接 `.\script.ps1`**：DSH 托管的 shell 对脚本加载有额外限制，
  会报 “未对文件进行数字签名”。加上 `-ExecutionPolicy Bypass` 用子进程运行即可：
  `powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\env-check.ps1`。
  你自己开的普通终端不受此限制。
- **不要 `pip install` 到内置 Python 之外**：`python` 已指向 DSH 内置解释器，
  装包会写进 DSH 的 `site-packages`。长期项目用 `.venv` 隔离。
- **密钥不入库**：`.gitignore` 已覆盖 `.env`、`*.pem`、`credentials.json` 等；
  需要提交样例时用 `.env.example`。
- **行尾符**：`.gitattributes` 统一仓库内为 LF，Windows 下工作区仍可用 CRLF。

---

## 6. 目录结构

```
.
├─ README.md                              本文件
├─ .gitignore                             忽略规则（Node / Python / 密钥 / 编辑器）
├─ .gitattributes                         行尾符与二进制文件规则
├─ docs/
│  ├─ dsh-plugin-development-report.md    DSH 插件开发研究报告（58KB）
│  └─ dsh-intent-translator-plan.md       意图翻译器实现计划
├─ plugins/
│  ├─ hackathon-starter/                  ← 插件骨架
│  │  ├─ package.json                     bundle 清单（dsh.bundle.patch / dsh.client）
│  │  ├─ cordis.patch.yml                 把插件行 insert 进 profile
│  │  ├─ index.js                         Host 半边：注册 plugin_ping 工具
│  │  ├─ client.js                        Client 半边：输入框下方徽标
│  │  ├─ icon.svg                         插件卡片图标
│  │  ├─ locale/{zh,en}.json              显示名称与描述
│  │  └─ README.md                        骨架的改造指引
│  └─ dsh-intent-translator/              ← 参赛作品：意图翻译器
│     ├─ package.json                     bundle + dsh.client + peerDependencies
│     ├─ cordis.patch.yml                 Host 行 insert
│     ├─ index.js                         Host 入口
│     ├─ lib/{engine,host}.js             纯逻辑 + 路由/LLM/超时
│     ├─ client.src.js → client.js        Client 源码与构建产物
│     ├─ scripts/build-client.mjs         零依赖构建（内联 engine.js）
│     ├─ test/*.test.mjs                  34 个 Node 测试
│     ├─ docs/preview.png                 验收截图（居中悬浮面板）
│     └─ README.md                        安装/配置/数据契约/V2 边界
└─ scripts/
   └─ env-check.ps1                       环境自检脚本
```

plugins.description: The machine's non-pwsh execution surfaces as one DSH tool: a WSL Linux userland, nushell's structured pipelines, the MSYS2 userland (bash/zsh/fish/brush), and a real console for interactive programs.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-shell-surfaces

[![test](https://github.com/Nesarf/dsh-shell-surfaces/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Nesarf/dsh-shell-surfaces/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![licence: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/licence-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

`https://github.com/Nesarf/dsh-shell-surfaces` -- a DSH plugin, installed with
`dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:Nesarf/dsh-shell-surfaces`.

The badge is the whole test workflow: the pure self-test, and the two-runner
probe that asks every shell on Windows and on Linux what it is. A green badge
therefore means "the table and the argv shape still hold, and both platforms
still answered", not just "the linter passed".

One DSH tool for the execution surfaces this machine has: a WSL Linux userland,
nushell's structured pipelines, the MSYS2 userland (bash / zsh / fish / brush),
PowerShell itself, and a real console for interactive programs.

It exists because a rule that is only written down is not a capability. The
selection rules for these surfaces have been recorded for a while, but a session
could only act on them by composing a command string for pwsh and hoping the
quoting survived the trip. Here they are callable.

```
shell_surfaces(action="surfaces")                    what exists here, and where each was looked for
shell_surfaces(action="run", surface="wsl",  command="grep -P '(?<=Linux )[0-9.]+' /proc/version")
shell_surfaces(action="run", surface="nu",   command="open data.json | where n > 3 | to json")
shell_surfaces(action="run", surface="msys", command="pacman -Q | wc -l")
shell_surfaces(action="run", surface="pwsh", command="Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem | Select-Object Caption")
shell_surfaces(action="run", surface="pty",  command="powershell -File install.ps1", send=["y\n"])
```

## PowerShell is a surface here

"Fall back to pwsh" used to mean "leave this tool and use the other one". The
`pwsh` surface closes that gap: a PowerShell command is an ordinary call here,
the same shape as every other surface, so a session that hits an awkward
surface does not have to change its tool to get a PowerShell job done.

What this surface deliberately does **not** carry, and the built-in `pwsh` tool
does, is approval and sandbox escalation, and a persistent session. Those are
reasons to use that tool and not this surface -- but "the command is PowerShell"
is not one of them.

A surface-level failure is also not a reason to change tools. When a surface is
absent, cannot spawn, or times out, the tool says so and names the next call
(`action="surfaces"`) that stays inside this plugin; the failure is about the
surface, not about the tool.

## Background work stays here too

`run_in_background: true` starts the command as a job and returns its id: the
output ring streams it, `job_output` reads it, `job_kill` stops it. No timeout
applies. `promote_on_timeout: true` turns a timeout into that same job instead of
killing the process -- the output collected before the budget expired is handed
over exactly once, and the rest keeps streaming.

That is why the built-in `pwsh` tool now covers only approval/sandbox escalation
and the persistent session: the job machinery no longer sends a session back to
it. A composition without the `jobs` service gets a refusal sentence for a
background request rather than a job nobody can collect, and the `pty` surface
has no background mode at all, because a console transcript is read while the
program is alive.

## The same sandbox as the built-in shell tools

A confined deployment confines this tool too. Each call resolves the session's
policy through `ctx.sandboxPolicy`, wraps the exact argv it is about to spawn
through `ctx.sandbox.confine`, and reports the mode, enforcement and denial facts
in the same vocabulary the built-in shell tools use. `danger-full-access` never
consults the provider, and a composition without the sandbox services runs
exactly as before.

A file effect the mode denies is a policy answer, not a command failure.
`sandbox_permissions` plus `justification` asks `ctx.approval` for exactly one
wider call -- the grant is consumed by that call and never persisted -- and an
escalation that is refused, cancelled or has no approval channel stops before
anything runs. The same-turn denial hint rides the tool result, so the sanctioned
retry does not depend on recalling the description.

## Persistent sessions

Pass `session: <name>` to run a command inside one long-lived shell per (agent,
surface, name): the current directory, variables and modules persist across
calls, and `session_reset: true` starts a fresh one. The session is a process
with a pipe, not a terminal -- a random nonce line marks where one command's
output ends, which is the only signal every supported shell (`pwsh`, `msys`)
prints without a prompt. A session runs one command at a time, so the job flags
are refused with it, and `pty` has no session at all: a console transcript is
read while the program is alive.

## Finding this machine's shells

The table is a set of defaults, and the scan is what makes them true on a
machine that moved its installs. The model is borrowed from
mega-index-map's `library_detect`: a built-in candidate table (shell names, the
usual install roots, the WSL launcher) resolved against PATH and this machine's
own locations, with every hit carrying where it was found. A scan costs one
PATH listing per directory plus a few `stat` calls and one `wsl -l -q` -- it is
not a walk of the drive.

What the scan adds to the table:

| Found | Becomes |
|---|---|
| a WSL distribution other than the default | its own `wsl-<distro>` surface |
| a Git-for-Windows or Cygwin bash | a `git-bash` surface (the MSYS2 one keeps `msys`) |
| `cmd.exe` | a `cmd` surface (`cmd /c`) |
| a terminal program (`wt`, `mintty`, `wezterm`, ...) | reported in `action="surfaces"` under `discovered`, not a surface: a terminal draws text, it does not interpret commands |

`action="surfaces"` answers with both halves: the surfaces this tool can run
now, and the `discovered` report (kind, name, path, source) the scan produced.
A discovered path also replaces a guessed default, so a machine whose
PowerShell lives outside `Program Files` still answers.

## Why one tool and not seven

Every registered tool spends part of the context on its description. Seven tools
would say the same thing seven times. The selection rules -- which surface for a
structured pipe, which for a Linux-only tool, which for a program that waits for
input -- live in this one description, and a session reads them exactly when it
is choosing.

This tool is the **first choice** for running a command, not a fallback for
"exceptional" cases: a job that needs a Linux tool, a POSIX pipeline, another
shell language, a structured pipe, a real console -- or PowerShell itself --
belongs on its surface. One prompt section says that, placed ahead of the pwsh
rule, because a tool description only speaks once the catalogue is already open.
Wrapping another shell inside a `pwsh` command line stays the thing to avoid: the
extra quoting layer is where paths get mangled.

## The row a call renders as

A `shell_surfaces` call used to render as the wire tool name --
"工具调用 · shell_surfaces · wsl" -- which names the catalogue entry rather than
the machine surface or the command. The plugin now ships a client half
(`lib/client.js`) that registers a `tool.call.toolview` row for this tool, so a
call reads as the sentence it is:

```
WSL · grep -P '(?<=Linux )[0-9.]+' /proc/version      完成 · 120ms
zsh · ls                                            1 · 12ms
conPTY · cmd /c ver                                  运行中
shells · 列出可用 surface                             完成
```

The surface name is at the head, the activity beside it, the exit status at the
end, and the captured output one click away. That is a client concern rather
than a host result: the pending row must already name its surface before any
output exists. Nothing patches a first-party package -- `tool.call.toolview` is
the supported keyed seam, and the stock row remains the fallback for every other
tool.

## What it is not

* **No message hooks.** It registers a t

plugins.description: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：在底部状态栏（composer dock）常驻显示当前日期与时间，提供可视化配置。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-clock

[![CI](https://github.com/DeepCodec/dsh-clock/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/DeepCodec/dsh-clock/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green.svg)](LICENSE)
[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@deepcodec/dsh-clock?label=npm&color=blue)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepcodec/dsh-clock)
[![dsh compatibility](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-0.2.0--rc.2-blueviolet)](package.json)

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）Web 插件：在**底部状态栏**（composer dock）常驻显示当前日期与时间，提供**可视化配置**。

## 效果

聊天界面底部状态条（输入框下方，系统"上下文用量"旁边）显示：

```
2026年10月12日 星期一 · 15:21:08
```

默认每秒刷新，纯浏览器本地 `Date` 渲染。

## 可视化配置（推荐）

打开 **设置 → 通用 → 时钟**，直接点选/拨动即可，改动即时生效并持久化到**当前 profile 的 Cordis patch**（`cordis.patch.yml` 中 `dsh-clock` 行的 `config`）：

| 设置项 | 控件 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 显示内容 | 下拉菜单 | 日期 + 时间 / 仅日期 / 仅时间 |
| 显示星期几 | 开关 | 日期行是否含星期几 |
| 显示秒 | 开关 | 时间是否显示秒 |
| 刷新间隔（毫秒） | 数字输入 | 250–60000ms |

## 命令行配置（可选）

同样可在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中预设默认值（就是可视化设置写入的同一层）：

```yaml
- id: dsh-clock
  name: dsh-clock
  config:
    mode: dateTime        # date | time | dateTime
    weekday: true         # 日期行是否含星期几
    showSeconds: true     # 时间是否显示秒
    intervalMs: 1000      # 刷新间隔（250–60000ms）
```

解析顺序（dsh-settings）：schema 默认值 → 继承的 composition 层 → 该 profile entry 的 `config`（用户设置写入的层）。

> 命名空间 = **profile entry id**：dsh-settings 以 `cordis.patch.yml` 中该行的 `id` 为 key，
> 因此 `dsh-clock` 既是设置命名空间，也是 `cordis.patch.yml` 里那一行的 `id`；
> 浏览器半用同一个 key 走 `ctx.configForms.get('dsh-clock')`。

## 实现

| 部分 | 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 浏览器半 | `src/client/index.jsx` → `lib/client.js` | Clock 组件（dock 槽位）+ 设置行（settings.general.item） |
| 设置策略 | `src/client/clock-policy.js` | ClockPolicy：configForms 读写、clamp、host 采纳、dispose |
| 设置行组件 | `src/client/ClockSettingsRow.jsx` | 设置 → 通用 里的可视化配置行 |
| 共享设置定义 | `src/client/clock-settings.js` | 命名空间、字段键、默认值（纯数据） |
| 格式化 | `src/client/clock-core.js` | 日期/时间本地化格式化（纯函数） |
| 样式 | `src/client/styles.js` + `*.css` | `--dsw-*` token，`data-plugin-css` 协议注入 |
| 宿主半 | `src/index.ts` → `lib/index.js` | volatile `Config` + `settings.configure({ auto: false })` |
| 构建 | `build.mjs` | esbuild 双半构建（baseline external） |
| 测试 | `test/*.spec.mjs` | 浏览器注册/策略/格式 + 宿主 schema/注册 + 主题 token 校验（14 项） |

### 规范符合性（对照 `packages/client/AGENTS.md`）

- **Slot 纪律**：dock 槽位 + `settings.general.item` 槽位，组件经标准 props shares + inject 面拿数据，组件不见 `ctx`。
- **本地化**：文案全部走 `zh`/`en` 字典 + `t` seat（含设置面文案），无硬编码产品文案。
- **样式**：CSS 语义类 + `--dsw-*` token，无内联样式/无字面色值；`data-plugin-css` 幂等注入（HMR claimStyles 协议）。
- **导出纪律**：浏览器半只导出 `apply`/`inject`；宿主半导出 `name`/`Config`/`SETTINGS_NAMESPACE`/`apply`。
- **可视化设置**：官方 settings 命名空间 = profile entry id；宿主导出 `.volatile()` `Config` 并经
  `settings.configure({ auto: false })` 发布（自绘设置行，不自动生成页面），浏览器半经
  `ctx.configForms.get('dsh-clock')` 读写（与 `dsh-client-locale`、`dsh-client-ui-conversation` 同款范式）。
- **inject 纪律**：`inject` 只声明运行时**真实存在**的服务（`slots` / `locale` / `configForms`）。
  cordis fiber 会一直 pending 在一个不存在的服务上，而 web boot 审计会把 pending 当作启动失败、
  直接让整个 Web 页面引导失败——`settingsScope` 正是这个坑（DSH 里没有这个服务）。
- **依赖声明**：peerDependencies 只声明实际使用；浏览器 baseline 模块（`dsh-client-store` 等）external 由模块表提供。
- **容错**：浏览器半 apply 全程 try/catch；host 半嵌套 inject，无 settings provider 也照常激活。

## 开发

```sh
pnpm install          # autoInstallPeers=false
pnpm build            # 生成 lib/client.js + lib/index.js
pnpm test             # 构建 + 33 项测试
```

## 安装

**装成依赖还不够**：插件半必须在 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里才会加载
（bundle 列表决定 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的 `insert` 是否生效）。

- **桌面端（Desktop）**：走 **设置 → 插件**（插件市场）安装/启用；`desktop` profile 由 Electron 应用独占管理，
  命令行 `dsh --profile desktop` 会被拒绝。
- **其他 profile**：

从 GitHub 安装（推荐，全路径）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:DeepCodec/dsh-clock
```

或指定 GitHub 仓库完整地址：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add https://github.com/DeepCodec/dsh-clock.git
```

本地开发调试（检出到本机后的绝对路径）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add /path/to/dsh-clock
```

发布到 npm 后（直接按包名安装）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add @deepcodec/dsh-clock
```

（或手动 `cd ~/.dsh/profiles/<name> && pnpm add @deepcodec/dsh-clock`，
并在 `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里追加 `@deepcodec/dsh-clock`。）
重启 DSH Desktop 生效。

## 卸载

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> remove dsh-clock
```

plugins.description: HTTP MCP bridge for Codex to create and continue visible sessions in DeepSeek Harness Web
plugins.readme_text:
# Codex DSH Bridge

让 Codex 通过 MCP 在正在运行的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web 中创建任务、继续已有会话、查询进度和获取结果。会话由同一个 DSH Host 管理，可在 DSH Web 中查看。

正式版本：`0.1.0`。通过 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/journ10/codex-dsh-bridge/releases) 分发，可直接安装 GitHub tag 或下载的 tarball；当前不发布 npm。

```text
Codex ── HTTP MCP + bearer token ──▶ DSH Web 中的插件
                                      └─ sessionController → DSH 会话
                                                               └─ Web 显示
```

## 开发

主插件仅使用 Node 内置模块和仓库内 JavaScript 文件，无第三方运行依赖，无编译步骤。

```sh
npm test
npm run test:legacy
npm run test:package
npm pack --dry-run --ignore-scripts
```

`npm test` 使用模拟 DSH 服务和临时 HTTP 端口；`test:legacy` 使用 stub 子进程。两者不会提交真实模型任务。Node 要求为 `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`；DSH peer 固定为 `0.2.1-alpha.2`，其他 DSH 版本需要重新验证。peer 标为 optional 是为了让安装复用已有 DSH，不自动下载第二份 Host。

## 安装发布版本

前提：已有 DSH `0.2.1-alpha.2`、支持的 Node 和 pnpm，Web profile 可正常启动。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:journ10/codex-dsh-bridge#v0.1.0
```

也可从 [v0.1.0 Release](https://github.com/journ10/codex-dsh-bridge/releases/tag/v0.1.0) 下载 `codex-dsh-bridge-0.1.0.tgz` 和 `SHA256SUMS`，在下载目录校验并安装：

```sh
shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS
dsh plugin --profile web add ./codex-dsh-bridge-0.1.0.tgz
```

安装完成后重启 DSH Web。包直接分发 JavaScript，不运行 `prepare` 或其他安装构建脚本。

## 安装本地开发版本

前提：已经安装 DSH 和 pnpm，并且 Web profile 能正常启动、模型与权限配置可用。建议先使用隔离的 `DSH_HOME` 验证你的配置。

在本仓库根目录执行：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add "$PWD"
```

如果使用 DSH 源码 checkout，从该 checkout 调用 `pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/codex-dsh-bridge`。安装后用你原来的方式重启 DSH Web；插件不会负责启动第二个 DSH。

默认端点示例：

```sh
curl --fail 'http://127.0.0.1:3080/codex-dsh?probe=tools'
```

此探针无需令牌，只返回服务标识和工具名称。地址、端口取决于你的 DSH Web 配置；探针成功不代表任务执行成功。

## 连接 Codex

将 [配置示例](examples/codex.config.toml) 中的 MCP 段合并到自己的 Codex 配置，保留其他已有设置，并在新会话中验证工具加载。

```toml
[mcp_servers.dsh]
url = "http://127.0.0.1:3080/codex-dsh"
bearer_token_env_var = "DSH_BRIDGE_TOKEN"
tool_timeout_sec = 3600
```

`DSH_BRIDGE_TOKEN` 必须在启动 Codex 的进程环境中可见。桥默认从 `$DSH_HOME/codex-dsh-bridge.token` 读取令牌；未设置 `DSH_HOME` 时目录为 `~/.dsh`，首次加载会以排他创建方式生成令牌。已有文件必须非空且为普通文件；POSIX 权限不能向组或其他用户开放（可用 `chmod 600` 修复）。读取或权限错误会阻止插件加载，避免覆盖已有令牌。令牌仅在用户机器上配置，不写进本仓库。

对于不继承终端环境的桌面进程，可以在个人 Codex 配置中使用 `[mcp_servers.dsh.http_headers]` 下的 `Authorization = "Bearer <本机令牌>"`，并移除 `bearer_token_env_var`。该凭据配置不应分享或加入版本控制。可用 `codex mcp get dsh` 检查配置是否被识别。

### 非交互 Codex 调用

`codex exec` 的退出码为 0 不代表 MCP 调用成功：在已验证的 Codex CLI `0.136.0` 中，如果工具需要审批而 `approval_policy = "never"`，调用会返回 `MCP tool call requires approval`，Codex 仍可能正常结束并报告失败。

交互使用时按提示批准工具。只有在你信任该 DSH 端点、并明确允许自动执行时，才在对应 MCP 配置段中加入：

```toml
[mcp_servers.dsh]
url = "http://127.0.0.1:3080/codex-dsh"
bearer_token_env_var = "DSH_BRIDGE_TOKEN"
tool_timeout_sec = 3600
required = true
default_tools_approval_mode = "approve"
```

这会预先允许该端点的工具调用，包括创建和继续 DSH 任务。自动化验证应使用独立 `CODEX_HOME`、隔离 DSH 和临时工作区；不要为测试修改正在使用的全局配置。使用 `codex exec --json` 保存事件，并检查真实 `mcp_tool_call` 结果。详见 [Codex 非交互模式](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/non-interactive-mode) 和 [MCP 配置](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/extend/mcp?surface=cli)。

本仓库尚未提供主方案的 Codex marketplace 安装包。`legacy/headless/codex-marketplace/` 是旧方案的参考文件，不能代替上述 Web MCP 配置。

## 工具

| 工具 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `dsh_workspaces` | 列出 DSH 已注册工作区，获取 `workspace_id` |
| `dsh_sessions` | 列出会话，可按工作区或目录过滤 |
| `dsh_task` | 在指定工作区或目录新建会话并发送 `prompt` |
| `dsh_send` | 给已有会话发送消息；`mode` 为 `queue` 或 `steer` |
| `dsh_wait` | 等待会话结果，传入异步提交返回的 `from_seq` 和 `request_id` |
| `dsh_status` | 查询当前状态、最近答案与工具调用 |

`dsh_task` 和 `dsh_send` 默认等待结果；`wait: false` 返回 `session_id`、`accepted`、`from_seq` 和 `request_id`，之后将 `session_id`、`from_seq`、`request_id` 一起传给 `dsh_wait`，按请求定位其回答；不传 `request_id` 时只查询区间的最近状态。等待结果包含 `turn_completed`、`stop_reason`、`answer`、`tool_calls` 和 `timed_out`；列表与状态工具返回各自的数据。超时结束等待，不等于停止 DSH 任务。客户端断连或插件卸载会取消等待并清理等待计时器，不保证中止已提交任务。`steer` 共享当前 turn，返回该 turn 的后续答案，并非独立消息的隔离执行。

新任务参数使用 `prompt`。旧 headless 方案的 `task`、`dsh_reply` 和文本尾标不适用于本方案。会话自身的文件权限、审批和模型配置由 DSH 管理。

## 插件配置

默认配置在 [cordis.patch.yml](cordis.patch.yml)。用户可在自己的 Web profile patch 中覆盖同一插件行，保留所需配置字段；DSH patch 会替换整段 `config`，不是深度合并。

| 字段 | 默认值 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `path` | `/codex-dsh` | MCP 路由，以 `/` 开头且不以 `/` 结尾 |
| `token` | 未指定 | 显式 bearer token；省略则读取 `tokenFile` |
| `tokenFile` | `$DSH_HOME/codex-dsh-bridge.token` | 本机令牌文件 |
| `allowedHosts` | `[]` | 除回环名称外额外允许的 HTTP Host 值 |
| `agentPreset` | DSH 默认 | 新建会话使用的 agent preset |
| `defaultTimeoutMs` | `600000` | 工具未指定超时时的等待时长 |

路由挂在 DSH Web server 上，位于 `/api` 浏览器鉴权路径之外，独立检查 Host 和 bearer token。Host 校验针对请求头，不是 TCP 来源地址限制；不要把它当作防火墙或远程部署方案。令牌持有者可以调用桥暴露的会话工具。

## 卸载

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove codex-dsh-bridge
```

重启 DSH Web，并移除个人 Codex 配置中的对应 MCP 段。是否保留令牌文件由用户决定；卸载不会删除 DSH 会话。

## 验证与限制

[完整验证记录与页面证据](https://github.com/journ10/codex-dsh-bridge/blob/v0.1.0/docs/validation-0.1.0.md)。

发布验证使用 macOS、Node `25.4.0`、pnpm `12.3.4`、DSH `0.2.1-alpha.2`（源码 commit `d743267388641bc76f17c45ce8b4c231aed1d32c`）。在隔离 `DSH_HOME` 和回环端口中，使用真实 DSH Web Host 与本地模拟模型端点，验证 profile 安装、MCP 握手和六工具、鉴权、会话创建、续聊、重启后读取及卸载。单元/HTTP 回归另覆盖排队结果归属、steer 转发、长冷会话、超时、卸载取消、输入校验和令牌保护。

正式版还通过真实 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash（`deepseek-flash`）和 Codex CLI `0.136.0`（`gpt-6-astra`）端到端测试：Codex 实际调用全部六个工具，DSH 读取随机测试文件、计算结果、继续同一会话并返回状态。Chrome 中已核对任务、答案、工具轨迹，完成 Web 续聊、刷新持久化及 MCP 读回。

- 验证范围为 Codex CLI 与 DSH Web；Codex Desktop 的配置发现与重载流程未单独验证。测试使用独立 home 和端口，未重启正在使用的 DSH。
- 面向 Web profile；未验证 Desktop、TUI 或 headless profile 安装。
- DSH 服务和事件仍在变化，因此使用精确 DSH peer；相同版本号的源码修改也可能影响兼容性。
- 配置由插件在加载时校验；尚未导出 DSH 配置表单使用的标准 `Config` schema，请使用 profile patch 配置。
- MCP 提供 JSON POST 响应和工具调用，没有服务器 SSE 推送；未声明完整协议一致性认证。
- 等待按请求区间查询；超长会话的查询成本随事件数量增长。`dsh_status` 默认仅折取末尾 200 个事件。
- `private: true` 保留以防意外 npm 发布，不影响 GitHub 或 tarball 安装。旧 headless 方案只在 `legacy/` 中保留，不进入安装包。

许可证沿用原插件的 MIT 声明，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: Read-only skill invocation monitor for DeepSeek Harness — which Agents are running, which Skill each is calling, status and elapsed time, live in the Web GUI sidebar. · 只读技能调用监控：侧边栏实时展示活动 Agent 正在调用的 Skill、状态与耗时。
plugins.readme_text:
dsh-skill-invocation-monitor

English | 简体中文

> A **read-only** [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) plugin that puts > every skill invocation on one screen: which Agents are running, which Skill each one is calling, > whether it is running / finished / failed, and how long it has been going — live, in the Web GUI sidebar. ![The Skill Monitor panel: two sessions, the first one running a skill the user invoked](docs/screenshot.png) *Captured from the running plugin: the sidebar entry opens a panel listing every Agent, and each row is one skill call with its status, elapsed time and start clock.* ## What changes after you install it Skill invocation in DSH is invisible. The model loads a skill, and you see the answer — not the call, not the timing, not the one that never came back. After installing this plugin: - the sidebar gains a **技能监控 / Skill Monitor** entry, with a live badge showing how many calls are running; - the panel lists every live Agent, and under each one every skill call with its **status** and **elapsed time**; - **both** ways a skill can be reached are covered and told apart — the model calling the `skill` tool, and **you** triggering a skill yourself, which carries a `用户触发` badge on its row; - nothing is written anywhere: no tool registered, no session state touched, no call intercepted or delayed. ## Install ```sh # from npm (recommended — prebuilt, so no build-script permission is needed) dsh plugin --profile web add @yyc-jnu/dsh-skill-invocation-monitor # or straight from GitHub (plain ESM JavaScript: no build step, so pnpm never asks for allowBuilds) dsh plugin --profile web add github:YYC-JNU/dsh-skill-invocation-monitor ``` Then **restart DSH and refresh the page**. Both halves — the host observers plus the read-only route, and the browser bundle — are scanned during host start-up, so no sidebar entry appears before that restart. Verify the layer before booting: ```sh dsh --profile web --dump-config # look for: # == @yyc-jnu/dsh-skill-invocation-monitor ``` If that layer is missing, the package installed as a plain dependency and the plugin never activated. Uninstall: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web remove @yyc-jnu/dsh-skill-invocation-monitor ``` ## Features | | | |---|---| | Live Agent list | Every live Agent, its session title, and whether it is running or idle | | Per-call rows | Skill name, status (`运行中` / `已完成` / `失败` / `未观测到结果`), elapsed time, start clock | | Both invocation paths | The model's `skill` tool call, and a human triggering a skill — marked `用户触发` | | Ticking durations | The elapsed time updates every second while a call is running | | Sidebar badge | The running-call count sits on the sidebar entry, so you can see activity without opening the panel | | Honest failures | A failed call shows a truncated reason, e.g. `skill "…" is unknown or no longer available` | | Self-check diagnostics | Every response carries counters describing what the plugin observed, so a wrong assumption is visible rather than silent | | Zero dependencies | Neither half imports a third-party package (the browser half uses only `react` from the host module table) | ## Permissions and data This plugin exists to observe, and its whole design is built around not participating. | | | |---|---| | Observes (read-only) | Five Cordis events: `tools/pre-execute`, `tools/result`, `session/event`, `agent/status`, `agent/disposed` | | Reads | The live Agent list, session titles, and the durable session-event feed as it is appended | | Does **not** write | No session state, no session log, nothing on disk, no config, no tool, no command | | Does **not** interfere | The `tools/pre-execute` listener returns `next()` unchanged and never denies, cancels, rewrites or delays a call; every observer is wrapped so a bug in this plugin cannot break a dispatch | | HTTP surface | Exactly one route, `GET /api/plugins/skill-monitor/state` — no body, no mutation, `cache-control: no-store` | | Network exposure | Loopback only: a non-loopback peer, a cross-site fetch marker or a foreign `Origin` gets `403`; any non-GET method gets `405` | | Where the data lives | One `Map` in host memory. Records are capped (200 by default) and expire (10 minutes after they settle); restarting DSH clears everything | | Not collected | Prompt text, model output, file contents, credentials, or anything else the plugin never reads | ## Compatibility | | | |---|---| | DSH | Verified against **0.2.0-rc.2** (the build this plugin was developed and tested on). The seams it uses are documented core surfaces, so other 0.2.x builds are expected to work | | Node.js | Declared `>=20`. The plugin runs inside the DSH host, so the host's own Node requirement is what matters | | Surface | Web GUI (`dsh.client.platform: "web"`). Uses only official Slots — `sidebar.panellist` for the entry and `main` for the panel — never DOM injection | | Skill paths | Uses the durable contracts for both paths: tool calls on `tools/pre-execute` / `tools/result`, and human invocations through the `skill-invocation` message source declared by the skills seam | ## How it works
The two invocation paths — and why the human one is read from a message source A skill can be reached two structurally different ways in DSH, and the plugin observes both. | | Model path | User path | |---|---|---| | Trigger | The model calls the `skill` tool | You invoke a skill (e.g. `/grill-me`) | | What DSH does | Runs the tool pipeline and produces a tool result | Appends the skill's instructions to the conversation as a `user/message` — **no tool call and no command event** | | Pairing key | `callId` | the message `id` | | Duration measured | `tools/result` − `pre-execute` | `turn/end` − injection (see the note below) | | Row marker | none | `用户触发` | The human path is read from the structured source the skills seam itself attaches (`SkillInvocationSource`, in the persistence catalog): ```json { "type": "user/message", "data": { "source": { "kind": "skill-invocation", "name": "grill-me", "form": "instructions" }, "role": "user", "id": "7c2e0f5a-3b9d-4e18-9a6c-1d2f3a4b5c6d" } } ``` The name comes straight from `source.name`, so no skill-catalog lookup and no text parsing is involved. That is a measured result, not a guess: an earlier implementation assumed the human path went through `command/run` / `command/done`, and a real session log disproved it — a human-invoked skill produces no command event at all, which removed an entire catalog cache and its 60-second TTL. **One deliberate choice:** a human skill has no result event of its own, so its duration is the *turn window* (injection until `turn/end`), not the skill's own execution time. That is a stated convention, not a measurement — if you would rather see an instantaneous event with a duration of 0, only the settling point changes.
Status semantics | Status | Meaning | |---|---| | `运行中` | A start was observed (a pre-execute or a skill message) and no ending event has arrived; the duration grows live | | `已完成` | The tool reported `isError === false`, or the turn that carried the skill ended normally | | `失败` | The tool reported `isError === true`; the row shows a truncated reason | | `未观测到结果` | No ending event arrived within 15 minutes (the call was denied before dispatch, its parent was cancelled, the host crashed). This is a *derived* status and is never written back into the record |

plugins.description: 将本机 qoderclicn CLI 的登录态包装成 OpenAI 兼容 Provider 接入 DeepSeek Harness — bring your local Qoder CLI login into DeepSeek Harness as a model provider.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Qoder Connect

[English](./README.en.md) | 中文

把**本机 `qoderclicn` CLI 的登录态**包装成一个 OpenAI 兼容 Provider 接入 DeepSeek Harness：安装并登录过 Qoder 后，Qoder 的模型直接出现在 DSH 的模型选择器里，零额外配置。

反代核心移植自 [1416277987/proxy-hub](https://github.com/1416277987/proxy-hub) 的 `adapters/qoder.js`；插件结构参照 [corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect](https://github.com/corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect)（MIT）。

## 功能

- **开箱即用**：插件复用 `qoderclicn login` 落盘的登录态，不另起 OAuth 流程；没有上游 HTTP 请求——本机 CLI 就是上游。
- **模型分组**：Qoder 模型以「Qoder」分组出现在模型选择器中；未安装 CLI 或未登录时分组自动隐藏，登录后（无需重启 DSH）自动出现。
- **模型列表**：启动时跑一次 `qoderclicn --list-models`，之后只在设置卡片上点「重新拉取模型」时再拉，所以 **Qoder 新增模型无需更新插件就能出现在选择器里**；拉取失败则保留现有列表（上次成功结果已落盘），不会让整个分组消失，卡片上会标明当前列表来自 CLI、上次保存还是内置兜底。就绪状态由假变真时分组会**显示**出来，此时用的是上次保存的列表，点一下刷新即可换成账号的真实列表。
- **登录态自动探测**：三种布局都认——`~/.qoderworkcn/.auth-cn/user`（proxy-hub 文档布局）、`~/.qoder-cn/.auth/user`（Qoder CN CLI，实测）、`~/.qoder/.auth/user`（国际版 qodercli）；也支持环境变量 `QODERCN_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN`。
- **CLI 不在 PATH 也能用**：按 PATH → 默认安装目录（`~/.qoder-cn/bin/qoderclicn`、`~/.qoder/bin/qodercli`）顺序解析，Windows `.cmd` shim 走 shell 正确启动。
- **图片输入**：官方目录标了 `is_vl` 的模型，在选择器里声明图片能力；请求里的图片以 `--attachment` 交给 CLI，**不经过任何上游 HTTP**。只支持 data URL（DSH 附件管道给的正是这个形态），远程图片地址会被跳过而不是发起请求。
- **上下文窗口一键切换**：设置卡片提供「使用上游声明的最大窗口」开关。开启后按各模型声明的最大窗口请求（如 1M），关闭则用官方客户端默认的窗口（通常 200K）。数值**只取自官方目录声明的档位**——CLI 对 `--context-window` 不校验，凭空给一个数没有意义。
- **模型开关**：设置卡片的「模型开关」区可逐个关闭不想用的模型，关闭的即从模型选择器隐藏；带即时搜索框与「全部开启 / 全部关闭」。列表覆盖全部模型（含已关闭的），所以关掉的模型随时能开回来。
- **设置卡片**：设置 → 插件 → Qoder 卡片展示 CLI 路径、登录方式、登录态文件与可用模型，未就绪时给出修复提示。
- **模型选择器里选推理档位**：Qoder 模型在 DSH 模型选择器中带「推理等级」选项（low / medium / high / xhigh / max），按模型生效、逐次请求下发，做法与 [dsh-workbuddy-connect](https://github.com/corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect) 一致——模型用 `thinkingLevelMap` 声明可用档位，DSH 把选中的档位作为 `reasoning_effort` 放进请求体，插件再翻成 CLI 的 `--reasoning-effort`。
- **模型选择器里显示官方系数与逐模型档位**：读取官方客户端缓存的加密模型目录（QMC v1），把官方 `price_factor`（含错峰促销）与**该模型真正接受的推理档位**带进选择器。详见下文「官方目录」。
- **设置卡片里可改全局默认**：设置卡片另有三项全局覆盖——推理等级（`--reasoning-effort`）、思考模式（`--thinking`）和思考预算（`--thinking-budget`）。**逐次请求的档位优先于全局设置**；全局项留空则不下发该参数、完全跟随 CLI 默认。
- **流式 / 非流式**：`/v1/chat/completions` 两种形态都支持；客户端断开或超时（默认 600s，`QODER_TIMEOUT_MS` 可调）会终止 CLI 子进程。
- **用量账本**：每次对话结束后，把 CLI 自报的 `total_credits`（stream-json `result` 记录——Qoder 唯一的真实计费来源）落盘成 `$DSH_HOME/qoder-credits/ledger.jsonl` 的一行；配合 `dsh-qoder-credits` 悬浮窗查看消耗趋势、日均与预估。账本写入是尽力而为的簿记，失败只丢一个数据点，不影响对话本身。

## 推理档位

档位值即 `--reasoning-effort` 的值，逐次请求下发——换档位不需要重启，也不影响其他会话。

| 选择器操作 | 下发 |
|---|---|
| 不选（默认） | 不下发该参数，跟随 CLI 自身默认 |
| 任一档位 | `--reasoning-effort <同名值>` |

**每个模型只显示它真正接受的档位**，取自官方目录（详见「官方目录」一节）：同名字段映射，但集合逐模型不同，且有些模型（Qwen3.7 系列、Auto、MiniMax）只有开/关、不显示档位控件。

CLI 另外还接受 `auto`、`none`、`ultracode`，但它们在 DSH 的档位刻度上没有对应位置：`auto` 就是「让 CLI 自己决定」，而不下发参数已经表达了这一点；`none`（关闭思考）会被 pi-ai 当作「每个未显式选档位的请求都发一次」的 `off` 值，写进档位表就会**默认关闭思考**。需要时用设置卡片里的全局项指定。

**⚠️ 全局设置会绕过逐模型校验**：设置卡片的「推理等级」是全局兜底，它能填 `auto` / `ultracode` 等选择器没有的值，且**会原样下发、不经该模型的档位表校验**。填了模型不支持的档位时，上游会**静默忽略并回落默认档**（不报错）。要精确控制请用模型选择器。

**档位生效的验证方式**：同一个模型同一句提示，`none` 档无 thinking 块、`max` 档产生 thinking 块且耗时更长（实测 1553ms → 2422ms）。这一点特意验过——WorkBuddy 那边实测发现「有些模型接受 `reasoning_effort` 却忽略未知值并回退到默认」，所以「请求成功」不等于「档位生效」。**这也正是逐模型档位必须来自官方目录的原因**：无法从"请求成功"反推某个档位有效。

## 模型

模型列表**运行时来自 `qoderclicn --list-models`**，所以 Qoder 新增的模型会自动出现。下面是 CLI 1.1.59 的内置兜底快照（拉取不到时使用）；DSH 里的模型 id 为 `qoder-` + 小写化的 CLI 名，显示名用 CLI 自己的拼写：

| DSH 模型 id | CLI `--model` |
|---|---|
| `qoder-auto` | `Auto` |
| `qoder-qwen3.8-max` | `Qwen3.8-Max` |
| `qoder-qwen3.8-flash` | `Qwen3.8-Flash` |
| `qoder-qwen3.7-max` | `Qwen3.7-Max` |
| `qoder-qwen3.7-plus` | `Qwen3.7-Plus` |
| `qoder-qwen3.7-flash` | `Qwen3.7-Flash` |
| `qoder-deepseek-v4-pro` | `DeepSeek-V4-Pro` |
| `qoder-deepseek-flash` | `DeepSeek-Flash` |
| `qoder-glm-5.3` | `GLM-5.3` |
| `qoder-glm-5.3-flash` | `GLM-5.3-Flash` |
| `qoder-glm-5.2` | `GLM-5.2` |
| `qoder-kimi-k3` | `Kimi-K3` |
| `qoder-kimi-k2.8-preview` | `Kimi-K2.8-Preview` |
| `qoder-minimax-m2.7` | `MiniMax-M2.7` |

id 的生成规则是 `qoder-` + CLI 名小写化，内置表 14 个全部符合，且实测 `--list-models` 拉到的 id 与内置表**逐字一致**——所以列表来源切换（CLI ↔ 兜底）不会让已有账本里的模型 id 失效。

**关于「短暂出现的模型」**：实测见过 CLI 把 `Fast` 列进 `--list-models`、随后又撤下（此时 `--model Fast` 会回退到 `auto`）。因此内置兜底只固化**稳定**的模型，短命条目不会被冻结在代码里、活得比 CLI 自己的提供期还长——它该由运行时拉取决定。

## 官方目录：系数、逐模型档位、上下文窗口

模型选择器里显示成 `Qwen3.8-Max · x0.2 · 错峰 4 折`、`Kimi-K3 · x1.4`、`Qwen3.8-Flash · x0 · 限时免费`。这些**全部来自 Qoder 官方目录**，插件不猜、不实测。

### 数据从哪来

官方桌面端/CLI 会把完整模型目录缓存在 `<home>/.models/<uid>/catalog-v6`，但它是 **QMC v1 加密容器**（不是 JSON），所以早期版本以为"没有可读的价目数据"。实际有公开的确定性解封装：

```
envelope = base64("QMC\x01" + nonce[12] + ciphertext || tag)
key      = HKDF-SHA256(ikm = uid, salt = "qoder-model-cache-enc", info = "model-cache-v1", 32)
cipher   = AES-256-GCM
```

`uid` 就在同目录的 `default` 文件里（明文 JSON）。**Node 内置 `crypto` 全覆盖**，零第三方依赖、零网络请求。AES-GCM 的 tag 让"uid 不对"变成可检测的失败，而不是解出乱码。

解密后取 `chat` 场景的模型，逐字段读出：

| 字段 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `price_factor` | **抵扣系数**（官方声明值，非实测） |
| `promotion` | 错峰折扣与时段（如 `0.4` + `22:00-08:00`） |
| `is_free` / `original_price_factor` | 「限时免费」标注 |
| `thinking_config.enabled.efforts` | **该模型真正接受的推理档位** |
| `context_config` / `max_input_tokens` | 上下文窗口 |

### 为什么逐模型档位是必须的

这是修掉的一个**静默 bug**。上游对不在该模型档位表内的 `reasoning_effort` **不报错、直接忽略、回落到默认档**——实测：`DeepSeek-Flash` 传官方表外的 `medium` 返回 HTTP 200 无错误；传完全非法的 `bogus` 才致命拒绝。

所以早期"给所有模型声明 low/medium/high/xhigh/max"会让选择器接受一个**实际不生效**的档位。现在按官方目录逐模型声明：

| 模型 | 官方档位 |
|---|---|
| Qwen3.8-Max / Qwen3.8-Flash | `low` / `medium` / `xhigh` |
| DeepSeek-Flash / GLM-5.3 / Kimi-K3 / Kimi-K2.8-Preview | `low` / `high` / `max` |
| DeepSeek-V4-Pro / GLM-5.3-Flash / GLM-5.2 | `high` / `max` |
| Qwen3.7-Max / Qwen3.7-Plus / Qwen3.7-Flash / Auto / MiniMax-M2.7 | 无档位（仅开/关），**不显示档位控件** |

档位与 `--reasoning-effort` 同名，所以声明的值就是上线值。

### 曾经走过的弯路（保留作为记录）

在发现这个容器之前，插件曾用**本机账本实测**反推系数（`credits` 均值之比，基准取调用最多的模型）。那套东西**已删除**，因为它不只是覆盖率低，**数值本身就是错的**：

- 覆盖：14 个模型只有 2 个能出数字（其余没调用过、样本不足、或计 0 积分无法做除数）
- 精度：同样 31 字符的两次 `Qwen3.7-Max` 调用计 7.43 与 0.61 积分（**差 12 倍**）——真实消耗主要由输出长度和思考深度决定，而 CLI 的 usage 里这两个字段恒为 0

对照官方值更能看出偏差有多大：`DeepSeek-Flash ÷ Qwen3.7-Max` 官方是 `0.1/0.5 = 0.20`，实测反推得到 **0.0082**，**偏了约 24 倍**。

**教训**：拿不到声明值时的"实测替代"如果混入了未受控变量，得到的不是近似值而是错值；宁可先不显示。

### 读不到时会怎样

`catalog-v6` 不存在、格式变化、解密失败、`chat` 场景为空——全部返回 `null`，此时：

- 模型**照常服务**，名称退回纯 CLI 拼写
- **不声明任何推理档位**（而不是声明一套可能无效的）
- 上下文窗口退回保守默认 `262144`

即"少显示"而不是"显示错的"。目录文件由官方客户端自己刷新，插件只在**启动时**和**设置卡片点「重新拉取模型」**时读一次，没有定时轮询——轮询也只会重复读到客户端已经决定发布的同一个快照。

## 安装

前置：已安装 Qoder 并至少执行过一次 `qoderclicn login`（或设置 `QODERCN_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN`）。

```sh
# 从 GitHub 安装（推荐）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:chilianxiao/dsh-qoder-connect
dsh web
```

或从本地源码安装（link: 指向插件目录）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add link:D:/dsh_web/plugins/qoder-connect
```

> **注意**：npm 上另有一个同名的 `dsh-qoder-connect` 包（作者 masknull），那是基于 PAT 的另一套实现，与本仓库无关。本插件的仓库是 [chilianxiao/dsh-qoder-connect](https://github.com/chilianxiao/dsh-qoder-connect)，请勿用 `npm add dsh-qoder-connect` 安装本插件。

安装后把 `dsh-qoder-connect` 加入 profile `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 列表（`dsh plugin add` 只负责 pnpm 装包，bundles 列表需手动维护），然后启动/重启对应界面。

版本对应：插件按 DSH `0.1.6-alpha.2` 起的接口编写（`dsh-llm-pi-ai` 的 profile 字段、`plugins.item` 客户端插槽）；设置卡片依赖 DSH 0.1.7 起的 settings API（`configure` + volatile 字段），在 0.1.6 上卡片仍会渲染但保存会失败。更早的 DSH 核心未经验证。

## 配置

| 配置 | 默认 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|
| `QODERCN_CLI` | `qoderclicn` | CLI 命令名或完整路径 |
| `QODERCN_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN` | 空 | 仅在没有落盘登录态时使用 |
| `QODER_TIMEOUT_MS` | `600000` | 单次请求的 CLI 总超时（ms） |
| `DSH_QODER_POLL_MS` | `30000` | 就绪状态轮询间隔（测试/排查用） |
| 设置项 `cli` | 空 | 在设置卡片同页编辑 CLI 路径，覆盖环境变量 |
| 设置项 `reasoningEffort` | 空 | `--reasoning-effort`，可选 `auto` / `none` / `low` / `medium` / `high` / `xhigh` / `max` / `ultracode` |
| 设置项 `thinking` | 空 | `--thinking`，可选 `auto` / `adaptive` / `enabled` / `disabled` |
| 设置项 `thinkingBudget` | 空 | `--thinking-budget` 固定思考 token 数（CLI 侧隐含开启 thinking），0–1000000 |
| 设置项 `contextWindowMax` | `false` | 按官方目录声明的最大上下文窗口请求（`--context-window`） |
| 设置项 `hiddenModels` | `[]` | 要从模型选择器隐藏的模型 id 列表 |

推理三项都在设置卡片的「推理设置」区编辑，写入插件自己的 `llm-qoder` 设置命名空间因而持久化；留空表示不下发该参数，跟随 CLI 自身默认。它们是**全局兜底**：模型选择器里选的档位优先于 `reasoningEffort`。取值按 CLI 1.1.59 实测的可选列表校验——**非法值会被 CLI 直接判为致命错误并终止本次请求**（`Invalid reasoning effort: ...`），所以写入前在插件侧就拒掉。

plugins.readme_text:
# acryl-quick-notes

A Cordis plugin for ACRYL and DeepSeek Harness: a small notebook icon in the top bar opens a Quick Notes list. Each note is saved as its own `.txt` file in the plugin's data folder on the host, so Web and Desktop share the same notes.

- Host half: `index.js` (stores the notes behind authenticated RPC routes under `/api`).
- Client half: `client.js` (the top bar button and the notes list).
- Permissions: `fs.write` (its own plugin data only), `ui`.

## Needs

The app it is loaded into must provide these Cordis services (each comes from a plugin of that app; they are listed in `package.json` as `acryl.requires`, generated from the code):

- Host: `connection`, `dshHomePath`.
- Client: `connection`, `slots`.

ACRYL and stock DeepSeek Harness (Web and Desktop) provide all of them; since 0.3.0 it runs in both (0.2.x needed ACRYL: its RPC channel relied on a `webServer` declaration stock DSH does not make). In an app without one of the services it waits and stays inactive; it never guesses a folder.

## Install

- ACRYL: type `/plugin pull github:inboxxobni/acryl-quick-notes` in a chat, or run `acryl plugin pull github:inboxxobni/acryl-quick-notes`, or paste `github:inboxxobni/acryl-quick-notes` into the Plugins page's "Add plugin" box. Each installs the latest release, checked by its sha512.
- Stock DeepSeek Harness: paste the `.tgz` URL of the latest release into the Plugins page's "Add plugin" box, or run `dsh plugin --profile web add <that URL>`.

## Discovery

This repository carries the GitHub topics `acryl-package`, `cordis-plugin` and `dsh-plugin`, and `package.json` carries the same keywords. Catalogs that index those topics list it without a submission step.

## License

MIT
