---

## 它解决什么问题

DSH 的 web GUI **没有任何认证**，而本机默认权限常常是 `danger-full-access`。把这个 GUI 暴露到公网 = 把整台机器的控制权挂出去：任何人打开那个地址就能执行任意命令、读写任意文件。

但「在外边看看任务跑到哪了 / 在手机上回一句话」只需要**一组固定的窄接口**。所以这里换了个做法：**不动 GUI，另开一个端口**，在那个端口上按白名单重发：

| 类别 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 读 | `/taskwatch`（页面）、`/taskwatch/data`（全部状态）、`/taskwatch/session`（单会话对话）、`/taskwatch/chat/*` 里的会话/模型/用量/工作区/标题/分页/交付文件 |
| 写（**4 条**，逐条在白名单里显式放行） | `/taskwatch/chat/send`、`/create`、`/cancel`、`/model`（另加附件上传 `/taskwatch/chat/upload`） |
| 中继自己的 | `/healthz`、`/taskwatch/pair*`、`/taskwatch/lan*`、`/taskwatch/entries`、`/taskwatch/ticket`、`/taskwatch/upstream-health` |

GUI 本体（`/api`、工具、文件、会话操作）**永远不出回环**；白名单之外的一切路径都是 404。

---

## 架构

**第一条路：公网 HTTPS（有域名、有服务器）**

```
  手机 (4G/5G/Wi-Fi)
    │  https://dsh.example.com/taskwatch?t=<一次性 ticket>
    ▼
  你的服务器  nginx（443，TLS 终点）
    │  proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:3099
    │  ▲ 反方向：nginx 主动连的这个端口，其实是 ssh 在那台服务器上开出来的本地监听
    ▼
  SSH 反向隧道：ssh -N -R 127.0.0.1:3099:127.0.0.1:3099 you@<server>
    │  （隧道是从你家这台电脑主动拨出去的，所以家里不需要公网 IP，也不用做端口映射）
    ▼
  本机中继  node server.mjs   ← 只听 127.0.0.1:3099
    │  令牌鉴权（?k= / cookie / Bearer）→ 白名单路由
    ▼
  DSH 上游  http://127.0.0.1:3080   （DSH 的 web 服务；插件 dsh-in-hand 提供 /taskwatch/* 数据）
```

**第二条路：局域网直连（同一个 Wi-Fi，什么都不用搭）**

```
  手机  ──同一 Wi-Fi──►  本机中继  http://192.168.1.20:3099/taskwatch
                             │  同一套装置：6 位配对码 + 30 天 cookie，令牌一次都不用抄
                             ▼
                        DSH 上游  http://127.0.0.1:3080
```

两条路共用**同一份**中继、同一套鉴权。区别只在入口，以及 HTTPS 带来的安全上下文（PWA / service worker / 摄像头 / 剪贴板）。

---

## 方案一：局域网直连（不需要域名，同一个 Wi-Fi 内用）

> 这条路**什么都不用申请**：不买域名、不租服务器、不动路由器。手机和电脑连同一个 Wi-Fi，直接访问中继。

### 0. 前置

- **Node ≥ 18**（`node --version`）。中继零依赖，不用 `npm install`。
- 电脑上跑着 **DSH 的 web 服务**，默认地址 `http://127.0.0.1:3080`（这是 `dsh web` 常见的监听端口；不是的话见下）。
- 手机上装了 **[dsh-in-hand](https://github.com/dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-in-hand) 插件**（提供 `/taskwatch/*` 数据接口）—— 没有它中继照样能起，只是取不到数据，页面会告诉你上游不可达。
- 手机和电脑连**同一个 Wi-Fi**。

装插件（在 DSH 里）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-in-hand
# 装完要重启 dsh web：插件行来自 profile 的 bundle 图
```

### 1. 确认 DSH 上游端口，必要时改掉

默认上游是 `http://127.0.0.1:3080`。如果你的 DSH 监听别处：

```powershell
# 永久改：写进同目录 .env（.gitignore 已排除）
"RELAY_UPSTREAM=http://127.0.0.1:3123" | Out-File -Encoding ascii .env
# 或临时改：
$env:RELAY_UPSTREAM='http://127.0.0.1:3123'
```

### 2. 第一次运行：令牌自己生成

```powershell
cd <这个仓库的目录>            # 例：D:\tools\dsh-in-hand-relay
node server.mjs
```

第一次运行会在同目录生成 `.token`（**256 位随机值**，权限 0600），并把它连同登录地址一起打印出来：

```
dsh-in-hand-relay 已启动
  监听      http://127.0.0.1:3099
  上游      http://127.0.0.1:3080
  访问地址  http://127.0.0.1:3099/taskwatch?k=<你的令牌>
  令牌文件  <这个仓库的目录>\.token
  令牌来源  <这个仓库的目录>\.token（本次新建）

  ⚠ 首次运行：已自动生成一个 256 位随机令牌并写进上面那个文件（权限 0600）。
    在这台电脑上打开下面这个地址即可登录，登录后浏览器记 30 天：
      http://127.0.0.1:3099/taskwatch?k=<你的令牌>
    换令牌 = 删掉 .token 再重启；也可以直接用 RELAY_TOKEN 环境变量覆盖。
```

把那个 `?k=` 地址在**这台电脑**的浏览器里打开一次：令牌会被换成 `HttpOnly` cookie，地址栏里的 `k` 随即被 302 去掉（免得留在历史记录/Referer 里）。也可以完全不用令牌，直接在电脑上打开 `http://127.0.0.1:3099/` —— 它会把你送到配对页。

> `?k=` 这条路适合脚本（`curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"` 也一样）。手机日常用下面的配对码。

### 3. 开局域网模式

默认只监听 `127.0.0.1`（连局域网都到不了）。开局域网模式有两种等价方式：

```powershell
# 方式 A：本项目带的脚本（自提权，顺手加防火墙规则、重启中继、探测一遍）
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\lan.ps1 on
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\lan.ps1 status
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\lan.ps1 off
```

```powershell
# 方式 B：手动，等价于 A 的核心
New-Item -ItemType File .lan          # 建标记文件
# 然后重启中继；防火墙需要放行 3099（私有网络）
```

或者用环境变量：`$env:RELAY_LAN='1'`。

开关的含义：**存在 `.lan` 标记文件（或 `RELAY_LAN=1`）就绑 `0.0.0.0`，否则只绑 `127.0.0.1`**。它只是「谁能连到这个端口」，不改变任何鉴权逻辑。

中继启动时会把手机入口直接打出来：

```
  局域网模式 已开启（标记文件 <这个仓库的目录>\.lan）
    手机入口  http://192.168.1.20:3099/taskwatch
    配对码页  http://127.0.0.1:3099/taskwatch/pair
    说明页    http://127.0.0.1:3099/taskwatch/lan
```

也可以用浏览器看说明页：`http://127.0.0.1:3099/taskwatch/lan`（或 JSON 版 `/taskwatch/lan.json`）。

### 4. 手机配对：6 位码从哪来

1. 在**这台电脑**上打开 `http://127.0.0.1:3099/taskwatch/pair`。页面上会出现一个 **6 位码**，带倒计时。
2. 手机上打开 `http://192.168.1.20:3099/taskwatch`（把你的实际局域网 IP 换掉），会跳到配对页。
3. 输入那 6 位码 → 换到一个 **30 天、会滑动续期**的 cookie。之后 30 天不用再输。
4. 手机浏览器「添加到主屏幕」即可当 App 用（**只有 HTTPS 那条路能装**，见[已知限制](#已知限制)）。

关于这个码的边界（都是故意的）：

- **只有从 `127.0.0.1` 直连才生成/显示码**。判断依据不是 `remoteAddress`（经隧道进来的公网请求看着也是 `127.0.0.1`），而是**有没有代理头**（`X-Forwarded-For` / `X-Real-IP` / `Forwarded`）。见到代理头就一律不算本机 —— 失败即关闭。
- 2 分钟有效、最多试 5 次、用掉或过期立刻作废、同时只有一个码。
- 单个来源连续失败 20 次封 10 分钟。
- 猜中概率 5/1000000 量级，而且**不能离线爆破**（每次尝试都要打公网）。

---

## 方案二：公网访问（需要域名 + 一台有公网 IP 的服务器）

> 这条路让你在**任何网络**下都能用手机连回这台电脑：一台有公网 IP 的服务器负责终止 HTTPS，你本机主动建立 **SSH 反向隧道**把端口搬上去 —— 所以你自己这台电脑**不需要公网 IP、不需要端口映射、不需要动路由器**。

目标：出门在外用 4G 也能打开 `https://dsh.example.com/taskwatch`。前提是你**有一台有公网 IP 的服务器**和一个域名（下面用占位符 `dsh.example.com` / `<server-ip>` / `192.168.1.20`，全部替换成你自己的）。

### 1. DNS

| 类型 | 主机记录 | 记录值 |
|---|---|---|
| A | `dsh` | `<server-ip>` |

### 2. 服务器上的 nginx

```nginx
# /etc/nginx/conf.d/dsh.conf
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name dsh.example.com;
    return 301 https://$host$request_uri;
}

server {
    listen 443 ssl;
    http2 on;
    server_name dsh.example.com;

    ssl_certificate     /etc/letsencrypt/live/dsh.example.com/fullchain.pem;
    ssl_certificate_key /etc/letsencrypt/live/dsh.example.com/privkey.pem;

    # 手机端是单页应用 + SSE，别让请求体太小
    client_max_body_size 32m;

    location / {
        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:3099;      # 这个端口由下面的 ssh -R 开出来
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Host              $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For   $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;   # 中继靠它区分"是不是本机"
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP         $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;

        # SSE / 流式对话必须关缓冲，否则"逐字输出"会变成"转圈到最后一起出来"
        proxy_buffering off;
        proxy_cache off;
        proxy_read_timeout 3600s;
        proxy_send_timeout 3600s;
    }
}
```

两个容易踩的点：

- **`X-Forwarded-For` 必须带上**。中继用它判断「这不是本机直连」，从而不在公网暴露配对码。
- **`proxy_buffering off` 必须带上**。中继已经发了 `x-accel-buffering: no`，但 nginx 的 `proxy_buffering` 是更硬的一层。

### 3. 从你自己电脑建立反向隧道

```sh
ssh -N \
    -o ExitOnForwardFailure=yes \
    -o ServerAliveInterval=30 -o ServerAliveCountMax=3 \
    -o TCPKeepAlive=yes \
    -R 127.0.0.1:3099:127.0.0

plugins.description: Give DeepSeek Harness its own persistent computer: a bundled microVM with shell, browser, live view and approval gates
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-computer **English** | [中文](#中文说明) Give [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) its own computer: a persistent Linux microVM with a browser, a live desktop view, and approval gates. No Docker required. ![dsh-computer demo](docs/demo.gif) *The agent runs commands and opens a page inside its own VM; the Computer panel in dsh shows its desktop live. (Recorded with a scripted model.)* - **Every agent command runs in the VM**, never on your machine. The session's workspace folder is shared into the VM at the same path. - **Its own browser** (`mcp__vm__browser_*` tools), with logins that persist across restarts. - **Live view inside dsh**: a monitor button in the session header opens a Computer tab in the right sidebar. Watch, click, type, or take over for a QR login or CAPTCHA. - **Audit log**: every command, VM tool call, approval and folder change is appended to `~/.dsh/dsh-computer-audit.jsonl`. - **Phone-friendly live view**: set `publicUrl` (e.g. via `tailscale serve`) and approval messages — including IM approval cards — link to it. - **Approval gates** for risky actions (`sudo`, `rm -rf`, `curl | sh`, `git push`, payment/login/delete clicks), with a link to the live view. - **Always there**: the VM keeps running after dsh quits and dsh reconnects to the same machine on next start. - **Lightweight**: a bundled [microsandbox](https://github.com/microsandbox/microsandbox) microVM (Hypervisor.framework on Apple silicon, WHP on Windows, KVM on Linux); Intel Macs fall back to Docker. ### Install (dsh desktop, macOS) ```bash osascript -e 'quit app "DeepSeek Harness"' "/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" \ plugin --profile desktop add github:Kevinwu901113/dsh-computer open -a "DeepSeek Harness" ``` The first start pulls the VM image (a few GB); agent commands queue until it is ready. Choose the **Computer** permission preset under the input box. Status: v0.5.0, verified on dsh desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 (macOS, Apple silicon). Want a Dots-style always-on agent on top of this (IM, schedules, budget caps)? See **[dsh-dot](https://github.com/Kevinwu901113/dsh-dot)**. Design notes and roadmap: [docs/DESIGN.md](docs/DESIGN.md) (Chinese). MIT licensed. --- ## 中文说明 给 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）一台自己的电脑：一台常驻的 Linux 微型虚拟机，带浏览器、实时桌面画面和审批闸门。不需要装 Docker。 - agent 的 bash 命令在虚拟机里执行，不碰你的系统。 - agent 的浏览器（`mcp__vm__browser_*` 工具）在虚拟机里，登录态长期保留。 - 你随时可以打开实时画面观看或接手操作（扫码、验证码）。 - 危险操作（`sudo`、`rm -rf`、`curl | sh`、`git push`，以及涉及支付、登录、删除的浏览器动作）先弹审批，审批信息附实时画面链接。 - 会话所在的工作区文件夹自动共享进虚拟机，路径不变。 - dsh 退出后虚拟机继续运行；下次启动自动连回同一台。 当前版本 0.5.0，在 dsh 桌面版 0.2.0-rc.2（macOS，Apple 芯片）上验证通过。 ## 一、要求 | 项目 | 要求 | |---|---| | 系统 | macOS（Apple 芯片）、Linux（有 `/dev/kvm`）、Windows（开启 Hypervisor Platform）。Intel Mac 自动改用 Docker | | 内存 | 虚拟机默认 4GB 上限，空闲约 0.5GB | | 磁盘 | 约 10GB 空闲（虚拟机镜像） | | 网络 | 首次启动要从 `ghcr.io` 下载镜像；插件会自动使用系统代理 | 虚拟机由 [microsandbox](https://github.com/microsandbox/microsandbox) 运行（libkrun 微型虚拟机，macOS 用 Hypervisor.framework）。它随插件的 npm 依赖一起安装，不需要单独安装。 ## 二、安装 ### dsh 桌面版（macOS） 桌面版使用名为 `desktop` 的配置，要用 App 自带的 dsh 命令安装： ```bash osascript -e 'quit app "DeepSeek Harness"' # 先退出桌面版 "/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" \ plugin --profile desktop add github:Kevinwu901113/dsh-computer open -a "DeepSeek Harness" ``` 重新打开后，在输入框下方的权限选择里会出现 **Computer** 预设。 ### 命令行版 ```bash npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 dsh plugin --profile web add github:Kevinwu901113/dsh-computer cd ~/某个项目 && dsh web ``` ### 第一次启动 插件会自动下载镜像（几 GB）并创建虚拟机，这期间 agent 的命令排队等待，不会报错。完成后日志出现： ``` computer ready — live view: http://127.0.0.1:18080/vnc/index.html?autoconnect=true&resize=scale ``` ## 三、共享文件夹 - 在某个工作区新建会话并执行命令时，插件自动把这个工作区共享进虚拟机，路径和本机一致。比如 `/Users/你/Documents/项目` 在虚拟机里也是这个路径。 - 共享新文件夹需要重建虚拟机：停机 → 磁盘快照 → 带新文件夹恢复，大约 20 秒。期间的命令自动排队，虚拟机里的文件、安装的软件和浏览器登录态都保留。 - **不会自动共享**：家目录本身、隐藏目录（如 `~/.dsh`、`~/.ssh`）、`~/Library`、`~/Applications`，以及家目录以外的位置。在这些位置启动时，命令在虚拟机的 `/home/gem` 里执行，并共享 `~/dsh-computer/workspace`。 - 想固定共享某些文件夹，在设置里写 `mounts`（见第五节）。显式写出的文件夹不受上面的限制。 ## 四、观看与接管 **在 dsh 界面里**：会话顶部右侧有一个显示器按钮，点一下就在右侧栏打开"虚拟机"标签页，可以直接点击和输入；再点一下收起。也可以在右侧栏的"+"引导页里选"虚拟机"。虚拟机还没就绪时，标签页会显示等待状态并自动重试。 **在浏览器里**： ``` http://127.0.0.1:18080/vnc/index.html?autoconnect=true&resize=scale ``` 看到的就是 agent 的电脑桌面，可以直接点击、输入。 **在手机上（不在电脑旁时）**：端口只监听本机，不要直接暴露到公网。推荐用 [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) 把它安全地转发到你自己的设备： ```bash tailscale serve --bg --https=443 http://127.0.0.1:18080 # 只在你的 tailnet 内可见 ``` 然后把得到的地址（如 `https://my-mac.tailnet-xxxx.ts.net`）写进设置文件的 `publicUrl`。之后审批消息（包括转发到 IM 的审批卡片）里的实时画面链接会用这个地址，在手机上点开就能看和接管。 > 风险：虚拟机的 web 服务本身没有鉴权。`tailscale serve` 只对你 tailnet 里的设备开放；不要用 `tailscale funnel`、端口转发或任何公网隧道直接暴露 18080。 ## 五、配置 桌面版拿不到终端环境变量（只能用 `launchctl setenv` 设置），推荐写设置文件 `~/.dsh/dsh-computer.json`，改完重启 dsh： ```json { "mounts": ["/Users/你/Projects/a", "/Users/你/Projects/b"], "memory": "6G", "cpus": 4 } ``` | 设置项 / 环境变量 | 默认值 | 作用 | |---|---|---| | `mounts` / `DSH_COMPUTER_MOUNTS` | 自动（见第三节） | 固定共享的文件夹；环境变量用 `:` 分隔（Windows 用 `;`） | | `memory` / `cpus` | `4G` / `2` | 虚拟机资源上限 | | `publicUrl` / `DSH_COMPUTER_PUBLIC_URL` | 空 | 从别的设备访问虚拟机 web 服务的地址（见第四节），用于审批消息和状态接口 | | `DSH_COMPUTER_PORT` | `18080` | 虚拟机服务在本机的端口（仅监听 127.0.0.1）；只能用环境变量设置 | | `image` / `DSH_COMPUTER_IMAGE` | `ghcr.io/agent-infra/sandbox:latest` | 虚拟机镜像 | | `backend` / `DSH_COMPUTER_BACKEND` | `auto` | `microsandbox` 或 `docker` | | `DSH_COMPUTER_GATE` | `risky` | `off` 不拦截；`risky` 拦危险命令和敏感浏览器动作；`browser` 每个浏览器动作都审批 | | `DSH_COMPUTER_PRESET` | `computer` | `computer-auto` 关闭审批，只建议在虚拟机里没有重要登录态时用 | ## 六、维护 插件自带的 msb 命令在 dsh 配置目录里（桌面版如下）： ```bash MSB=~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/@superradcompany/microsandbox-darwin-arm64/bin/msb $MSB list # 虚拟机状态 $MSB exec -u gem dsh-computer -- bash # 进入虚拟机 $MSB stop dsh-computer # 停机（下次 dsh 启动自动唤醒） $MSB rm -f dsh-computer # 删除虚拟机；若有快照，下次启动从最近的快照恢复 $MSB snapshot list --group dsh-computer ``` 每次共享新文件夹都会留下一个磁盘快照（`~/.microsandbox/snapshots/dsh-computer/`）。快照是链式的，后一个依赖前一个，不能单独删除；每次增加约 15–20MB。虚拟机被误删时，插件下次启动会从最新快照恢复。要回收空间只能整体重置：`$MSB rm -f dsh-computer` 后删除整个快照目录，虚拟机里的状态会一起清空。 ## 七、出问题时 插件把每次虚拟机操作写进 `~/.dsh/dsh-computer.log`。把最后 50 行发出来即可： ```bash tail -n 50 ~/.dsh/dsh-computer.log ``` | 现象 | 处理 | |---|---| | 日志里有“本机虚拟化不可用” | Windows：管理员执行 `Enable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName HypervisorPlatform -All` 和 `bcdedit /set "{current}" hypervisorlaunchtype auto`，然后重启 | | 镜像下载很慢或失败 | 确认系统代理可用，或用 `image` 换成能访问的镜像源 | | 浏览器工具报错，bash 正常 | 等一分钟；插件会自动清理浏览器锁文件并重启浏览器 | | agent 命令长时间无输出 | 看日志是否停在 `restore` 或 `pull` | ## 八、已知限制 - Mac 休眠时虚拟机暂停；真正 7×24 常驻需要一直开着的机器。 - 本机端口没有鉴权：`127.0.0.1:18080` 只对本机开放，但本机其他程序都能访问。不要在虚拟机里登录高价值账号。 - 浏览器登录后约 30–45 秒才把 cookie 写盘，立刻共享新文件夹或重启可能丢失刚完成的登录。 - 共享文件夹以外的虚拟机文件（如 `/home/gem`），dsh 的文件读写工具看不到，只能通过命令访问。 - 一个 dsh 配一台虚拟机，还没有“每个会话一台”。 - Docker 后端（Intel Mac）不支持自动共享新文件夹，需要在设置里写 `mounts` 后执行 `docker rm -f dsh-computer`。 - Windows 只验证到虚拟化检测，桌面版完整流程未验证。 ## 九、开发：界面部分 界面代码在 `ui/`，必须用 dsh 官方仓库的 tsdown 预设编译。把 `ui/` 放进官方仓库的 `packages/client/dsh-computer-ui/`，执行 `pnpm install --filter "dsh-computer..."`，然后在该目录运行 `npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noCheck && npx tsdown`，把生成的 `lib/client.js` 复制到本插件的 `lib/`。虚拟机端口固定读 18080；改了 `DSH_COMPUTER_PORT` 时，标签页暂时仍连 18080。 ## 十、审计日志与状态接口 **审计日志** `~/.dsh/dsh-computer-audit.jsonl`，每行一条 JSON，超过 10MB 轮转为 `.1`： | `kind` | 何时记录 | 主要字段 | |---|---|---| | `exec` / `terminal` | 每个在虚拟机里启动的进程 | `argv`、`cwd` | | `tool` | 每次 bash 或虚拟机工具调用结束（被拒绝的审批也在这里，`ok: false`） | `tool`、`session`、`args`、`ok`、`error` | | `approval-asked` | 审批闸门要求审批 | `tool`、`session`、`args`、`reason` | | `mount` | 共享 / 取消共享文件夹 | `action`、`dir`、`mounts` | | `status` | 虚拟机状态变化 | `state`、`error` | **状态接口**（给同一 dsh 里的其他插件用，例如 [dsh-dot](https://github.com/Kevinwu901113/dsh-dot)）：注入 `dshComputer` 服务后， ```js ctx.dshComputer.status() // { state: 'starting' | 'shell-only' | 'ready' | 'remounting' | 'error', // backend, liveViewUrl, publicLiveViewUrl, mounts, error } const stop = ctx.dshComputer.onStatus((snapshot) => { /* 状态变化时调用 */ }) ``` `dshComputer.audit(entry)` 也可以被其他插件用来往同一份审计日志里追加记录。

plugins.description: 官方 DSH 内核补丁的数据化版本：10 条自包含补丁 + 自适应应用器（自己找安装位置、逐个备份、语法检查、一键回退），五种打法、零硬编码路径。仅支持 DSH 1.5，后续会跟进更新。 / Official DSH core patches as data: ten patches plus an adaptive applier. Five ways to apply. DSH 1.5 only.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-patch-library

**The official DSH core patches, as data — and five ways to apply them.**

**官方 DSH 内核补丁的数据化版本 —— 10 条补丁，5 种打法。**

Ten self-contained patches for `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` and `@earendil-works/pi-ai`, plus a small
applier that finds *your* DSH installation by itself. No hard-coded paths, no personal information
anywhere in this repository, no network access required.

十条自成体系的补丁，覆盖 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` 与 `@earendil-works/pi-ai`；配一个小巧的应用器，
它会**自己找到你的 DSH 安装位置**。零硬编码路径、仓库里没有任何个人信息、全程不需要联网。

> 🌐 **中文完整说明（推荐中文读者从这里开始）** → **[README.zh-CN.md](README.zh-CN.md)**
>
> 中文读者还应该看这两份：[`教程-安装与官方补丁` 里的补丁库章节](https://github.com/xiamubumu/dsh-context-reclaim/blob/main/tutorial-install-and-official-patches.zh-CN.md)
> 与 [给 agent 的中文提示词](PROMPT.zh-CN.md)。

> Built for `@deepseek-ai/dsh` **0.1.5-rc.2** (the 1.5 line). Every patch records the exact
> sha256 of both the file it expects and the file it produces, so the applier can tell you
> `exact` / `applied` / `conflict` before it touches anything.

---

## Why this repository exists

Some fixes cannot be shipped as a plugin: they have to run *inside* an official file, in the middle
of a function that Cordis does not expose as a seam. Four of those fixes were already published as
plugins (`dsh-context-reclaim`, `dsh-capability-composer`, `dsh-composer-launcher`,
`dsh-aux-degrade`). The rest — plus the ones that only matter if you want the full set — live here,
as ordinary unified diffs that anyone can read, review, apply, revert, or regenerate.

Nothing here is a binary blob and nothing here is magic: `patches/<id>/change.diff` is a normal
patch, and `manifest.json` is the metadata that lets a script apply it safely and reversibly.

## The ten patches

| id | package → file | kind | size | restart | already handled by a plugin? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dsh-llm-writable-request` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` → `lib/index.js` | lines | +18 −1 | yes | **yes — `dsh-context-reclaim`** |
| `agent-loop-snapshot-prompt` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-loop` → `lib/index.js` | lines | +97 −20 | yes | no |
| `llm-pi-ai-system-prompt` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` → `lib/index.js` | lines | +96 −54 | yes | no |
| `compaction-pruner` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner` → `lib/index.js` | lines | +354 −14 | yes | no |
| `ui-renderer-turntail` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-renderer` → `lib/client.js` | lines | +9 −1 | no | no |
| `ui-sidebar-wrap` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar` → `lib/lib-client.js` | **regex** | +1 −1 | no | no |
| `session-format-v1-to-v2` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-format-v1-to-v2` → `lib/index.js` | lines | +2 −1 | yes | no |
| `session-persistence-jsonl` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl` → `lib/worker.cjs` | lines | +2 −1 | yes | no |
| `mcp-client` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` → `lib/index.js` | lines | +59 −6 | yes | no |
| `pi-ai-max-tokens-floor` | `@earendil-works/pi-ai` → `dist/api/simple-options.js` | lines | +11 −1 | yes | no |

Every patch has its own `patches/<id>/NOTES.md` with **what it changes, when you want it, how to
verify it, and what to do if it does not fit your build** — in English and Chinese.

`ui-sidebar-wrap` is a **regex** patch on purpose: the sidebar's class prefix is a build hash, so a
line diff would be invalidated by any rebuild. `patches/<id>/change.json` stores the pattern and its
explicit inverse.

## Five ways to apply them

Pick whichever matches how you like to work. All five are documented step by step in
[`docs/methods.md`](docs/methods.md) (Chinese: [`docs/methods.zh-CN.md`](docs/methods.zh-CN.md)).

| | method | command |
|---|---|---|
| **A** | script (recommended) | `node apply.mjs --check` then `node apply.mjs --apply --all` |
| **B** | `git apply` | `cd <pkg dir> && git apply -p1 <library>/patches/<id>/change.diff` |
| **C** | your own AI agent | paste the block from [`PROMPT.md`](PROMPT.md) and let it do A or B for you |
| **D** | regenerate for your build | `node tools/make-patch.mjs --file <patched> --orig <pristine> --pkg <pkg> --rel <rel>` |
| **E** | revert | `node apply.mjs --revert --all`, or restore any `*.orig` by hand |

All ten diffs were verified with `git apply -p1 --check` inside the package directory, so method B
works on every one of them.

### Method A in full

```bash
node apply.mjs --list                 # what is in here
node apply.mjs --roots                # which DSH installations were found on this machine
node apply.mjs --check                # per-file state: exact / applied / conflict / missing
node apply.mjs --apply --all          # apply everything that fits
node apply.mjs --apply --only mcp-client,compaction-pruner
node apply.mjs --revert --all         # put every .orig backup back
```

`--check` reports one of:

| state | meaning |
|---|---|
| `exact` | the file is the pristine version this library was built from — applying is safe |
| `applied` | the file already equals the patched version, nothing to do |
| `variant` | same version, different build (hash differs) but the hunks still fit — needs `--allow-variant`, or method D |
| `conflict` | the hunks do not fit. **Nothing is written.** Use method D to regenerate for your build |
| `missing` | that package is not part of the installation that was found |

### What the applier guarantees

* **It finds your installation, it does not assume one.** `--root`, `$DSH_APP_ROOT`,
  `$DSH_INSTALL_ROOT`, `$DSH_HOME` (including `profiles/*`), the running process's own DSH path,
  a `node` resolution from the current directory, and a bounded scan of the usual install locations
  for Windows / macOS / Linux — see `lib/discover.mjs`. `--root` means *exactly* that root, never
  that root plus whatever else was found.
* **`.orig` is sacred.** A backup is written once, next to the file, and never overwritten. If a
  `.orig` already exists, it is reused.
* **Every edit is syntax-checked.** `node --check` runs after each write; on failure the backup is
  restored immediately and the patch is reported as failed.
* **A hunk that does not fit is a conflict, never a guess.** The engine matches a hunk's old side
  exactly, exactly once, near the position it was recorded at.
* **It only writes inside the resolved root.** Nothing under `$DSH_HOME` is touched except, if you
  explicitly point `--root` at a profile directory, that profile's own `node_modules` copy of a
  package.

Exit codes: `0` success, `1` a requested action failed or conflicted, `2` no installation found.

## If you already run the four DSH plugins

You can skip `dsh-llm-writable-request` — `dsh-context-reclaim` takes over that path from inside the
plugin, with the official patch reverted. `--check` says so explicitly:

```
= dsh-llm-writable-request     already    node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm/lib/index.js
    not needed: the dsh-context-reclaim plugin already handles this
```

The other nine are independent of the plugins: install neither, one, or both.

## Self-test

```bash
node verify.mjs
```

Offline, no DSH installation required. It checks that every diff parses and its hunk counts agree,
that the declared marker really is added by its patch, that the apply/revert engine round-trips on
synthetic samples, that a duplicated context is rejected instead of guessed, that the regex patch
round-trips through any class prefix — and that **no file in this repository contains a drive
letter, a personal home directory or a private workspace name** (that scan is part of the test
suite, not a promise).

`verify.mjs` finishes with a read-only `--check` summary of whatever installation it finds.

## Repository layout

```
apply.mjs             the applier: --list --roots --check --apply --revert --show
verify.mjs            offline self-test + personal-information scan
manifest.json         every patch's metadata: hashes, sizes, markers, risk, why, applyWhen
lib/manifest.mjs      manifest loading and schema checks
lib/discover.mjs      finds DSH installations (fully adaptive, platform-aware)
lib/unified.mjs       unified-diff parse / apply / revert engine
lib/backup.mjs        .orig backup and restore
lib/hash.mjs          sha256 helpers
patches/<id>/change.diff   the patch itself

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）运行时治理插件：L3 拦截＋真值收口＋规则 Config 化＋提示词管理后台，把工程纪律下沉为运行时强制｜0.1 MVP 已发布
plugins.readme_text:
# shisan-xinuo-dsh-plugin

**DeepSeek Harness（DSH）运行时治理插件**——把「工程纪律」从提示词里的一句建议，变成宿主上**跑不掉的强制**，并带一套**提示词管理后台**。让工作过程**可审计**、危险动作**可拦截**、任务完成**可证明**。

## 它解决什么问题

给 DSH 干活时，常见四类坑：

- 危险操作不打招呼就执行；
- 口头说「验证通过」，其实没跑、或跑的不是那条命令；
- 该做的分级、清单、留档不做，出了事无法复盘；
- 说「任务完成」但没有一条可复核的证据。

本插件在宿主这一层把这些「靠自觉」的事改成「靠机制」：**不是把纪律写得更多，而是把纪律变成运行时强制。**

## 装了什么

### 1. 提示词层（常驻 + 按需）

- `content/discipline.md` —— 常驻核心纪律：状态行、开工协议、证据分级（K0–K6）、承载留档、红线、收口格式。
- `content/layered/` —— 按需加载的流程细则与固定模板，用完即走，不占上下文。
- 全部提示词允许用户修改；改坏自动回退内置默认。
- **自包含**：不依赖外部 Skill 才能运行，外部 Skill 仅可作为可选参考。

### 2. 挂载的工具包

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `discipline_gate` · 收口工具 | 收口时宿主**真实执行**你声明的验证命令，与声称的退出码比对；谎报退出码＝不通过 |
| `discipline_task` · 任务登记 | 开工登记任务清单与验收断言；回合收尾自动复核，未过＝打回 |
| `discipline_tools` · 工具目录 | 只读列出当前真正下发的工具面（线缆真值），不做裁剪 |

### 3. 运行时自动强制（不靠自觉）

- **判级自动检测**：宿主按「工具名 + 命令」独立推风险等级，与自报等级比对，低报也逃不掉。
- **调用工具检测**：按客观副作用（写／删除／执行）判是否需要收口，只读回合自动豁免。
- **L3 危险命令拦截**：命中危险域先拦下、要你确认，未授权不执行。
- **回合收尾复核**：已登记断言由宿主在收尾自动复核，未过即打回，不认「自己说完成了」。
- **遥测对账**：执行日志 + 统计对账 + 密钥脱敏，全程留痕可审计。

### 4. 更严谨的强权限管理

- L3 危险域可配置（`content/rules.json`），域命中即拦；配置损坏自动回退内置默认，**不静默解除防护**。
- 只读豁免规则区分「查看」与「改动」。
- 工作区边界守卫：越界写动作全程记录在案。

### 5. 提示词管理后台（DSH自定义）

内置一套网页管理后台（挂在 DSH 设置区），6 个页签：

- **会话管理**：只读查看每个会话实际装配的提示词；
- **系统提示词管理**：编辑常驻核心／我的提示词／渐进分节，整段接管或恢复官方原文；
- **快照与恢复**：一键备份、时间线回滚、JSON 导入导出；
- **统计数据**：护栏拦截、快照、会话改动等审计流水；
- **治理开关**：L3 总闸＋各危险域逐域开关＋误拦白名单，写 `governance.json` 热生效；
- **关于**：版本、反馈入口、卸载与还原指引。

## 诚实边界（先读，别误会）

- 收口验证是一条**新的执行通道**，不是安全沙箱——清单覆盖之外不拦。
- 退出码比对只抓「谎报」，与目标无关的命令仍会通过。
- 本插件**不保证模型更聪明，也不构成安全边界**——拦截面是枚举覆盖，验证面是真退出码。

## 安装 / 测试

```bash
npm test                          # 全套单测（Node ≥22.18）
node scripts/tally.mjs --report --freeze
```

开发态挂载示例见 `cordis.yml`；发行态经 `dsh plugin add` 使用 `cordis.patch.yml`（指向预编译产物 `lib/`）。

## 反馈

Bug／设计讨论开 [Issue](https://github.com/zxc663/shisan-xinuo-dsh-plugin/issues/new/choose)；安全相关走 `SECURITY.md` 私密披露渠道。

三库导航：[想法库/](想法库/) [推进库/](推进库/) [验证库/](验证库/)

plugins.description: Use your Kimi Code / Grok (X Premium) / Google Antigravity / GLM (BigModel) subscriptions as DeepSeek Harness LLM providers - OAuth sign-in, per-model visibility, drag-to-reorder Auto fallback, and plan quotas from the Settings page. No API keys.
plugins.readme_text:
[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README.zh.md)

# dsh-plugin-subscription-oauth

**Use the AI subscriptions you already pay for as LLM providers in DeepSeek Harness — no API key.**

Sign in once per provider from **Settings → Subscriptions** and that provider's models join the session model picker, with its plan quota shown live next to the connection. Tokens stay on your machine; every request streams through the provider's own API.

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-plugin-subscription-oauth.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-subscription-oauth)
[![Licence: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/licence-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

## Supported providers

| Provider | What you get | Sign-in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Kimi Code** | `kimi-for-coding`, `k3` (1M), `k3-256k` — read from the endpoint's own model list | OAuth device flow (show code, confirm in browser) |
| **Grok (X Premium)** | whatever the account's own model list reports (e.g. `grok-4.7`), **⚡ lightspeed** fast variant | Browser OAuth (auto-redirect) |
| **Google Antigravity** | Claude Sonnet/Opus, Gemini Flash, GPT-OSS, with reasoning tiers — read from the account's own list | Google account OAuth |
| **GLM (BigModel)** | whatever the coding host lists (e.g. `glm-5.3`, `glm-5.3-flash`) | ZCode browser sign-in (polled) |
| **Volcengine Ark** | the plan's own coding models | Volcengine SSO |
| **Xiaomi MiMo** | MiMo's own model list, with the app's two-model set as the fallback | Xiaomi account (QR / password) |
| **WorkBuddy (国内版)** | Hy, GLM, Kimi, DeepSeek, MiniMax models | Browser OAuth (Tencent) |

Every provider also feeds the **`auto`** route, which spans them all: pick `auto` and the harness walks your enabled models in order until one answers.

## Features

- **One sign-in per provider** — no API keys to find, paste, or rotate. The plugin runs the provider's own OAuth/device flow and keeps the token on disk (`~/.dsh/plugins/kimi-oauth/auth.json`, mode `0600`).
- **Live plan usage** — the Settings card and the composer chip show each account's remaining quota (Kimi's 5-hour / weekly windows + credit, Grok's weekly credit, Antigravity's Gemini + Claude buckets, GLM/Ark/MiMo/WorkBuddy credits), with a meter and reset time.
- **Model picker integration** — each provider's models appear in the session picker with context windows and reasoning tiers; hide or re-order them per provider.
- **Catalogs come from the provider, not from this build** — every route reads its own model list once and caches it as the provider's table, so a model released, renamed or retired server-side shows up (or disappears) without a plugin update. Signing in and the Settings **refresh models** action are what re-read it; browsing the picker never spends a request.
- **⚡ Fast / lightspeed variants** — for models that have one (e.g. Grok 4.7 → `grok-4.7-build-fast`), a bolt button beside the model selector switches to the fast variant; it reads as a reasoning rung so the base model always stays selectable.
- **Cross-account pool** — sign in to several accounts on one provider; the plugin draws on the next account when one's allowance runs out.
- **Auto fallback** — `auto` moves to the next enabled model when a provider refuses the preferred one (renamed, rate-limited, out of quota), and stops falling back once a stream has started.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-subscription-oauth
```

Then restart DeepSeek Harness and open **Settings → Subscriptions** (订阅).

To install a specific version, or straight from the repository:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-subscription-oauth@0.10.2
dsh plugin --profile web add github:EricFL1998/dsh-subscription-oauth
```

## How to use

1. **Open Settings → Subscriptions.** You see one card per provider; signed-in providers sort to the front, `auto` leads.
2. **Connect** a provider. A browser window (or a device code) starts the provider's own sign-in. Finish it there — the card updates by itself.
3. **Pick a model.** The provider's models now appear in the composer model picker, and the chip shows live usage.
4. **Expand a card** to manage accounts (set default, sign out, refresh token), toggle which models appear, re-order them, add a model id this build doesn't know yet, and see the credential file / endpoints.

> **Tip:** to use a different account on a provider, sign out first, then connect again — the browser sign-in follows whichever account the provider's page is signed in with.

## What it registers

| Surface | What appears |
| --- | --- |
| `ctx.llm` | the `kimi`, `grok`, `antigravity`, `glm`, `ark`, `mimo`, `workbuddy` and `auto` provider routes (models, reasoning, streaming) |
| Settings | a **Subscriptions** section: one card per provider |
| Model picker | each provider's own models, plus **`auto`** spanning them all |
| Composer chip | live plan usage for the provider in force |

## Hiding a provider

To keep a provider's models out of the picker without uninstalling, drop it from the route list in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yml
# $DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml
plugins:
  dsh-plugin-subscription-oauth:
    providers: [kimi, grok, antigravity, glm, ark, mimo, workbuddy]
```

Omit the ones you don't want. The list defaults to every implemented route.

## Security

- Credentials are stored locally at `~/.dsh/plugins/kimi-oauth/auth.json` (mode `0600`, written atomically), one section per provider.
- The plugin talks only to the providers' own hosts and OAuth endpoints — no telemetry, no third-party relay.
- Your subscriptions only; nothing is shared across machines.

## Develop

See the [developer README](README.dev.md) for the full wire protocol, token lifetimes, troubleshooting, and how to run the test suite.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: A daily Token-usage heatmap for the DSH settings page, including an estimated daily cost in CNY from DeepSeek list prices. Aggregated entirely from local session logs; no external requests. ｜ DSH 设置中的每日 Token 用量热力图，含人民币估算消费金额；数据取自本机会话日志，不发起外部请求。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-token-heatmap

[中文](README.zh.md) | English

A **daily token-usage heatmap** that adds a "Token usage" section to the DSH settings page. One cell per day; theme-aware greyscale indicates relative usage.

Selecting a day also shows an **estimated cost in CNY**, derived from DeepSeek's published list prices and their peak/off-peak schedule.

All data is derived from DSH's own local session logs. **No external network requests and no separate usage ledger.**

> **Privacy**: this plugin makes no outbound requests. Session logs are read on the local machine only, and the aggregated result is served to your local DSH page. The repository contains no personal data or credentials.

## Design highlights

- **A native settings section, not an overlay.** The component registers into the `settings.section` slot and renders React elements only. It does not append to `document.body`, does not replace the application root, and imports no Harness client package. It therefore occupies the settings sidebar alongside the built-in sections rather than floating above the application. See [Implementation notes](#implementation-notes).
- **Local data only, single source of truth.** No data leaves the machine and no additional ledger is required: every figure is derived from the session logs DSH already writes.
- **The session log format is parsed explicitly.** Concatenated zstd frames, replayed `seq` values and truncated tail frames are each handled as distinct cases. A single-pass decompression retains only the first frame of a multi-frame log and therefore under-reports usage. See [Data source](#data-source).
- **Colour levels remain readable at both ends of the scale.** The four metrics differ by orders of magnitude, so levels are derived from **quantiles of the local data set** (25th/50th/75th percentiles) rather than fixed thresholds. Cache reads frequently account for the majority of a day — 99% in the screenshots below — which is why `Input+output` is provided as a separate metric.
- **Brightness is reserved for days with recorded usage.** Days without usage occupy the lowest visual level, so an otherwise empty grid remains visually neutral and days with usage are distinguishable at a glance. This carries an accessibility benefit as well: the encoding never relies on colour hue.
- **Cost is estimated rather than billed.** DSH session logs record token counts but no currency amounts, so the detail panel applies DeepSeek's published CNY prices to the day's input, cache-read and output tokens. The peak/off-peak schedule is accounted for per record using the record's own timestamp, and the panel states that the figure is an estimate. See [Cost estimate](#cost-estimate).
- **Selection and expansion are separate states.** Collapsing a day's details retains its selection outline on the heatmap; selecting another day switches the details directly; `Esc` collapses first and clears the selection second. Reading a sequence of days therefore requires no intermediate close step.
- **Host integration for theme and language.** Colours are drawn from host theme tokens (`--dsw-alias-*`), and all visible text is registered through `ctx.locale.register`, so an application language change re-renders the section. Number units are localized as well (`万`/`亿` in Chinese, `K`/`M`/`B` in English).
- **Regression tests rather than claims.** Five self-test entry points cover frame parsing, deduplication, caching, weekly boundaries, client rendering and route registration. See [Layout](#layout).

## Screenshots

> **Note on screenshot currency.** The images below predate **v0.5.0** and have not been re-captured since. Three UI changes made since are therefore not visible in them:
>
> 1. **Empty-day cells render darker.** Days without recorded usage now occupy the dimmest level, reserving the brightness range for days with usage (v0.4.1).
> 2. **Collapsing a day retains its selection.** Selecting the same date again collapses only the detail body; the selection outline remains on the heatmap and the collapsed row carries an expand control (v0.4.1).
> 3. **The detail panel shows an estimated cost.** A daily cost in CNY is displayed next to the daily total (v0.5.0).
>
> The textual descriptions throughout this document reflect the current behaviour.

### Half-year heatmap and compact tooltip

Open Settings → **Token usage**. The default range is six months. Choose total, input+output, cache read or output, and switch between daily and weekly views. The range selector offers six months or a full year; the year is split into two rows.

Hover a date cell to display three lines: the date (YYYY-MM-DD), the selected metric's Token count, and “Click to view details”. The example below shows 2026-10-13 with a total of 117,405,946 Token. Selecting the cell displays that day's breakdown below the heatmap. The outline indicates hover or selection; today's cell has no default highlight. Cells with no recorded usage remain at the dimmest level, so the brightness range is reserved for days with usage.

![English half-year heatmap and tooltip](docs/heatmap-en.png)

### Inline daily details and Token composition

Selecting a date displays its details inline below the heatmap, without navigating away from the page. A single-line hint above the footnote indicates the interaction until a date is selected. Selecting the same date again collapses the detail body while retaining the selection outline on the heatmap, so the selected date remains identifiable; the collapsed row provides an expand control. Selecting a different date switches the details directly, with no intermediate collapse step. For keyboard users, `Esc` on a focused cell collapses the details, and a second press clears the selection. All filters remain available throughout.

Details include the total, input, output, cache reads and calls, plus cache writes when present, and an estimated daily cost in CNY. The grayscale bar shows each component's share by Token count. The October 13, 2026 example shows 117,405,946 Token, with cache reads accounting for 99.09%. These are screenshot examples; your statistics come from your local logs.

![English daily details and Token composition](docs/detail-en.png)

### Chinese interface

Labels, months, dates and number units follow the host language. The same daily total appears as “1.17 亿” in Chinese and “117.41M” in English.

![Chinese half-year heatmap and tooltip](docs/heatmap-zh.png)

![Chinese daily details and Token composition](docs/detail-zh.png)

## Features

- Default half-year range (26 weeks); full year uses two rows (27 + 26 weeks), each with month labels
- Cells capped at 20px with 4px gaps, sized to the container to avoid horizontal scrollbars
- **Daily / Weekly** views: daily levels or one shared level per natural week; Sunday–Saturday, future dates empty
- **Four metrics**: total / input+output / cache read / output, rendered in theme-aware grayscale
- Hover or focus shows the cell's date, the selected metric's Token count and a click hint; weekly counts are labeled
- Click a date for inline daily details below the heatmap: total, input, output, cache reads, calls, nonzero cache writes, and an estimated cost in CNY; weekly cells open their actual day
- Selecting the selected date again collapses the detail body while retaining its selection outline; an expand control and `Esc` both collapse, and selecting another date switches without an intermediate collapse
- **Cost estimate** based on DeepSeek's published CNY prices, including the peak/off-peak schedule applied per record timestamp; unknown models fall back to the Flash table and are labelled as such. The English interface writes `CNY ¥4.98` so the currency is explicit.
- Proportional Token composition bar with percentages and an empty state
- Approximately 600ms diagonal entrance without delaying the summary; filters and date selection do not replay it
- Native buttons support Enter/Space and focus feedback; respects system reduced-motion preferences
- Today / this week / all-time summary; minute refresh plus refresh on visibility or focus
- Chinese/English labels, month names and number units; follows the host light/dark th

plugins.description: DSH plugin: enable/disable skills by group (skill toggles manager)
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-skill-toggles

DeepSeek Harness 技能开关插件：**黑名单语义 + 分组**——所有技能默认可用，只有被"启用中的分组"显式禁用的才被过滤（生效黑名单 = 启用分组黑名单的并集）。全新安装、状态文件缺失或损坏都等于"全部启用"，永不出现"装上即全消失"。

![技能面板](assets/screenshots/panel.png)

## 安装

- **插件市场**：在 dshmarket 中搜索 `dsh-skill-toggles`，一键安装；
- **npm**：
  ```
  dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-skill-toggles
  ```
- **本地源码**：
  ```
  dsh plugin --profile desktop add file:<本仓库绝对路径>
  ```

安装后重启 DSH（浏览器半重新加载页面即可）。卸载：`dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-skill-toggles`（`postuninstall` 自动删除状态目录 `<DSH_HOME>/dsh-skill-toggles/`）。

## 使用

![分组管理](assets/screenshots/groups.png)

1. **打开面板**：聊天输入框工具条的「技能」按钮 → 左侧悬浮面板。
2. **分组**：内置默认分组（初始全开、可编辑、不可删除）；可新建/重命名/删除自定义分组，每组有自己的黑名单与启用开关——切换启用状态即整组生效/失效。
3. **技能列表**：每行开关作用于当前选中分组；支持搜索、按**来源分节**（插件包 / 用户 / 项目 / 自定义 / 其他，可折叠）与每节"全部禁用/全部启用"。技能被其它启用分组禁用时显示"被「××」禁用"徽标。
4. **Agent 工具**：`skill_toggles_list / disable / enable / enable_all / disable_all / source_set / group_create / group_delete / group_set_active`（均带可选 `group` 参数，缺省为默认分组）。
5. **改动生效时机**：

   | 路径 | 生效时机 |
   |---|---|
   | 输入框 `/` 技能菜单 | 下一次打开菜单（亚秒级） |
   | 模型 `<available_skills>` 目录 | 下一条消息（宿主"持久投影"机制，任何插件都如此） |
   | `skill` 工具 | 立即拒绝被禁用的技能 |

只管 skills，不做 MCP 开关。

## 已知限制

- Agent 未激活的冷会话由 preset 常驻 scope 供数，其 `/` 菜单可能仍显示已禁用技能，直到会话被激活（模型目录与 `skill` 工具不受影响）。
- 与旧插件 `dsh-skills-mcp-group-manager` **互斥**（两个影子 provider 叠加语义不可控），启动时检测到会打警告。
- 重装/升级**已安装** bundle 后，宿主半需要重启进程才换代码（Node 模块缓存）；浏览器半无此问题。

## 实现要点（维护者）

- 状态（v2）：`<DSH_HOME>/dsh-skill-toggles/state.json`，形如 `{ version:2, groups:[{id,name,disabled[]}], activeGroups[] }`；原子写；损坏回退为"全部启用"；v1 扁平文档加载时自动迁移进默认分组。
- 过滤机制：per-agent 影子 skill provider（`skill-toggles-filter`，注册在 agent 层）。`list()` 只发射"生效黑名单 ∧ 真实存在"的条目，invocation 改写为 `{modelInvocable:false, userInvocable:false}`，`rank:0` 在同层内直接胜出（文件系统根 rank 100..500）；启用的技能不重发，保留原 provider 的 `path` 预览与正文加载。
- 变更后 `control.invalidate()` 清空 skill registry 的 collect 缓存，再对每个活动会话 `emit('agent-preset/selected')` 使浏览器半目录缓存失效。
- 宿主半 `apply()` 保持同步（Cordis 对 prototype-bearing 函数的处理决定，异步 apply 会导致进程崩溃）。

## 开发

```
node test/state.test.mjs   # 纯逻辑 + 存储往返测试
```

```
dsh-skill-toggles/
├── lib/index.js        宿主半（影子 provider、RPC、9 个工具、事件广播）
├── lib/client.js       浏览器半（输入框按钮 + 分组管理悬浮面板）
├── lib/state.js        纯状态逻辑（分组黑名单语义 + v1 迁移，单测覆盖）
├── lib/store.js        原子写状态存储
├── scripts/cleanup.mjs postuninstall 清理
├── cordis.patch.yml    安装到 profile 的配置补丁片段
└── test/state.test.mjs
```

plugins.description: Marathon-inspired Acid Rain theme and native startup animation for DeepSeek Harness TUI
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-tui-marathon

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A Marathon-inspired appearance plugin for DeepSeek Harness TUI. Version 0.4.3 provides an Acid Rain theme and a responsive full-screen opening through the stock TUI's public interfaces. Conversations, models, tools and storage remain with Harness / dsh-TUI.

**Inspired by the repo [ALPDM00/dsh-theme-mls-desktop](https://github.com/ALPDM00/dsh-theme-mls-desktop)**

![Startup animation captured from the installed dsh-tui](evidence/startup.gif)

Version 0.4.3: actual 120×36 terminal output, replayed as a 24 fps GIF (about 10.3 seconds). The logo stays visible through the blue hold and maze transition until the red sweep covers it. The native interface returns after the opening.

The repository is named `dsh-tui-marathon`; the installable Cordis package is `dsh-theme-mls-tui`.

## Install, then run dsh-tui

This assumes `dsh`, `dsh-tui` and pnpm are already installed and your existing `dsh-tui` starts successfully. Supported host: dsh-TUI 0.14.x; verified version: 0.14.0.

Install the theme once:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add https://github.com/Huangmr0719/dsh-tui-marathon/releases/download/v0.4.3/dsh-theme-mls-tui-0.4.3.tgz
```

Keep using your usual command afterward:

```sh
dsh-tui
```

The plugin joins the launcher's default `dsh-tui` profile, selects Acid Rain and plays the opening automatically. No source checkout, host build or project-directory launch is needed. If you set `DSH_HOME`, use the same value during installation and startup. Restart `dsh-tui` after configuration changes or updates.

First-time host users can complete its normal credential setup after the opening. The theme does not change model, credential or session configuration.

Alternatively, download [the v0.4.3 archive](https://github.com/Huangmr0719/dsh-tui-marathon/releases/download/v0.4.3/dsh-theme-mls-tui-0.4.3.tgz) and replace the URL above with its local file path.

To remove the theme and keep using `dsh-tui`:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui remove dsh-theme-mls-tui
```

## Appearance and compatibility

- Automatic animation runs only at startup. Successful turns, cancellations and history replay never open an animation.
- Acid Rain yellow `#D7FF00`, dark surfaces and neutral body text. The opening retains electric blue, maze graphics and the red panel exit.
- Actual terminal text, block glyphs, borders and solid color cells replace the old full-frame sampled renderer.
- Six green scan frames use heavy box-drawing strokes and closer spacing; the scan stage lasts 0.8 seconds longer than 0.4.2.
- Both whale axes share one physical scale. Borders, maze and panels fill the viewport independently, including host page margins.
- The host frame clock drives motion without the former 50ms quantization. Measured moving-frame output is approximately 58 fps; terminal and machine load affect results.
- Resizing works during playback and pause. Validation covers 48–180 columns, 20–54 rows and several physical cell proportions.

The stock pixel whale has hardcoded blue pixels. The plugin hides it through public `setWhale(false)`, keeps the themed native title and restores the previous preference on unload. Set `nativeWhale: true` to retain that sprite.

Stock `tuiScenes` replaces the conversation. Panel masks animate within the plugin scene; the original conversation returns on close. Progressive reveal of native content needs an additional host interface. See [COMPATIBILITY.md](COMPATIBILITY.md).

## Controls and configuration

`Alt+M` replays the opening. During animation, `Esc`, `Enter`, `q` or click exits; space pauses/resumes. Configure Option as Alt/Meta on macOS when needed.

| Cordis option | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `autoTheme` | `true` | Select and save MLS once on activation |
| `autoBoot` | `true` | Play the startup opening |
| `motion` | `full` | `reduced`: brief static display; `off`: theme only |
| `graphics` | `cells` | `auto`: use a supported host image only for the central logo; outer geometry stays native |
| `cellAspect` | `0` | Read host cell measurements; fall back to height / width = 2 |
| `nativeWhale` | `false` | Keep the unthemeable stock blue whale |

No terminal brand is required. If the host supplies no pixel metrics, arbitrary font proportions cannot be inferred exactly. Optional `cellAspect` calibration uses cell height / width, such as `1.8` or `2.2`. Native cell rendering needs no image protocol.

## Development

These steps are for source changes; theme installation does not require them. Source development uses Node `^22.19 || >=24` and pnpm `11.21.0`. Keep a stock `dsh-TUI/` checkout next to this repository for dev links and integration tests. The revision below is the verified host baseline:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI.git
git -C dsh-TUI checkout 1d832df3f97e828b1aaea8376657d6b6ecf30b86
pnpm --dir dsh-TUI install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm --dir dsh-TUI build
git clone https://github.com/Huangmr0719/dsh-tui-marathon.git
cd dsh-tui-marathon
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
npm run build
npm test
npm run verify
```

For interactive development, `npm run setup:local` installs the official Harness CLI into ignored `.runtime/`; then run `npm start`. That launcher uses isolated development configuration and sessions. Normal use follows the `dsh-tui` workflow above. Configure API credentials through your shell environment as required by Harness. Do not commit credentials or sessions. Model-free tests need no API key.

Environment variables for the development launcher:

```sh
MLS_GRAPHICS=auto npm start
MLS_CELL_ASPECT=2.2 npm start
MLS_NATIVE_WHALE=1 npm start
MLS_MOTION=reduced npm start
npm start -- --inline
```

Optional development commands:

```sh
npm run measure:motion
npm run pack:local
```

MIT licensed; retain artwork attribution. See [QUALITY.md](QUALITY.md) for validation and [THIRD_PARTY.md](THIRD_PARTY.md) for asset provenance and regeneration.

plugins.description: DSH desktop (Windows) titlebar menu: a Restart button that closes and relaunches the whole app - shell + Host. Plugin-only, no app.asar patching.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-restart-button

给 **DSH 桌面端（Windows）** 的标题栏菜单栏加一个「重启」按钮：点一下，整个应用（Electron shell + DSH Host + 渲染进程 + 插件守护进程）退出并自动重新打开。

![菜单栏示意图](assets/preview.svg)

---

## 为什么需要它

DSH 桌面端的「应用」菜单是 **Electron 主进程** 用原生 `Menu` 弹出的（`applicationItems()`，打包在 `app.asar` 内）。菜单里本来就有一项「重启应用与 Host」，但它被 `development`（`!app.isPackaged`）门槛挡住，**正式安装包里看不到**。

而 DSH 插件运行在 **Host 子进程** 里：

```
"DeepSeek Harness.exe" --expose-internals "...\app.asar\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop-host\lib\index.js" ...
```

这个子进程：

- 拿不到 `app.relaunch()` / `app.quit()` —— 那是主进程的 API；
- 没有任何往原生菜单插项的扩展点 —— 菜单项列表硬编码在主进程里；
- 没有「请求主进程重启」的 IPC 通道 —— IPC 只允许主进程 → Host 单向指挥（`shutdown` / `quit-inspection` / `update-tasks`）。

所以插件只能**从外面把应用关掉再拉起来**。这正是本插件做的事：不改 `app.asar`、不依赖桌面端版本、装一次就一直在。

## 工作原理

### host 半边（`host.js`）

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/restart-button/status` | 可用性 + 进程信息（`exe`、`appName`、`workdir`、`mainPid`、`hostPid`、`electronVersion`、`logPath`） |
| POST | `/restart-button/restart` | 安排一次重启，立刻返回 `{ ok, via, dryRun, delayMs, scriptPath, logPath }` |

`POST /restart` 的动作序列：

1. 把一段 **VBScript** 助手脚本写到 `%TEMP%\dsh-restart-button-<random>.vbs`；
2. 用一段隐藏的 PowerShell 只做一件事：通过 **WMI**（`Invoke-CimMethod -ClassName Win32_Process -MethodName Create`）以 `wscript.exe //B //Nologo <脚本>` 创建它 —— WMI 创建的进程挂在 `WmiPrvSE.exe` 名下，**不属于本应用的进程树**，因此第 4 步「按 exe 路径杀掉整个应用」不会把助手自己一起杀掉（WMI 不可用时退化为 `spawn(..., { detached: true, stdio: "ignore" })`）；
3. 助手先睡 `1500ms`，让 HTTP 响应先回到页面（否则页面会看到连接被掐断）；host 侧 `waitForHelperStart()` 同时轮询日志里的 `helper started`，2s 内没出现就返回 `helper-did-not-start`（页面提示失败并可重试）；
4. 按 **exe 路径**枚举并终止该应用的所有进程：主进程 + Host + 渲染/GPU 进程 + 用同一个 exe 以 Node 模式跑的插件守护进程（例如 `billion-context` 的 `... start --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18789`），轮询 30s、每 3s 重试终止；
5. 从主进程原始命令行里取出参数（正常情况下为空），再用 WMI `Win32_Process.Create`（`CommandLine` + `CurrentDirectory`）重新启动同一个 exe。

> **为什么用 VBScript 而不是 PowerShell**：v1.0.1 及以前助手是 PowerShell，`Start-Process` 启动的应用会**继承那个 PowerShell 的控制台**，于是重启后桌面上多出一个 shell 窗口，里面滚着 main 进程的 `Checking for update…`、host 的 `dsh web: …` banner 和插件日志。`DeepSeek Harness.exe` 是 GUI 子系统程序，本身不申请控制台；改成 `wscript`（同为 GUI 子系统）且助手内部**只用 WMI**（不用 `taskkill` / `Start-Process`）后，整条重启链路不再产生任何控制台窗口。顺带两个坑：`powershell -WindowStyle Hidden` **挡不住** Windows Terminal 给控制台程序开标签页；`CREATE_NO_WINDOW` 也无法经 WMI 传给 `Win32_Process.Create`（三参重载返回 `21` / `WBEM_E_INVALID_PARAMETER`）。

日志写在 `%TEMP%\dsh-restart-button.log`，每次重启的完整决策链（`helper started (wscript)`、目标 PID 列表、是否 dry-run、重启命令行）都在里面。

### client 半边（`client.js`）

Windows 的「应用 / 编辑」菜单栏不是原生菜单条，而是桌面端 preload **画在页面里的 DOM**（`div[data-windows-menu]`，open shadow root）。client 半边在这个菜单栏里追加第三个按钮「重启」：

- 点击 → 确认气泡（中英双语，跟随 `document.documentElement.lang`）；
- 确认 → `POST /restart-button/restart` → 全屏遮罩 + 每 2s 轮询 `/status`（探不通 = Host 已退出，说明重启已生效）；
- 25s 内仍能探通则提示失败并可重试；
- 2.5s 内找不到菜单栏（例如跑在 `dsh web` 里）→ 退化为右下角浮动按钮 `#dsh-restart-button-floating`。

### 安全边界

两个路由都带栅栏，只接受：**loopback Host** + **非 `cross-site`** + **origin 同源或 `dsh-app://app`** 的请求（与官方插件 `isTrustedApiRequest` 相同的判定口径）。

## 安装

> 前置：DSH 桌面端（Windows）。profile 目录默认 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop`。

### 方式 A：用 dsh-super-injector（最省事，热装配免重启）

如果你装了 **dsh-super-injector**（DSH 插件运行时注入器），直接注入本目录的绝对路径：

```
dev_inject_plugin   dir=<本插件目录绝对路径>
```

或写进 profile（重启后仍在）：

```
dev_install_package dir=<本插件目录绝对路径> profile=desktop
```

> ⚠️ 两种注入方式与 bundle patch 的正式条目**不要同时存在**：`dev_install_package` 会先建一个临时 entry（幽灵），而 `cordis.patch.yml` 的正式 entry 后加载时会因为路由重复报
> `webserver: duplicate prefix route "/restart-button"`。处置：清掉幽灵 entry 后让正式 entry `refresh()`，或干脆重启一次应用（正式条目会正常加载）。

### 方式 B：手动装进 profile

1. 把插件目录放进 profile 的 `node_modules`（目录拷贝或 junction 均可）：

   ```bat
   mklink /J "%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-restart-button" "C:\path\to\dsh-restart-button"
   ```

2. 编辑 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\package.json`：

   ```jsonc
   {
     "dependencies": {
       "dsh-restart-button": "link:C:\\path\\to\\dsh-restart-button"
     },
     "dsh": {
       "profile": {
         "bundles": [
           // ... 其它 bundles ...
           "dsh-restart-button"
         ]
       }
     }
   }
   ```

3. 重启 DSH（关掉桌面端再打开，或重启 `dsh web`）。

### 方式 C：从 GitHub / tgz 安装

在 profile 目录里用 DSH 捆绑的 pnpm 安装，再把包名加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`，然后重启：

```bash
# 直接从 GitHub
pnpm add "dsh-restart-button@github:wangbofan/dsh-restart-button"
# 或从打包产物
pnpm add "file:C:\path\to\dsh-restart-button-1.0.0.tgz"
```

### 卸载

从 `dsh.profile.bundles` 与 `dependencies` 里删掉 `dsh-restart-button`，删掉 `node_modules` 下的链接，重启 DSH 即可（插件不写任何其它位置，除 `%TEMP%` 下的脚本与日志）。

## 使用

标题栏菜单栏：`应用 | 编辑 | 重启` → 点「重启」→ 确认气泡 → 应用关闭并自动重新打开。

> 位置说明：原生「应用」下拉的菜单项列表在 Electron 主进程内，插件无法插入菜单项，所以按钮做在菜单栏上、紧邻「应用」。

## 配色（跟随 DSH 主题）

弹窗、遮罩、按钮**全部使用 DSH 自己的语义 token**（`--dsw-alias-*`），因此和原生菜单一样随外观切换：浅色主题下是「近黑按钮 + 白字」，深色主题下是「近白按钮 + 深字」。没有写死颜色（`var()` 逗号后的值只是 token 缺失时的兜底）。

![浅色 / 深色主题下的弹窗](assets/theme-preview.png)

| 元素 | token | 浅色（DSH 默认） | 深色 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 菜单栏「重启」按钮 | 继承 preload shadow root 里 `button` 的样式：`interactive-bg-hover` + `label-primary` | 文字 `#61666b`；悬停底 `rgba(38,49,72,.06)`、文字 `#0f1115` | 文字 `#cfd3d6`；悬停底 `rgba(255,255,255,.08)`、文字 `#f9fafb` |
| 弹窗背景 / 边框 | `bg-layer-2` / `border-l4` | `#ffffff` / `rgba(0,0,0,.16)` | `#2c2c2e` / `rgba(255,255,255,.2)` |
| 弹窗阴影 / 圆角 | `elevation-panel` / `radius-lg` | 与 DSH 浮层一致 | 与 DSH 浮层一致 |
| 主按钮「重启」 | `button-primary-fill` + `label-primary-foreground` | 底 `#0f1115`、字 `#ffffff` | 底 `#f9fafb`、字 `#0f1115` |
| 主按钮悬停 | `button-primary-hover` | `#43454a` | `#ebeef2` |
| 次按钮「取消」 | `label-primary` + `border-l3` | 字 `#0f1115`、边 `rgba(0,0,0,.12)` | 字 `#f9fafb`、边 `rgba(255,255,255,.16)` |
| 重启遮罩 | `bg-mask-1` | `rgba(0,0,0,.24)` | `rgba(0,0,0,.5)` |
| 浮动兜底按钮 | `button-floating-fill` + `border-l3` | 底 `#ffffff`、字 `#0f1115` | 底 `#2c2c2e`、字 `#f9fafb` |
| 转圈 | `state-business-primary` | `#4176e6` | `#7aaaff` |

> v1.0.0 曾用 `--dsw-alias-brand-primary` 当主按钮底色：深色主题下它是近白色（`#f9fafb`），而文字写死 `#fff` —— 按钮上的字几乎看不见。现已改成 DSH 原装的 `button-primary-fill` + `label-primary-foreground` 配对。

## 配置

| 环境变量 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `DSH_RESTART_BUTTON_DRY_RUN=1` | 演练模式：助手只把将要终止的 PID 与重启命令行写进日志，**不真的杀进程**。也可以不设环境变量、临时用 `POST /restart-button/restart?dryRun=1` 演练一次 |

代码内常量（`host.js`）：`ROUTE_PREFIX = "/restart-button"`、`HELPER_DELAY_MS = 1500`。

## 自测

`GET /restart-button/status` 会打印主进程 PID 与 exe 路径，把它们喂给自测脚本（用 DSH 捆绑的 node，本机 `node` 不在 PATH 时）：

```powershell
& "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\node\bin\node.exe" `
  tools\self-test.mjs <mainPid> "C:\Users\22437\AppData\Local\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\DeepSeek Harness.exe"
```

它跑 8 项断言，整个过程不碰正在运行的应用：

1. 生成的助手源码里不含 `powershell` / `Start-Process` / `taskkill` / `cmd.exe`；
2. **用与插件完全相同的 WMI 方式**启动 wscript 助手；
3. 读日志断言 `helper started (wscript)` 与 `targets: <pids>`；
4. dry-run 走到 `dry run: would start: <exe>`；
5. 启动前后 `conhost` 进程数必须不变（证明没创建控制台宿主 —— 这正是 .vbs 助手的意义）；
6. 用 VBS 的 `Win32_Process.Create`（助手重启应用所用的同一个原语）创建进程写文件，断言成功。

实测输出（本机 8 个同 exe 进程）：

```
helper started (wscript) target=16852
targets: 5168, 16852, 19352, 3296, 18780, 20500, 15968, 9348
dry run: the application is left running
dry run: would start: C:\...\DeepSeek Harness\DeepSeek Harness.exe
conhost before=5 after=5
launchapp returned 19868
```

配色自测：`tools/theme-preview.html` 把 DSH 两套 token 值内联进去、复用 `client.js` 的 CSS 渲染浅/深两版弹窗，用无头 Edge 截图即得 `assets/theme-preview.png`：

```powershell
& "C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe" --headless=new --disable-gpu --hide-scrollbars `
  --force-device-scale-factor=2 --window-size=780,470 --screenshot=assets\theme-preview.png tools\theme-preview.html
```

## 兼容性与限制

- 仅 **Windows 桌面端**；`dsh web` 下 `capabilities()` 会返回 `available: false`（`reason: "not-supervised"`），client 半边退化为浮动按钮但点击会提示不可用。
- **不是优雅关闭**：按 exe 路径硬杀进程树，正在跑的任务会被中断（确认气泡里有提示）。
- 不修改 `app.asar`，桌面端更新后依然有效。
- 重启后窗口位置/会话由桌面端自己恢复；本插件不保存任何状态。

## License

MIT © wangbofan

---

`dsh-restart-button` adds a **Restart** button to the DSH desktop titlebar menu bar (Windows). The native「应用」dropdown is built inside the Electron main process and has no plugin extension point, and plugins run in the *Host child process* with no way to call `app.relaunch()`. So the Ho

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-vedar — Vedar (Kamchatka travel) MCP server for DeepSeek Harness

[中文](README.zh.md)

**Vedar** (vedarai.ru, Russian name Ведар) is the travel platform of the Kamchatka peninsula, Russia. Its public MCP server gives AI agents live tours and availability from local operators, the safety status of places and routes (volcanoes, earthquakes, weather warnings), weather, stays, gear rental, transfers and trip plans. No auth, rate-limited by IP.

This plugin does one thing: it registers one instance of the official bridge `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` in your DeepSeek Harness profile, pointed at `https://vedarai.ru/api/mcp`. After install the model calls the tools as `mcp__vedar__<tool>`.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:tourhabk-ui/dsh-vedar
```

`dsh plugin` forwards to pnpm, so pnpm must be on PATH (`npm i -g pnpm`); without it the command stops with "pnpm was not found".

Restart `dsh web`. The tools appear before the first turn.

No plugin? Put the same row into `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` (identical to `cordis.patch.yml` in this repository):

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: mcp-vedar
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: vedar
        transport: streamable-http
        url: https://vedarai.ru/api/mcp
```

Or add it by URL in a settings panel (`dsh-mcp-center`, `dsh-mcp-panel`, `dsh-mcp-connector`): type Streamable HTTP, URL `https://vedarai.ru/api/mcp`, auth none.

## Tools (20)

Read: `get_tours`, `get_tour_details`, `get_tour_availability`, `get_place_info`, `get_volcano_status`, `safety_status`, `get_guardian_context`, `get_weather`, `search_accommodations`, `search_gear`, `search_transfers`, `make_trip_plan`, `edit_trip_plan`, `get_request_status`, `search`, `fetch`.

Write, four requests confirmed by a human, no online payment: `create_lead`, `create_booking_request`, `create_stay_request`, `request_charter`.

Platform data is in Russian; tool arguments work best in Russian or English. Emergency number in Kamchatka: 112.

## Status

DeepSeek Harness is in developer preview and config fields may change. The row in this plugin follows the README of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 0.2.0-rc.2 (checked 2026-10-13). Verified end to end on 2026-10-14 with dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 and pnpm 10.28.0 (headless profile, GitHub Actions runner): the plugin installed with the command above, and DeepSeek answered a Chinese question about brown bears in August by calling 17 Vedar tools, all completed. Please report problems at [tourhabk-ui/pos](https://github.com/tourhabk-ui/pos/issues).

Русский: плагин DeepSeek Harness, который одной командой подключает MCP-сервер Ведара. Исходник живёт в `integrations/dsh-vedar/` репозитория платформы.

More: [vedarai.ru/mcp](https://vedarai.ru/mcp) · [vedarai.ru/zh](https://vedarai.ru/zh) · [llms.txt](https://vedarai.ru/llms.txt) · manifest [/.well-known/mcp.json](https://vedarai.ru/.well-known/mcp.json)

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
> **Release compatibility:** The current tested Host is official `0.2.0-rc.2`. SeekTTY `1.3.0` is paired with that Host. See the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md) for changes and installation, and the [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md) for exact package evidence.

SeekTTY

A terminal workspace for DeepSeek Harness.

Overview · Quick start · Clarify and Plan · Features · Compatibility

English · 中文

--- ## Overview Run `deepseek` from a project directory to use the native Agent, Session, model, permission, Settings, Profile, plugin, and persistence services of [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) in one terminal workspace. SeekTTY is the terminal surface; Harness remains the owner of runtime state. Models, Providers, Agent Presets, permissions, commands, tools, Settings, Skills, MCP servers, and marketplace sources are discovered from the running Harness. Capabilities added by upstream or third-party Bundles therefore appear without being hard-coded into SeekTTY. For requirements that still need definition, the optional [Clarify Host plugin](https://github.com/Hilbert-beinghappy/dsh-plugin-clarify) adds a guided `/clarify` workflow. It asks focused questions, updates a reviewable Draft after each answer, and returns the accepted Draft to the composer. Harness-native `/plan` can then turn the submitted requirement into an implementation plan. ## Development checkout Build and install a local SeekTTY package from the repository root: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm run build pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false ./seektty-1.3.0.tgz dsh --profile tui ``` Use the local tarball for source development and testing. For the released package, use the exact npm version below. ## Quick start Install the published SeekTTY release on its verified official DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 dsh --profile tui ``` These commands install the prebuilt Bundle through native `dsh plugin` reconciliation. The per-command pnpm option avoids the pnpm 11 Global Virtual Store layout that the Cordis loader in the currently tested dsh releases cannot reliably load. SeekTTY never changes global pnpm configuration. Clarify and Auxiliary Runtime are optional, not default dependencies; their historical joint acceptance is listed under [Compatibility](#compatibility-and-verification). The exact `seektty@1.3.0` npm package is documented in the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### Bare `deepseek` launcher After installing `dsh`, install the same SeekTTY release globally and pin Profile reconciliation to its exact npm version: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 export SEEKTTY_SPEC=seektty@1.3.0 deepseek ``` PowerShell uses the same exact npm spec: ```powershell pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false 'seektty@1.3.0' $env:SEEKTTY_SPEC='seektty@1.3.0' deepseek ``` `deepseek` requires `dsh` on `PATH`, or `DSH_BIN` pointing to its executable. Common launch forms include: ```sh deepseek "check this project" deepseek --cwd ../project deepseek --resume deepseek --resume deepseek --profile team-tui deepseek --version deepseek --update ``` `deepseek --update` is self-first: it checks SeekTTY before dsh, installs at most one compatible component per run, and never installs an untested gap or future Host. `DSH_BIN`, local installs, and `SEEKTTY_SPEC` overrides are left unchanged. Update failures do not block startup. Set `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=check` for a post-session notice or `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=0` to disable checks. SeekTTY `1.3.0` supports official dsh `0.2.0-rc.2` and brings more native workflows into the terminal. See the bilingual [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [complete PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### What's new in 1.3.0 - Access native Session actions, plans and artifacts, MCP resources, Team information, schedules, timed/continued questions, and account/model information from the terminal. - Browse Host workspace files with text/binary views and available file watching. Plugins can add terminal Session actions and guarded draft input activities with undo. - Install optional Creator, Browser, or Computer companion Bundles when you need them. With the official voice-input Bundle enabled, `/speech wav` provides reviewed WAV transcription; it does not record from the microphone. - Fix current-Host preset/forms/tool-result handling, stale targets, approval display, watcher cleanup, and bounded shutdown. Keep native Harness ownership and the existing terminal workflows. The release notes also fill gaps in the `1.2.6` summary: Agent Tree navigation, semantic transcript copying, target-specific context menus, Provider configuration, VS Code theme discovery, independent appearance controls, native scrollback, and long-session rendering fixes. Those features were already shipped; the [audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md) identifies their original PRs and versions. ## Interface | DeepSeek light | DeepSeek dark | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek light start screen](assets/seektty-tui.png) | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek dark start screen](assets/seektty-tui-dark.png) | | TypeScript in the light interface | Tools, file reads, and Diff in the dark interface | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY light TypeScript syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-light.png) | ![SeekTTY dark tool and Diff syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-dark.png) | Full mode uses a fixed alternate-screen viewport and keeps the composer and status at the bottom. Its mouse support browses history, selects text, and clicks existing controls inside SeekTTY. F3 or `/mouse native` switches while idle to terminal-native mode: SeekTTY leaves the alternate screen, writes the complete loaded conversation to ordinary terminal scrollback, disables mouse reporting, and lets the terminal or tmux own scrolling, search, and selection. Backfill is sequential and reports progress; Esc stops it without stopping the Session, while Ctrl+L refreshes only the active tail. `/transcript` opens transcript browsing and `/transcript replay` explicitly writes the available conversation again. Images use a textual attachment row in native mode. Already-written history is not recolored or reflowed by SeekTTY; the terminal owns that history. An empty session now opens with a responsive Fastfetch-style welcome page rather than sendable task suggestions. The default uses a packaged, original-color DeepSeek pixel whale plus runtime facts from the current Profile; it does **not** execute Fastfetch. The first-time API-key prompt remains higher priority and finishes before option

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: hold back goal auto-continuation while background subagents are still running (in-process disarm/resume guard), so a delegated turn does not burn <goal_round> injections while it waits for settlement.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-goal-guard

**后台子代理还在跑时，别让 goal 自动续跑被烧掉。**

DeepSeek Harness（DSH / Cordis）插件。在「派发后台 continuable 子代理 → 结束回合 → 等结算通知」
这种委托纪律下，`goal-round-driver` 会在母会话每次回到 idle 时注入一轮 `<goal_round>`——
它不知道还有未结算的子代理。本插件在等待窗口内**进程内**解除 goal 的自动续跑
（`goals.disarm`，不产生耐久事件、不改 phase/revision），全部子代理结算后自动恢复
（`goals.resume`）。

## 为什么需要它（这是核心缺口，不是某个插件的私有 workaround）

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-goal-round-driver` 的 `readyToDrive` 只检查

```js
return ctx.fiber.state === 2 && !state.stopping
  && ctx.agents.get(state.agent.id) === state.agent
  && state.agent.status === "idle"
  && !state.competingQueued
```

——**没有子代理维度**：该包不注入 `subagents`，`Config` 也只有 `defaultMaxGoalRounds`，
没有任何原生开关。而模型工具层的 `update_goal(pause/resume)` 要求「直接人类回合」，
模型自救不了。

远端实测（web profile，子代理运行期间）复现：

```
+ 66ms  agent/created   origin=subagent depth=1        ← 子代理诞生
+ 72ms  agent/status    running (子代理)
+209ms  <goal_round> round=1 注入                      ← ★ 子代理仍在跑，driver 照注入
+859ms  agent/error     QUOTA (子代理)
+943ms  user/message    sourceKind=subagent-settled     ← 结算通知
```

装上本插件后同一场景：**窗口内零注入**，且结算后 goal 自动回到 `armed`（见下方验收记录）。

## 行为

| 时机 | 动作 |
| --- | --- |
| 子代理诞生（`agent/created` 带 `origin='subagent'` + `parentSession`） | 母会话 goal 若 `active + armed` → **抢先 disarm**（母会话仍在 running，零竞态；覆盖 `subagent` / `subagent_fork` / `workflow` 等所有派发路径） |
| goal 被 arm 但已有子代理在跑（`goal/changed` 采纳） | 立即 disarm（堵住「先派子代理、后 arm goal」的窗口） |
| idle / 结算通知（`agent/status` idle、`subagent-settled`、`turn/end`） | 有 running 子代理 → 保持 disarm；无 running 子代理 → 自动 resume |
| `agent/error`、回合 `max-tokens` / `aborted` | **毒化**：不再自动 resume（不覆盖 harness 的熔断决定，交人类） |
| `agent/disposed`、`agent/session-start` | 整段窗口状态作废（新 epoch 不继承） |

### 安全不变量

`goals.resume` 在**服务层没有人类门**（人类门在 `dsh-tool-goal`），所以本插件只重新武装
**自己刚 disarm 过的、`id + revision` 完全一致、且仍为 `active + disarmed`** 的 goal。
goal 被清 / 被编辑 / complete / blocked / paused / 被第三方重新武装 → 一律清 mark 交人类，
绝不猜。「还有子代理在跑」用 `subagents.listDescendants(...)` 的 `activity === 'running'`
判定；**查询失败按「未知」处理，未知不构成 disarm 或 resume 的理由**。

## 安装

```bash
# 方式一：DSH 插件管理器（写入 profile 依赖 + bundle 装配）
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-goal-guard

# 方式二：dsh-super-injector（运行时注入，免重启）
dev_inject_plugin /path/to/dsh-goal-guard

# 方式三：作为 profile patch overlay 挂载
dsh web --patch ./cordis.patch.yml
```

`cordis.patch.yml` 把本插件插到 profile **根 roster**。挂载位置很重要：`dsh-scope` 的准入规则是

```js
const tag = scopeOf(ctx);
if (tag === void 0) return true;          // 未打标的监听器 → 全局准入
```

只有**未打标**的监听器才能收到根会话的 `agent/status`；被打标的 ctx 只收其作用域链后代的事件。

## 配置

```yaml
# profile patch / 插件 config
- id: dsh-goal-guard
  config:
    enabled: true              # 总开关；关闭即退回原生行为
    statusRoute: true          # 注册 /dsh-goal-guard/api/status
    tool: true                 # 注册 goal_guard 工具
    watchdogIntervalMs: 30000  # 看门狗周期；0 = 关闭
    maxWindowMs: 1800000       # 窗口超时告警阈值
```

## 观测

- `GET /dsh-goal-guard/api/status` → `{ ok, loggerPresent, guarded, tracked, states, diag }`
- 工具 `goal_guard`：`action=status` 看守卫状态；`action=resume` 立即重新评估并尝试恢复
  （模型自查「为什么 goal 没继续」用）
- 告警走 `ctx.logger.warn` **并额外落 `console.warn`**：某些宿主不把插件 logger 输出落到
  可见位置，而「resume 失败 / 窗口卡住」是本功能唯一的人工可见面，不能丢

## 兼容性

| 项 | 值 |
| --- | --- |
| `dsh.engines.dsh` | `>=0.1.7-rc.1 <0.2` |
| peer | `@deepseek-ai/cordis`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`、`@deepseek-ai/schemastery` |
| 必需服务 | 无（`goals` / `agents` / `subagents` / `tools` / `webServer` 全部可选且惰性解析） |

## 验收记录（2026-10-15，远端测试环境）

被测形态 = 真实部署形态：插件放进 `profiles/node_modules/`，按**包名**由 profile 根 roster 挂载；
验收夹具另挂一个探针插件造激励（自建 root agent → 派 continuable 子代理 → arm goal），
不依赖 LLM 成功（远端凭证余额不足，回合以 QUOTA 失败，但生命周期事件齐全）。

| 场景 | 窗口内 `<goal_round>` 注入 | disarm 时点 | 结算后 resume | 判定 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **基线**（无插件，探针实测） | **1** | — | — | 病根复现 |
| `adopt`（先派子代理 → 再 arm goal） | **0** | arm 后 **+15ms** | ✅ `armed` | **PASS** |
| `proactive`（先 arm goal → 立刻派子代理） | **0** | 子代理 `agent/created` 时（早于 spawn 时间戳） | ✅ `armed` | **PASS** |

对照数字：driver 从 `goal/changed` 到排队轮次约 **178ms**（内部有 `await sessions.flush()` 检查点），
守卫 disarm 在 **15ms** 内完成 → 赢约 160ms。`/api/status` 实测 HTTP 200，
diag `spawned:1 / windowDisarms:1 / resumes:1 / resumeFails:0 / watchdogTicks:2`。

复现（夹具在 `test/remote/`）：

```bash
# 远端：<DSH_HOME> 指向测试 home，dsh 用部署树里的 bin
scp -r lib package.json <remote>:<profile>/node_modules/dsh-goal-guard/
scp test/remote/goal-guard-accept.mjs test/remote/patch.yml <remote>:/root/test-env/
ssh <remote> 'cd /root/test-env && GG_ACCEPT_MODE=adopt dsh web --patch /root/test-env/patch.yml --port 3099 --no-open'
# 报告：/root/test-env/accept-out/report.json（看 verdict.pass）
```

## 开发

```bash
bash scripts/build.sh        # src/ → lib/（从部署树链类型依赖，用全局 tsc）
npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
npm test                     # node --test（先 build 再 test，测的是 lib/ 产物）
```

**本仓库不 `npm install`**：`scripts/build.sh` 从 `~/.dsh/profiles/node_modules` 或
`/usr/lib/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/node_modules` 探测一份 DSH 依赖树，把
`@deepseek-ai/*` 软链进本地 `node_modules` 后用系统 `tsc` 编译。`lib/` 是产物但**入库**
（`files` 含 `lib`），这样 `dsh plugin add` / git 直装不需要构建步骤。

## 两个踩过的坑（都来自真实部署，别重犯）

1. **不要 `import 'schemastery'`**。部署树里没有顶层 `schemastery` 包，只有
   `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`（官方包与已发布第三方插件一律 import 这个 scoped 名）。
   用顶层名会「本地构建通过、真机 `failed to import`」——本插件第一版就是这样在远端被拒的。
   同理：不要靠 build 时生成的 `node_modules/<name>` 软链在运行期解析裸名。
2. **服务句柄必须惰性取**。实测 headless profile 在 `apply()` 时
   `goals`/`agents`/`subagents`/`tools` **全部尚未就绪**（到 `agent/created` 才齐）；
   装配期抓死句柄会直接坏掉。本插件的 `inject` 因此留空。

## License

BSD-3-Clause

# dsh-balance-usage DeepSeek Harness 插件：在侧边栏**左下角**用**绿色**显示 DeepSeek 账户余额与**当前峰谷时段** （空闲 / 忙碌），点击展开账户余额、峰谷切换倒计时、忙碌时段时间表与近期用量统计； 并在输入框下方与每一轮的用量旁边，按**官方高峰 / 空闲价**估算**每个会话**与**每一轮**的花费。 只依赖 DSH 官方账号服务与本地会话日志，不接入任何第三方服务。
English overview A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that adds cost awareness to the Web UI. It shows the DeepSeek account balance and the current peak / off-peak phase in the sidebar, and estimates per-session and per-turn cost using the official peak and off-peak rates. The balance comes from DSH's own account service and the cost is estimated from local session logs — it talks to no third-party service. - **Sidebar footer (bottom-left)** — the account balance in green when healthy, plus a coloured dot and a label stating whether it is currently **off-peak** or **peak** (peak = twice the off-peak price). Clicking opens a panel with the balance, the current pricing window with a live countdown to the next switch, the peak-hours timetable, and recent usage (today / last 7 days / last N days, a 14-day chart, and a per-model table). - **Composer dock** — an inline `本会话消耗 ≈¥x` pill next to DSH's own session usage line. Clicking expands an anchored panel **upwards** (a `position: fixed` portal, so the row never grows). - **Per-turn actions row** — an inline `本轮花费 ≈¥x` trigger rendered in the same row as DSH's built-in `本轮用量` trigger, using flex `order` to sit to its right. Pricing follows the official rules: peak is **Mon–Fri 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 Beijing time**; weekends and Chinese public holidays are off-peak all day. Un-cached input, cache reads, cache writes and output are priced separately, using the token fields DSH records per request. Everything is local: the client talks to the host half over one read-only loopback route (`/dsh-balance-usage/summary` and `/dsh-balance-usage/session`). Credentials are never touched by the plugin — the balance comes from DSH's account service, or from a `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` only when the official account is not signed in. `npm test` runs `test/verify.mjs`, a dependency-free offline end-to-end verifier (176 assertions) that drives the real host route handler with fake services and renders the client half through a minimal React compatibility layer. The rest of this document is in Chinese.
--- ## 功能 ### 1. 左下角余额条目（绿色） - 侧边栏展开时：钱包图标 + `余额` + 金额胶囊 + 时段圆点 + 时段文字。 - 侧边栏收起（56px 轨道）时：紧凑显示 `¥12.34`，圆点颜色依旧表示峰谷。 - 金额按余额状态着色： - **充足 → 绿色**（`--dsw-alias-state-success-primary`） - 偏低 → 琥珀色（低于 `lowBalanceThreshold`，默认 10） - 为 0 → 红色 - 时段圆点：**绿色 = 空闲时段**，**琥珀色 = 忙碌时段**。 - 悬停提示会同时给出余额、当前时段与「距切换还有多久」。 ### 2. 点击展开的浮层面板 | 区块 | 内容 | |---|---| | 账户余额 | 总额（大字、按状态着色，**点击直接跳官方账号页**）、充值 / 赠送拆分、余额来源；「官方账号」与「充值」分别打开官方用量页 / 充值页 | | 当前计价时段 | 空闲 / 忙碌胶囊、当前北京时间、**距下一次切换的实时倒计时**与切换时刻 | | 忙碌时段（高峰计价） | 明确列出 **周一至周五 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00（北京时间）**，并说明高峰价 = 空闲价 × 2、周末与法定节假日全天按空闲计价 | | 近期用量 | 今日 / 近 7 天 / 近 N 天的 Token、估算费用、请求次数；近 14 天每日 Token 柱状图；按模型拆分表 | - **竖条悬停看详情**：鼠标移到每日柱状图上会弹出明细浮层 —— 日期、合计 Token、输入 / 输出、 缓存命中、请求次数、高峰 / 空闲拆分，以及当天的**花费**。 - Token 一律用 **K / M** 表示（不换算成 B），大小量级之间可以直接比较。 - 面板 **560px 宽**，高度贴合可用窗口（最多占满视口高度减去 32px），内容超出时面板内部滚动。 - 面板通过 `react-dom` 的 portal 渲染到 `document.body`，用 `position: fixed` 贴住左下角条目向上展开， 因此不受侧边栏 `overflow` 与过渡动画的裁剪影响。 - 点击面板外部或按 `Esc` 关闭；点「刷新」、**右键余额条目**、或窗口重新获得焦点都会立即刷新。 - **自动刷新间隔可调**：面板底部有下拉框（关闭 / 15 秒 / 1 分钟 / 2 分钟 / 5 分钟 / 15 分钟）， 改动立即生效并存进 `localStorage`（键名 `dsh-balance-usage.prefs`）。默认值来自 Host 的 `config.refreshSeconds`（出厂 60 秒）。 - **外观可切换**：面板底部的「外观」分三档 —— **默认**（跟随应用主题）/ **深色** / **浅色**， 选择也存进 `dsh-balance-usage.prefs`，两个浮层（左下角面板、底部与每轮的花费浮层）一起生效。 深色 / 浅色不是另画一套配色，而是在浮层根元素上**覆盖官方主题 token** （`--dsw-alias-bg-overlay`、`--dsw-alias-label-*`、`--dsw-alias-border-*` 等）， 浮层里所有既有规则整体跟随，不会出现「不深不浅」的半吊子配色。 - **不会让你白等一个刷新周期**：刚打开 Harness 时 Host 路由可能刚注册、当前会话也可能还没有用量， 这时每 3 秒重试一次直到拿到数据（拿到后交回常规刷新间隔）；页面重新可见或窗口重新获得焦点时 也会立刻刷新。Host 侧也**不再缓存失败结果**，避免客户端在 TTL 内一直拿不到数据。 ### 3. 对话下方：本会话花费 注册进 `conversation.composer.dock`（输入框下方那一栏）： ``` 🎛 本会话消耗 ≈ ¥5.67 ← 胶囊是 inline-flex，和官方那行用量统计并排同一行 ``` 点一下**向上**弹出明细浮层： ``` ┌───────────────────────────────┐ │ 🎛 本会话金额 ≈ ¥5.67 │ │ ───────────────────────────── │ │ 高峰花费 ≈ ¥1.20 │ │ 空闲花费 ≈ ¥4.47 │ │ 请求次数 128 次 │ │ 缓存命中率 99.4% │ │ 模型 deepseek-flash │ │ │ │ 本地按官方价表估算，非官方账单。│ └───────────────────────────────┘ ``` 关键是**展开不会改变那一栏的高度**（早期版本就是在这一点上做错了）： - 胶囊外层 `display:inline-flex`，与官方那行用量统计**并排**，不另起一行； - 展开的浮层是 **portal 到 `document.body` 的 `position: fixed` 元素**，用官方基元 `primitives.useAnchoredPosition({ side: "top", gap: 6, margin: 8 })` 锚在胶囊上沿并**向上**展开 —— 浮层完全脱离文档流，展开 / 收起时那一栏高度一个像素都不变； - 关闭走官方基元 `primitives.useDismissOnOutsidePointer`，另加 `Esc`； - 两个官方基元缺失时都有降级实现（自己按 `bottom` 定位 + 自己监听外部点击），功能不受影响； - 官方界面已经显示 Token 用量，所以这里**只谈钱**：胶囊显示金额，浮层显示花费拆分与请求数， 不再重复 `未缓存输入 / 缓存读取 / 输出` 那些数字； - 没有可统计用量时**整条不渲染**（不留占位、不留空行）。 数据来自 Host 的 `/dsh-balance-usage/session?sessionId=…`（按会话统计整个对话，不按时间窗口截断， 带 15 秒缓存），随自动刷新间隔一起更新。 ### 4. 每一轮：本轮花费 挂在 `conversation.chat.assistant-actions` —— 也就是**官方「本轮用量」所在的那一行**。 DSH 内部把该槽位的内容当作 `extraActions` 传给 `MessageIconActions`，而官方的 「本轮用量」正是同一个组件的 `usageAction`： ```jsx } // 官方「本轮用量 11.14M tok」 /> ``` `extraActions` 在 `usageAction` **之前**渲染，而 `.actions` 是 flex 容器， 所以本插件用 `order: 1` 把自己排到所有默认 `order: 0` 的兄弟之后，落到行尾： ``` … ⧉ ⑂ | 本轮用量 11.14M tok 12:34 | 🎛 本轮花费 ≈¥0.46 ↑ 本插件（order:1 排到最后） ``` - 触发器尺寸对齐官方 `TurnUsagePanel` 的触发器：`inline-flex`、高 `calc(28px + var(--dsh-content-font-delta,0px))`、`border-radius:var(--dsw-radius-sm)`， hover / 展开时用 `--dsw-alias-interactive-bg-hover` —— 和官方那个触发器是同一套控件； - 图标用官方的 **`IconGaugeOutlineRegular`**（仪表盘 = 计量 / 消耗）。 官方「本轮用量」用的是 `IconDatabaseOutlineRegular`，所以花费这边刻意不复用它； - 点击用**和官方完全相同的交互**向上弹出明细浮层（portal 到 body + `position: fixed` + `useAnchoredPosition({ side: "top" })`）：标题「本轮金额」+ 高峰花费 / 空闲花费 / 请求次数 / 模型； - 该槽位只提供 `messageId`，所以 Host 会把每一轮包含哪些 assistant 消息 id 一起返回， 客户端按 `messageId → 轮次 → 花费` 反查； - **没有该轮数据时返回 `null`**（该 slot 的契约明确允许「无内容的条目返回 null」）， 不会留空位、不会多出空白。 ### 5. 空闲 / 忙碌时段的官方口径 依据 DeepSeek 官方定价文档： > Off-peak rates are half of the peak rates. **Peak hours are 01:00 - 04:00 and 06:00 - 10:00 UTC, > Monday through Friday, excluding Chinese public holidays.** All other hours are off-peak, > including weekends and Chinese public holidays in full. > > —— 换算为北京时间（UTC+8）即： | | 时间 | |---|---| | **忙碌（高峰计价）** | 周一至周五 **09:00–12:00**、**14:00–18:00** | | **空闲（低谷计价）** | 工作日其余时间、**周六周日全天**、**中国法定节假日全天** | 内置了 `2026` 年法定节假日表（依据[国务院办公厅 2025-11-04 通知](https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/content/202511/content_7047090.htm)）， 可用 `holidays` 配置项整体覆盖。 峰谷归属按**请求发起时刻**（`step/start` 事件时间）判定，取不到时回退到消息完成时刻。 官方未公开跨时段请求按发起还是按完成计费，这是合理近似；实测请求耗时在秒级，边界影响极小。 ### 6. 价格表（空闲时段价，元 / 百万 tokens） | 模型 | 输入（缓存未命中） | 输入（缓存命中） | 输出 | |---|---|---|---| | `deepseek-flash` | 1 | 0.02 | 4 | | `deepseek-v4-pro` | 4.5 | 0.15 | 13.5 | | `deepseek-chat`（旧） | 2 | 0.5 | 3 | | `deepseek-reasoner`（旧） | 4 | 1 | 16 | 高峰时段按 ×2 计。模型名做了归一化：含 `pro` → v4-pro，含 `flash` → flash， 因此 `deepseek-flash` 与旧名 `deepseek-v4-flash` 走同一套价。 > **计费口径**：DSH 的 `TokenUsage.inputTokens` 是**未缓存输入**，不含缓存命中的部分 —— > 实测 `inputTokens + cacheReadTokens + cacheWriteTokens + outputTokens === totalTokens`， > 正好和官方价表的「INPUT (CACHE MISS)」/「INPUT (CACHE HIT)」两栏一一对应。 > 所以未缓存输入按 input 价、缓存读取按 cacheRead 价分别计价（早期版本曾把缓存读取从输入里 > 再减一次，导致未缓存输入被算成 0、费用偏低，已修正）。 --- ## 安装 本插件是一个标准的 DSH bundle 包（`package.json` 里带 `dsh.bundle.patch` 与 `dsh.client`）， 安装后由 profile 的 bundle 栈自动挂载，无需手改 `cordis.patch.yml`。 ### 已验证的安装方式（本地 link） ```powershell cd $env:DSH_PROFILE_DIR # 通常是 C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\profiles\desktop pnpm add "link:C:\Users\<你>\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\dsh-balance-usage" ``` 然后把 `dsh-balance-usage` 加进该 profile `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组： ```json { "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles":
